3/4 Sit-Up.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let jayein aur apne paon ko kisi cheez ke neeche phansa lein. Aap ki taangein ghutnon se mudi honi chahiye.
Apne haath sar ke peeche ya sar ki side par rakhein. Shuru mein aap ki kamar zameen par hogi. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhon aur reerh ki haddi ko mod kar apna dhad ghutnon ki taraf uthayein.
Contraction ke top par aap ka dhad zameen ke amoodi (perpendicular) hona chahiye. Harkat ko ulta karein, aur sirf 3/4 tak neeche jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

90/90 Hamstring.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein, ek taang seedhi phaila kar rakhein.
Doosri taang ke kulhe aur ghutne ko 90 degree tak moden. Zaroorat ho to apni taang ko haathon se sahara de sakte hain. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taang ko seedha hawa mein phailayein, upar thori der rukein. Taang ko wapas shuruati position mein le aayein.
10-20 reps karein, phir doosri taang se karein.

Ab Crunch Machine.instructions_ur:
Halka wazan chunein aur ab machine par baith jayein, apne paon diye gaye pads ke neeche rakhein aur upar wale handles pakad lein. Aap ke baazu 90 degree ke zaviye par mude hone chahiye aur triceps diye gaye pads par tike hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saath hi saath taangein upar uthana shuru karein aur apne dhad ka upar wala hissa crunch karein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Harkat aahista aur control mein karein. Wazan ko hilane ke liye abs par tawajjo dein aur taangon aur paon ko dheela rakhein.
Ek second rukne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Ab Roller.instructions_ur:
Ab Roller ko dono haathon se pakdein aur farsh par ghutno ke bal baith jayein.
Ab ab roller ko apne saamne farsh par rakhein taake aap haathon aur ghutnon ke bal hon (jaise ghutno ke bal push up ki position). Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab roller ko aahista aahista seedha aage ki taraf rol karein, apne jism ko khinch kar seedhi position mein le aayein. Tip: Jitna neeche ja sakte hain jayein lekin jism farsh ko na chhooe. Harkat ke is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Khinchi hui position mein ruk kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue apne aap ko wapas shuruati position mein khinchna shuru karein. Tip: Aahista chalein aur har waqt abs ko tight rakhein.

Ab Wheel.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position: Farsh par ghutno ke bal baith jayein aur ab wheel apne saamne rakhein.
Wheel pakrein: Handles ko mazbooti se pakrein.
Roll out: Aahista aahista wheel ko aage ki taraf roll karein, core tight rakhte hue apna jism phailayein.
Wapsi: Core mein tension barqarar rakhte hue wheel ko wapas ghutnon ki taraf kheenchein.

Ab Wheel Rollout.instructions_ur: Bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Adductor.instructions_ur:
Ulte let jayein aur ek taang foam roller par rakhein.
Taang ko is tarah ghumayein ke foam roller aap ki andar wali raan ko chhoo raha ho. Jitna bardasht ho sake utna wazan foam roller par daalein.
Andar wali raan ke muscles ko dheela chhorne ki koshish karte hue, kulhe aur ghutne ke darmiyan foam par roll karein, aur tension wale points par 10-30 second ruke rahein. Doosri taang ke saath dohrayein.

Adductor/Groin.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein aur paon chhat ki taraf utha lein.
Apne partner se apne paon ya takhne pakarwayein. Taangon ko jitna ho sake bahar ki taraf khol lein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
10 ya us se zyada seconds tak taangon ko aapas mein milane ki koshish karein, jabke aap ka partner aap ko aisa karne se rokay.
Ab taangon ke muscles ko dheela chhor dein jabke aap ka partner aap ke paon ko alag kare, utna stretch karein jitna aap ke liye aaram deh ho. Partner ko zaroor batayein ke stretch kaafi ho gaya hai taake zyada stretch ya chot se bacha ja sake.

Advanced Kettlebell Windmill.instructions_ur:
Ek baazu se kettlebell ko clean kar ke sar ke upar press karein.
Kettlebell ko har waqt lock out rakhte hue, apne kulhe us taraf bahar dhakelein jis taraf kettlebell lock out hai. Jo baazu kaam nahi kar raha use kamar ke peeche rakhein aur paon ko kettlebell wale baazu se paintalees degree ke angle par bahar ki taraf moorein.
Jitna ho sake neeche jayein.
Ek second rukein aur harkat ulti kar ke wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Air Bike.instructions_ur:
Farsh par seedhe let jayein aur kamar ka nichla hissa zameen se laga kar rakhein. Is exercise ke liye haath sar ke dono taraf rakhne honge. Lekin dhyan rakhein ke karte waqt gardan par zor na dalein. Ab kandhon ko utha kar crunch position mein aa jayein.
Ghutnon ko itna upar layein ke woh farsh ke perpendicular hon, aur taangon ka nichla hissa farsh ke parallel ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ab ek saath, aahista aahista cycle chalane jaisi harkat karein: daayin taang aage ki taraf seedhi karein aur baayin taang ka ghutna andar layein. Side par crunch karte hue daayin kohni ko baayein ghutne ke qareeb layein, aur saath hi saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Taangon se cycle chalate hue doosri taraf crunch karein, baayin kohni ko daayein ghutne ke qareeb layein aur saans bahar nikaalein.
Isi tarah baari baari karte rahein jab tak har side ke liye jitne reps tay kiye hain woh poore na ho jayein.

All Fours Quad Stretch.instructions_ur:
Haathon aur ghutno ke bal shuru karein, phir ek taang zameen se uthayein aur paon ko haath se pakar lein.
Haath se paon ya takhna pakrein, ghutne ko poori tarah mora hua rakhein, aur quadriceps aur hip flexors ko stretch karein.
Kulhon ko seedha karne par dhyan dein, unhein zameen ki taraf dhakelein. 10-20 seconds tak rukein aur phir side badal lein.

Alternate Hammer Curl.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare ho jayein, dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakar kar baazu poori tarah neeche latka kar rakhein. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb honi chahiyein.
Hatheliyan dhad ki taraf honi chahiyein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baazu ka upar wala hissa hilaye baghair, saans bahar nikaalte hue aur biceps ko tight karte hue daayein haath ka weight aage ki taraf curl karein. Harkat jaari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah tight na ho jayein aur dumbbells kandhon ki oonchai tak na aa jayein. Biceps ko dabate hue is position ko ek second rokein. Tip: Sirf forearms hilne chahiyein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbells ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Yehi harkat baayein haath se dohrayein. Yeh ek rep hua.
Isi tarah baari baari karte rahein, jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa.

Alternate Heel Touchers.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let jayein, ghutne mor lein aur paon farsh par lagbhag 18-24 inch ke faasle par rakhein. Aap ke baazu side par seedhe phaile hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad ko aage aur oopar lagbhag 3-4 inch right side ki taraf crunch karein aur right heel (aedi) ko chhuein, aur ek second ke liye contraction rok kar rakhein. Yeh harkat karte waqt saans bahar nikaalein.
Ab saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Ab dhad ko aage aur oopar lagbhag 3-4 inch left side ki taraf crunch karein aur left heel ko chhuein, aur ek second ke liye contraction rok kar rakhein. Yeh harkat karte waqt saans bahar nikaalein aur phir saans andar lete hue shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. Jab dono heels chhu li jayein, to yeh 1 rep shumaar hoga.
Isi tarah baari baari sides badalte rahein jab tak tamam tay shuda reps poore na ho jayein.

Alternate Incline Dumbbell Curl.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakar kar incline bench par baith jayein, baazu poori tarah neeche latke hon. Tip: Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baazu ka upar wala hissa hilaye baghair, saans bahar nikaalte hue aur biceps ko tight karte hue daayein haath ka weight aage curl karein. Saath hi haath ko is tarah ghumayein ke hatheli upar ki taraf ho jaye. Harkat jaari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah tight na ho jayein aur dumbbells kandhon ki oonchai tak na aa jayein. Biceps ko dabate hue is position ko ek second rokein. Tip: Sirf forearms hilne chahiyein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Yehi harkat baayein haath se dohrayein. Yeh ek rep hua.
Isi tarah baari baari karte rahein, jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa.

Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound.name_ur: Baari baari taang se Diagonal Bound
Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound.instructions_ur:
Aaram deh stance mein khare ho jayein, ek paon doosre se thoda aage ho.
Aagli taang se zor laga kar dhakka dein, mukhalif ghutne ko aage aur jitna ho sake upar le jayein, phir zameen par utrein. Har bound ke saath har side par jitna zyada faasla tay kar sakein karne ki koshish karein.
Side se side faasla naapne ke liye zameen par ek line istemal karna madadgar ho sakta hai.
Doosri taang se yeh sequence dohrayein.

Alternating Bicep Curls.instructions_ur:
Do dumbbells pakrein, baazu seedhe hon, haath aap ki
side par hon aur hatheliyan andar ki taraf hon. Ek waqt mein ek baazu moorein aur weight ko
tezi se upar layein. Saath hi, harkat ke bilkul shuru mein baazuon ko 90 degrees
ghumayein. Sab se oonchi jagah par weights ko thoda aur
bahar ki taraf ghumayein. Ruke baghair baazu ko aahista aahista wapas neeche layein, aur doosre baazu se bhi yehi karein.
Exercise ke dauran jism ko jhoolne na dein, saara kaam
biceps karte hain, aur sirf yehi muscles hilne chahiyein (kohniyon par
khaas dhyan dein).

Alternating Cable Shoulder Press.instructions_ur:
Cables ko tower ke neeche le jayein aur munasib weight chunein.
Cables pakrein aur unhein kandhon ki unchai par rakhein, hatheliyan aage ki taraf. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Sar aur seena upar rakhte hue, kohni ko seedha karte hue ek taraf ko seedha sar ke upar press karein.
Upar ruk kar, wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein aur doosri taraf dohrayein.

Alternating Deltoid Raise.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar dono haathon mein dumbbells apni side par pakrein.
Kohniyan halki si mori rakhte hue weights ko seedha apne saamne kandhon ki unchai tak uthayein, jhoolne ya cheating se bachein.
Weights ko wapas apni side par le aayein.
Agle rep par weights ko side ki taraf uthayein, yani bahar ki taraf kandhon ki unchai tak.
Weights ko shuruati position mein wapas layein aur baari baari saamne aur side ki taraf karte rahein.

Alternating Floor Press.instructions_ur:
Zameen par let jayein aur do kettlebells apne kandhon ke paas rakhein.
Pehle ek ko seene par jagah par layein aur phir doosri ko, kettlebells ko handle se pakrein aur hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon.
Dono baazu seedhe karein taake kettlebells seene ke upar hon. Ek kettlebell neeche layein, use seene tak layein aur kalai ko lock out kettlebell ki taraf ghumayein.
Kettlebell ko upar uthayein aur doosri taraf dohrayein.

Alternating Hang Clean.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells apne paon ke darmiyan rakhein. Shuruati position mein aane ke liye apne kulhe peeche dhakelein aur seedha saamne dekhein.
Ek kettlebell ko clean karke kandhe tak layein aur doosri kettlebell ko latakti position mein pakde rakhein. Kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karne ke liye taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karein aur kettlebell ko kandhon ki taraf khinchein. Aisa karte hue apni kalai ghumayein.
Clean ki hui kettlebell ko latakti position mein neeche layein aur doosri kettlebell ko clean karein. Dohrayein.

Alternating Kettlebell Press.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells ko clean kar ke kandhon tak layein. Kettlebells ko kandhon ki taraf kheenchte hue taangon aur kulhon ko seedha kar ke unhein kandhon tak clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalaiyan ghumayein.
Kohni seedhi karte hue ek kettlebell ko seedha sar ke upar press karein, aur use is tarah ghumayein ke hatheli saamne ki taraf ho jaye, jabke doosri kettlebell ko saakit rakhein.
Press ki hui kettlebell ko shuruati position tak neeche layein aur foran doosre baazu se press karein.

Alternating Kettlebell Row.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells apne paon ke saamne rakhein. Ghutne thore se moorein aur kulhe jitna ho sake peeche nikaalein. Shuruati position mein aane ke liye jhukte hue dono kettlebells ko handles se pakar lein.
Ek kettlebell ko zameen se khinchein jabke doosri ko pakre rakhein. Kaam karne wali side ka shoulder blade peeche khinchein, aur kohni morte hue kettlebell ko pait ya pasliyon ki taraf layein.
Kaam karne wale baazu ki kettlebell neeche layein aur doosre baazu se dohrayein.

Alternating Renegade Row.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells farsh par kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein. Apne paon ki ungliyon aur haathon par aise position lein jaise pushup kar rahe hon, jism seedha aur phaila hua ho. Upper body ko sahara dene ke liye kettlebells ke handles istemal karein. Sahare ke liye shayad aapko paon chaure rakhne paren.
Ek kettlebell ko farsh mein dabayein aur doosre kettlebell ka row karein, kaam karne wali side ki shoulder blade ko peeche kheenchte hue kohni moden aur use apni side tak kheenchein.
Phir kettlebell ko farsh par neeche layein aur doosre haath se kettlebell shuru karein. Kai reps tak dohrayein.

Ankle Circles.instructions_ur:
Sahara lene ke liye koi mazboot cheez pakrein, jaise squat rack.
Daayin taang hawa mein uthayein (farsh se taqreeban 2 inch upar) aur paon ke angoothe se gol daira banayein. Yun samjhein ke aap angoothe se ek bara daira bana rahe hain. Tip: Ek daira 1 rep ke barabar hai. Harkat karte waqt normal saans lete rahein.
Daayein paon se faarigh ho kar, yehi baayin taang se dohrayein.

Ankle Dorsiflexion Rocks.instructions_ur: Edi zameen par rakhte hue apna ghutna aage le jayein. Is position ko kuch second ke liye rokein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Ankle On The Knee.instructions_ur:
Let kar, apne ghutne mod lein aur paon farsh par rakhein.
Ek paon ka takhna mukhalif ghutne par rakhein.
Neeche wali taang ki raan ya ghutna pakdein aur dono taangon ko seene ki taraf khinchein. Gardan aur kandhon ko dheela rakhein. 10-20 second tak rokein aur phir side badlein.

Ankle Roll.instructions_ur:
Farsh par baith jayein aur ek paon zameen se uthayein, misaal ke taur par us taang ko doosre ghutne par rakh kar.
Aahista aahista paon se daire banayein, sirf takhne se harkat karein. Dono taraf kai daire banayein, phir paon badal lein.

Anterior Tibialis-SMR.instructions_ur:
Zameen par baith kar shuru karein, taangein mudi hui aur paon farsh par hon.
Muscle Roller ya belan ki madad se pindli ki haddi ke bahar wale muscles par dabaav dalein. Ghutne ke bilkul neeche se takhne ke upar tak kaam karein, aur tension wali jagahon par 10-30 seconds ruken. Doosri taang par dohrayein.

Anti-Gravity Press.instructions_ur:
Incline bench ke sar wale hisse ke peeche zameen par ek bar rakhein.
Bench par pait ke bal let jayein. Pronated grip ke saath barbell ko zameen se uthayein. Kohniyan mor kar reverse curl karein aur bar ko seene ke qareeb le aayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Shuru karne ke liye, kohniyan seedhi karte hue barbell ko sar ke saamne bahar ki taraf press karein. Poori harkat ke dauran baazu zameen ke mutawazi rakhein.
Wapas shuruati position mein aayein aur set poora karne ke liye dohrayein.

Arabesque.instructions_ur: Apna saara wazan ek taang par daal dein aur isi position ko barqarar rakhein, poore waqt kulhe aur pelvis seedh mein rakhein. Kamar neutral position mein rakhte hue khud ko aage ki taraf jhukayein aur taang ko peeche oopar ki taraf uthayein, phir aahista aahista glutes ki madad se wapas neutral position mein aa jayein.

Arm Circles.instructions_ur:
Khare ho jayein aur baazu seedhe dono side par phaila dein. Baazu farsh ke parallel aur dhad ke perpendicular (90 degree angle) hone chahiyein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Aahista aahista har phaile hue baazu se taqreeban 1 foot qutar ke circles banana shuru karein. Harkat karte hue normal saans lete rahein.
Phaile hue baazuon ki gol harkat taqreeban das seconds tak jaari rakhein. Phir harkat ulti kar ke doosri simt mein karein.

Arnold Press.instructions_ur: dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Around The Worlds.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein, har haath mein ek dumbbell pakren aur hatheliyan chhat ki taraf hon. Tip: Aap ke baazu farsh ke mutawazi aur raanon ke saath hone chahiyein. Chot se bachne ke liye kohniyan thori si mudi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab dumbbells ko aadha daira banate hue shuruati position se sar ke upar tak le jayein. Saari harkat ke dauran baazu har waqt farsh ke mutawazi rehne chahiyein. Harkat ke is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Harkat ko ulta karte hue weight ko wapas shuruati position mein laayein aur saans bahar nikaalein.

Atlas Stone Trainer.instructions_ur:
Yeh trainer un logon ke liye Atlas Stone ki taaqat banane mein mufeed hai jin ke paas stones nahi hote, aur yeh aam tor par bar ke siron ya bhari pipe se banaye jate hain.
Pehle bar par pasand ka wazan load karein. Wazan ke dono taraf paon rakh kar khare hon, baazu us ke gird lapetein aur kulhon se jhukein.
Wazan ko ghutnon se upar kheenchein, kulhon ko seedha karte hue. Jab wazan ghutnon se upar aa jaye to use raanon par tika kar peeche baith sakte hain, aur use seene se mazbooti se chimta lein.
Kulhon aur ghutnon ko seedha karte hue wazan ko jitna ho sake upar utha kar harkat mukammal karein. Agle reps ke liye wazan ko wapas godi mein ya zameen par rakha ja sakta hai.

Atlas Stones.instructions_ur:
Atlas stone ko apne paon ke darmiyan rakh kar shuru karein. Kulhon se jhuk kar apne baazu Atlas Stone ke gird khare rukh mein lapetein, aur koshish karein ke ungliyan stone ke neeche chali jayein. Aksar stones ke neeche ek chhota sa hamwar hissa hota hai, jis se stone pakarna aasaan ho jata hai.
Stone ko apne dhad ki taraf kheenchte hue, paon ke pichle hisse se zor laga kar stone ko zameen se uthayein.
Jab stone ghutnon se guzar jaye, to peeche ki taraf baith kar use god mein le lein, yani stone ko raanon ke upar kheench lein.
Neeche baithe rahein, stone ko seene par ooncha le jayein aur grip badal kar haath stone ke upar se le jayein. Kulhon se zor laga kar khare ho jayein. Loading platform ke qareeb jayein, aur peeche jhuk kar kulhe seedhe karein taake stone jitna ho sake ooncha chala jaye.

Axe Hold.instructions_ur: Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein aur seedhe baazu side mein kandhon ki unchai tak uthayein. Is position ko jitni dair ho sake rokein.

Axle Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Bar ke paas is tarah aayein ke woh aap ke paon ke beech mein ho. Aap ke paon taqreeban kulhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Kulhon se jhuk kar bar ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakren, aur kandhe ki haddiyon ko aage aane dein. Aam tor par over/under grip istemal ki jati hai.
Paon aur grip set karne ke baad gehri saans lein, phir kulhe neeche karein aur ghutne moden yahan tak ke pindli ki haddi bar ko chhoo le. Sar se saamne dekhein, seena upar rakhein aur kamar mein kham rakhein, aur ediyon se zor lagate hue weight ko upar uthana shuru karein.
Jab bar ghutnon se guzar jaye, to bar ko zor se peeche khinchein, kandhe ki haddiyon ko aapas mein milate hue kulhon ko aage bar ki taraf dhakelein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar bar ko neeche laayein aur usay farsh tak le jayein.

Back Extension.instructions_ur: Bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Back Extension on Stability Ball.instructions_ur:
Stability Ball par pet ke bal let jayein, aur balance ke liye paon ki ungliyan farsh par mazbooti se jama kar rakhein.
Haath seene par cross kar ke ya kaanon ke paas rakh kar, seene ko ball se upar uthayein taake reerh ki haddi peeche ki taraf poori tarah khinch jaye (hyperextension).
Aahista aahista seena wapas ball par layein.
Dohrayein.

Back Flyes - With Bands.instructions_ur:
Exercise band ko kisi post ya machine ke gird seene ke darmiyani hisse ki oonchai par bandh dein.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, pet andar khencha ho aur ghutne halke se mude hon.
Post se itna peeche khare hon ke band mein khinchaav ho, band ko pakar kar baazu saamne seedhe phailayein aur kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakhein; yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Control ke saath baazu peeche layein jab tak woh aap ki side par parallel aur kandhon ki seedh mein na aa jayein.
Aahista aahista baazu wapas seene ke saamne shuruati position mein layein.
Dohrayein.

Backward Drag.instructions_ur:
Sled par apni marzi ka wazan load karein, aur sled ke saath rope ya straps lagayein jinhein aap pakar sakein.
Exercise shuru karne ke liye ek tay faasle tak peeche ki taraf chalein. Peeche jhuk kar, taangon ko seedha karte hue chhote qadam lein taake jitna tez ho sake chal sakein.

Backward Medicine Ball Throw.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise partner ke saath behtar hoti hai. Agar partner na ho to ball phenk kar khud utha sakte hain ya deewar par phenk sakte hain.
Apne partner se kuch meter aage khare ho kar shuru karein, dono ka rukh ek hi taraf ho. Ball ko apni taangon ke darmiyan pakar kar shuru karein.
Neeche squat karein aur phir zor se rukh badlein, poori tarah seedhe hon aur ball ko sar ke upar se partner ki taraf uchhal dein.
Aapka partner phir ball ko aap ki taraf wapas rol kar sakta hai. Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Balance Board.instructions_ur:
Balance board apne saamne rakhein.
Us par khare ho jayein aur apna balance banane ki koshish karein.
Jitni dair chahein balance qaim rakhein.

Ball Leg Curl.instructions_ur:
Farsh par kamar ke bal let kar shuru karein, paon ball ke upar rakhein.
Ball ko is tarah rakhein ke jab taangein seedhi hon to takhne ball ke upar hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe zameen se upar uthayein, weight kandhe ki haddiyon aur paon par rakhein.
Ghutne moden, ball ko jitna ho sake apne qareeb khinchein aur hamstrings ko sukerein.
Thora rukne ke baad wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Ball Wall Circles.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar seedhe khare ho jayein.
Swiss ball ko deewar ke saath seene ki oonchai par rakhein aur baayein haath se ball ko deewar par chhote chhote dairon mein ghumayein.
Baazu poora seedha rakhein, kohni mein halka sa kham ho.
Dairon ki simt ulat dein.
Baazu badal lein.

Band Assisted Pull-Up.instructions_ur:
Band ko pullup bar ke beech mein lapait kar baandh dein. Madad ki mukhtalif levels ke liye aap mukhtalif bands istemal kar sakte hain.
Band ka sira neeche khinchein aur ek mora hua ghutna loop mein rakhein, yaqeeni banayein ke woh phisal kar na nikle. Bar par medium se chauri grip lein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Lats ko sukerte hue aur kohni morte hue khud ko upar khinchein. Kohni ko apni side ki taraf le kar jayein. Saamne ki taraf khinchein aur thodi ko bar ke upar le jane ki koshish karein. Jhoolne ya jhatke wali harkaton se bachein.
Thora sa rukne ke baad wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Band Chest Press.instructions_ur: Resistance band ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Band Good Morning.instructions_ur:
41 inch band istemal karte hue uske ek sire par khare ho jayein, paon thore se khole rakhein. Kulhon se jhuk kar band ke doosre sire ko gardan ke peeche daal lein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taangein seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se seedhe hote hue taqreeban khari position mein aa jayein.
Wapas shuruati position mein neeche jate hue dhyan rakhein ke kamar gol na ho.

Band Good Morning (Pull Through).instructions_ur:
Band ko ek post ke gird lapait dein. Thora door khare ho kar doosra sira gardan ke gird daal lein. Aap ke haath band ko jagah par rakhne mein madad kar sakte hain.
Kulhon se jhukna shuru karein, kulhe jitna ho sake peeche le jayein. Kamar seedhi rakhein aur takreeban 90 degree tak aage jhukein. Ghutne sirf thore se mude hone chahiye.
Kulhon ko aage dhakelte hue wapas khari position mein aa kar shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Band Hip Adductions.instructions_ur:
Ek band ko kisi mazboot khambe ya kisi aur cheez ke gird baandh dein.
Baayin side khambe ki taraf kar ke khare hon, aur daayan paon band mein daal kar band ko takhne ke gird le ayein.
Seedhe khare ho jayein aur zaroorat ho to khamba pakar lein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutna seedha rakhte hue, daayin taang ko jitna ho sake side par bahar uthayein.
Wapas shuruati position mein aayein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Side badal lein.

Band Pull-Apart.instructions_ur: resistance band ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Band Row.instructions_ur: resistance band ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Band Skull Crusher.instructions_ur:
Band ko rack ke base ya bench se mazbooti se baandh dein. Bench par is tarah let jayein ke band aap ke sar ki seedh mein ho.
Band pakdein, apni kohniyan uthayein taake upar wala baazu farsh ke amoodi ho. Kohni mudi hui ho to band aap ke sar ke upar hona chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni se baazu seedha karein, upar wale baazu ko apni jagah par rakhein. Harkat ke top par rukein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Band Squat.instructions_ur: Resistance band ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Band Terminal Knee extension.instructions_ur: Yeh ghutne ke extensors ke liye end range mazbooti ki exercise hai. Ek ghutne ke peeche band ka loop daal kar shuru karein aur doosra sira apne saamne kisi mazboot cheez se baandh dein. Split stance mein khare hon, band wala ghutna moda hua aur aage wali taang ke taur par rakha ho. Band ki resistance ke khilaf kheenchne ke liye ghutna seedha karein aur chhorne se pehle quads mein 5 seconds tak contraction barqarar rakhein.

Banded Ankle Mobility.instructions_ur:
Resistance band ko apne peeche neeche ki taraf baandh dein, maslan rack ke bottom par, aur use apne takhne ke saamne, paon se zara upar loop karein.
Half-kneeling position mein aa jayein, band wala paon aage ho, taake band aapke takhne ko peeche ki taraf kheenche.
Aedi farsh par rakhte hue ghutne ko paon ki ungliyon ke upar se aage dhakelein, phir control ke saath wapas aayein. Kai reps tak dohrayein aur side badlein.

Barbell Ab Rollout.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko pushup position mein aana hai, lekin haath farsh par rakhne ke bajaye aap Olympic barbell pakrein ge (har taraf 5-10 lbs weight laga ho). Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Kamar mein halka sa kham rakhte hue, kulhe uthayein aur saans bahar nikaalte hue barbell ko paon ki taraf roll karein. Tip: Harkat karte waqt glutes upar uthne chahiyein, abs tight rakhein aur har waqt kamar ki position barqarar rakhein. Saath hi poori harkat ke dauran baazu farsh ke perpendicular rehne chahiyein. Agar aisa nahi karenge to abs ke bajaye kandhon aur kamar par zyada zor parega.
Upar ek second tight karne ke baad, saans andar lete hue barbell ko aahista aahista wapas aage shuruati position tak roll karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Ab Rollout - On Knees.name_ur: Barbell Ab Rollout - Ghutno ke bal
Barbell Ab Rollout - On Knees.instructions_ur:
Har taraf 5-10 lbs weight wala Olympic barbell pakrein aur farsh par ghutno ke bal ho jayein.
Ab barbell ko apne saamne farsh par rakhein taake aap haathon aur ghutnon par hon (jaise ghutno ke bal push up ki position). Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Aahista aahista barbell ko seedha aage roll karein aur jism ko khench kar seedhi position mein layein. Tip: Jitna neeche ja sakte hain jayein, lekin jism farsh ko na chhuye. Is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Khinchi hui position mein ek second rukne ke baad, saans bahar nikaalte hue khud ko wapas shuruati position mein khenchein. Tip: Aahista karein aur har waqt abs tight rakhein.

Barbell Back Squat.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Bench Press.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par kamar ke bal let jayein. Medium width grip istemal karte hue (aisi grip jis se harkat ke beech mein forearms aur upper arms ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle bane), bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu lock kar ke apne upar seedha pakrein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Shuruati position se saans andar lein aur aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein yahan tak ke bar aap ke seene ke beech ko chhoo le.
Thore se waqfe ke baad, saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko wapas shuruati position tak dhakelein. Bar ko seene ke muscles se dhakelne par dhyan dein. Harkat ke top par baazu lock karein aur seene ko sukerein, ek second rukein aur phir dobara aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Behtar yeh hai ke wazan neeche laane mein uthane se taqreeban dugna waqt lage.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Jab mukammal ho jayein, bar ko wapas rack mein rakh dein.

Barbell Bent-Over Row.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Clean and press.instructions_ur: Is exercise mein barbell ko zameen se kandhon tak uthaya jata hai, phir sar ke upar press kiya jata hai. Yeh ek compound movement hai jo kai muscle groups ko target karti hai, jin mein taangein, kamar, kandhe aur baazu shamil hain. Yeh aksar strength aur conditioning programs mein majmooi taqat aur athletic salahiyat behtar karne ke liye istemal hoti hai.

Barbell Curl.instructions_ur: barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Curls Lying Against An Incline.name_ur: Incline par Let kar Barbell Curls
Barbell Curls Lying Against An Incline.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par let jayein, baazuon mein barbell pakre hue jo neeche horizontal line mein latke hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upper arms ko saakit rakhte hue, biceps ko sukerte hue weight ko jitna upar ho sake curl karein. Harkat ke is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Sirf forearms harkat karein. Baazu jhulayein nahin.
Ek second sukerne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein. Tip: Yaqeeni banayein ke aap poora neeche tak jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar is tarah khare hon ke paon bar ke neeche hon.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se aage jhukein, ghutnon mein thoda kham aane dein.
Bar ko overhand grip se pakrein, haathon ke darmiyan taqreeban 16 inch faasla ho.
Bar ko seedhe baazuon mein pakre hue kamar seedhi kar ke khare ho jayein.
Dobara aage jhukein aur bar ko farsh se zara upar tak neeche layein.

Barbell Full Squat.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise hifazat ke liye squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai. Shuru karne ke liye bar ko rack par kandhon ki satah se thora upar rakhein. Sahi unchai chun kar aur bar load kar ke, bar ke neeche aayein aur use kandhon ke pichle hisse par (gardan se thora neeche) rakhein.
Dono haathon se bar ko dono taraf se pakrein aur pehle taangon se dhakel kar aur saath hi dhad ko seedha karte hue use rack se uthayein.
Rack se peeche hatein aur kandhon ke barabar medium stance mein paon rakhein, paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf. Har waqt sar upar rakhein aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne mor kar aur kulhon ko peeche le ja kar aahista aahista bar neeche laana shuru karein, sar upar aur posture seedha rakhte hue. Itna neeche jayein ke hamstrings pindliyon par aa jayein. Is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, eri ya paon ke beech se zameen ko dhakel kar, taangein seedhi karte hue aur kulhe khol kar bar ko upar uthayein aur shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Glute Bridge.instructions_ur:
Zameen par baith kar shuru karein, loaded barbell aapki taangon ke upar ho. Moti bar ya bar par pad istemal karne se is exercise ki takleef kaafi kam ho sakti hai. Bar ko rol karein taake woh bilkul aapke kulhon ke upar ho, aur farsh par seedhe let jayein.
Ediyon se zor laga kar harkat shuru karein, kulhon ko bar ke saath seedha upar ki taraf uthayein. Aapka wazan kamar ke upar wale hisse aur paon ki ediyon par hona chahiye.
Jitna ho sake upar uthayein, phir harkat ulti kar ke wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Good Morning.instructions_ur:
Shuru mein bar ko rack par kandhon ki oonchai par rakhein. Bar ko kandhon ke peechle hisse par tika dein jaise power squat mein rakhte hain, kandhon ke bilkul upar nahi. Kamar tight rakhein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein dabayein, aur ghutne halke se mode rakhein. Rack se peeche hat jayein.
Kulhon se jhukna shuru karein, unhein peeche le jate hue taqreeban farsh ke parallel tak jhukein. Kamar mein arch barqarar rakhein aur gardan ki reerh ki haddi sahi seedh mein rakhein.
Glutes aur hamstrings ki madad se kulhe seedhe kar ke harkat ulat dein. Jab tak shuruati position mein wapas na aa jayein, jaari rakhein.

Barbell Guillotine Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Darmiyani chauri grip istemal karte hue (aisi grip jo harkat ke beech mein forearms aur upper arms ke darmiyan 90 degree ka zaviya banaye), bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu lock karke gardan ke seedha upar pakren. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue bar ko aahista aahista neeche laayein yahan tak ke woh gardan se taqreeban 1 inch door ho.
Ek second rukne ke baad saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ke muscles se bar ko dhakel kar wapas shuruati position mein laayein. Baazu lock karein aur contracted position mein seene ko sukerein, ek second rokein aur phir dobara aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Neeche aane mein upar jane se kam az kam dugna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.
Jab mukammal ho jayein to bar ko wapas rack mein rakh dein.

Barbell Hack Squat.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Hip Thrust.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Gri.name_ur: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Gri.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par peeche let jayein. Medium chaurai wali grip istemal karte hue (aisi grip jo harkat ke beech mein forearms aur upper arms ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle banaye), bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu lock karke seedha apne upar pakrein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aayein jab tak bar aapke upper seene par mehsoos na ho.
Ek second ruk kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko wapas shuruati position mein layein aur seene ke muscles se bar ko dhakelein. Contracted position mein baazu lock karein, seena sukerein, ek second rokein aur phir dobara aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: neeche jaane mein upar aane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Tay kiye gaye reps ke mutabiq harkat dohrayein.
Jab mukammal ho jayein, bar ko wapas rack mein rakh dein.

Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise.instructions_ur:
Incline Bench par let jayein. Medium width grip (kandhon se thori chauri grip) ke saath bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu seedhe rakhte hue apne upar seedha pakrein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue, shoulder blades ko aage le ja kar bar ko uthayein, aur saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ko bench se upar uthayein.
Saans andar lete hue bar ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Lunge.instructions_ur:
Hifazat ke liye yeh exercise squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai. Shuru karne ke liye pehle bar ko rack par kandhon se zara neeche ki oonchai par rakhein. Sahi oonchai chunne aur bar par weight lagane ke baad, bar ke neeche jayein aur kandhon ka peechla hissa (gardan se thoda neeche) bar ke neeche tika dein.
Dono haathon se bar ko dono taraf se pakrein aur pehle taangon se zor laga kar aur saath hi dhad seedha karte hue bar ko rack se uthayein.
Rack se hat jayein aur daayin taang se aage qadam rakhein, phir dhad seedha aur balance barqarar rakhte hue kulhon se neeche squat karein. Neeche jate hue saans andar lein. Note: Neeche aate waqt ghutne ko paon ki ungliyon se aage na jaane dein, kyunke is se ghutne ke jor par ghair zaroori dabaav parta hai.
Zyada tar paon ki eri ka istemal karte hue upar dhakelein aur saans bahar nikaalte hue shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir baayin taang se karein.

Barbell Lunges Standing.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko kandhon ke peeche rakhein. Seedhe khare ho jayein, phir pehla qadam aage ki taraf lein. Qadam itna aage hona chahiye ke sahara dene wali taang ka ghutna farsh ko chhoo sake. Phir wapas khare ho jayein aur doosri taang se dohrayein.
Achha posture qaim rakhna yaad rakhein.

Barbell Overhead Press.instructions_ur: barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Rear Delt Row.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho jayein aur barbell ko chauri (kandhon se zyada faasle par) aur overhand (hatheliyan jism ki taraf) grip se pakren.
Ghutne thore se moden aur kamar ka qudrati kham barqarar rakhte hue aage jhukein. Baazu bar pakre hue saamne latakne dein. Jab dhad farsh ke mutawazi ho jaye, to kohniyan bahar aur jism se door phailayein. Tip: Aap ka dhad aur baazu angrezi harf "T" jaise nazar aane chahiyein. Ab aap exercise shuru karne ke liye tayyar hain.
Upper arms ko dhad ke amudi rakhte hue barbell ko seene ke upar wale hisse ki taraf khinchein, rear delts ko sukerein aur saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Sahi tareeqe se karne par yeh exercise ulti bench press jaisi lagni chahiye. Biceps se kaam lene se bhi parhez karein. Rear delts par focus karein; baazu sirf hook ki tarah kaam karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Rollout from Bench.instructions_ur:
Ek loaded barbell ko zameen par, bench ke kinare ke qareeb rakhein. Dono ghutne bench par rakh kar ghutno ke bal baith jayein, aur barbell par medium se tang grip lein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Shuru karne ke liye, kulhe seedhe karte hue aahista aahista bar ko aage roll karein. Roll out karte hue kandhe ko move kar ke bar ko sar se aage le jayein. Dhyan rakhein ke poori harkat ke dauran baazu seedhe rahein.
Jab bar jitna ho sake aage chala jaye, to wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Seated Calf Raise.instructions_ur:
Flat bench se taqreeban 12 inch aage ek block rakhein.
Bench par baith jayein aur paon ka agla hissa (panja) block par rakhein.
Kisi se kahein ke barbell aap ki raanon ke upar, ghutnon se taqreeban 3 inch upar rakh kar pakre rakhe. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Calves ko dabate hue aur saans bahar nikaalte hue panjon par jitna ho sake upar uthein.
Ek second tight karne ke baad aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. Tip: Zyada faida lene ke liye calves ko jitna ho sake stretch karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Shoulder Press.instructions_ur:
Squat rack mein back support wale bench par baith jayein. Barbell ko sar se zara upar ki oonchai par rakhein. Barbell ko pronated grip se pakrein (hatheliyan saamne ki taraf).
Sahi grip ki chaurai ke saath barbell pakarne ke baad, baazu lock kar ke bar ko sar ke upar uthayein. Isey taqreeban kandhon ki oonchai par aur sar se thoda aage pakre rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue bar ko aahista aahista kandhon tak neeche layein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko wapas shuruati position tak upar uthayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Shrug.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Barbell Shrug Behind The Back.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho jayein, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein aur dono haathon se barbell ko kamar ke peeche pronated grip (hatheliyan peeche ki taraf) se pakrein. Tip: Aap ke haath kandhon ke faasle se thore chaure hone chahiyein. Behtar grip ke liye is exercise mein wrist wraps istemal kar sakte hain. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ko jitna ho sake oopar uthayein aur ek second ke liye contraction rok kar rakhein. Tip: Barbell ko biceps se uthane ki koshish na karein. Baazu har waqt seedhe phaile rehne chahiyein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Side Bend.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho jayein aur barbell ko kandhon ke peeche (gardan se thora neeche) rakh kar pakrein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kamar seedhi aur sar upar rakhte hue, sirf kamar se jitna ho sake daayein taraf jhukein. Side mein jhukte hue saans andar lein. Phir ek second rokein aur saans bahar nikaalte hue wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein. Tip: Baqi jism ko saakit rakhein.
Ab yahi harkat baayein taraf jhuk kar dohrayein. Ek second rokein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Side Split Squat.instructions_ur:
Kandhon ki pichli taraf (gardan se thoda neeche) barbell rakh kar seedhe khare ho jayein. Paon chaure faasle par hon aur aage wali taang ka paon side ki taraf bahar mura hua ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Aage wali taang ka ghutna aur kulha mod kar jism ko mure hue paon ki side ki taraf neeche layein, aur doosri taang sirf thodi si mudi rahe. Jism neeche laate hue saans andar lein.
Aage wali taang ka kulha aur ghutna seedha kar ke wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain woh poore karne ke baad, doosri taang se yehi harkat dohrayein.

Barbell Squat.instructions_ur:

Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. (Note: Is wazahat mein hum upar bataya gaya darmiyana stance istemal karenge jo overall development ke liye hai; lekin aap foot stances section mein bataye gaye teeno stances mein se koi bhi chun sakte hain.)
Ghutne aur kulhe mor kar aahista aahista bar ko neeche lana shuru karein, aur sar upar rakhte hue posture seedha rakhein. Neeche jate rahein jab tak raan aur calves ke darmiyan zaviya 90 degrees se thoda kam na ho jaye. Is hisse mein saans andar lein. Tip: Agar exercise sahi ki hai to ghutnon ka agla hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banayega jo saamne ki taraf perpendicular hogi. Agar ghutne us khayali line se aage hain (yani paon ki ungliyon se aage) to ghutne par ghair zaroori dabaav par raha hai aur exercise ghalat tareeqe se ki gayi hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue paon ki eri se farsh ko dhakelein, taangein dobara seedhi karte hue bar ko upar uthayein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Squat To A Bench.instructions_ur:
Hifazat ke liye yeh exercise squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai. Shuru karne ke liye pehle apne peeche ek flat bench ya box rakhein. Flat bench is liye hai taake aap kulhe peeche le jana aur poori gehrai tak jana seekhein.

Phir bar ko rack par us oonchai par rakhein jo aap ke qad ke hisaab se behtareen ho. Sahi oonchai chunne aur bar par weight lagane ke baad, bar ke neeche jayein aur kandhon ka peechla hissa (gardan se thoda neeche) bar ke neeche tika dein.
Dono haathon se bar ko dono taraf se pakrein aur pehle taangon se zor laga kar aur saath hi dhad seedha karte hue bar ko rack se uthayein.
Rack se hat jayein aur taangon ko kandhon ke barabar darmiyane stance mein rakhein, paon ki ungliyan thodi bahar ki taraf hon. Sar har waqt upar rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigar jata hai, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. (Note: Is wazahat mein hum upar bataya gaya darmiyana stance istemal karenge jo overall development ke liye hai; lekin aap foot stances section mein bataye gaye teeno stances mein se koi bhi chun sakte hain.)
Ghutne mor kar aur kulhe peeche le ja kar aahista aahista bar ko neeche lana shuru karein, sar upar rakhte hue posture seedha rakhein. Neeche jate rahein jab tak peeche rakhe bench ko halka sa chhu na lein. Is hisse mein saans andar lein. Tip: Agar exercise sahi ki hai to ghutnon ka agla hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banayega jo saamne ki taraf perpendicular hogi. Agar ghutne us khayali line se aage hain (yani paon ki ungliyon se aage) to ghutne par ghair zaroori dabaav par raha hai aur exercise ghalat tareeqe se ki gayi hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue paon ki eri se farsh ko dhakelein, taangein seedhi kar ke aur kulhe aage la kar bar ko upar uthayein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Barbell Step Back Lunge.instructions_ur:
Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, barbell apni upper kamar par pakre hue.
Kamar seedhi rakhein, seena upar aur core engaged rakhein.
Ek taang se peeche qadam lein aur dono ghutne mod kar jism neeche layein. Yaqeeni banayein ke peeche wala ghutna zameen ko taqreeban chhoo jaye.
Peeche wale paon se zor laga kar wapas shuruati position mein aayein.
Doosri taang se harkat dohrayein.
Jitne reps chahiye utne tak taangein baari baari badalte rahein.

Barbell Step Ups.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko kandhon ke peeche (gardan se thoda neeche) tika kar seedhe khare ho jayein, aur ek oonche platform ke peeche khare hon (jaise flat bench ke peeche spotting ke liye platform hota hai). Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Daayan paon oonche platform par rakhein. Daayin taang ka kulha aur ghutna seedha karte hue platform par charh jayein. Baqi jism ko upar uthane ke liye zyada tar eri ka istemal karein aur baayin taang ka paon bhi platform par rakh dein. Upar aane ke liye zor lagate waqt saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue daayin taang ka kulha aur ghutna mor kar baayin taang se neeche utrein. Daayan paon baayein paon ke saath shuruati jagah par rakh kar wapas asal khari position mein aa jayein.
Daayin taang se jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir baayin taang se karein.

Barbell Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko sar ke upar tang overhand grip ke saath rakhein.
Kohniyan sar ke upar rakhte hue forearm ko upper arm ke peeche neeche layein. Forearm ko sar ke upar seedha karein. Neeche layein aur dohrayein.

Barbell Walking Lunge.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar aur barbell kamar ke upar wale hisse par rakh kar khare ho kar shuru karein.
Ek taang se aage qadam rakhein, ghutne mod kar kulhe neeche layein. Itna neeche jayein ke pichla ghutna zameen ko taqreeban chhoo le. Jism seedha rahe, aur aage wala ghutna aage wale paon ke upar rahe.
Aage wale paon ki aedi se zor lagayein aur dono ghutne seedhe kar ke wapas upar uthein.
Pichle paon se aage qadam rakhein, aur doosri taang par lunge dohrayein.

Barbell Wrist Curl.instructions_ur:
Bench par baith kar barbell ko is tarah pakren ke hatheliyan upar ki taraf hon aur haath kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Forearms ko raanon par rakhein aur kalaiyon ko ghutnon se aage latakne dein. Hatheliyon aur kalaiyon ko chehre ki taraf curl karke harkat karein.
Upar wali position mein thori der rukein, phir aahista aahista barbell ko wapas shuruati position mein le aayein.

Battling Ropes.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko ek bhaari rope chahiye jo 15-20 feet door apne darmiyan se bandhi ho. Rope ke saamne khare ho kar har haath mein ek sira pakrein aur baazu side par seedhe rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Harkat shuru karne ke liye ek baazu ko jitni tezi se ho sake kandhe ki unchai tak uthayein.
Jab woh baazu shuruati position mein neeche gire, to doosri side ka baazu uthayein.
Baari baari left aur right baazu chalate rahein, rope ko jitni tezi se ho sake oopar neeche lehrayein.

Bear Crawl Sled Drags.instructions_ur:
Harness ya dheela weight belt pehen kar chain ko peeche lagayein taake aapka mun sled se doosri taraf ho. Neeche jhukein taake aapke haath zameen par hon. Kamar seedhi (flat) aur ghutne mude hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Taangon se zor laga kar shuru karein, baari baari baayein aur daayein. Haathon se balance qaim rakhein aur kheenchne mein madad lein. Tay faasla tay karte hue kamar seedhi rakhne ki koshish karein.

Behind Head Chest Stretch.instructions_ur:
Zameen par seedhe baith jayein aur partner aap ke peeche ho.
Apne haath sar ke peeche rakhein, aur kohniyan jitna ho sake peeche dhakelein. Aap ka partner aap ki kohniyan pakre. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Haath sar ke peeche hi rakhte hue 10 ya zyada second tak narmi se kohniyan aage kheenchne ki koshish karein. Aap ka partner kohniyon ko hilne na de.
Ab muscles dheele chhor dein aur partner narmi se kohniyan utna peeche kheenche jitna aap ke liye aaramdeh ho. Zaroor partner ko bata dein ke stretch kab kaafi hai taa ke zyada stretch ya chot se bacha ja sake.

Bench Dip.instructions_ur: Bench ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Bench Dips.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko apni kamar ke peeche ek bench rakhna hoga. Bench aap ke jism ke perpendicular ho, aur us ki taraf peeth kar ke, haathon ko poora seedha kar ke kandhon ke barabar faasle par bench ka kinara pakrein. Taangein aage ki taraf seedhi hon, kulhon se mudi hon aur dhad ke perpendicular hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue kohniyan mod kar aahista aahista jism neeche layein, itna neeche ke baazu ke upar wale hisse aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degrees se thoda kam angle ban jaye. Tip: Poori harkat ke dauran kohniyan jitna ho sake qareeb rakhein. Forearms hamesha neeche ki taraf hone chahiyein.
Triceps ki madad se dhad ko dobara upar layein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Bench Jump.instructions_ur:
Apne saamne 1-2 feet ke faasle par box ya bench rakh kar shuru karein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare ho jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Jump ki tayyari ke liye chhota sa squat karein; baazu peeche ki taraf jhulayein.
Is position se uchhal kar kulhon, ghutnon aur takhnon ko seedha karte hue jitna ho sake ooncha jump karein. Baazu aage aur upar jhulayein.
Bench ke upar se jump karein, ghutne mude hue rakh kar utrein aur jhatke ko taangon se jazb karein.
Mud kar ulti simt mein munh karein, phir bench ke upar se wapas jump karein.

Bench Press - Powerlifting.instructions_ur:
Bench par let kar shuru karein, agar mumkin ho to apna sar bar se aage tak le jayein. Apne paon apne neeche mod lein aur kamar ko arch karein. Bar ka sahara le kar apne kandhe bench se uthayein aur unhein peeche khinchein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein. Paon ki madad se apne traps ko bench mein dabayein. Poori harkat ke dauran jism ki yeh tight position barqarar rakhein.
Grip jitni bhi chauri ho, woh bar par bane ring ko cover kare. Kandhon ko aage nikaale baghair bar ko rack se nikaalein. Bar ko zor se dabane aur usay alag alag khinchne ki koshish par tawajjo dein.
Bar ko seene ke nichle hisse ya pait ke upar wale hisse tak neeche layein. Bar, kalai aur kohni har waqt ek seedh mein rehni chahiye.
Jab barbell dhad ko chhooe to rukein, aur phir poori taqat se bar ko upar dhakelein. Lockout tak kohniyan andar ki taraf rehni chahiye.

Bench Press - With Bands.instructions_ur:
Flat bench istemal karte hue band ko bench ki us taang ke neeche mazbooti se laga dein jo aap ke sar ke sab se qareeb ho.
Jab band mazbooti se lag jaye, to uske dono handles pakren aur bench par let jayein.
Baazu seedhe karein taake band ke handles aap ke saamne kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Kandhon ke barabar faasle par aane ke baad kalaiyon ko aage ghumayein taake hatheliyan aap se door ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Handles ko aahista aahista neeche laayein yahan tak ke kohni 90 degree ka zaviya banaye. Har waqt poora control rakhein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ke muscles se handles ko upar le jayein. Contracted position mein baazu lock karein, seene ko sukerein, ek second rokein aur phir aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein upar jane se kam az kam dugna waqt lagna chahiye.
Apne training program ke mutabiq jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Bench Press Narrow Grip.instructions_ur:
Setup: Bench par seedhe let jayein aur bar ko kandhon ke barabar chaurai par pakrein (aam bench press se zyada qareeb).
Neeche lana: Control ke saath bar ko seene ke nichle hisse tak layein.
Form: Kohniyan dhad ke saath achhi tarah sata kar rakhein, unhein bahar ki taraf na phailne dein.
Upar lana: Bar ko seedha wapas upar press karein aur upar pohanch kar triceps ko dabayein.

Bench Press with Chains.instructions_ur:
Leader chain ko adjust karein, use apni marzi ki lambai tak chhota karein. Chains ko bar ke sleeves par rakhein.
Bench par let kar, agar mumkin ho to apna sar bar se aage le jayein. Paon apne neeche mod lein aur kamar mein arch banayein. Bar ki madad se wazan sambhalte hue kandhon ko bench se uthayein aur peeche khenchein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein. Paon se zor laga kar traps ko bench mein dabayein. Poori harkat ke dauran jism ki yeh tight position qaim rakhein. Grip jitni bhi chauri ho, woh bar par bane ring ko cover kare.
Kandhon ko aage le jaye baghair bar ko rack se nikaalein. Bar ko zor se dabane aur use kheench kar alag karne ki koshish par dhyan dein. Bar ko seene ke nichle hisse ya pait ke upar wale hisse tak neeche layein. Bar, kalai aur kohni hamesha ek seedh mein rahein.
Jab barbell dhad ko chhoo le to rukein, phir poori taaqat se bar ko upar dhakelein. Lockout tak kohniyan andar ki taraf rahein.

Bench Sprint.instructions_ur:
Zameen par khare ho jayein aur ek paon bench ya box par rakhein, edi kinare ke qareeb ho.
Bench par rakhe paon se zor laga kar kulhe aur ghutne ko seedha karte hue upar uthein.
Doosre paon ko box ke upar rakh kar utrein, aur pehle paon ko wapas shuruati position mein le aayein.
Set mukammal karne ke liye baari baari ek paon se doosre paon par badalte rahein.

Bent High Pulls.instructions_ur: Do dumbbells pakar kar thora sa aage jhukein. Kohniyan jitni unchi ho sakein rakhte hue dumbbells ko seene tak kheenchein.

Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With.name_ur: Jhuk kar Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise Sar Bench par rakh kar
Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakad kar seedhe khare ho jayein aur apne saamne incline bench rakhein.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue aur uska qudrati kham barqarar rakhte hue aage jhukein yahan tak ke maatha saamne wale bench ko chhoo le. Baazu saamne zameen ke amudi latakne dein. Hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf hon aur dhad farsh ke mutawazi ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad ko aage aur saakit rakhte hue, aur baazu seedhe magar kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakh kar, dumbbells ko seedha side mein uthayein yahan tak ke dono baazu farsh ke mutawazi ho jayein. Weight uthate hue saans bahar nikaalein. Ehtiyat: dhad ko jhulane ya baazuon ko side ke bajaye peeche le jane se parhez karein.
Upar ek second ke contraction ke baad aahista aahista dumbbells ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche laayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Bent Over Dumbbell Rows (Single Arm).name_ur: Jhuk kar Dumbbell Rows (Ek baazu se)
Bent Over Dumbbell Rows (Single Arm).instructions_ur: Haath mein dumbbells le kar kulhon se itna jhukein ke haath ghutnon se zara neeche latak jayein (straight-legged deadlift ki shuruati position jaisa). Upper body ka angle ek jaisa rakhein aur lats ko sukerte hue kohniyan peeche kheenchein, oopar shoulder blades ko aapas mein dabayein. Har rep par khare hone se bachein, har rep par check karein ke haath ghutnon se neeche ja rahe hain.

Bent Over Low-Pulley Side Lateral.instructions_ur:
Wazan chunein aur low pulley ka handle apne daayein haath se pakdein.
Kulhon se aage jhukein yahan tak ke aap ka dhad taqreeban farsh ke mutawazi (parallel) ho jaye. Aap ki taangein thodi mudi hon aur baayan haath baayein raan ke nichle hisse par rakha ho. Daayan baazu kandhe se aap ke saamne latak raha ho aur kohni mein halka sa mod ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Daayan baazu, kohni thodi mudi hui, side ki taraf uthayein yahan tak ke baazu farsh ke mutawazi ho aur daayein kaan ki seedh mein ho. Yeh qadam karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wazan ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir doosre baazu se harkat dohrayein.

Bent Over One-Arm Long Bar Row.name_ur: Jhuk kar Ek baazu se Long Bar Row
Bent Over One-Arm Long Bar Row.instructions_ur:
Olympic barbell ke ek sire par weight lagayein. Yaqeeni banayein ke barbell ka doosra sira do deewaron ke kone mein rakha ho; ya zameen par koi bhaari cheez rakhein taake barbell peeche na phisle.
Aage jhukein jab tak aapka dhad jitna ho sake farsh ke parallel ke qareeb na aa jaye aur ghutne halke se mude rakhein.
Ab jis taraf weight laga hai us taraf plates ke bilkul peeche ek baazu se bar pakrein aur doosra haath apne ghutne par rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni andar rakhte hue (kamar par zyada asar ke liye) bar ko seedha upar kheenchein jab tak plates aapke nichle seene ko na chhoo lein. Weight uthate hue kamar ke muscles sukerein aur harkat ke top par ek second rokein. Weight uthate hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Dhad ko bilkul jhoolne na dein. Sirf baazu harkat kare.
Aahista aahista bar ko shuruati position tak neeche layein aur lats mein achha stretch mehsoos karein. Tip: Plates ko farsh se na lagne dein. Behtareen range of motion ke liye main chhoti plates (25-lb wali) istemal karne ka mashwara deta hoon, bari plates (jaise 35-45lb wali) ke bajaye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur baazu badlein.

Bent Over Rear Deltoid Raise With Head O.name_ur: Jhuk kar Rear Deltoid Raise, Sar Bench par rakh kar
Bent Over Rear Deltoid Raise With Head O.instructions_ur:
Harkat ko mustehkam rakhne ke liye apna maatha incline bench par tika dein taake aap is tarah jhuke hon ke kamar farsh ke parallel ho, aur pet andar khench lein.
Haathon mein dumbbells pakrein, baazu seedhe hon aur kohniyan halki si mudi hon, dhyan rakhein ke woh lock na hon.
Aahista aahista dumbbells ko kandhon ki oonchai tak uthayein.
Ek lamhe ke liye rukein aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

Bent Over Rowing Reverse.instructions_ur:
Yeh aam rowing jaisi hi hai, lekin ulti grip ke saath (hatheliyan saamne ki taraf):
Barbell ko chauri grip se pakrein (kandhon se thoda zyada chaura) aur aage jhukein. Upper body bilkul farsh ke parallel nahi balke halka sa zaviya banati hai. Poori exercise ke dauran seena bahar rahe.
Ab barbell ko tezi se naaf ki taraf khenchein, is se upar nahi. Aahista aahista shuruati position mein neeche jayein. Jism ko jhulayein nahi aur baazu jism ke saath rakhein.

Bent Over Two-Arm Long Bar Row.name_ur: Jhuk kar Dono baazu se Long Bar Row
Bent Over Two-Arm Long Bar Row.instructions_ur:
Olympic barbell ke ek sire par weight lagayein. Barbell ka doosra sira do deewaron ke kone mein rakhein; ya zameen par koi bhaari cheez rakh dein taake barbell peeche na phisle.
Aage jhukein jab tak dhad jitna ho sake farsh ke parallel na ho jaye, aur ghutne thode mude rakhein.
Ab dono baazuon se bar ko plates ke bilkul peeche, us taraf se pakrein jahan weight lagaya hai, aur doosra haath apne ghutne par rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan andar rakhte hue (taake kamar par zyada zor aaye) bar ko seedha upar kheenchein jab tak plates seene ke nichle hisse ko na chhoo lein. Weight uthate hue kamar ke muscles sukerein aur harkat ke oopar ek second rokein. Weight uthate hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Bar ke sire ke neeche stirrup ya double handle cable attachment phansa kar istemal karein.
Aahista aahista bar ko shuruati position tak neeche layein aur lats mein achi stretch mehsoos karein. Tip: Plates ko farsh se na lagne dein. Behtareen range of motion ke liye, main bari plates (jaise 35-45 lb wali) ke bajaye chhoti plates (25 lb wali) istemal karne ka mashwara deta hoon.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell le kar (hatheliyan dhad ki taraf), ghutne halke se moden aur kulhon se aage jhukein; jhukte hue kamar seedhi rakhein jab tak woh farsh ke taqreeban parallel na ho jaye. Tip: Sar upar rakhein. Weights seedha aapke saamne latakne chahiyein jabke baazu farsh aur dhad ke perpendicular latke hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Dhad saakit rakhte hue, dumbbells ko apni side tak uthayein (saans bahar nikaalte hue), kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakhein (weights pakarne ke ilawa forearm se koi zor na lagayein). Top contracted position par kamar ke muscles sukerein aur ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista weight ko dobara shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In.name_ur: Jhuk kar Dono Dumbbell Row Hatheliyan Andar ke saath
Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell le kar (hatheliyan aamne saamne), ghutne halke se moden aur kulhon se aage jhukein, kamar seedhi rakhte hue jab tak woh farsh ke taqreeban parallel na ho jaye. Tip: Sar upar rakhein. Weights seedha aapke saamne latakne chahiyein jabke baazu farsh aur dhad ke perpendicular latke hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Dhad saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbells ko apni side tak uthayein aur shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein. Top contracted position par kamar ke muscles sukerein aur ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista weight ko dobara shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Bent Press.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karein. Taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karte hue kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf uthayein aur kandhe tak clean karein. Aisa karte waqt kalai ghoomni chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kettlebell ke mukhalif side ki taraf jhukna shuru karein, aur tab tak jhukte rahein jab tak khaali haath se zameen ko chhu na sakein, nazar kettlebell par rakhein. Aisa karte hue kohni seedhi kar ke weight ko seedha oopar press karein, baazu zameen ke perpendicular rakhein.
Seedhi position mein wapas aa jayein, kettlebell sar ke oopar ho. Kettlebell ko wapas kandhe par layein aur jitne reps chahiye utni dafa dohrayein.

Bent-Arm Barbell Pullover.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur barbell ko kandhon ke barabar grip se pakrein.
Bar ko seene ke bilkul upar seedha pakrein, baazuon mein halka sa kham ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baazuon ko mude hue rakhte hue, saans andar lete hue weight ko aahista aahista sar ke peeche arc mein neeche layein jab tak seene mein stretch mehsoos na ho.
Us jagah par pohanch kar, barbell ko usi arc mein wapas shuruati position tak layein jis mein neeche gaya tha, aur yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Weight ko shuruati position par ek second rokein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover.instructions_ur:
Ek dumbbell ko flat bench par khara kar ke rakhein.
Yaqeeni banayein ke dumbbell bench ke upar mazbooti se tika rahe, phir bench ke aar paar let jayein (dhad bench ke upar cross ki shakal mein) aur sirf kandhe bench par hon. Kulhe bench se neeche hon aur taangein mudi hon, paon farsh par mazbooti se jame hon. Sar bhi bench se bahar hoga.
Dumbbell ko dono haathon se pakrein aur seene ke bilkul upar seedha rakhein, baazuon mein halka sa kham ho. Dono hatheliyan dumbbell ki ek side ke andar wale hisse par dabi honi chahiyein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. Ehtiyat: Hamesha yaqeeni banayein ke is exercise ke liye istemal hone wala dumbbell mehfooz ho. Dheeli plates wala dumbbell khul kar aap ke chehre par gir sakta hai.
Baazuon ko mude hue lock rakhte hue, saans andar lete hue weight ko aahista aahista sar ke peeche arc mein neeche layein jab tak seene mein stretch mehsoos na ho.
Us jagah par pohanch kar, dumbbell ko usi arc mein wapas shuruati position tak layein jis mein neeche gaya tha, aur yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Weight ko shuruati position par ek second rokein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Bent-Knee Hip Raise.instructions_ur:
Farsh par seedhe let jayein, baazu jism ke dono taraf rakhein.
Ab ghutnon ko taqreeban 75 degree ke zaviye par moorein aur paon farsh se taqreeban 2 inch upar uthayein.
Lower abs ka istemal karte hue, taangon mein 75 degree ka kham barqarar rakhte hue ghutnon ko apni taraf layein. Yeh harkat jaari rakhein jab tak pelvis ko peeche roll kar ke kulhe farsh se upar na uth jayein. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Harkat ke aakhir mein ghutne aap ke seene ke upar honge.
Upar ek second ke liye abs ko dabayein aur phir saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. Tip: Har waqt harkat control mein rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Bent-Over One Arm Triceps Extension with.name_ur: Jhuk kar Ek baazu se Triceps Extension Dumbbell ke saath
Bent-Over One Arm Triceps Extension with.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, pet andar khencha ho aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue aage jhukein.
Daayein haath mein dumbbell pakrein.
Daayan baazu side par upar layein taake dumbbell taqreeban seene ke parallel ho, baazu ka nichla hissa seedha khara (vertical) rakhein aur baazu ko arc mein peeche press karein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein, dohrayein aur baazu badal lein.

Bent-Over Two Arm Triceps Extension with.name_ur: Jhuk kar Dono baazuon se Triceps Extension Dumbbell ke saath
Bent-Over Two Arm Triceps Extension with.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, pet andar khencha ho aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue aage jhukein jab tak upper body farsh ke parallel na ho jaye.
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein.
Daayan baazu side par upar layein taake dumbbell seene ki seedh mein ho, baazu ka nichla hissa seedha khara (vertical) rakhein aur baazu ko arc mein peeche press karein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein, dohrayein aur baazu badal lein.

Bent-over Lateral Cable Raises.instructions_ur:
Low pulley ka handle daayein haath se pakrein.
Kulhon se aage jhukein; upper body taqreeban farsh ke parallel honi chahiye. Ghutne halke se moorein aur baayan haath baayin raan par rakhein. Daayan baazu kandhe se saamne latakne dein, kohni halki si mudi ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Kohni halki si mudi rakhte hue daayan baazu uthayein.
Baazu ko uthate rahein jab tak woh farsh ke parallel aur daayein kaan ki seedh mein na aa jaye.
Aahista aahista weight ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Baayein baazu se exercise karein aur phir dohrayein.

Bent-over Lateral Raises.instructions_ur: Weights pakar kar bench par baith jayein. Jitna ho sake aage jhukein, baazu kohni se thore se mude hon. Kohni ka mor barqarar rakhte hue lateral raise karein.

Bicep Curl Lunge with Bowling Motion.name_ur: Bicep Curl Lunge, Bowling wali harkat ke saath
Bicep Curl Lunge with Bowling Motion.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein Medicine Ball kandhe ki oonchai par pakrein, hatheli upar ki taraf ho.
Ek paon peeche le ja kar lunge karein, aage wala paon apni jagah rakhein aur peechle ghutne ko zameen se na lagne dein.
Lunge karte hue ball ko neeche aur peeche layein jaise bowling kar rahe hon.
Baazu wapas shuruati position tak upar layein, taangein badlein aur dohrayein.
Note: Is exercise mein aahista aur mustaqil harkatein karein.

Bicep Curl on Stability Ball with Leg Ra.name_ur: Stability Ball par Bicep Curl, Taang utha kar
Bicep Curl on Stability Ball with Leg Ra.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell palms up grip se pakrein (hatheliyan upar).
Ek paon ka upar wala hissa peeche Stability Ball par rakhein (tasveer dekhein), jaise taang ko stretch kar rahe hon.
Kamar seedhi rakhein aur pet andar khench lein.
Baazu neeche taangon ke saamne layein.
Biceps ko tight karte hue baazuon ko curl kar ke upar layein.
Baazu neeche layein, shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein aur taang badal lein.

Bicep Curl with Deadlift with Barbell.name_ur: Barbell se Bicep Curl aur Deadlift
Bicep Curl with Deadlift with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Yeh ek advanced exercise hai. Is exercise mein bicep curl aur deadlift ko mila diya gaya hai.
EZ Curl bar ya barbell ko hatheliyan upar ki taraf rakh kar pakrein.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur ghutne halke se mod kar khare hon, pet andar khench lein.
Baazu seedhe karein taake bar raanon ke saamne tika ho.
Kulhon se aage jhukte hue bar ko farsh se zara upar tak neeche layein.
Wapas khare hote hue bar ko upar layein aur baazu curl karein, forearms ko biceps ki taraf layein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein aur dohrayein.
Note: Yeh exercise aaine ke saamne karne se aap apni form dekh kar theek kar sakte hain.

Biceps Curl Reverse with Dumbbells.name_ur: Ulti grip Biceps Curl Dumbbells ke saath
Biceps Curl Reverse with Dumbbells.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hon aur pet andar khencha ho.
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon.
Baazu side par aur kohniyan ek jagah sakht rakhte hue dumbbells ko kandhon ki taraf upar uthayein.
Ek lamhe ke liye rukein aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Biceps Curl Seated on Stability Ball wit.name_ur: Stability Ball par Baith kar Biceps Curl Dumbbell ke saath
Biceps Curl Seated on Stability Ball wit.instructions_ur:
Biceps curl ke is tareeqe mein Stability Ball istemal hoti hai. Stability Ball par ki jane wali exercises se posture behtar hota hai aur core muscles mazboot hote hain.
Stability Ball par baith kar dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein, paon saamne farsh par mazbooti se jame hon aur pet andar khencha ho.
Kohniyan side par aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue baazuon ko seene tak curl karein.
Biceps ko tight karte hue ek lamhe ke liye rukein.
Aahista aahista baazu shuruati position tak neeche layein.

Biceps Curl Squat with Dumbbell.name_ur: Biceps Curl Squat Dumbbell ke saath
Biceps Curl Squat with Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein squat aur curl ko mila kar poore jism par asar daar kaam hota hai. Yeh ek advanced exercise hai.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hon aur pet andar khencha ho.
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein aur baazuon ko kandhon tak curl karein.
Kulhon se jhukte hue squat karein aur haath farsh ki taraf neeche layein (curl ka nichla hissa).
Ek lamhe ke liye rukein aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Note: Baazu upar curl karte waqt biceps ko tight karein.

Biceps Curl V Sit on Dome with Dumbbells.name_ur: Dome par V Sit Biceps Curl Dumbbells ke saath
Biceps Curl V Sit on Dome with Dumbbells.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein Dome (ya Bosu) ko seat ke taur par istemal kiya jata hai, jis se poori exercise ke dauran abs ko tight rakhna parta hai. Naam is liye hai ke jism ki shakal "V" jaisi hoti hai.
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein aur dome par baith jayein.
Taangein saath milayein aur ghutne mode rakhein.
Pet andar khench kar rakhein aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
Baazu side par seedhe rakhte hue biceps ko tight karte hue curl karein, forearms ko kandhon ki taraf layein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Note: Koshish karein ke balance barqarar rahe aur poori exercise mein taangein na hilein.

Biceps Curl With Cable.instructions_ur: Cable se taqreeban 30 - 40cm door khare hon, paon farsh par mazbooti se jame hon. Bar pakrein aur tezi se weight uthayein. Weight ko dumbbell curls ki tarah aahista aahista aur control ke saath neeche layein.

Biceps Curl with Overhead Extension usin.name_ur: Stability Ball par Dumbbells se Biceps Curl aur Overhead Extension
Biceps Curl with Overhead Extension usin.instructions_ur:
Yeh ek advanced exercise hai. Is exercise ko sahi tareeqe se karne se pehle zaroori hai ke aap Stability Ball par ghutno ke bal balance bana sakein.
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan upar ki taraf hon.
Stability Ball par ghutno ke bal ho jayein, pet andar khench lein aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
Ek baazu kandhe ke upar uthayein aur doosra baazu curl kiya hua rakhein.
Upar uthaye hue baazu ko peeche moorein jaise triceps extension kar rahe hon, aur saath hi doosra baazu neeche la kar dobara curl karein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein aur baazu badal kar dohrayein.
Note: Yeh exercise mehfooz tareeqe se seekhne ke liye kisi Personal Trainer ya Instructor ki madad lein.

Biceps Curls With Barbell.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko kandhon ki chaurai par pakrein, kamar seedhi ho, kandhe thode peeche hon aur baazu seedhe hon. Baazu mor kar tezi se weight upar layein. Ruke baghair bar ko aahista aur control ke saath neeche layein.
Exercise ke dauran jism ko jhoolne na dein, saara kaam biceps karte hain aur sirf yehi muscles hilne chahiyein (kohniyon par khaas dhyan dein).

Biceps Curls With SZ-bar.instructions_ur:
SZ-bar ko kandhon ke barabar chaurai par pakdein, kamar seedhi ho, kandhe thode peeche hon, baazu seedhe hon. Baazu mod kar wazan ko tezi se upar layein. Ruke baghair, bar ko aahista aur control ke saath neeche layein.
Exercise ke dauran jism ko jhoolne na dein, saara kaam biceps karte hain, sirf yahi muscles hilne chahiye (kohniyon par dhyan dein).

Biceps Hammer Curl with Dumbbell.name_ur: Dumbbell ke saath Biceps Hammer Curl
Biceps Hammer Curl with Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein hathode jaisi (upar neeche) harkat se biceps ko alag se target kiya jata hai.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hon aur pet andar khencha ho.
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell is tarah pakrein ke hatheliyan aamne saamne hon.
Baazu seedhe kar ke jism ke dono taraf rakhein.
Kohniyan ek jagah sakht (lock) rakhte hue baazuon ko arc mein kandhon ki taraf uthayein.
Baazuon ko ek jaisi raftaar aur control ke saath neeche layein aur dohrayein.
Note: Is exercise ke dauran kalaiyan na ghumayein.

Biceps with TRX.instructions_ur: TRX straps ke handles pakrein, jism ko peeche jhukayein, baazu aur taangein seedhi hon, aur jism ek seedhi line mein ho. (Yeh baazu ki exercise hai, pait ki nahi.)

Bicycling.instructions_ur: Shuru karne ke liye bike par baith jayein aur seat ko apne qad ke mutabiq adjust karein.

Bicycling, Stationary.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye bike par baith jayein aur seat ko apne qad ke mutabiq adjust karein.
Menu se pasandeeda option chunein. Machine on karne ke liye shayad aap ko pedal chalana shuru karna pare. Aap manual setting istemal kar sakte hain, ya koi program chun sakte hain. Aam tor par aap apni umar aur wazan daal kar exercise ke dauran jalne wali calories ka andaza laga sakte hain. Workout ke dauran resistance ka level badla ja sakta hai. Handles ke zariye dil ki dharkan check ki ja sakti hai taake aap munasib intensity par rahein.

Bird Dog.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Blackroll.instructions_ur:
Control ke saath harkat karein
Aahista aahista harkat karein
Jhatke ya momentum ka istemal na karein

Board Press.instructions_ur:
Bench par let kar shuru karein, mumkin ho to sar bar se aage rakhein. 2x6 ki lakri se bane ek se paanch boards aapas mein screw kiye ja sakte hain aur training partner, bands ke zariye ya bas shirt ke neeche daba kar jagah par rakhe ja sakte hain.
Paon apne neeche moden aur kamar ko arch karein. Bar ka sahara le kar apna weight sambhalte hue kandhe bench se uthayein aur unhein peeche kheenchein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein. Paon se zor laga kar traps ko bench mein dabayein. Poori harkat ke dauran yeh tight position barqarar rakhein.
Aap normal bench grip le sakte hain, ya triceps par focus ke liye kandhon ke barabar grip. Kandhe aage nikale baghair bar ko rack se nikaalein. Bar, kalai aur kohni har waqt ek seedh mein rehni chahiyein. Bar ko sukerne aur use kheench kar alag karne ki koshish par dhyan dein.
Bar ko boards tak neeche layein, aur phir jitna zor ho sake laga kar bar ko upar dhakelein. Lockout tak kohniyan andar ki taraf rehni chahiyein.

Body Leg Lifts.instructions_ur:
Balance ke liye kisi post ya oonche weight bench ka sahara lein, seedhe khare hon aur pet andar khench lein.
Ek taang par khare reh kar doosri taang zameen se utha kar peeche le jayein.
Aahista aahista taang neeche layein aur glutes ko tight karte hue dobara uthayein.
Doosri taang se dohrayein.

Body Row.instructions_ur:
Bar ke neeche is tarah let jayein ke bar seene ke darmiyani hisse ki seedh mein ho aur paon farsh par mazbooti se jame hon.
Pet andar khench lein aur kamar seedhi (flat) rakhein.
Baazuon ki madad se jism ko bar ki taraf utha kar row karein.
Ek lamhe ke liye rukein aur aahista, control wali harkat se wapas shuruati position mein neeche aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

Body Tricep Press.instructions_ur:
Rack mein bar ko seene ki unchai par rakhein.
Khare ho kar bar ko kandhon ke barabar grip se pakrein aur ek do gaz peeche hat jayein, paon saath mila kar aur baazu seedhe rakhein taake aap bar par jhuke hue hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni mor kar khud ko bar ki taraf neeche le jayein.
Ruk jayein, phir kohniyan seedhi kar ke harkat ulat dein.
Bodyweight se aage barhne ke liye kandhon par chains daal kar wazan barhayein.

Body-Up.instructions_ur:
Zameen par plank position mein aa jayein. Aap ka wazan paon ki ungliyon aur forearms par ho, dhad seedha rahe. Forearms kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Hatheliyan mazbooti se zameen par dabate hue kohniyan seedhi karein aur jism ko zameen se oopar uthayein. Harkat ke dauran dhad sakht rakhein.
Kohniyon ko morte hue aahista aahista forearms ko wapas zameen par le aayein.
Dohrayein.

Bodyweight Flyes.instructions_ur:
Do barabar wazan wali EZ bars zameen par ek doosre ke saath rakhein. Yaqeeni banayein ke woh lurhak sakti hon.
Bars ke upar push-up position mein aa jayein, apna wazan paon ki ungliyon aur haathon par rakhein, baazu seedhe aur jism seedha ho.
Haath bars par rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Aahista aur control wali harkat se haathon ko jism ki darmiyani line se door le jayein, bars ko alag lurhakayein. Is hisse ke dauran saans andar lein.
Bars ko jitna ho sake door le jane ke baad, unhein wapas aapas mein khinch kar shuruati position mein aa jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.

Bodyweight Mid Row.instructions_ur:
Pull-up apparatus ko medium se chauri grip ke saath pakrein, hatheliyan aap se door ki taraf. Latki hui position se ghutne seene ki taraf modein, peeche jhukein aur taangein pull-up apparatus ke apni taraf wale hisse ke upar le jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Seedhe baazuon se shuru karte hue, kohniyan modein aur shoulder blades ko peeche kheench kar jism ko upar uthayein yahan tak ke taangein pull-up apparatus ko chhoo lein.
Thore se waqfe ke baad shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Bodyweight Squat.instructions_ur:
