Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare ho jayein. Haath sar ke peeche rakh sakte hain. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne aur kulhe mod kar, kulhon ko peeche le jate hue harkat shuru karein.
Agar mumkin ho to poori gehrai tak neeche jayein, aur phir tezi se harkat ulti karke shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. Squat karte hue sar aur seena upar rakhein aur ghutnon ko bahar ki taraf dhakelein.

Bodyweight Walking Lunge.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar shuru karein, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur haath kulhon par rakhein.
Ek taang se aage qadam barhayein, ghutne mor kar kulhe neeche le jayein. Itna neeche jayein ke peeche wala ghutna taqreeban zameen ko chhu le. Posture seedha rahe aur aage wala ghutna aage wale paon ke oopar rahe.
Aage wale paon ki aedi se zor lagayein aur dono ghutne seedhe kar ke wapas oopar aa jayein.
Peeche wale paon se aage qadam barhayein aur doosri taang par lunge dohrayein.

Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends.name_ur: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch Side Bends ke saath
Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends.instructions_ur:
Cable machine ke har baazu par ek standard handle lagayein, aur unhein sab se neeche wali position par set karein.
Bosu Ball lein aur usay cable machine ke saamne beech mein rakhein.
Bosu Ball par is tarah let jayein ke kamar ka nichla hissa ball ke gird mura hua ho. Aap ke kulhe farsh ke qareeb hon magar usay chhoo na rahe hon.
Dono haath peeche le ja kar har cable ka handle pakren.
Paon chauri stance mein rakh kar baazu seedhe apne saamne aur ghutnon ke darmiyan phailayein. Haath ghutnon ki oonchai par hone chahiyein.
Baazu seedhe aur cable ke upar ki taraf jate zaviye ki seedh mein rakhein. Baazu girane ya modne ke baghair crunch ki tarah dhad ko upar uthayein.
Baazuon ko sakht position mein rakhein. Aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche aayein, kamar Bosu Ball ke gird mudi hui ho aur pait ke muscles khinche hue hon.
Yehi harkat tab tak dohrayein jab tak mazeed na kar sakein.
Jab mazeed na kar sakein, to abs sakht rakhein aur dhad ko plank position mein uthayein taake kamar Bosu Ball se upar ho.
Baazu neeche side mein le aayein; unhein seedha rakhein. Baari baari side bends shuru karein; ediyon tak pahunchne ki koshish karein! Yeh aakhri harkat obliques par focus karegi.

Bosu Ball Push Up.instructions_ur:
Bosu ball ko flat side neeche kar ke farsh par rakhein.
Farsh par ghutno ke bal ho jayein, baazu poore seedhe kar ke ball par rakhein aur jism seedha rakhein.
Pet andar khench kar aur jism seedha rakhte hue, kohniyan mor kar seena ball tak neeche layein.
Ek lamhe ke liye rukein aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

Bottoms Up.instructions_ur:
Zameen par kamar ke bal let kar shuru karein. Taangein seedhi aur baazu side par hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Harkat karne ke liye kulhe aur ghutne mor kar ghutno ko seene ki taraf layein. Is ke baad taangon ko seedha apne upar uthayein taake woh zameen ke perpendicular hon. Pelvis ko ghuma kar upar uthayein taake glutes zameen se uth jayein.
Thora sa rukne ke baad wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein kettlebell pakar kar seedhe khare ho kar exercise shuru karein.
Kettlebell ko zor se peeche swing karein aur phir zor se harkat ulat dein. Kettlebell ke handle ko jitna zor se ho sake dabayein aur kettlebell ko apne kandhe tak uthayein.

Box Jump.instructions_ur: bench ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Box Jump (Multiple Response).instructions_ur:
Box ya platform ki taraf munh kar ke aaraam se khare ho jayein, taqreeban ek baazu ke faasle par. Baazu side par neeche hon aur taangein halki si mori hon.
Shuruati zor ke liye baazuon ki madad lete hue oopar aur aage ki taraf jump karein, aur dono paon ek saath box ya platform ke oopar land karein.
Foran neeche utar jayein ya jump kar ke wapas pehli jagah par aa jayein; phir yeh silsila dohrayein.

Box Skip.instructions_ur:
Aapko kai boxes chahiye honge jo taqreeban 8 feet ke faasle par qataar mein rakhe hon.
Pehle box ki taraf mun kar ke shuru karein, ek taang doosri se thora peeche ho.
Pichhli taang se zor laga kar kulhon ko jitna ho sake unchai tak le jane ki koshish karein.
Box par utarte hi foran doosri taang ko aage aur upar dhakelein taake unchai aur faasla mile, aur box se chhalang lagayein. Pehle do boxes ke darmiyan usi taang par utrein jo pehle box par utri thi.
Phir agle box par qadam rakhein aur dohrayein.

Box Squat.instructions_ur:
Box squat se aap pasand ki gehrai tak squat kar sakte hain aur squat movement mein dhamakedar taaqat banti hai. Power rack mein khare hon aur apne peeche munasib unchai ka box rakhein. Aam tor par aisi unchai ka box rakha jata hai jo aap ko parallel squat tak le jaye, lekin chahein to oonchi ya neechi training bhi kar sakte hain.
Bar ke neeche aayein aur use kandhon ke pichle hisse par rakhein. Shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein aur kohniyan aage ki taraf ghumayein, jaise bar ko kandhon par morna chahte hon. Bar ko rack se uthayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein mazboot kham banayein, aur peeche hat kar position mein aayein. Kamar, glutes, adductors aur hamstrings par zyada zor ke liye paon chaure rakhein, ya quads ke liye qareeb rakhein. Sar saamne ki taraf rakhein.
Kamar, kandhe aur core tight rakhte hue, ghutne aur kulhe bahar dhakelein aur neeche aana shuru karein. Kulhon ko peeche le ja kar box par baith jayein. Behtar yeh hai ke aap ki pindliyan zameen ke seedhe khari (perpendicular) hon. Box par pohanch kar rukein aur hip flexors ko dheela chhorein. Kabhi bhi box se uchhal kar na uthein.
Wazan eriyon par rakhte hue aur paon aur ghutne bahar dhakelte hue, box se zor laga kar upar uthein aur harkat ki qiyadat sar se karein. Upar jaate rahein, sar se paon tak jism tight rakhte hue.

Box Squat with Bands.instructions_ur:
Power rack mein shuru karein, peeche munasib unchai ka box rakha ho. Bands ko sleeves par lagayein aur unhein band pegs, rack ya dumbbells se is tarah bandhein ke munasib tension ho. Agar dumbbells istemal kar rahe hain to unhein mazbooti se rakhein taake woh hilein nahi. Yeh bhi yaqeeni banayein ke dumbbells istemal ho rahe bands ke liye kaafi bhaari hon. Dumbbells ko dabaye rakhne ke liye mazeed plates istemal ho sakti hain. Agar zyada tension chahiye to farsh par base chaura kar sakte hain ya bands ko choke kar sakte hain. Aam taur par box ki unchai aisi rakhein ke aap parallel squat tak pohanchein, lekin chahein to unchi ya neechi bhi train kar sakte hain.
Bar ke neeche qadam rakh kar use kandhon ke peeche rakhein. Shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein aur kohniyan aage ki taraf ghumayein, jaise bar ko kandhon par mor rahe hon. Bar ko rack se uthayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein tight arch banayein, aur peeche qadam le kar position mein aa jayein. Kamar, glutes, adductors aur hamstrings par zyada zor ke liye paon chaure rakhein, ya quads ke liye paon qareeb rakhein. Sar ka rukh aage rakhein.
Kamar, kandhe aur core tight rakhte hue ghutne aur kulhe bahar ki taraf dhakel kar neeche aana shuru karein. Kulhon ko peeche le jayein yahan tak ke aap box par baith jayein. Behtar hai ke pindliyan zameen se 90 degree par hon. Box par pohanch kar rukein aur hip flexors ko dheela chhorein. Box se kabhi bounce na karein.
Wazan ediyon par rakhte hue aur paon aur ghutne bahar dhakelte hue, box se upar ki taraf zor lagayein aur harkat ki qayadat sar se karein. Sar se paon tak tightness qaim rakhte hue upar uthte rahein. Barbell ko ehtiyat se wapas rack mein rakhein.

Box Squat with Chains.instructions_ur:
Power rack mein shuru karein, aur apne peeche munasib unchai ka box rakhein. Aam taur par box ki unchai aisi ho ke aap parallel squat tak pohanchein, lekin chahein to oonchi ya neechi unchai par bhi train kar sakte hain.
Chains set karne ke liye pehle leader chain ko bar ki sleeves par lapetein. Bhaari chain ko snap hook se jorein. Lead chain ki lambai aisi adjust karein ke harkat ke oopar wale hisse mein bhi kuch kariyan farsh par rahein.
Bar ke neeche aa kar use kandhon ke peeche rakhein. Shoulder blades ko aapas mein dabayein aur kohniyan aage ghumayein, jaise bar ko kandhon par morne ki koshish kar rahe hon. Bar ko rack se uthayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein mazboot kham banayein, aur peeche qadam le kar position mein aa jayein. Kamar, glutes, adductors aur hamstrings par zyada zor ke liye paon chaure rakhein, ya quads ke liye paon qareeb rakhein. Sar seedha aage rakhein.
Kamar, kandhe aur core ko sakht rakhte hue neeche aana shuru karte waqt ghutne aur kulhe bahar ki taraf dhakelein. Kulhon se peeche baithte jayein jab tak box par baith na jayein. Behtar hai ke pindliyon ki haddi zameen ke perpendicular ho. Box par pohanch kar ruk jayein aur hip flexors ko dheela chhor dein. Kabhi bhi box se uchhal kar na uthein.
Wazan aediyon par rakhte hue aur paon aur ghutne bahar dhakelte hue, sar se harkat ki rehnumai karte hue box se zor laga kar oopar uthein. Sar se paon tak jism ko sakht rakhte hue oopar aate rahein.

Brachialis-SMR.instructions_ur:
Karwat le kar let jayein, upper arm foam roller par rakhein. Upper arm taqreeban jism ki seedh mein ho, aur bicep ka bahar wala hissa foam roller par daba ho.
Kulhe zameen se uthayein, wazan baazu aur paon par rakhein. 10-30 second rokein, phir side badlein.

Bradford/Rocky Presses.instructions_ur:
Military Press Bench par baith jayein, bar kandhon ki unchai par ho aur pronated grip (hatheliyan aage ki taraf) se pakrein. Tip: Grip kandhon ke faasle se chauri honi chahiye aur barbell neeche aate waqt forearm aur upper arm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle banna chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Sahi grip se barbell uthane ke baad baazu lock karte hue bar ko sar ke oopar le jayein.
Ab saans andar lete hue bar ko aahista aahista sar ke peeche neeche layein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko wapas shuruati position tak uthayein.
Saans andar lete hue bar ko aahista aahista shuruati position mein neeche layein. Yeh ek rep hai.
Isi tarah baari baari karte rahein jab tak tay shuda reps poore na ho jayein.

Bridging.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hon aur paon farsh par seedhe jame hon.
Pet andar khenchte hue aur glutes ko tight rakhte hue kulhe farsh se upar uthayein.

Bulgarian Split Squat.instructions_ur: dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Bulgarian Split Squats Left.instructions_ur:
Kursi ke saamne seedhe khare ho jayein aur ek bara qadam aage rakhein. Ek paon ka upar wala hissa kursi par rakh dein.
Aage wala ghutna moorein, baazuon se balance karte hue, jab tak pichla ghutna zameen ko taqreeban chhoo na le.
Zor laga kar wapas shuruati position mein aayein aur dohrayein.

Bulgarian Squat with Dumbbells.instructions_ur: Bulgarian split squat mein ek taang par squat kiya jata hai jabke peechle paon ko ek oonchi jagah par rakha jata hai. Peechli taang ko bench par uthane se balance mushkil hota hai aur exercise ki range of motion barh jati hai.

Burpee.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Bus Drivers.instructions_ur: Weight plate ko steering wheel ki tarah dono haathon mein pakad kar baith jayein; usay aankhon ki oonchai se thora neeche tak uthayein

Butt Lift (Bridge).instructions_ur:
Zameen par kamar ke bal seedhe let jayein, haath pehluon mein aur ghutne mude hue. Paon taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Zyada tar ediyon se zor lagate hue, kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhe zameen se uthayein. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein aur upar ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Butt-Ups.instructions_ur:
Pushup position mein shuru karein lekin kohniyan zameen par hon aur wazan forearms par ho. Baazu 90 degree ke angle par mude hon.
Kamar ko bilkul seedha rakhne ke bajaye thora sa upar ki taraf arch karein.
Glutes ko chhat ki taraf uthayein, abs ko zor se sukerein taake pasliyon aur kulhon ke darmiyan faasla kam ho. Aakhir mein aap high bridge position mein honge. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche aayein. Tip: Kamar ko neeche latakne na dein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Butterfly.instructions_ur:
Machine par baith jayein, kamar pad ke saath seedhi lagi ho.
Handles pakar lein. Tip: Baazu ka upar wala hissa farsh ke parallel hona chahiye; machine isi hisaab se adjust karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Seene ko beech mein dabate hue aahista aahista handles ko aapas mein milayein. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein aur ek second ke liye tight position rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas jayein jab tak seene ke muscles poori tarah stretch na ho jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Weight munasib miqdaar par set karein aur handles pakar kar baith jayein. Upper arms jism se taqreeban 45 degree par hon, sar aur seena upar. Kohniyan taqreeban 90 degree tak mudi hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni seedhi karte hue handles ko apne bilkul saamne ek saath press karein. Harkat ke dauran shoulder blades peeche kheenche rakhein.
Poora phailne par ruk kar, cables par tension barqarar rakhte hue shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Aap yeh harkat kamar pad se hata kar, incline ya decline par, ya baari baari haathon se bhi kar sakte hain.

Cable Concentration Curl.instructions_ur: Concentration curl biceps ko ek ek baazu se banane ki ek classic exercise hai. Yeh jhuk kar ya ghutno ke bal bhi ki ja sakti hai, magar zyada tar bench par baith kar ki jati hai. Yeh biceps ki peak ko ubhaarne ke liye behtareen hai aur aksar biceps workout ke aakhir mein ki jati hai

Cable Crossover.instructions_ur: Cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Cable Crunch.instructions_ur: Cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Cable Curl.instructions_ur: cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Cable Deadlifts.instructions_ur:
Cables ko towers ke sab se neeche le jayein aur munasib weight chunein. Dono uprights ke bilkul beech mein khare ho jayein.
Shuru karne ke liye kulhe aur ghutne mod kar squat karte hue neeche jayein yahan tak ke handles tak pahunch sakein.
Handles pakadne ke baad upar uthna shuru karein. Ediyon se zor lagate hue kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karein, haath side mein latke rahein. Poori harkat ke dauran sar aur seena upar rakhein.
Poori tarah khare hone ke baad wapas shuruati position mein aayein aur dohrayein.

Cable Front Raise with a small bar.name_ur: Chhoti bar ke saath Cable Saamne Raise
Cable Front Raise with a small bar.instructions_ur:
Chhoti bar ke saath Cable Front Raise aap ke anterior deltoids (kandhon ka saamne wala hissa) ko musalsal tension de kar alag se kaam karwata hai. Is mein aap low pulley ki taraf peeth kar ke khare hote hain, bar ko overhand grip se pakarte hain, aur halke mude hue baazuon ke saath use saamne kandhon ki unchai tak uthate hain, jhulne se bachte hue aur core tight rakhte hue taa ke upar neeche harkat control mein rahe. Halka se darmiyana wazan istemal karein, aur aahista, control wale reps par dhyan dein taa ke muscle ka kaam mehsoos ho, momentum ka nahi.
Cable Front Raise (Bar) kaise karein
Setup: Chhoti seedhi bar ko low cable pulley se lagayein. Wazan halka ya darmiyana rakhein.
Shuruati position: Machine ki taraf peeth kar ke khare hon, bar ko overhand grip (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) se kulhon ki satah par pakrein, baazu seedhe lekin lock nahi. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par, core tight, kandhe peeche aur neeche.
Uthana: Saans bahar nikaalein aur aahista aahista bar ko apne saamne seedha upar uthayein, kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakhte hue, yahan tak ke haath kandhon ki unchai (ya thora neeche) tak pohanch jayein.
Rokna: Top par thora sa rukein aur saamne wale delts ko sukerein.
Neeche laana: Saans andar lete hue aahista aur control ke saath bar ko wapas shuruati position tak layein, tension barqarar rakhte hue.

Cable Glute Extension.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise glutes ke upar wale, ya bare, hisse par kaam karti hai. Is wajah se, glutes ki training ke liye isolated exercises ki routine mein yeh kabhi missing nahi honi chahiye.
Cable machine ke saamne khare hon aur low pulley dhoondein. Phir low pulley par kaam karne ke liye ankle strap lagayein. Posture ke liye, har waqt seedhe khare rahein. Chot se bachne ke liye kamar seedhi rakhne par khaas dhyan dein.
Behtar balance ke liye machine ko pakar lena behtar hai. Jis taang par cable ka weight hai, us se ghutna mode baghair aahista aahista peeche ki taraf stretch karein.

Cable Hammer Curls - Rope Attachment.instructions_ur:
Low pulley par rope attachment lagayein aur machine ki taraf munh karke us se taqreeban 12 inch door khare hon.
Rope ko neutral (hatheliyan andar) grip se pakrein aur kamar ka qudrati kham aur dhad saakit rakhte hue seedhe khare hon.
Kohniyan apni side par rakhein aur poori harkat ke dauran unhein wahin saakit rakhein. Tip: Sirf forearms harkat karein; upper arms nahi. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Biceps istemal karte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue baazu upar kheenchein jab tak biceps forearms ko na chhoo lein. Tip: Kohniyan andar aur upper arms saakit rakhna yaad rakhein.
1 second ke contraction ke baad jis mein biceps sukerein, aahista aahista weight ko wapas asal position mein lana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Incline Pushdown.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par high pulley machine ki taraf peeth kar ke let jayein, jis par straight bar attachment laga ho.
Straight bar attachment ko sar ke upar pronated (overhand; hatheliyan neeche) grip se kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakrein aur baazu apne saamne seedhe karein. Bar aapki upper raanon se taqreeban 2 inch door honi chahiye. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Upper baazu ko hilaye baghair, baazuon ko aadhe daire (semi circle) mein peeche le jayein jab tak bar seedha aapke sar ke upar na aa jaye. Movement ke is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Lats ka istemal karte hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein aur shuruati position par pohanch kar contraction ko roke rakhein. Is movement ke dauran saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Incline Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par high pulley machine ki taraf peeth kar ke let jayein, jis par straight bar attachment laga ho.
Straight bar attachment ko sar ke upar pronated (overhand; hatheliyan neeche) tang grip (kandhon ke faasle se kam) se pakrein aur kohniyan apne pehluon ke saath jor kar rakhein. Farsh se naapne par aapke upper baazu taqreeban 25 degree ka angle banayein.
Upper baazu ko hilaye baghair, triceps ko sikorte hue baazu seedhe karein. Movement ke is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein aur contraction ko ek second roke rakhein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Internal Rotation.instructions_ur:
Low pulley ke saath side ki taraf baith jayein (taangein saamne phaila kar ya cross kar ke) aur cable ke qareeb wale baazu se single hand cable attachment pakrein. Tip: Agar pulley ki oonchai adjust ho sakti hai to aap baithne ke liye flat bench bhi istemal kar sakte hain.
Kohni ko apne pehlu ke saath laga kar 90° par mor kar rakhein aur baazu pulley ki taraf ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kandhe ko andar ki taraf ghumate hue single hand cable attachment ko apne jism ki taraf khenchein, jab tak aapka forearm pet ke saamne na aa jaye. Aap ek khayali aadha daira bana rahe honge. Tip: Forearm har waqt aapke dhad ke saath 90 degree par rehna chahiye.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir doosre baazu se yahi movement karein.

Cable Iron Cross.instructions_ur:
Shuru mein pulleys ko oonchi position par le jayein, resistance chunein, aur har haath mein ek handle pakar lein.
Dono pulleys ke bilkul darmiyan khare ho jayein aur baazu dono side par phaila dein. Sar aur seena upar hon aur baazu "T" ki shakal banayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan seedhi rakhte hue, baazuon ko seedha apni side ki taraf neeche kheenchein.
Poori tarah sukerne ki position par thoda ruk kar baazuon ko wapas shuruati position mein le jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat jaari rakhein.

Cable Judo Flip.instructions_ur:
Tower par rope attachment lagayein, aur cable ko sab se neechi pulley position par le jayein. Cable ki taraf side kar ke chauri stance mein khare hon, aur dono haathon se rope pakrein.
Jism ko pulley se door ki taraf ghumayein aur rope ko kandhe ke upar se layein, jaise aap judo flip kar rahe hon.
Ghumte aur aage crunch karte hue weight ko ek paon se doosre paon par le jayein, aur cable ko neeche kheenchein.
Wapas shuruati position mein aayein aur tab tak dohrayein jab tak mazeed na kar sakein.
Phir position badal kar doosri side par yehi harkatein dohrayein.

Cable Lateral Raise.instructions_ur: cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Cable Lying Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur low pulley ke straight bar attachment ko tang overhand grip se pakrein. Tip: Sab se aasaan tareeqa yeh hai ke letne ke waqt koi aapko bar pakra de.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue bar ko apne dhad ke upar le aayein. Aapke baazu aur dhad 90 degree ka angle banayein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Upper baazu ko hilaye baghair aur kohniyan andar rakhte hue, kohni se mor kar bar neeche layein. Itna neeche jayein ke bar halka sa aapke maathe ko chhoo le. Movement ke is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Triceps ko sikorte hue bar ko wapas shuruati position par uthayein. Movement ke is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein.
Contracted position par ek second rukein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable One Arm Tricep Extension.name_ur: Ek baazu se Cable Tricep Extension
Cable One Arm Tricep Extension.instructions_ur:
Seedhe haath se high-cable pulley par lage single handle ko supinated (underhand; hatheliyan upar) grip se pakrein. Aap weight stack ke bilkul saamne khare hon.
Ab handle ko neeche khenchein taake aapka upper baazu aur kohni jism ke pehlu ke saath lock ho jayein. Upper baazu aur forearm ek tang angle (90 degree se kam) banayein. Doosra baazu kamar par rakh sakte hain, aur behtar balance ke liye ek taang aage aur doosri peeche rakh sakte hain. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Triceps ko sikorte hue single handle attachment ko apne pehlu ki taraf neeche layein jab tak baazu seedha na ho jaye. Yeh movement karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Sirf forearm hilna chahiye. Upper baazu har waqt saakit rehna chahiye.
Triceps ko daba kar is contracted position mein ek second rukein.
Aahista aahista handle ko shuruati position par wapas layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir doosre baazu se yahi movement karein.

Cable Preacher Curl.instructions_ur:
Preacher bench ko pulley machine se taqreeban 2 feet aage rakhein.
Low pulley par straight bar lagayein.
Preacher bench par baith jayein, kohni aur upper baazu bench pad ke upar mazbooti se rakhein aur kisi se kahein ke low pulley se bar aapko pakra de.
Bar pakrein aur preacher bench pad ke upar baazu poori tarah seedhe karein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ab weight ko kandhon ki taraf upar khenchna shuru karein aur movement ke top par biceps ko zor se dabayein. Yeh movement karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Top par ek second rukein bhi.
Ab aahista aahista weight ko shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Pull-Through.instructions_ur: cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Cable Rear Delt Fly.instructions_ur:
Pulleys ko munasib unchai par set karein aur wazan adjust karein. Pulleys aapke sar se upar honi chahiye.
Baayein pulley ko daayein haath se aur daayein pulley ko baayein haath se pakrein, aur unhein apne saamne cross karein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu peeche aur bahar ki taraf le ja kar harkat shuru karein, harkat ke dauran baazu seedhe rakhein.
Harkat ke aakhir mein rukein, phir handles ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.

Cable Reverse Crunch.instructions_ur:
Low pulley cable par ankle strap attachment lagayein aur uske saamne farsh par mat bichha dein.
Paon pulley ki taraf kar ke baith jayein aur cable ko takhnon se jor lein.
Let jayein, taangein uthayein aur ghutnon ko 90 degree ke angle par mor lein. Aap ki taangein aur cable ek seedh mein honi chahiyein. Agar nahi hain to pulley ko oopar ya neeche adjust karein.
Haath sar ke peeche rakhte hue ghutnon ko andar dhad ki taraf layein aur kulhon ko farsh se uthayein.
Ek lamhe ke liye ruk jayein aur aahista aur control ke saath kulhe neeche layein aur taangon ko wapas shuruati 90 degree ke angle par le aayein. Aaraam wali position mein bhi abs par tension rehni chahiye.
Yehi harkat failure tak dohrayein.

Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Pulley machine ki neeche wali pulley par rope lagayein.
Dono haathon se rope pakar kar, neutral grip (hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf) ke saath baazu seedhe karein aur haath bilkul sar ke upar le jayein. Kohniyan sar ke qareeb hon aur baazu farsh ke perpendicular hon, ungliyon ke jod chhat ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu ke upar wale hisse ko saakit rakhte hue aahista aahista rope ko sar ke peeche neeche layein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans andar lein aur jab triceps poori tarah stretch ho jayein to ruk jayein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps ko sukerte hue wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Rope Rear-Delt Rows.instructions_ur:
Low pulley row station par usi position mein baithein jaise kamar ke liye baith kar cable rows karte waqt baithte hain.
Pulley par rope lagayein aur use overhand grip se pakrein. Baazu seedhe aur farsh ke parallel hon aur kohniyan bahar ki taraf khuli hon.
Kamar ka nichla hissa seedha rakhein aur kulhe peeche le jayein taake ghutne thore mude hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan upar aur side mein rakhte hue cable attachment ko seene ke upar wale hisse ki taraf, gardan se bilkul neeche tak kheenchein. Saans bahar nikaalte hue yeh harkat jaari rakhein jab tak kohniyan kamar se thora peeche na chali jayein. Tip: Poori harkat ke dauran upar ke baazu horizontal, dhad ke perpendicular aur farsh ke parallel rakhein.
Wapas shuruati position mein jayein jahan baazu seedhe hon aur kandhe aage ki taraf stretch hon. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Russian Twists.instructions_ur:
Standard handle attachment lagayein aur cable ko darmiyani pulley position par set karein.
Stability ball par cable ke perpendicular let jayein aur ek haath se handle pakrein. Aap pulley se taqreeban ek baazu ke faasle par hon, aur cable par wazan ki tension ho.
Dono haathon se handle pakrein aur baazu seene ke upar poori tarah seedhe karein. Aapke haath pulley ki bilkul seedh mein hon. Agar na hon to pulley ko upar ya neeche adjust karein jab tak seedh mein na aa jayein.
Kulhe upar aur abs engaged rakhein. Dhad ko pulley se doosri taraf poore quarter rotation tak ghumayein. Aapka jism sar se ghutnon tak seedha (flat) hona chahiye.
Ek lamha rukein aur aahista aahista control ke saath wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein. Aaram ki position mein bhi cable par side tension honi chahiye.
Yahi harkat failure tak dohrayein.
Phir position badal kar doosri taraf yahi tamaam harkatein dohrayein.

Cable Seated Crunch.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par baith jayein, kamar high pulley ki taraf ho.
Cable rope attachment ko dono haathon se pakrein (hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf hon) aur haathon ko mazbooti se dono kandhon ke upar rakhein. Tip: Wazan ko kamar ke nichle hisse ko thora sa peeche khinchne dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe saakit rakhte hue kamar se aage jhukein taake kohniyan kulhon ki taraf jayein. Yeh step karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Seated Lateral Raise.instructions_ur:
Do aamne saamne low pulleys ke beech mein khare ho jayein aur apne theek peeche ek flat bench rakhein (aap ke perpendicular; bench ka tang kinara aap ke peeche ho). Har pulley par istemal hone wala weight select karein.
Ab peeche rakhe flat bench ke kinare par baith jayein aur paon ghutnon ke aage rakhein.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue aage jhukein aur dhad ko raanon par tika dein.
Kisi se pulleys se jure single handles pakarwayein. Weight select karne ke baad left pulley ko right haath se aur right pulley ko left haath se pakrein. Pulleys aap ke ghutnon ke neeche se guzarein aur baazu seedhe hon, hatheliyan aamne saamne aur kohniyon mein halka sa kham ho. Yeh shuruati position hogi.
Baazuon ko saakit rakhte hue upper arms ko side ki taraf itna uthayein ke woh farsh ke parallel aur kandhon ki unchai par aa jayein. Yeh harkat karte waqt saans bahar nikaalein aur ek second ke liye contraction rok kar rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue baazuon ko aahista aahista shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein. Tip: Poori exercise mein upper arms dhad ke perpendicular aur kohni ki position fix (10 se 30 degree ka angle) rakhein.

Cable Shoulder Press.instructions_ur:
Cables ko towers ke neeche tak le jayein aur munasib wazan chunein.
Dono uprights ke bilkul darmiyan khare ho jayein. Cables pakdein aur unhein kandhon ki unchai par rakhein, hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Sar aur seena upar rakhte hue, kohniyan seedhi karke handles ko seedha sar ke upar press karein.
Top par rukne ke baad, wapas shuruati position mein aayein aur dohrayein.

Cable Shoulder Shrugs.instructions_ur:
Cable machine par pulley ko sab se neeche wali setting par lagayein.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, pet andar khencha hua aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
Pulley ko kamar ki oonchai se shuru karein.
Pulley ko pakrein aur baazu seedhe rakhte hue kandhe upar uchkayein (shrug karein).
Is position mein thori der rukein phir control ke saath pulley ko kamar ki oonchai wali shuruati position par wapas layein.

Cable Shrugs.instructions_ur:
Low pulley se lagi cable bar attachment ko kandhon ke barabar ya thori chauri overhand (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) grip se pakrein.
Pulley ke qareeb seedhe khare ho jayein, baazu saamne seedhe hon aur bar pakri ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ko jitna ho sake upar utha kar bar ko uthayein. Upar contraction ko ek second rokein. Tip: Baazu hamesha seedhe rehne chahiye. Bar uthane ke liye biceps istemal na karein. Sirf kandhe upar neeche hone chahiye.
Bar ko wapas asal position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cable Wrist Curl.instructions_ur:
Low pulley cable ke saamne flat bench rakhein jis par seedhi bar attachment lagi ho.
Cable bar ko tang se kandhon ke barabar supinated grip (hatheliyan upar) se pakrein aur baazu upar layein taa ke forearms raanon ke upar tike hon. Aap ki kalaiyan ghutnon se zara aage latki honi chahiyein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kalai ko upar ki taraf curl karein. Ek second tak sukerein rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista kalaiyan wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Forearms saakit rehne chahiyein kyunke is exercise mein sirf kalai ki harkat chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Calf Press.instructions_ur:
Seat ko aise adjust karein ke shuruati position mein taangein sirf halki si mudi hon. Paon ke panje platform par mazbooti se tike hone chahiyein.
Munasib weight chunein, aur handles pakrein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne seedhe karke taangein seedhi karein, weight ko stack se bas zara sa uthayein. Aapka takhna poori tarah mura hona chahiye, paon ki ungliyan upar ki taraf. Paon ke panjon se jitna ho sake neeche ki taraf dabate hue harkat karein.
Thora ruk kar, harkat ulti karein aur dohrayein.

Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine.name_ur: Leg Press Machine par Calf Press
Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine.instructions_ur:
Leg press machine par baith jayein aur taangein apne bilkul saamne platform par medium (kandhon ke barabar) paon ke faasle par rakhein.
Weighted platform ko thaamne wali safety bars neeche karein aur platform ko poora upar dhakelein jab tak taangein saamne poori seedhi na ho jayein, lekin ghutne lock na karein. (Note: Kuch leg press machines mein aap ziyada hifazat ke liye safety bars lagi reh sakte hain. Agar aapki machine is ki ijazat deti hai to exercise karne ka yahi behtar tareeqa hai.) Aapka dhad aur taangein bilkul 90 degree ka angle banayein. Ab ehtiyat se apni ungliyan aur paon ke panje platform ke nichle hisse par rakhein aur aediyan bahar latki hon. Ungliyan saamne, bahar ya andar ki taraf hon jaisa chapter ke shuru mein bataya gaya hai. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aediyan utha kar platform ko dabayein, takhnon ko jitna ho sake upar seedha karein aur calf ko sikorein. Khayal rakhein ke ghutna har waqt saakit rahe. Kisi waqt bhi mor nahi aana chahiye. Wapas neeche aane se pehle contracted position ko ek second roke rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein, aediyan neeche karte hue takhne moren jab tak calves stretch na ho jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Calf Raise On A Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Balance ke liye kisi mazboot cheez ko pakdein aur dumbbell ke handle par khare ho jayein, behtar hai ke gol plates wala ho taake woh lurhke, is tarah aap ko khud ko saakit rakhne ke liye zyada mehnat karni padegi; is se exercise ka asar badh jata hai.
Ab apne paon ko thoda aage rol karein taake pindli mein achha stretch mehsoos ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Paon ko handle ke upar se rol karte hue pindli ko uthayein taake poora extension mile. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Top par pindli ko zor se sukerein aur ek second rokein. Tip: Upar aate hue dumbbell ko thoda peeche ki taraf rol karein.
Ab saans andar lein aur neeche aate hue dumbbell ko thoda aage rol karein taake behtar stretch mile.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Calf Raises with Band.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein resistance ke liye band istemal hota hai.
Exercise band par panjon ke bal khare hon aur handles ko kandhon tak upar uthayein.
Haath kandhon ke paas rakhte hue panjon ke bal upar uthein.
Thori der rukein aur phir aediyan farsh par neeche layein.
Dohrayein.

Calf Stretch Elbows Against Wall.name_ur: Deewar se Kohniyan laga kar Calf Stretch
Calf Stretch Elbows Against Wall.instructions_ur:
Deewar ki taraf munh kar ke do teen feet door khare ho jayein.
Deewar par jhuk jayein aur wazan forearms par daal dein.
Koshish karein ke aediyan zameen par rahein. 10-20 second tak rokein. Aap deewar se door ya qareeb ho kar ise mushkil ya aasaan bana sakte hain.

Calf Stretch Hands Against Wall.name_ur: Deewar par haath rakh kar Calf Stretch
Calf Stretch Hands Against Wall.instructions_ur:
Deewar se kuch feet door uski taraf munh karke khare ho jayein. Stance aage peeche karein, ek paon aage rakhein.
Aage jhukein aur haath deewar par rakhein, edi, kulha aur sar ek seedhi line mein rakhein.
Edi zameen par rakhne ki koshish karein. 10-20 seconds rokein aur phir side badlein.

Calf-Machine Shoulder Shrug.instructions_ur:
Calf machine par is tarah position lein ke shoulder pads aap ke kandhon ke upar hon. Dhad seedha ho aur baazu aam tor par side par seedhe hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ko kaanon ki taraf upar uthayein aur poore ek second tak sukerein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Calves Foam Roller.instructions_ur: Apni pindliyon ko foam roller par aahista aahista chalayein

Calves-SMR.instructions_ur:
Zameen par baith kar shuru karein. Nichli taang ke neeche foam roller rakhein. Doosri taang ya to pehli ke upar cross ho ya zameen par rakhi ho aur kuch wazan sambhale. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Haath pehluon mein ya thora peeche rakhein, aur neeche dabaa kar kulhe zameen se uthayein, taa ke zyada wazan pindli ke muscle par aaye. Ghutne ke neeche se takhne ke upar tak roll karein, tension wali jagahon par 10-30 second rukein. Doosri taang ke liye dohrayein.

Captain's Chair Knee Raise.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position
Captain's chair (vertical knee raise station) mein aa jayein. Forearms pads par rakhein aur handles pakrein. Upper body seedha rakhein, seedha saamne dekhein aur kamar pad se laga kar rakhein, usay gol ya mehraab jaisa na karein. Taangein taqreeban seedhi hon aur ghutnon mein halka sa kham ho, paon zameen se upar hon aur taangein aapas mein mili hon.
Harkat
Mudi hui taangein upar kheenchein, ghutnon ko seene ki taraf layein. Sirf utna upar jayein jitna achhi form ke saath mumkin ho, aur taangein poora waqt aapas mein mili rahein. Phir saans andar lete hue taangein wapas neeche layein, paon zameen par rakhe baghair.

Captain's Chair Oblique Knee Raise.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position
Captain's chair (dip station) mein aa jayein. Forearms pads par rakhein aur handles mazbooti se pakrein. Kamar seedhi aur pad ke qareeb rakhein aur seedha saamne dekhein. Taangein is tarah moorein ke raan aur pindli taqreeban seedha zaawiya (right angle) banayein.
Harkat
Ghutne upar uthayein aur saath hi taangon ko thora ek taraf, taqreeban 30-45 degree, ghumayein, raanon ko zameen ke mutawazi rakhte hue. Phir yahi doosri taraf karein. Aap beech mein thora ruk sakte hain ya seedha doosri taraf ja sakte hain.

Car Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Is event ke apparatus mein aam tor par neutral grip handles hote hain, lekin kuch mein seedha bar hota hai jise aap aam deadlift ki tarah utha sakte hain. Apparatus par gaadi ya doosri bhaari cheezein jaise tractor ke tyre ya kegs load kiye ja sakte hain.
Agar aap squat mein mazboot hain to handles ke beech mein khare hon, aur agar deadlift mein mazboot hain to do inch peeche khare hon. Aap ke paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Handles pakadne ke liye kulhon se jhukein. Paon aur grip set karke, gehri saans lein aur phir kulhe neeche karein aur ghutne modein.
Sar se saamne dekhein, seena upar aur kamar arch rakhein, aur wazan upar uthane ke liye aedhiyon se zor lagana shuru karein. Jaise jaise wazan upar aaye, kulhon ko aage dhakelte hue shoulder blades ko aapas mein khinchein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar aur wazan ko guide karte hue farsh tak neeche layein.

Car Drivers.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho kar barbell plate ko dono haathon se 3 aur 9 baje ki positions par pakrein. Hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf hon aur baazu saamne seedhe phaile hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Plate ko ek taraf jitna ho sake ghuma kar harkat shuru karein. Wahi harkat karein jo steering wheel ko ek taraf ghumane mein karte hain.
Harkat ulti karein aur plate ko poori tarah doosri taraf ghumayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Carioca Quick Step.instructions_ur:
Apne paon kuch inch ke faasle par rakh kar shuru karein aur baayan baazu dheeli, athletic position mein upar ho.
Daayein paon se tezi se peeche qadam rakhein aur ghutna upar khinchein.
Daayan ghutna khinchte waqt apne baazu tezi se wapas upar le jayein, dhyan rakhein ke ghutna seedha upar aur neeche jaye. Chalte hue paon ko mat ghumayein aur side ki taraf jaate hue saamne dekhte rahein.

Cat Stretch.instructions_ur:
Zameen par haathon aur ghutnon ke bal aa jayein.
Pait andar kheenchein aur reerh ki haddi, kamar ka nichla hissa, kandhe aur gardan gol karein, sar ko neeche dheela chhor dein.
15 second tak rukein.

Cat-Cow Stretch.instructions_ur: Baghair equipment ke tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Catch and Overhead Throw.instructions_ur:
Deewar ya partner ki taraf mun kar ke khare ho kar shuru karein.
Dono haathon se ball ko sar ke peeche le jayein, jitna ho sake stretch karein, aur ball ko zor se aage phenkein.
Throw ko poora follow through karein, aur throw se wapas aane wali ball pakarne ke liye tayyar rahein. Agar deewar par phenk rahe hain to deewar ke itne qareeb khare hon ke wapas aati ball pakar sakein, aur partner ke muqable mein thora upar nishana lagayein.

Chain Handle Extension.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko do cable handle attachments, ek flat bench aur chains chahiye hongi. Chains ke beech wale hisse ko handles se jor dein, aur flat bench par position lein. Kohniyan seedhi upar ki taraf hon.
Upper arm ko saakit rakhte hue kohni se seedha karna shuru karein, kalaiyan pronated (neeche ki taraf mori hui) hon.
Lockout par rukein, aur harkat ulti kar ke shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Chain Press.instructions_ur:
Chains ko cable handle attachments se jor kar shuru karein. Flat bench par usi position mein aayein jaise dumbbell press ke liye. Kalaiyan pronated aur baazu farsh ke perpendicular hone chahiyein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan mod kar chains ko neeche layein, chain ka kuch hissa farsh par utar dein.
Jab tak kohni 90 degree ka angle na bana le jaari rakhein, aur phir kohni seedhi karte hue lockout tak harkat ulti karein.

Chair Leg Extended Stretch.name_ur: Kursi par Taang phaila kar Stretch
Chair Leg Extended Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kursi par seedhe baith jayein aur seat ko dono taraf se pakrein.
Ek taang uthayein, ghutna seedha karein aur saath hi takhna morein.
Aahista aahista us taang ko jitna ho sake bahar ki taraf le jayein, phir wapas beech mein aur neeche layein.
Doosri taang ke liye dohrayein.

Chair Lower Back Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kursi par seedhe baith jayein.
Baazu sar ke upar rakh kar ek taraf jhukein. Khali haath se kursi pakar sakte hain.
10 seconds tak rukein, aur doosri taraf dohrayein.

Chair Squat.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye bar ko apne qad ke mutabiq position par set karein. Bar load hone ke baad uske neeche aa jayein aur use kandhon ke peeche rakhein.
Hatheliyan aage ki taraf rakhte hue bar pakrein, unlock karein aur taangein seedhi kar ke rack se utha lein.
Paon bar se lagbhag 18 inch aage le jayein. Taangein kandhon ke barabar stance mein rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf hon. Har waqt aage dekhein aur reerh ki haddi neutral ya halki si kham daar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Sar oopar aur posture seedha rakhte hue ghutne mor kar aahista aahista bar neeche layein. Tab tak neeche jayein jab tak upper aur lower leg ke darmiyan angle 90 degree se kam na ho jaye.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aediyon se farsh ko dhakel kar bar uthana shuru karein, ghutne seedhe karein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Chair Upper Body Stretch.instructions_ur:
Chair ke kinare par baith jayein, uski back ko pakar kar.
Baazu seedhe karein, kamar seedhi rakhein, aur upper body ko aage kheenchein taake stretch mehsoos ho. 20-30 seconds tak rokein.

Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch.name_ur: Chest aur Kandhon ke Saamne ka Stretch
Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch.instructions_ur:
Taangein saath mila kar khare ho kar shuru karein, bodybar ya jhaaru ka danda pakre hue.
Danda kandhon se thora chauri grip mein pakrein aur hatheliyan neeche ki taraf rakhte hue apne saamne rakhein.
Ehtiyat se danda upar aur sar ke peeche le jayein.

Chest Dip.instructions_ur: Bodyweight ke saath setup karein, movement ko control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Seat ki unchai aise set karein ke grips aap ke seene ke barabar hon.
Taangon se foot pedal ko aage dhakelein.
Handles ko shuruati position mein layein.
Kamar ko back pad se lagaye rakhein aur bahar ki taraf press karein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue handles ko seene se door dhakelein.
Handles ko aaram se andar aane dein yahan tak ke woh seene tak pohanch jayein.
Saans andar lete hue handles ko wapas seene tak aane dein.

Chest Push (multiple response).instructions_ur:
Deewar ki taraf mooh kar ke ghutno ke bal baith kar shuru karein ya kisi partner ki madad lein. Ball ko dono haathon se seene ke saath mazbooti se pakrein.
Kulhon se tezi se aage aur bahar ki taraf zor lagate hue ball ko jitna zor se ho sake dhakelein aur pass karein.
Pass ke baad aage gir kar haathon se khud ko sambhal lein.
Foran seedhi position mein wapas aa jayein. Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Chest Push (single response).instructions_ur:
Ghutno ke bal baith kar shuru karein, medicine ball ko dono haathon se mazbooti se seene ke saath pakar kar rakhein.
Kulhon se zor laga kar aage aur bahar ki taraf dhamake se harkat karte hue ball ko jitna door ho sake dhakelein.
Harkat poori karte hue aage gir jayein aur haathon par khud ko sambhal lein.

Chest Push from 3 point stance.instructions_ur:
Three point stance mein shuru karein, squat karke neeche, kamar seedhi aur ek haath zameen par. Medicine ball ko seedha apne saamne rakhein.
Shuru karne ke liye, pehla qadam lete hue ball ko seene tak kheenchein, throw ki tayyari ke liye dono haath position mein rakhein.
Doosra qadam lete hue, ball ko poore zor se dhamake ke saath aage chhor dein.

Chest Push with Run Release.name_ur: Run Release ke saath Chest Push
Chest Push with Run Release.instructions_ur:
Athletic stance mein shuru karein, ghutne mude hue, kulhe peeche aur kamar seedhi ho. Medicine ball ko taangon ke paas pakrein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Pehla qadam lete hue medicine ball ko seene tak khinch layein.
Doosra qadam lete hue ball ko poori taqat se aage dhakelein, aur chhorte hi foran 10 yards tak sprint karein. Agar aap bohat tez hain to apna pass khud pakar sakte hain!

Chest Stretch on Stability Ball.instructions_ur:
Exercise ball ke paas haathon aur ghutno ke bal aa jayein.
Kohniyan ball ke upar rakhein, baazu side ki taraf bahar ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni ko ball ke upar rakhte hue dhad ko zameen ki taraf neeche layein. 20-30 seconds tak stretch rokein, aur doosre baazu se dohrayein.

Chest-Supported Row.instructions_ur: dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Child's Pose.instructions_ur: Baghair equipment ke tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Chin To Chest Stretch.instructions_ur:
Zameen par baithi hui position mein aa jayein.
Dono haath sar ke pichle hisse par rakhein, ungliyan aapas mein phansi hon, angoothe neeche ki taraf aur kohniyan seedha saamne ki taraf. Aahista aahista sar ko seene ki taraf neeche kheenchein. 20-30 second rokein.

Chin-Up.instructions_ur: Pull-up bar ke saath setup karein, movement ko control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Circus Bell.instructions_ur:
Circus bell ek bara dumbbell hota hai jis ka handle mota hota hai. Dumbbell ko apne paon ke darmiyan rakh kar shuru karein, aur handle ko dono haathon se pakrein.
Kulhon aur ghutno ko seedha karte hue dumbbell ko clean karein aur use matlooba kandhe tak layein, doosra haath chhor dein.
Yaqeeni banayein ke dumbbell ka ek sira kandhe ke peeche ho taake aap ka balance na bigre. Sar ke upar uthane ke liye ghutne mor kar thora neeche jayein, aur phir upar zor lagate hue dumbbell ko sar ke upar seedha karein, sath hi us se thora door jhukein.
Bell ko ehtiyat se wapas zameen par layein, jitna ho sake control mein rakhein. Zameen ko nuqsan se bachane ke liye yeh event mote rubber mat par karna behtar hai.

Clap Push-UP.instructions_ur:
Clap push-up upper body ki ek explosive movement hai jo power aur fast-twitch muscle strength banati hai. Yeh aam push-up mein plyometric challenge shamil karti hai kyunke rep ke darmiyan haathon ko zameen se uthana hota hai.
Mazboot push-up position mein shuru karein, haath kandhon ke faasle se thore chaure hon aur core tight ho
Jism ko neeche layein aur itni taqat se zameen ko dhakelein ke haath zameen se uth jayein.
Haathon ko wapas zameen par rakhne se pehle jaldi se seene ki oonchai par taali bajayein.
Jhatka jazb karne ke liye narm kohniyon ke saath land karein aur foran agla rep shuru karein

Claps Over the Head.instructions_ur: Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare ho jayein. Baazu uthayein aur sar ke oopar taali bajayein

Clean.instructions_ur:
Barbell farsh par pindliyon ke qareeb ho, taangon ke bilkul bahar overhand (ya hook) grip se pakrein. Kulhe neeche layein, wazan aediyon par ho, kamar seedhi, sar aage, seena oopar, aur kandhe bar se thore aage hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.

Pehla pull aediyon se zor laga kar ghutne seedhe karte hue shuru karein. Kamar ka angle wahi rehna chahiye aur baazu seedhe rehne chahiyein. Control ke saath weight ko ghutnon se oopar tak le jate rahein.
Phir doosra pull aata hai, jo clean mein raftaar ka asal zariya hai. Jab bar raan ke darmiyan tak pohanche, kulhon ko seedha karna shuru karein. Jump jaisi harkat mein kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe kar ke raftaar barhayein aur bar ko tezi se oopar le jayein. Weight ki raftaar barhane ke liye baazuon se kheenchne ki zaroorat nahi honi chahiye; doosre pull ke aakhir mein jism poori tarah seedha ho, halka sa peeche jhuka ho, aur baazu ab bhi seedhe hon.
Jab poori extension ho jaye to teesre pull mein jayein, zor se shrug karein aur kohniyan oopar aur bahar karte hue baazu morein. Poori extension par zor se khud ko neeche kheenchein aur kohniyan bar ke neeche ghumayein. Bar ko front squat position mein receive karein, jiski gehrai teesre pull ke aakhir mein bar ki unchai par munhasir hai. Bar aage nikle hue kandhon par tiki ho, halka sa gale ko chhuti ho aur haath dheele hon. Neeche squat position tak jate rahein, is se wapas uthne mein madad milegi.
Foran aediyon se zor laga kar uthein, dhad seedha aur kohniyan oopar rakhein. Tab tak uthte rahein jab tak poori tarah khare na ho jayein.

Clean Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko pindli ki haddi ke qareeb rakh kar khare ho kar shuru karein. Paon seedha kulhon ke neeche hon aur thora bahar ki taraf mude hon. Bar ko double overhand grip ya hook grip se pakrein, taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par. Squat kar ke bar tak neeche jayein. Reerh ki haddi poori seedhi ho, kamar ka zaawiya aisa ho ke kandhe bar se aage hon aur kamar jitni ho sake vertical ho.
Ediyon ke agle hisse se zameen ko dhakel kar shuru karein. Jaise jaise bar upar jaye, kamar ka zaawiya ek jaisa rakhein. Ghutnon ko side mein bahar ki taraf kholein taa ke woh bar ke raaste se door rahein.
Bar ghutnon se guzarne ke baad, kulhon ko bar ki taraf dhakel kar lift poori karein yahan tak ke kulhe aur ghutne seedhe ho jayein.

Clean Pull.instructions_ur:
Barbell farsh par pindliyon ke qareeb rakhein, aur taangon ke bilkul bahar overhand ya hook grip se pakren. Kulhe neeche karein, weight ediyon par ho, kamar seedhi, sar saamne ki taraf, seena upar, aur kandhe bar se thore aage hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ediyon se zor laga kar aur ghutne seedhe karte hue pehla pull shuru karein. Kamar ka zaviya wahi rehna chahiye, aur baazu seedhe aur kohniyan bahar ki taraf rehni chahiyein. Weight ko control ke saath ghutnon se upar tak le jayein.
Is ke baad doosra pull aata hai, jo clean mein raftaar ka asal zariya hai. Jab bar raan ke darmiyan tak pahunche, to kulhon ko seedha karna shuru karein. Jump ki tarah kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue raftaar barhayein, aur speed se bar ko upar le jayein. Weight ki raftaar barhane ke liye baazuon se khinchne ki zaroorat nahi honi chahiye; doosre pull ke aakhir mein jism poori tarah seedha, thora peeche jhuka hua, aur baazu ab bhi seedhe hone chahiyein. Poora extension tez aur achanak hona chahiye, aur dhyan rakhein ke extension ko zaroorat se zyada lamba na karein.

Clean Shrug.instructions_ur:
Kandhon ke barabar, double overhand ya hook grip ke saath shuru karein, bar raan ke darmiyani hisse tak latka hua ho. Kamar seedhi ho aur thodi aage jhuki ho.
Kandhon ko kaanon ki taraf shrug karein. Halaanke is exercise mein aam taur par clean se zyada weight lagaya ja sakta hai, lekin itna zyada weight na lagayein ke harkat dheemi par jaye.

Clean and Jerk.instructions_ur:
Barbell farsh par pindliyon ke qareeb rakhein, aur taangon ke bilkul bahar overhand ya hook grip se pakren. Kulhe neeche karein, weight ediyon par ho, kamar seedhi, sar saamne ki taraf, seena upar, aur kandhe bar se thore aage hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ediyon se zor laga kar aur ghutne seedhe karte hue pehla pull shuru karein. Kamar ka zaviya wahi rehna chahiye, aur baazu seedhe rehne chahiyein. Weight ko control ke saath ghutnon se upar tak le jayein.
Is ke baad doosra pull aata hai, jo clean mein raftaar ka asal zariya hai. Jab bar raan ke darmiyan tak pahunche, to kulhon ko seedha karna shuru karein. Jump ki tarah kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue raftaar barhayein, aur speed se bar ko upar le jayein. Weight ki raftaar barhane ke liye baazuon se khinchne ki zaroorat nahi honi chahiye; doosre pull ke aakhir mein jism poori tarah seedha, thora peeche jhuka hua, aur baazu ab bhi seedhe hone chahiyein.
Jaise hi poora extension ho, kandhon ko zor se shrug karte hue aur kohniyan upar aur bahar rakhte hue baazu mod kar teesre pull mein jayein. Poore extension par khud ko zor se neeche khinchein, aur saath hi kohniyon ko bar ke neeche ghumayein. Bar ko front squat position mein receive karein, jis ki gehrai teesre pull ke aakhir mein bar ki oonchai par munhasir hai. Bar aage nikle hue kandhon par rack honi chahiye, gale ko halka sa chhooti hui aur haath dheele hon. Squat ki sab se neeche wali position tak jate rahein, is se uthne mein madad milegi.
Foran ediyon se zor laga kar uthein, dhad seedha aur kohniyan upar rakhein. Poori tarah khare hone tak uthte rahein.
Doosra marhala jerk hai, jis mein weight ko sar ke upar uthaya jata hai. Weight kandhon ke saamne rack karke khare hon, aur dip se shuru karein. Paon kulhon ke bilkul neeche rakh kar, kulhe peeche le jaye baghair ghutne moden. Sirf thora sa neeche jayein, aur jitni taqat se ho sake simt ulti karein.
Ediyon se zor laga kar jitni ho sake speed aur taqat paida karein, aur jab bar kandhon se uthe to sar raaste se hata lein.
Is lamhe jab paon farsh se uthein, to paon ko jitna jaldi ho sake receiving position mein rakhna zaroori hai. Us chhote se lamhe mein jab paon platform par zor nahi laga rahe hote, bar ko upar dhakelne ki koshish athlete ko neeche le jati hai. Paon split hone chahiyein, ek paon aage aur ek peeche. Bar ko sar ke upar baazu lock karke receive karein. Wapas khari position mein aa jayein.

Clean and Press.instructions_ur:
Kandhon ke barabar stance mein khare hon, ghutne baazuon ke andar hon. Ab kamar seedhi rakhte hue ghutnon aur kulhon se jhukein taa ke aap bar ko poore seedhe baazuon aur pronated grip se pakar sakein jo kandhon se thori chauri ho. Kohniyan side mein bahar ki taraf rakhein. Bar pindliyon ke qareeb ho. Kandhe bar ke upar ya thora aage hon. Kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne seedhe karte hue bar kheenchna shuru karein. Kamar ka zaawiya ek jaisa rakhte hue kulhe aage aur kandhe ek hi raftaar se upar layein; bar ko jism ke qareeb rakhte hue seedha upar uthate rahein.
Jab bar ghutne se guzre, takhne, ghutne aur kulhe zor se seedhe karein, bilkul chhalaang jaisi harkat ki tarah. Saath hi haathon se bar ko guide karte rahein, kandhe shrug karein aur harkat ke momentum se bar ko jitna ho sake upar kheenchein. Bar jism ke qareeb rahe aur kohniyan bahar rakhein.
Sab se zyada unchai par, aap ke paon zameen se uth jayein aur aap khud ko bar ke neeche kheenchna shuru karein. Is ka tareeqa istemal hone wale weight ke hisaab se thora badal sakta hai. Bar ke neeche jaate hue squat position mein neeche jayein.
Jab bar apni aakhri unchai par pohanche, kohniyon ko bar ke ird gird aur neeche ghumayein. Dhad seedha rakhte hue aur kulhe aur ghutne mor kar bar ka wazan jazb karte hue bar ko kandhon ke saamne rack karein.
Poora seedha khare ho jayein, bar ko clean position mein pakre hue.
Paon hilaye baghair, saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko sar ke upar press karein. Bar ko control ke saath neeche layein.

Clean from Blocks.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko pasandeeda unchai ke boxes ya stands par rakh kar, taangon ke bilkul bahar overhand ya hook grip lein. Kulhe neeche layein, weight aediyon par, kamar seedhi, sar saamne, seena upar, aur kandhe bar se thora aage. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Aediyon se zor laga kar aur ghutne seedhe karte hue first pull shuru karein. Kamar ka angle wahi rehna chahiye, aur baazu seedhe rehne chahiyein, kohniyan bahar ki taraf.
Jab poora extension ho jaye, zor se shrug karte hue aur kohniyan upar aur bahar mod kar receiving position mein jayein. Zor se khud ko neeche kheenchein, aur saath hi kohniyan bar ke neeche ghumayein. Bar ko front squat position mein receive karein, jis ki gehrai third pull ke aakhir mein bar ki unchai par munhasir hai. Bar aage nikle hue kandhon par rack ho, gale ko halka sa chhoota hua aur haath dheele. Bottom squat position tak neeche jaate rahein, is se recovery mein madad milegi.
Foran aediyon se zor laga kar recover karein, dhad seedha aur kohniyan upar rakhein. Jab tak khare na ho jayein jaari rakhein. Agle rep ke liye weight ko wapas boxes par rakhein.

Clock Push-Up.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ulte let kar position mein aayein, wazan haathon aur paon ki ungliyon par ho.
Baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur haath kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Poori harkat ke dauran jism seedha rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan mod kar neeche aayein, seene ko zameen ki taraf layein.
Neeche pohanch kar, kohniyan seedhi karte hue jitni tezi se ho sake khud ko upar dhakelein yahan tak ke aap hawa mein utth jayein. Ek taraf 12-18 inch "jump" karne ki koshish karein.
Upar uthte hue bahar wala paon apni harkat ki simt se door le jayein. Zameen chhorte hue agle rep ke liye jism ko taqreeban 30 degree ghuma dein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aa kar exercise dohrayein, poora chakkar lagayein yahan tak ke wapas wahin pohanch jayein jahan se shuru kiya tha.

Close Grip Standing Biceps Curls with Ba.name_ur: Tang grip Khare ho kar Barbell ke saath Biceps Curls
Close Grip Standing Biceps Curls with Ba.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hue aur pet andar khencha hua.
Barbell ko hatheliyan upar rakh kar pakrein, haathon ke darmiyan taqreeban 12 inch ka faasla ho.
Baazu poori tarah seedhe kar ke raanon ke saath rakhein.
Kohniyan jism ke saath saakit rakhte hue bar ko seene ki taraf uthayein jab tak forearms seene ko na chhoo lein.
Thori der rukein aur phir shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Note: Agar jism jhoolne se rokne mein mushkil ho to deewar ya khambe se tek laga lein.

Close Triceps Pushup.instructions_ur:
Pushup ka yeh tareeqa triceps (baazu ke peeche wale muscles) ko alag se target karta hai.
Farsh ya mat par ghutnon ke bal aayein, haath is tarah rakhein ke angoothe aapas mein mil jayein aur panjon ke bal upar uthein.
Pet andar khenchein aur kamar aur gardan ko ek seedhi line mein rakhein.
Baazu mor kar aahista aahista jism ko farsh ki taraf neeche layein jab tak aap farsh ko chhoone ke qareeb na pohanch jayein.
Control ke saath jism ko wapas shuruati position tak upar uthayein.

Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein. Tang grip (taqreeban kandhon ke barabar) se bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu lock kar ke apne upar seedha pakrein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aayein jab tak bar seene ke darmiyani hisse par mehsoos na ho. Tip: Aam bench press ke baraks, triceps ko ziyada se ziyada kaam mein laane ke liye kohniyan har waqt dhad ke qareeb rakhein.
Ek second rukne ke baad, saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps ki madad se bar ko wapas shuruati position par dhakelein. Contracted position mein baazu lock karein, ek second rukein aur phir dobara aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche jaane mein upar aane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa movement dohrayein.
Jab mukammal ho jaye to bar ko wapas rack mein rakh dein.

Close-Grip Dumbbell Press.instructions_ur:
Ek dumbbell ko flat bench par khara karke rakhein.
Yaqeeni banate hue ke dumbbell bench ke upar mazbooti se rakha rahe, bench ke perpendicular let jayein, sirf kandhe bench par hon. Kulhe bench se neeche hon aur taangein mudi hui, paon farsh par mazbooti se.
Dumbbell ko dono haathon se pakrein aur baazu ki poori lambai par seedha seene ke upar rakhein. Dono hatheliyan dumbbell ke sides ke neeche wale hisse par dabi honi chahiyein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Dumbbell ko seene tak neeche la kar harkat shuru karein.
Kohniyan seedhi karke shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Close-Grip EZ Bar Curl.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hue aur pet andar khencha hua.
EZ bar ko bar ke sab se andar wale hisse par underhand tang (4 inch) grip se pakrein.
Baazu poori tarah seedhe kar ke raanon ke saath rakhein.
Kohniyan jism ke saath saakit rakhte hue bar ko seene ki taraf uthayein.
Thori der rukein aur phir shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Note: Agar jism jhoolne se rokne mein mushkil ho to deewar ya khambe se tek laga lein.

Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl with Band.name_ur: Band ke saath Tang grip EZ-Bar Curl
Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl with Band.instructions_ur:
Bar ke dono siron par ek ek band lagayein. Bar pakrein aur ek paon band ke beech mein rakhein. EZ bar ko tang, supinated grip se pakar kar seedhe khare hon. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb honi chahiyein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upper arms ko apni jagah rakhte hue kohniyan mor kar curl karein. Wazan uthate hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Harkat jaari rakhein yahan tak ke biceps poori tarah sukur jayein aur bar kandhon ki satah par aa jaye. Is position ko ek second rokein aur biceps ko zor se sukerein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista bar ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Close-Grip EZ-Bar Press.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein, EZ bar par munasib weight load ho.
Tang grip se bar uthayein aur kohniyan andar rakhte hue use dhad ke seedha oopar pakrein. Baazu farsh ke perpendicular hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans andar lete hue bar ko seene ke nichle hisse tak neeche layein. Yeh harkat karte waqt kohniyan andar rakhein.
Triceps se bar ko wapas oopar dhakelte hue, saans bahar nikaalte waqt kohniyan seedhi kar ke use shuruati position tak press karein.
Dohrayein.

Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown.instructions_ur:
Pull-down machine par baith jayein jis ki upar wali pulley par chauri bar lagi ho. Machine ka knee pad apne qad ke mutabiq set karna zaroori hai. Yeh pads bar par lage resistance se aap ke jism ko upar uthne se rokte hain.
Tay ki gayi grip ke saath, hatheliyan saamne ki taraf rakh kar bar pakrein. Grips par note: Chauri grip ke liye haathon ka faasla kandhon ki chaurai se zyada hona chahiye. Medium grip ke liye haathon ka faasla kandhon ki chaurai ke barabar hona chahiye aur tang grip ke liye kandhon ki chaurai se kam.
Jab dono baazu aap ke saamne seedhe hon - aur bar chuni hui grip chaurai par pakri ho - dhad ko taqreeban 30 degrees peeche le jayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein kham banayein aur seena bahar nikaalein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, kandhon aur baazu ke upar wale hisson ko neeche aur peeche kheench kar bar ko neeche layein jab tak woh seene ke upar wale hisse ko na chhoo le. Tip: Poori tarah sukerne ki position par pahunch kar kamar ke muscles ko sukerne par dhyan dein. Dhad ka upar wala hissa saakit rahe (sirf baazu hilein). Forearms ka kaam sirf bar pakarna hai; is liye forearms se bar ko neeche kheenchne ki koshish na karein.
Sukri hui position mein ek second ke baad, kandhe ki haddiyon (shoulder blades) ko aapas mein sukerte hue, aahista aahista bar ko wapas shuruati position tak upar le jayein jab baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur lats poori tarah stretch hon. Harkat ke is hisse mein saans andar lein.

Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let jayein aur haath ek khare kiye hue dumbbell par rakhein. Paon ki ungliyon aur haathon par wazan sambhalte hue dhad sakht, kohniyan andar aur baazu seedhe rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.

Kohniyan seedhi karte hue khud ko wapas shuruati position tak upar dhakelein. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein.
Contracted position mein thora rukne ke baad, jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Close-Grip Standing Barbell Curl.name_ur: Tang grip Khare ho kar Barbell Curl
Close-Grip Standing Barbell Curl.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko dono haathon se pakrein, hatheliyan upar ki taraf hon aur haath kuch inch ke faasle par hon.
Dhad seedha aur sar upar rakh kar khare ho jayein. Paon takreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon aur kohniyan dhad ke qareeb hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi. Tip: Poori harkat ke dauran upper arms aur kohniyan saakit rakhein.
Bar ko adhe daire ki shakal mein upar curl karein yahan tak ke forearms biceps ko chhoo lein. Yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur upar ek second ke liye biceps ko zor se sukerein. Tip: Wazan uthate hue kamar morne ya jhoolne wali harkaton se bachein. Sirf forearms harkat karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Close-grip Lat Pull Down.instructions_ur: Pull-down bar ko kandhon se kam faasle par pakrein, hatheliyan aap se door ki taraf. Thora sa peeche jhukein. Bar ko seene ki taraf neeche kheenchein, neeche aate hue kohniyan pehluon ke qareeb rakhein. Harkat ke aakhir mein kandhe peeche kheenchein.

Close-grip Press-ups.instructions_ur: Mazboot plank position mein aa jayein, haath itne qareeb layein ke taqreeban chhoo rahe hon. (picture 1) Kohniyan mod kar aahista aahista seena farsh tak layein (picture 2). Kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakhte hue dhamake ke saath wapas upar dhakelein. Dohrayein. Har rep par neeche aane mein waqt lein aur form durust rakhein.
