Cobra Stretch.instructions_ur: Baghair equipment ke tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Cocoons.instructions_ur:
Zameen par kamar ke bal let kar shuru karein. Taangein seedhi hon aur baazu sar ke peeche phaile hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Harkat karne ke liye, ghutnon ko seene ki taraf sameitein, aur pelvis ko ghuma kar glutes ko farsh se uthayein. Aisa karte hue reedh ki haddi ko moorein, aur baazuon ko sar ke upar se wapas laa kar saath saath crunch ki harkat karein.
Thoda ruk kar wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Conan's Wheel.instructions_ur:
Weight load karke, implement ke sire par zurcher hold lein. Bar ko kohni ke mor mein rakhein aur apni kalai pakrein. Weight ko forearms se door rakhne ki koshish karein.
Weight ko zameen se utha kar shuru karein. Chalna shuru karte hue posture tight aur seedha rakhein, chhote aur tez qadam lein. Daire mein ghoomte hue upar aur door dekhein. Event ke dauran saans na rokein. Jab tak ek ya zyada poore chakkar mukammal na ho jayein chalte rahein.

Concentration Curls.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke kinare par baith jayein, paon farsh par seedhe aur taangein khuli rakhein.
Haath mein dumbbell pakrein, hatheli upar ki taraf.
Kohni ko andar wali raan ke saath daba kar dumbbell ko seene ki taraf curl karein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Dohrayein aur baazu badlein.
Note: Jis baazu se exercise kar rahe hain us ke ilawa poora jism saakit rakhein.

Conventional Deadlift.instructions_ur: barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Cossack Squat.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Cross Body Hammer Curl.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan andar ki taraf.
Hatheliyan andar ki taraf rakhte hue (aur baazu ko ghumaye baghair) dumbbell ko mukhalif kandhe ki taraf curl karein.
Dumbbell ka upar wala hissa kandhe tak la kar use chhoo dein.
Aahista aahista control ke saath dumbbell ko wapas shuruati position par neeche layein.

Cross-Bench Dumbbell Pullovers.instructions_ur: Darmiyane wazan wala dumbbell is tarah pakdein ke hatheliyan upar wali plates ke neeche wale hisse par seedhi hon aur angoothe bar ke gird hon. Flat bench par aar paar kamar ke bal let jayein taake sirf kamar ka upar wala hissa aur kandhe bench ko chhuein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon aur sar thoda neeche latak raha ho. Dumbbell ko seene ke bilkul upar baazu ki lambai par rakhte hue, baazu taqreeban 15 degree modein aur poori harkat mein mude rakhein. Dumbbell ko aahista aahista peeche aur neeche ek aadhe daire (semicircle) mein jitna aaram se neeche ja sake le jayein. Usay aahista aahista usi raste se wapas shuruati point tak uthayein, aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Cross-Body Crunch.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal seedhe let jayein aur ghutne taqreeban 60 degree tak moren.
Paon farsh par seedhe rakhein aur haath halke se sar ke peeche rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ab upar curl karein aur seedhi kohni aur kandhe ko jism ke aar paar le jayein, aur saath hi ulta ghutna ulte kandhe ki taraf andar layein. Kohni se ghutne ko chhoone ki koshish karein. Yeh movement karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Sirf kohni nahi balke kandhe ko ghutne ki taraf upar laane ki koshish karein, aur yaad rakhein ke asal baat movement ke dauran abs ko sikorna hai, sirf kohni hilana nahi.
Ab saans andar lete hue shuruati position par wapas neeche aayein aur ulti kohni aur seedhe ghutne ke saath dohrayein.
Isi tarah baari baari karte rahein jab tak tay kiye gaye saare reps mukammal na ho jayein.

Crossover Reverse Lunge.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare ho jayein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ek paon peeche le ja kar aur kulhe aur aage wala ghutna mod kar rear lunge karein. Aisa karte hue dhad ko aage wali taang ke upar se ghumayein.
Thora rukne ke baad shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur doosri taraf dohrayein, baari baari yeh jaari rakhein.

Crossover with Bands.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise seene, biceps aur kandhon ko mazboot karne ke liye hai.
Exercise band ko kisi khambe (ya mazboot pole) se bandh dein aur dono haathon mein pakrein.
Khambe ki taraf peeth kar ke aage qadam barhayein taake band mein kuch tanao aa jaye.
 Baazu seene ki darmiyani oonchai par aur side mein phaile hon, hatheliyan saamne ki taraf; yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Haathon ko apne saamne aapas mein milayein.
Thori der isi position mein rukein aur phir control ke saath shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Crucifix.instructions_ur:
Crucifix mein aap wazan ko side par saakit pakad kar waqt ke liye rokte hain. Halaanke yeh event dumbbells se practice ki ja sakti hai, behtar hai ke istemal hone wale kisi implement, jaise kulhaadi aur hathoda, se practice karein, kyunki unka ehsaas mukhtalif hota hai.
Khare ho kar shuru karein, aur implements pakad kar baazu side par uthayein. Aap ke baazu zameen ke mutawazi hone chahiye. Muqable mein judges ya sensors batate hain ke kab aap parallel se neeche aaye. Jitni dair ho sake rokein. Aam tor par wazan itna bhaari hona chahiye ke aap 30-60 second mein fail ho jayein.

Crunch - Hands Overhead.instructions_ur:
Farsh par kamar seedhi rakh kar let jayein aur ghutne is tarah moden ke hamstrings aur pindliyon ke darmiyan taqreeban 60 degree ka zaviya ho.
Paon farsh par seedhe rakhein aur baazu sar ke upar phailayein, hatheliyan ek doosre par cross hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upper body ko aage curl karein aur kandhe ki haddiyon ko farsh se thora sa upar uthayein. Har waqt baazu sar, gardan aur kandhon ki seedh mein rakhein. Unhein us position se aage na layein. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein aur contraction ko ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein neeche aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Crunch - Legs On Exercise Ball.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal seedha let jayein, paon exercise ball par tike hon aur ghutne 90 degree ke angle par mude hon.
Paon ke darmiyan teen se chaar inch ka faasla rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan andar ki taraf kar ke aapas mein mila dein.
Haath halke se sar ke dono taraf rakhein aur kohniyan andar rakhein. Tip: Ungliyan sar ke peeche lock na karein.
Kamar ke nichle hisse ko zameen mein neeche dabayein taa ke pait ke muscles behtar tor par alag kaam karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kandhon ko zameen se upar roll karna shuru karein aur kamar ke nichle hisse se jitna zor se ho sake neeche dabate rahein. Kandhe zameen se sirf chaar inch tak upar aane chahiyein, aur kamar ka nichla hissa zameen par rehna chahiye. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein. Top par pait ke muscles ko zor se sukerein aur ek second rokein. Tip: Aahista, control wali harkat par dhyan dein. Kabhi bhi momentum istemal na karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Crunches.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal seedhe let jayein, paon zameen par seedhe rakhein, ya bench par tikayein aur ghutne 90 degree ke angle par mude hon. Agar paon bench par rakh rahe hain to unhein teen se chaar inch ke faasle par rakhein aur ungliyan andar ki taraf kar ke aapas mein milayein.
Ab haath halke se sar ke dono taraf rakhein aur kohniyan andar rakhein. Tip: Ungliyan sar ke peeche aapas mein lock na karein.
Pet ke muscles ko behtar target karne ke liye kamar ke nichle hisse ko farsh mein dabate hue, kandhon ko farsh se upar uthana shuru karein.
Abs ko sikorte hue aur saans bahar nikaalte hue kamar ke nichle hisse se jitna zor se ho sake neeche dabate rahein. Kandhe farsh se sirf taqreeban chaar inch upar uthne chahiyein aur kamar ka nichla hissa farsh par hi rehna chahiye. Movement ke top par abs ko zor se sikorein aur contraction ko ek second roke rakhein. Tip: Aahista aur control wali movement par dhyan dein - jhatke (momentum) ka sahara le kar khud ko dhoka na dein.
Ek second ke contraction ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas neeche aana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Crunches with Legs on Stability Ball.name_ur: Stability Ball par Taangein rakh kar Crunches
Crunches with Legs on Stability Ball.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein aur paon stability ball par upar rakhein.
Haath seene par cross kar ke ya sar ke dono taraf rakhein.
Kamar ke nichle hisse ko farsh par rakhte hue sar, kandhe aur seena farsh se upar uthayein.
Abs ko sikorte hue thori der rukein aur phir shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Note: Jaldi na karein aur yeh exercise aahista aur control ke saath karein.

Cuban Press.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar har haath mein ek dumbbell pronated grip se pakdein. Upar wale baazu uthayein taake woh farsh ke mutawazi hon, aur neeche wale baazu "scarecrow" position mein latakne dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Harkat shuru karne ke liye kandhon ko bahar ki taraf ghuma kar baazu ko 180 degree hilayein. Upar wale baazu apni jagah rakhein, aur unhein ghumayein yahan tak ke kalaiyan kohniyon ke bilkul upar hon aur forearms farsh ke amoodi hon.
Ab kohniyan seedhi karke dumbbells ko press karein, baazu sar ke upar seedhe kar dein.
Saans andar lete hue qadam ulte kram mein karke wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Curl De Muñeca Con Barra.instructions_ur:
Yeh flat bench press ka ek tareeqa hai jo pectoralis major ke clavicular head (upar wale hisse) par zor dene ke liye banaya gaya hai. Dhad ko jhukane se push ka angle badal jata hai, aur zyada tension seene ke upar wale hisse aur kandhon par chali jaati hai, jis se dhad ki zyada khoobsurat, mutawazin aur three-dimensional development mein madad milti hai.
Shuruati position: Bar ko overhand grip (hatheliyan upar ki taraf) se kandhon jitni chauraai par pakrein.
Bench par position: Flat bench ke saamne ghutno ke bal baith jayein aur forearms ki pichhli taraf bench par rakhein. Kalaiyan aur haath bench ke kinare se thora bahar hon taake poori range of motion mil sake.
Eccentric phase (neeche lana): Kalaiyon ko farsh ki taraf seedha karte hue bar ko control ke saath neeche layein. Harkat ke neeche ungliyan thori kholein taake bar thora neeche rol ho jaye aur stretch zyada se zyada ho.
Concentric phase (uthana): Pehle ungliyan band kar ke bar ko mazbooti se pakrein, phir kalaiyon ko tezi se lekin control ke saath upar mor kar bar ko jitna ho sake upar layein. Upar ki position par forearms ko ek second zor se sukerein.
Form: Poori exercise ke dauran forearms ko bench par mazbooti se dabaye rakhein; sirf kalaiyan aur ungliyan hilni chahiyein.

Dancer's Stretch.instructions_ur:
Farsh par seedhe baith jayein.
Daayein taang ko baayein taang ke upar se cross karein, ghutna mura rahe. Baayein taang seedhi aur farsh par ho.
Baayan baazu daayein taang par rakhein aur daayan haath farsh par.
Upar wale jism ko daayein taraf ghumayein aur 10-20 seconds rokein. Side badlein.

Dead Bug.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Deadlift with Bands.instructions_ur:
Chhote bands ke saath deadlift karne ke liye, shuru karne se pehle unhein bas bar ke upar daal dein, aur set up karne ke liye un ke andar qadam rakhein. Lambe bands ko kisi mazboot cheez se baandhna hoga, jaise bhaari dumbbells ya rack.
Paon aur grip set karne ke baad gehri saans lein, phir kulhe neeche karein aur ghutne moden yahan tak ke pindli ki haddi bar ko chhoo le. Sar se saamne dekhein, seena upar rakhein aur kamar mein kham rakhein, aur ediyon se zor lagate hue weight ko upar uthana shuru karein. Jab bar ghutnon se guzar jaye, to bar ko zor se peeche khinchein, kandhe ki haddiyon ko aapas mein milate hue kulhon ko aage bar ki taraf dhakelein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar bar ko neeche laayein aur usay farsh tak le jayein.

Deadlift with Chains.instructions_ur:
Aap chains ko bar ki sleeves se jor sakte hain, ya bas beech wala hissa bar par latka dein taake uthate hue weight zyada barhe.
Bar ke paas aise aayein ke woh aapke paon ke beech mein ho. Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par hone chahiyein. Kulhon se jhuk kar bar ko kandhon ke barabar pakrein, shoulder blades ko aage aane dein. Aam taur par, bhaari sets par overhand grip ya over/under grip istemal hoti hai. Paon aur grip set karke, gehri saans lein aur phir kulhe neeche karein aur ghutne moden jab tak pindliyon ki saamne wali haddi bar ko na chhoo le.
Sar se saamne dekhein, seena upar aur kamar arch rakhein, aur aediyon se zor laga kar weight upar uthana shuru karein. Bar ghutnon se guzar jaye to zor se bar ko peeche kheenchein, shoulder blades aapas mein kheenchte hue kulhe aage bar ki taraf dhakelein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar aur bar ko farsh tak le ja kar neeche layein.

Decline Bench Leg Raise.instructions_ur:
Setup: Decline bench par is tarah let jayein ke sar upar ki taraf ho aur handles pakar lein.
Shuruat: Taangein poori seedhi karein, unhein thora upar utha kar rakhein taake core engage ho.
Lift: Abs ki madad se taangein chhat ki taraf uthayein, jhatke (momentum) se nahi.
Squeeze: Upar rukein aur pait ke nichle abs ko sukerein.
Wapsi: Taangon ko aahista aahista control ke saath shuruati position tak neeche layein.

Decline Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Decline bench ke aakhir mein apni taangein mehfooz tareeqe se phansa lein aur aahista aahista bench par let jayein.
Medium chaurai wali grip (aisi grip jo movement ke darmiyan forearm aur upper baazu ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle banaye) se bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu lock kar ke apne upar seedha pakrein. Baazu farsh ke saath 90 degree par hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi. Tip: Rotator cuff ki hifazat ke liye behtar hai ke barbell ko rack se uthane mein koi spotter aapki madad kare.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aayein jab tak bar seene ke nichle hisse par mehsoos na ho.
Ek second rukne ke baad, saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ke muscles ki madad se bar ko wapas shuruati position par dhakelein. Contracted position mein baazu lock karein aur seena dabayein, ek second rukein aur phir dobara aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche jaane mein upar aane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa movement dohrayein.
Jab mukammal ho jaye to bar ko wapas rack mein rakh dein.

Decline Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Machine ki seat ko is tarah adjust karein ke handles seene ke nichle hisse ke qareeb hon.
Aahista aahista handles ko aage dabayein jab tak haath poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein, kohniyan lock na karein.
Thori der rukein aur phir control ke saath haathon ko wapas shuruati position par layein.

Decline Close-Grip Bench To Skull Crushe.name_ur: Decline Tang grip Bench se Skull Crusher
Decline Close-Grip Bench To Skull Crushe.instructions_ur:

Contracted position par ek second rukein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa movement dohrayein.

Decline EZ Bar Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Decline bench par seedhe (chehra upar) let jayein aur EZ Bar (curved barbell) pakrein.
Baazu seedhe kar ke seene ke saath 90 degree par rakhein, aur kohniyan ek jagah saakit rakhte hue bar ko sar ki taraf neeche layein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Decline Oblique Crunch.instructions_ur:
Decline bench ke aakhir mein apni taangein mehfooz tareeqe se phansa lein aur aahista aahista bench par let jayein.
Jism ka upar wala hissa bench se uthayein jab tak farsh se naapne par aapka dhad taqreeban 35-45 degree par na ho.
Ek haath sar ke paas aur doosra raan par rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Shuruati position se jism ka upar wala hissa aahista aahista uthayein aur saath hi dhad ko baayein taraf ghumayein. Saans bahar nikaalte hue crunch karte rahein jab tak seedhi kohni ulte ghutne ko na chhoo le. Is contracted position ko ek second roke rakhein. Tip: Abs ko tight rakhne aur movement ko aahista aur control mein rakhne par dhyan dein.

Seedhi taraf ek set tay kiye gaye reps ke saath mukammal karne ke baad, baayein taraf badal lein. Tip: Upar wali position mein dhad ko achhi tarah ghumane aur contraction mehsoos karne par dhyan dein.

Decline Push-Up.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ulte let jayein aur haath taqreeban 36 inch ke faasle par rakhein, baazu seedhe karke dhad ko upar uthaye rakhein. Paon box ya bench par rakh dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans andar lete hue khud ko neeche laayein yahan tak ke seena farsh ko taqreeban chhoo le.
Ab saans bahar nikaalein aur seene ko sukerte hue upper body ko wapas shuruati position tak upar dhakelein.
Upar contracted position mein thora rukne ke baad, jitne reps zaroori hon utni dafa dobara neeche aana shuru kar sakte hain.

Decline Reverse Crunch.instructions_ur:
Decline bench par kamar ke bal let jayein aur dono haathon se bench ke upar wala hissa pakar lein. Is position se jism ko neeche phisalne na dein.
Abs ki madad se taangon ko farsh ke parallel rakhein, ghutne aur paon aapas mein mile hon. Tip: Taangein poori seedhi hon aur ghutne mein halka sa mor ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.

Decline Smith Press.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ke neeche decline bench rakhein. Ab barbell ko aisi unchai par rakhein jahan let kar aur baazu taqreeban poore seedhe kar ke aap pohanch sakein. Zara ruk kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue kohniyan seedhi kar ke bar ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.
Tay shuda reps ke mutabiq harkat dohrayein.
Set mukammal hone par bar ko wapas rack mein lock kar dein.

Deficit Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Shuru mein koi platform ya weight plates rakhein jin par aap khare ho sakein, aam tor par 1-3 inch unche. Bar ke paas is tarah aayein ke woh aap ke paon ke beech ke upar ho. Depth Jump Leap.instructions_ur:
Is drill ke liye aap ko do boxes ya benches chahiye honge, ek 12 se 16 inch ooncha aur doosra 22 se 26 inch ooncha.
Do boxes mein se ek par khare ho jayein, baazu side par hon; paon aapas mein mile hue aur depth jump ki tarah kinare se thore bahar hon. Doosra box apne saamne takreeban do ya teen feet door rakhein, jis ka rukh aap ki taraf ho.
Pehle box se neeche girein, land karein aur sath hi dono paon se dobara uchhlein.
Jitna zor se ho sake upar aur aage ki taraf uchhal kar rebound karein, baazuon aur jism ko poori tarah seedha kar ke oonche box par chhalang lagayein. Phir se taangon ko jhatka jazb karne dein.

Devil’s Press.instructions_ur:
Devil's Press ek hybrid harkat hai jo dumbbell burpee aur double dumbbell snatch ko mila deti hai. Yeh poore jism ki, high-intensity exercise hai jo taaqat, power aur metabolic conditioning barhati hai.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell le kar shuru karein aur burpee karein, dumbbells pakre hue seena zameen ko chhune dein.
Dhamake se paon aage jump karein aur dumbbells ko taangon ke beech jhulayein.
Ek musalsal harkat mein dumbbells ko sar ke oopar le jayein aur baazu lock kar dein.
Control ke saath dumbbells neeche la kar shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein aur dohrayein

Dip Machine.instructions_ur:
Dip machine mein mazbooti se baith jayein, weight chunein aur handles ko mazbooti se pakar lein.
Ab kohniyan side par andar ki taraf rakhein taake triceps par zor aaye. Kohniyan 90 degree angle par mudi honi chahiyein.
Triceps ko sukerte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue baazu neeche ki taraf seedhe karein. Tip: Harkat ke neeche, baazuon mein thoda sa kham rakhein taake triceps muscle par tension bani rahe.
Ab saans andar lete hue aahista aahista baazuon ko wapas shuruati position tak upar aane dein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dips - Chest Version.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko parallel bars chahiye. Shuruati position mein aane ke liye, bars ke upar baazu seedhe (lock) kar ke jism ko uthaye rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue, dhad ko taqreeban 30 degrees aage jhuka kar aur kohniyan thodi bahar ki taraf phaila kar aahista aahista neeche jayein jab tak seene mein halki stretch mehsoos na ho.
Stretch mehsoos hote hi, saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ki taaqat se jism ko wapas shuruati position mein layein. Tip: Harkat ke oopar ek second ke liye seene ko sukerna yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Dips - Triceps Version.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position mein aane ke liye, apne jism ko baazu ki lambai par rakhein aur baazu bars ke upar taqreeban lock hon.
Ab saans andar lein aur aahista aahista khud ko neeche layein. Aap ka dhad seedha rehna chahiye aur kohniyan jism ke qareeb rehni chahiye. Is se triceps par behtar tawajjo milti hai. Itna neeche jayein ke upar wale baazu aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka zaviya ban jaye.
Phir saans bahar nikaalein aur triceps ki madad se dhad ko wapas upar dhakel kar shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Dips Between Two Benches.instructions_ur: Do benches itne faasle par rakhein ke aap ek ko haathon se pakar sakein aur doosri tak bamushkil paon pohanch sakein. Poori exercise ke dauran taangein bilkul seedhi rehti hain. Kohniyan peeche ki taraf rakhte hue unhein jitna ho sake moren. Khud ko upar dhakelein, lekin baazu poori tarah seedhe na karein.

Donkey Calf Raises.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aapko donkey calf raise machine chahiye hogi. Shuru mein kamar ka nichla hissa aur kulhe machine ke padded lever ke neeche rakhein. Pad se dum ki haddi (tailbone) wala hissa laga hona chahiye.
Dono baazu side handles par rakhein aur paon ke panje calf block par rakhein, aediyan bahar latki hon. Jis hisse ko target karna ho us ke mutabiq ungliyan saamne, andar ya bahar ki taraf rakhein, aur ghutne lock kiye baghair seedhe karein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aediyan uthayein, takhnon ko jitna ho sake upar seedha karein aur calf ko sikorein. Khayal rakhein ke ghutna har waqt saakit rahe. Kisi waqt bhi mor nahi aana chahiye. Wapas neeche aane se pehle contracted position ko ek second roke rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein, aediyan neeche karte hue takhne moren jab tak calves stretch na ho jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Double Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean.name_ur: Double Kettlebell Baari baari Hang Clean
Double Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells apne paon ke darmiyan rakhein. Shuruati position mein aane ke liye kulhe peeche dhakelein aur seedha saamne dekhein.
Ek kettlebell ko clean karke kandhe tak laayein aur doosri kettlebell ko pakre rakhein.
Ek rawan harkat mein upar wali kettlebell ko neeche laayein aur saath hi neeche wali kettlebell ko upar le jayein.

Double Kettlebell Jerk.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek kettlebell handle se pakrein.
Taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karte hue kettlebells ko kandhon ki taraf kheench kar clean karein. Saath hi kalaiyan ghumayein taa ke hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne mor kar jism ko thora neeche layein, dhad seedha rakhte hue.
Foran harkat ulat dein, eriyon se zor laga kar, yaani momentum banane ke liye jaise chhalang lagate hain.
Saath hi baazu seedhe kar ke kettlebells ko sar ke upar lockout tak press karein, jism ka momentum istemal karte hue.
Paon ko split andaaz mein zameen par wapas layein, ek paon aage aur ek peeche.
Wazan sar ke upar rakhte hue, paon milate hue khari position mein wapas aayein. Agle rep ke liye wazan neeche layein.

Double Kettlebell Push Press.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells ko clean kar ke kandhon tak layein.
Kuch inch neeche squat karein aur tezi se harkat ulti karein. Taangon se milne wale momentum se kettlebells ko sar ke upar le jayein.
Jab kettlebells lock out ho jayein, to unhein wapas kandhon tak neeche layein aur dohrayein.

Double Kettlebell Snatch.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells apne paon ke peeche rakhein. Ghutne moorein aur peeche baith kar kettlebells utha lein.
Kettlebells ko taangon ke darmiyan zor se swing karein aur rukh badal dein.
Kulhon se zor lagayein aur ek hi lagataar harkat mein kettlebells ko sar ke upar lock kar dein.

Double Kettlebell Windmill.instructions_ur:
Ek kettlebell apne agle paon ke saamne rakhein aur doosre baazu se ek kettlebell ko clean and press kar ke sar ke upar le jayein. Taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karte hue kettlebell ko kandhon ki taraf khinch kar kandhe tak clean karein. Sath hi kalai ghumayein taake hatheli aage ki taraf ho.
Kettlebell ko har waqt lock out rakhte hue kulhe lock out kettlebell ki taraf bahar nikaalein. Paon ko lock out kettlebell wale baazu se 45 degree ke angle par bahar ki taraf moorein.
Kulhe se ek taraf jhukte hue, kulhe bahar nikaal kar, aahista aahista itna jhukein ke zameen se kettlebell utha sakein. Sar ke upar pakri kettlebell par har waqt nazar rakhein.
Zameen se kettlebell uthane ke baad ek second rukein aur harkat ulti kar ke shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Double Leg Butt Kick.instructions_ur:
Ghutne thore se mod kar khare ho kar shuru karein.
Tezi se thora sa squat karein, kulhe aur ghutne moden, aur foran seedhe ho kar jitna ho sake ooncha jump karein.
Upar jate hue ghutne mod kar ediyon ko samet lein, aur unhein kulhon se chhoone ki koshish karein.
Ghutne sirf thore mude hue rakh kar utarte hue harkat mukammal karein, aur jhatka taangon se jazb karein.

Double Leg Calf Raise.instructions_ur: Dono taangon wala heel raise takhne aur ghutne ke ird gird mazbooti, control aur stability banane, aur kulhe aur pelvis ko balance aur control dene ke liye ahem hai.

Downward Facing Balance.instructions_ur:
Exercise ball ke upar ulte let jayein.
Pait ke bal ball par tike hue, haathon ko zameen par aage chalayein aur taangein uthayein, kohniyan aur ghutne seedhe karte hue.

Drag Curl.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise marhoom Vince Gironda, "Iron Guru" se mansoob hai. Yeh na sirf biceps par zabardast kaam karti hai balke forearms ko bhi kaam mein laati hai.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hue aur pet andar khencha hua.
Bar ko hatheliyan neeche rakh kar kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakrein.
Baazu poori tarah seedhe kar ke raanon ke saath rakhein.
Hatheliyan neeche rakhte hue aahista aahista baazu uthayein aur bar ko seene tak layein.
Note: Is exercise ke dauran kohniyan ya kandhe na hilayein.

Drop Push.instructions_ur:
Neeche boxes ya doosre platforms 2-3 feet ke faasle par rakhein.
Un ke darmiyan pushup position mein aa jayein, haath boxes par rakh kar khud ko sambhalein.
Achhe posture ke saath upar dhakel kar platforms se neeche girein aur haathon ko kandhon ke faasle par le jayein, baazuon se jhatka jazb kar ke narmi se land karein.

Dumbbell Bench Press.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath setup karein, movement ko control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Dumbbell Bench Press with Neutral Grip.name_ur: Neutral grip ke saath Dumbbell Bench Press
Dumbbell Bench Press with Neutral Grip.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell lein aur flat bench par peeche let jayein. Paon farsh par seedhe rakhein aur shoulder blades peeche kheench kar rakhein.
Neutral grip barqarar rakhte hue, hatheliyan aamne saamne, baazu seedhe apne oopar farsh ke perpendicular rakh kar shuru karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni mor kar upper arms ko side ki taraf neeche laate hue harkat shuru karein. Tab tak neeche layein jab tak dumbbells dhad tak na aa jayein.
Ruk jayein, phir kohni seedhi karein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Dumbbell Bent Over Face Pull.instructions_ur: Is exercise mein dumbbells se jhuk kar face pull kiya jata hai, jo kamar ke oopri hisse aur kandhon ko target karta hai. Is harkat mein kohniyan oonchi rakhte hue aur shoulder blades ko aapas mein dabate hue weights ko chehre ki taraf kheencha jata hai.

Dumbbell Bicep Curl.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho jayein, dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell baazu ki poori lambai par latka hua ho. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb rakhein aur hatheliyan ghuma kar saamne ki taraf kar lein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ab upper baazu ko saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalein aur biceps ko sikorte hue weights ko curl karein. Weights uthate rahein jab tak biceps poori tarah sikur na jayein aur dumbbells kandhon ki oonchai par na aa jayein. Biceps ko dabate hue contracted position mein thori der rukein.
Phir saans andar lein aur aahista aahista dumbbells ko wapas shuruati position par neeche lana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Bicep Curl to Press.name_ur: Dumbbell Bicep Curl se Press tak
Dumbbell Bicep Curl to Press.instructions_ur:
Kohniyan mod kar dumbbells ko kandhon tak uthayein.
Dumbbells ko sar ke upar dhakelein aur saath hi baazu ghumayein taake hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon. Neeche laane ke liye harkat ulti karein. Exercise dohrayein.

Dumbbell Clean.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell le kar khare hon, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par.
Kulhe aur ghutne mod kar weights ko farsh tak neeche layein, kulhe peeche dhakelein jab tak dumbbells farsh tak na pohanch jayein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Harkat shuru karne ke liye, kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue zor se upar ki taraf jump karein taake weights tezi se upar jayein. Dumbbells par neutral grip barqarar rakhte hue, poora extension hone tak baazu seedhe rakhein.
Poore extension ke baad, weight ko squat position mein receive karne ke liye kulhe aur ghutne dobara moden. Baazuon ko mudne dein, dumbbells ko apne kandhon tak le jayein.
Squat position mein weight receive karne ke baad, kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karke khare ho jayein, weights kandhon par hon.

Dumbbell Curl.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Dumbbell Dead Lifts.instructions_ur:
2 dumbbells pakrein aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue kamar (waist) se jhukein, aur ghutnon mein thora mor aane dein.
Dono haathon mein dumbbells ko overhand grip se pakrein.
Dumbbells ko baazu ki poori lambai par pakre hue kamar seedhi kar ke khare hon.
Dobara jhukein aur dumbbells ko farsh se zara upar tak neeche layein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Dohrayein.

Dumbbell Donkey Kick.instructions_ur:
Dumbbell donkey kick glutes aur hamstrings ke muscles ke liye ek asar daar exercise hai. Yeh exercise aam tor par haathon aur ghutnon ke bal ki jaati hai, aur resistance barhane ke liye dumbbell istemal hota hai. Isay sahi tareeqe se karne ke steps neeche diye gaye hain.
Shuruati position: Mat par haathon aur ghutnon ke bal aa jayein, haath kandhon ke neeche aur ghutne kulhon ke neeche hon.
Dumbbell rakhna: Ek dumbbell lein aur usay us taang ke ghutne ke peeche rakhein jo aap uthane wale hain. Yaqeeni banayein ke woh mazbooti se phansa ho taa ke exercise ke dauran gire nahin.
Exercise:
Saans andar lein aur saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbell wali taang upar uthayein, ghutna 90 degree par mura rakhein.
Taang ko zameen ke mutawazi hone tak uthayein, glutes mein sukerna mehsoos karein.
Upar ek second rokein aur phir aahista aahista taang ko shuruati position mein wapas neeche layein.
Reps: Har taang ke liye 10 se 15 reps karein, aur poori exercise ke dauran achhi form barqarar rakhein.
Sets: Apni fitness level ke hisaab se 2 se 3 sets poore karein.

Dumbbell Floor Press.instructions_ur:
Haathon mein dumbbells pakar kar farsh par let jayein. Ghutne mude ho sakte hain. Weights ko poori tarah apne upar seedha rakh kar shuru karein.
Weights ko neeche layein jab tak upper arm farsh se na lag jaye. Triceps ke size aur taqat par zor dene ke liye kohniyan andar rakh sakte hain, ya seene par focus ke liye baazuon ko side ki taraf angle karein.
Neeche ruk kar, phir kohniyan seedhi karte hue weight ko top par ek saath layein.

Dumbbell Fly.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath setup karein, movement ko control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Dumbbell Front Raise.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath setup karein, movement ko control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Dumbbell Front Squat.instructions_ur: Is exercise mein har haath mein ek dumbbell kandhon ki unchai par pakar kar squat kiya jata hai. Yeh nichle jism ke muscles, jaise quads, hamstrings aur glutes ko target karti hai, aur saath hi core aur upar wale jism ko bhi engage karti hai.

Dumbbell Hang Power Cleans.instructions_ur: Paon par seedhe khare hon, dumbbells pehluon mein pakre hue. Kulhon se jhuk kar dumbbells ko ghutnon tak neeche layein (tasveer 1). Halki si chhalaang ke saath wapas khare hon, aur momentum se dumbbells ko kandhon par kheench layein (tasveer 2). Seedhe khare hon, phir control ke saath pehluon mein neeche layein aur dohrayein. Isay tez aur dhamakedaar rakhein; agar aap ki dil ki dharkan bohat tez nahin hoti to aap yeh ghalat kar rahe hain.

Dumbbell Hex Press.instructions_ur:
Muscles ko active karein
Paon chaure rakhein
Control wali harkat
Aahista harkat
Wazan ko seene ke nichle hisse/pait ki taraf layein

Dumbbell Hip Thrust.instructions_ur: Is exercise mein zameen par baith kar dumbbell ko kulhon par rakha jata hai, phir glutes ko sukerte hue kulhon ko upar dhakela jata hai. Yeh glutes ko mazboot karne aur kulhon ki lachak behtar karne ke liye behtareen exercise hai.

Dumbbell Incline Row.instructions_ur:
Neutral grip istemal karte hue incline bench par seena tika kar jhuk jayein.
Har haath mein neutral grip se ek dumbbell pakren, baazu seedhe hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kandhe ki haddiyon ko peeche khinchein aur kohniyan mod kar dumbbells ko row karte hue side tak laayein.
Harkat ke upar rukein, aur phir wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Dumbbell Incline Shoulder Raise.instructions_ur:
Incline Bench par baith jayein aur har haath mein ek dumbbell raanon ke oopar pakrein.
Taangein utha kar weights ko kandhon tak dhakelein aur peeche jhuk jayein. Dumbbells ko kandhon ke oopar rakhein aur baazu seedhe hon. Baazu farsh ke perpendicular hon, hatheliyan aage ki taraf aur ungliyon ke jor chhat ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu seedhe aur lock rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte waqt kandhon ko bench se utha kar dumbbells oopar le jayein.
Saans andar lete hue dumbbells ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Lateral Raise.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath setup karein, movement ko control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Dumbbell Lunges.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare hon aur dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pehluon ke saath pakrein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Seedhi taang se taqreeban 2 feet aage qadam rakhein, peeche wala paon apni jagah rahe, aur dhad seedha aur balance barqarar rakhte hue jism ko neeche layein. Neeche jaate hue saans andar lein. Note: Doosri exercises ki tarah, neeche aate waqt ghutne ko paon ki ungliyon se aage na jaane dein, warna ghutne ke jor par bila wajah dabao padega. Khayal rakhein ke aage wali taang ki pindli zameen ke saath 90 degree par rahe.
Ziyada tar paon ki aedi ka zor laga kar upar uthein aur saans bahar nikaalte hue shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa movement dohrayein aur phir ulti taang se karein.

Dumbbell Lying One-Arm Rear Lateral Rais.name_ur: Dumbbell Let kar Ek baazu se Rear Side Raise
Dumbbell Lying One-Arm Rear Lateral Rais.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein dumbbell pakar kar, halke se incline (farsh se naapne par taqreeban 15 degree) adjustable bench par seena neeche kar ke let jayein. Balance ke liye doosre haath se bench ki taang pakar sakte hain.
Dumbbell wale haath ki hatheli neutral rakhein (hatheli dhad ki taraf), baazu seedha aur kohni halki si mudi hui. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbell wale baazu ko side mein uthayein jab tak kohni kandhe ki oonchai par na aa jaye aur baazu taqreeban farsh ke mutawazi (parallel) na ho jaye. Tip: Poori movement ke dauran baazu seedha aur dhad ke saath 90 degree par rakhein. Top par contraction ko ek second roke bhi rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell ko shuruati position par neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Lying Pronation.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par pait ke bal let jayein, ek haath mein dumbbell aur doosra haath bench ke upar mora hua taa ke aap us par sar rakh sakein.
Dumbbell wale baazu ki kohni morein taa ke upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka zaawiya bane.
Ab upper arm uthayein taa ke forearm zameen par amudi (perpendicular) ho aur upper arm dhad par amudi ho. Tip: Upper arm zameen ke mutawazi ho aur dhad ke saath bhi 90 degree ka zaawiya banaye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, forearm ko bahar ki taraf ghumayein taa ke dumbbell aage ki taraf uthe, aur upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka kham barqarar rakhein. Yeh external rotation tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak forearm zameen ke mutawazi na ho jaye. Is moqe par ek second ke liye sukerna rokein.
Saans andar lete hue, aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Lying Rear Lateral Raise.name_ur: Dumbbell Let kar Rear Side Raise
Dumbbell Lying Rear Lateral Raise.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakar kar, halke se incline (farsh se naapne par taqreeban 15 degree) adjustable bench par seena neeche kar ke let jayein.
Hatheliyan neutral rakhein (hatheliyan dhad ki taraf), baazu seedhe aur kohniyan halki si mudi hui. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue baazuon ko side mein uthayein jab tak kohniyan kandhon ki oonchai par na aa jayein aur baazu taqreeban farsh ke mutawazi (parallel) na ho jayein. Tip: Poori movement ke dauran baazu seedhe aur dhad ke saath 90 degree par rakhein. Top par contraction ko ek second roke bhi rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbells ko shuruati position par neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir doosre baazu par badal lein.

Dumbbell Lying Supination.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par karwat ke bal let jayein, ek baazu mein dumbbell pakrein aur doosra haath bench ke upar mor kar rakhein taake sar us par tika sakein.
Dumbbell wale baazu ki kohni moorein taake upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle ban jaye.
Ab upper arm ko uthayein taake forearm zameen ke parallel aur dhad ke perpendicular ho (Tip: Yaani forearm bilkul aap ke saamne hoga). Upper arm dhad ke saath saakit rahega aur zameen ke parallel hona chahiye (har waqt dhad ki seedh mein). Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue forearm ko bahar ki taraf ghumayein taake dumbbell adhe daire ki shakal mein upar uthe, aur upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka mor barqarar rakhein. Yeh bahar ki taraf ghumana jari rakhein yahan tak ke forearm zameen ke perpendicular ho aur chhat ki taraf ho. Is point par ek second ke liye sukerein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir doosre baazu par switch karein.

Dumbbell One-Arm Shoulder Press.name_ur: Dumbbell Ek baazu se Shoulder Press
Dumbbell One-Arm Shoulder Press.instructions_ur:
Dumbbell pakrein aur military press bench ya kamar ke sahare wali utility bench par baith jayein aur dumbbell ko raanon ke upar seedha khara rakhein, ya phir seedhe khare ho jayein.
Dumbbell ko clean kar ke kandhe ki oonchai tak layein. Doosra haath side mein poora phaila kar, kamar par, ya kisi mazboot cheez ko pakar kar rakh sakte hain.
Kalai ghumayein taake hatheli saamne ki taraf ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbell ko upar dhakelein jab tak baazu poori tarah seedha na ho jaye.
Ek second rukne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas neeche aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir baazu badlein.

Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension.name_ur: Dumbbell Ek baazu se Triceps Extension
Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Dumbbell pakrein aur military press bench ya kamar ke sahare wali utility bench par baith jayein aur dumbbell ko raanon ke upar seedha khara rakhein, ya phir seedhe khare ho jayein.
Dumbbell ko clean kar ke kandhe ki oonchai tak layein aur phir baazu sar ke upar seedha karein taake poora baazu farsh ke saath 90 degree par aur sar ke paas ho. Dumbbell aapke upar hona chahiye. Doosra haath side mein poora phaila kar, kamar par, dumbbell wale upper baazu ko sahara de kar, ya kisi mazboot cheez ko pakar kar rakh sakte hain.
Kalai ghumayein taake hatheli saamne ki taraf ho aur chhoti ungli chhat ki taraf ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Upper baazu ko saakit rakhte hue dumbbell ko aahista aahista sar ke peeche neeche layein. Yeh movement karte hue saans andar lein aur jab triceps poori tarah stretch ho jayein to rukein.
Triceps ko sikorte hue aur saans bahar nikaalte hue shuruati position par wapas aayein. Tip: Yeh bohat zaroori hai ke sirf forearm hile. Upper baazu har waqt sar ke paas saakit rehna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur baazu badlein.

Dumbbell One-Arm Upright Row.name_ur: Dumbbell Ek baazu se Upright Row
Dumbbell One-Arm Upright Row.instructions_ur:
Dumbbell pakrein aur seedhe khare ho jayein, baazu saamne seedha ho, kohni mein halka sa mor ho aur kamar seedhi ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi. Tip: Dumbbell raan ke upar tika hona chahiye aur hatheli raan ki taraf ho.
Doosra haath side mein poora phaila kar, kamar par, ya kisi mazboot cheez ko pakar kar rakh sakte hain. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue side wale kandhe ke muscles se dumbbell ko upar uthayein. Upar le jaate waqt dumbbell jism ke qareeb rehna chahiye. Uthate rahein jab tak dumbbell taqreeban thodi ki seedh mein na aa jaye. Tip: Movement kohni se chalni chahiye. Dumbbell uthate waqt kohni hamesha forearm se oonchi rehni chahiye. Dhad ko saakit rakhein aur movement ke top par ek second rukein.
Dumbbell ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position par neeche layein. Movement ke is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur baazu badlein.

Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl.name_ur: Ulte let kar Dumbbell Incline Curl
Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakdein aur incline bench par munh ke bal let jayein, kandhe incline ke top ke qareeb hon. Aap ke ghutne seat par tik sakte hain ya taangein dono sides par phaila sakte hain (mera pasandeeda tareeqa).
Baazuon ko seedha hone dein aur qudrati tor par saamne latakne dein taake woh farsh ke amoodi hon.
Ab kohniyan apni side ke saath andar rakhein aur hatheliyan saamne ki taraf karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Biceps ko sukerte hue dumbbells uthayein yahan tak ke baazu poori tarah mud jayein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur yaqeeni banayein ke sirf forearms hilein. Upar wale baazu har waqt saakit rehne chahiye.
Dumbbells ko neeche layein yahan tak ke baazu poori tarah seedhe ho jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Pullover.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Dumbbell Raise.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakdein aur seedhe khare ho jayein, baazu side par seedhe hon, kohniyon mein halka sa mod ho aur kamar seedhi ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi. Tip: Dumbbell aap ki raanon ke saath hona chahiye aur hatheliyan peeche ki taraf hon.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ke side wale hisse se dumbbells uthayein. Upar le jaate hue dumbbells jism ki side par hone chahiye. Uthate rahein yahan tak ke dumbbells taqreeban thodi ki seedh mein aa jayein. Tip: Harkat kohniyon se chalni chahiye. Dumbbell uthate hue kohni hamesha forearm se oonchi honi chahiye. Saath hi dhad ko saakit rakhein aur harkat ke top par ek second rukein.
Dumbbells ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Rear Delt Row.instructions_ur: Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakren. Kulhon se aage jhukein taake kamar taqreeban farsh ke mutawazi ho jaye. Baazu neeche latakne dein. Baazu kandhon ki seedh mein rakhein. Kohniyan mod kar side mein bahar ki taraf uthayein yahan tak ke upper arms farsh ke mutawazi ho jayein. Aahista aahista wapas aayein aur dohrayein

Dumbbell Rear Lunge.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare hon aur dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pehluon ke saath pakrein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Seedhi taang se ulte paon se taqreeban do feet peeche qadam rakhein aur dhad seedha aur balance barqarar rakhte hue jism ko neeche layein. Neeche jaate hue saans andar lein. Tip: Doosri exercises ki tarah, neeche aate waqt ghutne ko paon ki ungliyon se aage na jaane dein, warna ghutne ke jor par bila wajah dabao padega. Khayal rakhein ke aage wali taang ki pindli zameen ke saath 90 degree par rahe. Lunge ke dauran dhad seedha rakhein; hip flexors ka lachakdar hona zaroori hai. Lamba lunge Gluteus Maximus (glutes) par ziyada zor deta hai; chhota lunge quads par ziyada zor deta hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue upar uthein aur shuruati position par wapas aayein. Tip: Quads par ziyada zor dene ke liye paon ke panjon se dhakelein. Glutes par focus karne ke liye aediyon se dabayein.
Ab doosri taang se dohrayein.

Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift.instructions_ur: Is exercise mein har haath mein ek dumbbell pakar kar, kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se aage jhuka jata hai, phir wapas khari position mein aaya jata hai. Yeh khaas tor par hamstrings aur glutes ko target karti hai.

Dumbbell Scaption.instructions_ur:
Yeh corrective exercise un muscles ko mazboot karti hai jo shoulder blade ko mustahkam rakhte hain. Har haath mein halka weight pehluon mein latka kar pakrein. Angoothe upar ki taraf hon.
Baazuon ko apne saamne, beech se taqreeban 30 degree hat kar, upar uthate hue harkat shuru karein. Harkat ke dauran baazu poore seedhe hon.
Jab tak baazu zameen ke mutawazi na ho jayein uthate rahein, phir shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Dumbbell Seated Box Jump.instructions_ur:
Bench ki side mein do teen feet ke faasle par box rakhein. Dono haathon se dumbbell seene se laga kar pakrein aur box ki taraf munh kar ke bench par baith jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Paon mazbooti se zameen par jama kar aage jhukein, aur kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karte hue oopar aur aage ki taraf jump karein.
Dono paon se box par land karein, kulhe aur ghutne mor kar jhatke ko jazb karein.
Neeche utar jayein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise.name_ur: Dumbbell Baith kar Ek taang par Calf Raise
Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise.instructions_ur:
Flat bench se taqreeban 12 inch door farsh par ek block rakhein.
Flat bench par baith jayein aur dumbbell ko ulti raan ke upar wale hisse par, ghutne se taqreeban 3 inch upar rakhein.
Ab ulte paon ka panja block par rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aur calf muscle ko sikorte hue panjon ke bal jitna ho sake upar uthein. Contraction ko ek second roke rakhein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein aur jitna ho sake neeche tak stretch karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir seedhi taang se dohrayein.

Dumbbell Shoulder Press.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath setup karein, movement ko control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Dumbbell Shrug.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell (hatheliyan dhad ki taraf) le kar seedhe khare hon, baazu pehluon mein seedhe latke hue.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ko jitna ho sake upar utha kar dumbbells uthayein. Top par contraction ko ek second roke rakhein. Tip: Baazu har waqt seedhe rehne chahiyein. Dumbbells uthane ke liye biceps ka istemal na karein. Sirf kandhe upar neeche hone chahiyein.
Dumbbells ko wapas shuruati position par neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Side Bend.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho jayein, baayen haath mein dumbbell pakrein (hatheli dhad ki taraf) aur daayan haath kamar par rakhein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Kamar seedhi aur sar ooper rakhte hue, sirf kamar se daayen taraf jitna ho sake jhukein. Side par jhukte hue saans andar lein. Phir ek second rukein aur saans bahar nikaalte hue wapas shuruati position par aayein. Tip: Baaqi jism ko bilkul na hilayein.
Ab yahi harkat dohrayein lekin is dafa baayen taraf jhukein. Ek second rukein aur wapas shuruati position par aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir haath badal lein.

Dumbbell Side Squat.instructions_ur: Is exercise mein ek haath mein dumbbell pakar kar side ki taraf qadam lete hue squat kiya jata hai. Yeh taangon, glutes aur core muscles ko target karti hai.

Dumbbell Snatch.instructions_ur:
Sahi tareeqe se karne ke ahem steps:
Setup: Dumbbell ko apne paon ke darmiyan rakhein, kandhe kulhon ke upar, seena upar aur kamar seedhi ho.
The Pull: Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne poori taqat se seedhe karein (triple extension) taake dumbbell upar jaye, kohni oonchi aur dumbbell jism ke qareeb rakhein.
The Catch: Jaldi se kulhe aur ghutne mor kar dumbbell ke neeche jayein aur use sar ke upar lock baazu ke saath pakrein, half-squat stance mein land karein.
Aam ghaltiyan: Wazan uthane ke liye taangon ke bajaye baazuon ka zyada istemal karna, pull phase mein kohni neeche hona, aur aakhri position mein kandha, kohni aur kalai seedh mein na hona. Beginners ke liye mashwara hai ke halke wazan se shuru karein, technique par dhyan dein, aur har baazu ke liye 3 se 5 reps ke 3 se 5 sets karein.

Dumbbell Squat.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho jayein aur dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein (hatheliyan taangon ki side ki taraf).
Taangon ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par medium stance mein rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf hon. Har waqt sar ooper rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigar jata hai, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. Note: Yahan hum ooper bataya gaya medium stance istemal karenge jo overall development ke liye hai; lekin aap foot stances section mein bataye gaye teenon stances mein se koi bhi chun sakte hain.
Ghutne mor kar aahista aahista dhad ko neeche layein, posture seedha aur sar ooper rakhein. Itna neeche jayein ke raanein farsh ke mutawazi (parallel) ho jayein. Tip: Agar exercise sahi ki gayi hai to ghutnon ka agla hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banaye ga jo saamne ki taraf amudi (perpendicular) ho. Agar ghutne us khayali line se aage nikal jayein (yaani paon ki ungliyon se aage) to ghutne par bewaja dabao parta hai aur exercise ghalat tareeqe se ki gayi hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue zyada tar aeri se farsh ko dhakel kar dhad ko ooper uthayein, taangein dobara seedhi karein aur shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Squat To A Bench.instructions_ur:
Peeche flat bench rakh kar seedhe khare ho jayein aur dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein (hatheliyan taangon ki side ki taraf).
Taangon ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par medium stance mein rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf hon. Har waqt sar ooper rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigar jata hai, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. Note: Yahan hum ooper bataya gaya medium stance istemal karenge jo overall development ke liye hai; lekin aap foot stances section mein bataye gaye teenon stances mein se koi bhi chun sakte hain.
Ghutne mor kar aahista aahista dhad ko neeche layein, posture seedha aur sar ooper rakhein. Itna neeche jayein ke peeche rakhe bench ko halka sa chhoo lein. Is hisse mein saans andar lein. Tip: Agar exercise sahi ki gayi hai to ghutnon ka agla hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banaye ga jo saamne ki taraf amudi (perpendicular) ho. Agar ghutne us khayali line se aage nikal jayein (yaani paon ki ungliyon se aage) to ghutne par bewaja dabao parta hai aur exercise ghalat tareeqe se ki gayi hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue zyada tar aeri se farsh ko dhakel kar wazan ooper uthayein, taangein dobara seedhi karein aur shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Dumbbell Step Ups.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho jayein aur dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein (hatheliyan taangon ki side ki taraf).
Daayan paon oonche platform par rakhein. Daayen taang ke kulhe aur ghutne ko seedha karte hue platform par charh jayein. Zyada tar aeri ka zor laga kar baaqi jism ooper uthayein aur baayan paon bhi platform par rakh dein. Ooper aane ke liye zor lagate hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue daayen taang ke kulhe aur ghutne ko mor kar baayen taang se neeche utrein. Phir daayan paon baayen paon ke saath shuruati jagah par rakh kar wapas seedhe khare ho jayein.
Daayen taang se jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir baayen taang se karein.

Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ko taangon ke beech zameen par rakhein. Chauri stance banayein aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue squat kar ke neeche jayein. Dumbbell ko seedha khara rakh kar uske oopri 'head' se pakrein (tasweer 1). Seena oopar aur core sakht rakhte hue farsh ko dhakelein aur wapas khare ho jayein (tasweer 2). Dohrayein. Agar aap aasani se 20-30 reps kar lete hain, to do dumbbells istemal karein.

Dumbbell Tricep Extension -Pronated Grip.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur do dumbbells seedha kandhon ke upar pakrein. Baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur dhad aur farsh se 90 degree ka angle banayein.
Hatheliyan aage ki taraf honi chahiyein, aur kohniyan andar ki taraf. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans andar lein aur aahista aahista dumbbells neeche layein jab tak woh kaanon ke qareeb na aa jayein. Upper arms saakit aur kohniyan andar rakhna yaqeeni banayein.
Phir saans bahar nikaalein aur triceps se weight ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.

Dumbbell Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Ek dumbbell sar ke upar rakhein, dono haath andar wali plate ke neeche (dil ki shakal wali grip).
Kohniyan sar ke upar rakhte hue, kohniyan mor kar forearm ko upper arm ke peeche neeche layein. Neeche kalaiyan modein taa ke dumbbell gardan ke peeche na lage. Kohniyan seedhi karte hue aur kalaiyon ko hyperextend karte hue dumbbell ko sar ke upar uthayein. Wapas aayein aur dohrayein.

Dumbbell Upright Rows.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein overhand grip se ek ek dumbbell pakrein (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) aur unhein raanon ke saamne rakhein.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, pait andar khinchein aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
Dumbbells raanon ke paas se shuru karte hue kohniyan mor kar aahista aahista unhein kandhon ki taraf ooper uthayein.
Ooper rukein aur kandhon ki haddiyon (shoulder blades) ko aapas mein milayein.
Control ke saath dumbbells wapas raanon tak neeche layein.
Dohrayein

Dumbbell Wide Bicep Curls.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakdein, haath kandhon ki chaurai se thode zyada khule hon aur hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon.
Kohniyan mod kar dumbbells ko kandhon tak uthayein. Aahista aahista wapas layein aur dohrayein.

Dynamic Back Stretch.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue, unhein apne saamne seedha upar 5-10 dafa jhulayein, har dafa range of motion barhayein jab tak baazu sar se upar na chale jayein.

Dynamic Chest Stretch.instructions_ur:
Haath milaa kar khare ho jayein, baazu seedhe aap ke saamne phaile hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue, unhein tezi se jitna ho sake peeche le jayein aur phir wapas andar layein, bilkul barhi chadhi taali bajane jaisi harkat. 5-10 dafa dohrayein, aur saath saath raftaar badhayein.

EZ Bar Curl with Barbell.name_ur: Barbell ke saath EZ Bar Curl
EZ Bar Curl with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon aur ghutne thore se mor lein.
Hatheliyan ooper ki taraf rakh kar barbell pakrein.
Bar ko neeche layein taake woh raanon ke saath lagi ho.
Kohniyan bilkul na hilayein aur bar ko seene tak ooper uthayein taake forearms biceps ko chhoo lein.
Note: Jism ko jhoolne se bachane ke liye deewar ya pillar ke saath tek laga lein.

EZ-Bar Curl.instructions_ur:
EZ curl bar ko bahar wale chaure handle se pakar kar seedhe khare ho jayein. Hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon aur bar ki shakal ki wajah se thori andar ki taraf jhuki hon. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab upper arms saakit rakhte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur biceps sukerte hue weights ko aage curl karein. Sirf forearms ko harkat dene par dhyan dein.
Wazan uthate rahein yahan tak ke biceps poori tarah sukre hon aur bar kandhon ki oonchai par ho. Upar sukri hui position mein thori der rukein aur biceps ko sukerein.
Phir saans andar lein aur bar ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

EZ-Bar Skullcrusher.instructions_ur:
Tang grip se EZ bar uthayein aur bench par lette hue kohniyan andar rakh kar pakrein. Baazu farsh ke amudi (perpendicular) hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Upper arms ko hilaye baghair kohniyan mor kar bar neeche layein. Is hisse mein saans andar lein. Jab bar bilkul maathe ke ooper aa jaye to rukein.
Kohniyan seedhi karte aur saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko wapas shuruati position par layein.
Dohrayein.

Elbow Circles.instructions_ur:
Paon thode faasle par rakh kar baith jayein ya khare ho jayein.
Haath kandhon par rakhein, kohniyan kandhon ki oonchai par hon aur bahar ki taraf hon.
Aahista aahista kohniyon se circle banayein. Circle shuru karte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur circle poora karte hue saans andar lein.

Elbow to Knee.instructions_ur:
Zameen par let jayein, daayein taang ko mude hue baayein ghutne ke upar cross karein. Haath sar ke peeche jor lein, shoulder blades zameen par hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Reerh ki haddi ko mor kar aur dhad ghuma kar baayein kohni ko daayein ghutne tak layein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur side badalne se pehle jitne reps chahiye utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Elbows Back.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho jayein.
Dono haath kamar ke nichle hisse par rakhein, ungliyan neeche ki taraf aur kohniyan bahar hon.
Phir aaram se kohniyan peeche kheenchein, koshish karein ke woh aapas mein mil jayein.

Elevated Back Lunge.instructions_ur:
Bar ko rack par kandhon ki unchai par rakhein aur munasib wazan load karein. Apne peeche ek chhota, ooncha platform rakhein.
Bar ko upper back par rakhein, kamar mein kham aur tight rakhte hue. Dono paon ke saath ooncha platform par chadh jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ek taang ke saath peeche qadam rakhein. Kulhe aur ghutne mor kar neeche jayein yahan tak ke ghutna zameen ko chhoo le.
Rukein, aur kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karte hue upar uthein, taang badalne se pehle poori tarah shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Elevated Cable Rows.instructions_ur:
Koi platform lein (aerobics ya calf raise platform ho sakta hai) jis ki unchai taqreeban 4-6 inch ho.
Use cable row machine ki seat par rakhein.
Machine par baith jayein aur paon saamne wale platform ya crossbar par rakhein, yaqeeni banayein ke ghutne halke se mude hon aur lock na hon.
Kamar ki qudrati seedh barqarar rakhte hue aage jhukein aur V-bar handles pakrein.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue peeche kheenchein jab tak dhad taangon se 90 degree ka angle na bana le. Kamar halki si arch ho aur seena bahar nikla ho. Bar ko saamne pakarte hue lats mein achha stretch mehsoos hona chahiye. Yeh exercise ki shuruati position hai.
Dhad saakit rakhte hue, baazu jism ke qareeb rakh kar handles ko dhad ki taraf kheenchein jab tak pait ko na chhoo lein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Is waqt kamar ke muscles zor se sukerne chahiyein. Yeh contraction ek second rokein aur saans andar lete hue aahista aahista asal position mein wapas jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Elliptical Trainer.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye elliptical par chadhein aur menu se pasand ka option chunein. Zyada tar ellipticals mein manual setting hoti hai, ya aap koi program chala sakte hain. Aam tor par aap apni umar aur wazan daal kar exercise ke dauran jalne wali calories ka andaza laga sakte hain. Workout ki shiddat badalne ke liye elevation ko adjust kiya ja sakta hai.
Handles se aap apni dil ki dhadkan monitor kar sakte hain taa ke munasib shiddat par rahein.

Exercise Ball Crunch.instructions_ur:
Exercise ball par is tarah let jayein ke kamar ke nichle hisse ka kham ball ki golai se laga ho. Ghutne mude hon aur paon farsh par mazbooti se jame hon. Dhad ka upar wala hissa ball ke upar se latka ho. Baazu jism ke saath rakhein ya seene par cross kar lein, kyunke in positions mein gardan par zor nahi aata (sar ke peeche haath rakhne ke muqable mein).
Gardan ko hamesha saakit rakhte hue dhad ko stretch position mein neeche layein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe saakit rakhte hue, abs ko sukerein aur kandhon aur dhad ko upar ki taraf curl karein jab tak abs mein achhi contraction mehsoos na ho. Agar baazu side mein hain to woh taangon ke saath upar slide karein, aur agar cross hain to seene par hi rahein. Kamar ka nichla hissa hamesha ball se laga rehna chahiye. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur contraction ko ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue wapas shuruati position mein jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Exercise Ball Pull-In.instructions_ur:
Exercise ball paas rakhein aur uske saamne farsh par push-up position mein let jayein, haath farsh par kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Ab pindliyon ka nichla hissa exercise ball ke ooper rakhein. Tip: Is waqt taangein poori seedhi hon, pindliyan ball ke ooper hon aur upper body push-up jaisi position mein saamne seedhe dono baazuon par tiki ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Kamar bilkul seedhi aur upper body ko sakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue ghutnon ko seene ki taraf khinchein aur ball ko takhnon ke neeche aage roll hone dein. Abs ko sakht karein aur ek second is position mein rukein.
Ab saans andar lete hue aahista aahista taangein seedhi karein aur ball ko wapas shuruati position tak roll karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Explosive Push-Ups.instructions_ur:
Explosive Push-Ups
Normal push-up position mein shuru karein, seena neeche layein, phir dhamake ke saath zameen se itna zor lagayein ke haath farsh se uth jayein. Narmi se land karein aur foran dohrayein.

Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor.name_ur: Extended Range Ek baazu se Kettlebell Floor Press
Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let jayein aur ek baazu se press karne ke liye kettlebell ko position karein. Kettlebell ko handle se pakrein. Jis side se press kar rahe hain us side ki taang mudi honi chahiye, aur ghutna jism ki darmiyani line ko cross kar raha ho.
Kohni seedhi karte hue aur baazu ko andar ki taraf laate hue kettlebell ko jism ke upar press karein. Wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

External Rotation.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par karwat le kar let jayein, ek haath mein dumbbell aur doosra haath bench ke upar mora hua taa ke aap us par sar rakh sakein.
Dumbbell wale baazu ki kohni morein taa ke upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka zaawiya bane. Tip: Baazu ko dhad ke mutawazi rakhein.
Ab upper arm ko saakit rakhte hue kohni morein. Is tarah forearm zameen ke mutawazi aur dhad par amudi hoga (Tip: Yaani forearm bilkul aap ke saamne hoga). Upper arm dhad ke saath saakit rahega aur zameen ke mutawazi hona chahiye (har waqt dhad ki seedh mein). Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, forearm ko bahar ki taraf ghumayein taa ke dumbbell aadhe daire (semicircle) mein upar uthe, aur upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka kham barqarar rakhein. Yeh external rotation tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak forearm zameen par amudi na ho jaye aur chhat ki taraf ishara kare. Is moqe par ek second ke liye sukerna rokein.
Saans andar lete hue, aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir doosre baazu par badal lein.

External Rotation Stretch.instructions_ur:
Paon ke talwe aapas mein dabaye hue baith jayein, aur ek ghutna poori tarah jism ki side ki taraf utha hua ho.
Kohni ko uthe hue ghutne par rakhein, use 90 degree par modein, aur haath seedha saamne ki taraf rakhein, barbell/dumbbell pakre hue.
Kandha neeche aur peeche dabaye rakhein, haath ko upar uthayein yahan tak ke forearm seedha khara ho jaye, jaise aap robot ki tarah kisi ko haath hilane wale hon.
Haath ko wapas pehli position mein neeche layein aur dohrayein.

External Rotation with Band.instructions_ur:
Band ko kisi post ke gird lapet kar phansa dein. Band aap ki kohni ki unchai par hona chahiye. Apni baayin side band ki taraf karke do teen foot ke faasle par khare ho jayein.
Band ka sira daayein haath se pakdein, aur kohni ko mazbooti se apni side ke saath daba kar rakhein. Hamara mashwara hai ke kohni ke saath ek pad ya foam roll daba kar rakhein taake kohni apni jagah par mazbooti se rahe.
Upar wala baazu apni jagah par ho, kohni 90 degree par mudi ho aur haath aap ke dhad ke saamne se aar paar ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni ko apni jagah rakhte hue, baazu ko backhand ki tarah ghuma kar harkat karein.
Jitna aage ja sakein jayein, rukein, aur phir wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

External Rotation with Cable.instructions_ur:
Cable ko apni kohni ki oonchai par set karein. Baayin side band ki taraf kar ke do teen feet door khare hon.
Daayein haath se handle pakrein, aur kohni ko mazbooti se side ke saath daba kar rakhein. Hamara mashwara hai ke kohni se ek pad ya foam roll daba kar rakhein taake kohni apni jagah mazbooti se rahe.
Baazu ka upar wala hissa apni jagah par rakhte hue, kohni 90 degrees par mudi ho aur haath dhad ke saamne se doosri taraf ja raha ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni ko apni jagah rakhte hue, backhand jaisi harkat mein baazu ko ghuma kar harkat karein.

Face Pull.instructions_ur: cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Face Pulls with Yellow/green Band.name_ur: Yellow/green Band ke saath Face Pulls
Face Pulls with Yellow/green Band.instructions_ur: Band ke saath face pulls - khare ho kar horizontal pull. Band ko chehre ki unchai par pakrein, kohniyan unchi aur chauri rakhte hue chehre ki taraf kheenchein aur saath shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein. Yeh upper back aur kandhon ke pichle hisse ko train karti hai aur posture behtar banati hai.

Farmer's Walk.instructions_ur:
Farmer's walk ke liye mukhtalif implements istemal ho sakte hain. Agar yeh implements dastiyab na hon to yeh bhari dumbbells ya chhoti bars ke saath bhi kiya ja sakta hai. Implements ke darmiyan khare ho kar shuru karein.
Handles pakarne ke baad, eriyon se zor laga kar unhein uthayein, kamar seedhi rakhein aur sar upar rakhein.
Chhote, tez qadam lete hue chalein, aur saans lena na bhoolein. Ek tay faasla, aam tor par 50-100 feet, jitna tez ho sake tay karein.

Fast Skipping.instructions_ur:
Aaram daah position mein shuru karein, ek taang thori aage ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Step-hop pattern se skip karein: right-right-step phir left-left-step, aur isi tarah baari baari aage peeche karte rahein.
Tez skips ke liye zameen se qareebi raabta rakhein aur hawa mein rehne ka waqt kam karein, jitna ho sake tezi se harkat karein.

Finger Curls.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon se barbell pakdein, hatheliyan upar ki taraf hon; haathon ka faasla taqreeban kandhon ke barabar ho.
Paon farsh par seedhe rakhein, kandhon ke faasle se thoda zyada khule. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ungliyan seedhi karke bar ko jitna ho sake neeche layein. Bar ko haathon par neeche lurhakne dein, aur ungliyon ke aakhri jod se bar ko pakad lein.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue haath band karke bar ko jitna ho sake upar curl karein. Top par contraction rokein.

Finger Pushup.instructions_ur:
Haathon ki position:
Plank position mein shuru karein, haath bilkul kandhon ke neeche hon.
Ungliyan chauri phaila kar zameen par mazbooti se rakhein.
Ungliyon ki placement:
Dheere dheere hatheliyan zameen se uthayein, wazan ungliyon par muntaqil karte hue.
Wazan ko ungliyon ke siron aur angoothon par barabar taqseem karne par dhyan dein.
Jism ki alignment:
Core ko engage karne ke liye sar se eriyon tak seedhi line barqarar rakhein.
Poori exercise ke dauran jism ko control aur mustahkam position mein rakhein.
Neeche jaane ka marhala:
Aahista aahista kohniyan modein, seena zameen ki taraf neeche layein.
Harkat control mein rakhein, ungliyon ke siron par tawazun barqarar rakhte hue.
Upar push karna:
Ungliyon ke siron se dabaa kar baazu seedhe karein aur shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Poore push-up ke dauran ungliyon aur angoothon ke istemal par zor dein.

Flat Bench Cable Flyes.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ko do low pulleys ke darmiyan is tarah rakhein ke jab aap us par letein to aap ka seena cable pulleys ki seedh mein ho.
Bench par seedhe let jayein aur paon zameen par rakhein.
Kisi se kahein ke aap ke dono haathon mein handles pakra de. Har single handle ko hatheliyan ooper wali grip se pakrein.
Baazu side par phaila dein aur kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakhein. Tip: Yeh kham poori harkat ke dauran ek jaisa rakhein. Baazu farsh ke mutawazi (parallel) hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ab cables ko aapas mein khinchte hue baazuon ko seedha apne saamne aadhe daire (semi-circle) mein uthayein, yahan tak ke ooper dono haath mil jayein. Is dauran seene ko sakht karein aur saans bahar nikaalein. Ooper ek second contraction rok kar rakhein. Tip: Sahi tareeqe se karne par ooper wali position mein baazu dhad aur farsh ke amudi hon aur haath seene ke ooper milein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Flat Bench Leg Pull-In.instructions_ur:
Exercise mat ya flat bench par let jayein, taangein kinare se bahar hon.
Haath ya to glutes ke neeche hatheliyan neeche ki taraf rakhein ya pehluon mein bench pakar kar (ya exercise mat par pehluon mein hatheliyan neeche). Taangein bhi seedhi bahar phaila dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue ghutne modein aur raanon ko pait ki taraf kheenchein. Yeh harkat jaari rakhein yahan tak ke ghutne seene ke qareeb aa jayein. Is position ko ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Flat Bench Leg Raises.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur haath kulhon ke neeche rakh kar kamar ko sahara dein.
Ghutnon se neeche taangein bench se bahar hon, un ke neeche bench ka sahara na ho.
Paon jor kar aur paon ki ungliyan ooper ki taraf mor kar, seedhi taangein bench se kuch cm ooper uthayein; dono taangein bench ko na chhooein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ghutnon mein halka sa kham rakhte hue taangein seedhi rakhein aur unhein kulhon ke saath 90 degree se zara pehle tak ooper uthayein.
Ooper rukein aur aahista, control ke saath taangein wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Dohrayein.

Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise.name_ur: Flat Bench par Let kar Leg Raise
Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise.instructions_ur:
Bench par kamar seedhi rakh kar let jayein aur taangein saamne bench ke kinare se bahar phaila dein.
Haath ya to glutes ke neeche hatheliyan neeche ki taraf karke rakhein, ya side mein bench ko pakad lein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taangon ko jitna ho sake seedha rakhte hue, ghutne halke se mude magar lock hon, taangein upar uthayein yahan tak ke woh farsh ke saath 90 degree ka zaviya banayein. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein aur upar contraction ko ek second rokein.
Ab saans andar lete hue aahista aahista taangein wapas shuruati position tak neeche laayein.

Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls.instructions_ur:
Dumbbell ko us side se pakrein jo aap se door hai taake aap ke qareeb wali side par zyada wazan ho. (Yeh biceps ki tamaam dumbbell exercises mein achha asar deta hai.) Ab normal incline dumbbell curl karein, lekin kalaiyon ko jitna ho sake peeche rakhein taake un par parne wala dabao khatam ho jaye.
45 degree par set incline bench par baith jayein aur dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein.
Baazu side par neeche latakne dein, kohniyan andar rakhein, aur hatheliyan saamne ki taraf ghumayein, angoothe jism se bahar ki taraf hon. Tip: Poori harkat mein haathon ki yahi position rakhein, ooper aate hue haath bilkul na ghumayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Dono dumbbells ek saath curl karein jab tak biceps poori tarah sakht na ho jayein, aur saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Baazu na jhulayein aur jhatke (momentum) ka istemal na karein. Har waqt harkat control mein rakhein. Ooper sakht position mein ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Floor Dips.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position:
Baazu peeche rakh kar baith jayein, jo kamar ko sahara dein. Ungliyan aage ki taraf hon. Ghutne mude hue aur paon jure hue hon.
Steps:
Baazu seedhe karte hue kulhe zameen se upar uthayein.
Kohniyan moden, kulhon ko neeche laayein.
Baazu seedhe karein aur pichli position mein wapas aayein.
Step 2 aur 3 dohrayein.
Notes:
Exercise ki mushkil is par munhasir hai ke aap kulhe kitne oonche uthate hain.

Floor Glute-Ham Raise.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap partner ki madad le sakte hain ya paon kisi mazboot cheez ke neeche phansa sakte hain.
Ghutno ke bal shuru karein, raanein aur dhad seedhe khare hon. Agar partner hai, to woh aap ke paon mazbooti se pakar kar aap ko position mein rakhega. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne se seedha hote hue khud ko neeche layein, aur dhyan rakhein ke aage jaate hue kulhe NA moorein.
Farsh tak pahunchte hue haath apne saamne rakh dein. Yeh harkat bohat mushkil hai aur ho sakta hai aap baghair madad ke ise na kar sakein. Shuruati position mein wapas aane ke liye baazuon se farsh ko halka sa dhakelein.

Floor Press.instructions_ur:
J-hooks ko itni unchai par set karein ke bar rack ho sake. Zameen par is tarah let kar shuru karein ke sar power rack ke kinare ke qareeb ho. Shoulder blades aapas mein kheenche rakhte hue bar ko hooks se utarein.
Bar ko seene ke nichle hisse ya pait ke upar wale hisse ki taraf neeche layein, aur saath hi bar ko zor se dabayein aur usay kheench kar alag karne ki koshish karein. Poori harkat ke dauran kohniyan andar rakhein. Bar ko tab tak neeche layein jab tak upper arm zameen ko na chhoo le aur ruk jayein, weight ko patakhne ya uchhalne se bachein.
Bar ko jitni tezi se ho sake wapas upar press karein, bar, kalaiyan aur kohniyan ek seedh mein rakhte hue.

Floor Press with Chains.instructions_ur:
J-hooks ko itni unchai par set karein ke bar rack ho sake. Is exercise ke liye chains ko seedha bar ke kinare par latkayein, aur koshish karein ke un ke siray plates se door rahein.
Zameen par is tarah let kar shuru karein ke sar power rack ke kinare ke qareeb ho. Shoulder blades aapas mein kheenche rakhte hue bar ko hooks se utarein.
Bar ko seene ke nichle hisse ya pait ke upar wale hisse ki taraf neeche layein, aur saath hi bar ko zor se dabayein aur usay kheench kar alag karne ki koshish karein. Poori harkat ke dauran kohniyan andar rakhein. Bar ko tab tak neeche layein jab tak upper arm zameen ko na chhoo le aur ruk jayein, weight ko patakhne ya uchhalne se bachein.
Bar ko jitni tezi se ho sake wapas upar press karein, bar, kalaiyan aur kohniyan ek seedh mein rakhte hue.

Flutter Kicks.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par munh neeche kar ke let jayein, kulhe bench ke kinare par hon, taangein seedhi aur paon ki ungliyan farsh se kaafi ooper hon, aur baazu bench ke ooper rakh kar uska agla kinara pakrein.
Glutes aur hamstrings ko sakht karein aur taangein seedhi kar ke kulhon ki seedh tak layein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baayen taang ko daayen taang se zyada ooper utha kar harkat shuru karein.
Phir baayen taang neeche layein aur daayen taang ooper uthayein.
Isi tarah baari baari karte rahein (jaise paani mein flutter kick karte hain) jab tak har taang ke tay shuda reps poore na ho jayein. Har waqt harkat control mein rakhein. Tip: Is dauran normal saans lete rahein.

Fly With Cable.instructions_ur: cable machine, do qadam aage, kamar seedhi

Foam Roller Adductors.instructions_ur: Pait ke bal let jayein, ek taang mora kar side mein bahar rakhein aur foam roller raan ke andar wale hisse ke neeche ho. Darmiyani dabao ke saath adductors par aahista aahista aage peeche roll karein.

Foam Roller Anterior tibialis.instructions_ur: Apni pindli ke saamne wale hisse (tibialis anterior) ko foam roller par darmiyane dabaao ke saath aahista aahista aage peeche rol karein.

Foam Roller Gluteus.instructions_ur: Foam roller par baith jayein aur darmiyani dabao ke saath aahista aahista glutes par aage peeche roll karein.

Foam Roller Iliotibial band.instructions_ur: Pehlu ke bal let jayein, foam roller raan ke bahar wale hisse ke neeche rakhein aur darmiyane dabaao ke saath iliotibial band par aahista aahista aage peeche roll karein.

Foam Roller quadriceps.instructions_ur: Ulte let jayein, foam roller raanon ke neeche rakhein aur darmiyana dabao dete hue aahista aahista quadriceps par aage peeche roll karein.

Foot-SMR.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise paon ke muscles ke fascia ko stretch karti hai. Joote utaar kar baith kar shuru karein. Foot roller ya isi tarah ki koi cheez, jaise pvc pipe ka chhota tukra, istemal karein aur paon ko roller par is tarah rakhein ke roller paon ke talwe ke kham (arch) ke aar paar ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Mazbooti se dabayein aur paon ke arch par rol karein. 10-30 seconds rokein, phir paon badlein.

Forearm Curls (underhand grip).instructions_ur:
Muscles engage karein
Momentum istemal na karein
Control ke saath harkat
Aahista harkat

Forward Drag with Press.name_ur: Press ke saath Aage ki taraf Drag
Forward Drag with Press.instructions_ur:
Sled ke saath do handles wali chain ya rope attachment lagayein. Aap ka moonh sled se door ho, aur har haath mein ek handle ho.
Ek qadam aage chal kar harkat shuru karein. Aage jhukte hue, taangein aur kulhe seedhe kar ke aage barhein, har qadam par ruk kar kohniyan seedhi karein aur haath aage press karein. Tab tak aage qadam barhayein jab tak aap press ke liye tayyar shuruati position mein wapas na aa jayein.

Forward Lunge with Bicep Curl using Dumb.name_ur: Dumbbell Bicep Curl ke saath Aage ki taraf Lunge
Forward Lunge with Bicep Curl using Dumb.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan ooper ki taraf.
Paon jor kar khare hon, kamar seedhi rakhein aur pait andar khinchein.
Baazuon ko jism ki side par poori tarah neeche seedha latakne dein.
Jism seedha rakhte hue ek qadam aage barhayein aur phir kamar aur ghutna mor kar lunge karein.
Dhyan rakhein ke peeche wala ghutna farsh par na lagne paye.
Lunge mein jate hue baazuon ko kandhon ki taraf curl karein aur biceps ko sakht karein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein aur taang badal lein.
Note: Kisi Personal Trainer ya Instructor se yeh exercise sahi tareeqe se karna seekh lein.

Frankenstein Squat.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill aap ko clean aur front squat ke dauran bar aur jism dono ki sahi position sikhati hai.
