Barbell ko kandhon ke saamne rakhein, grip chhor dein aur baazu apne saamne phaila dein. Kandhe aage dhakel kar ek shelf banayein, aur bar gale ko chhoo rahi ho. Dhyan rakhein ke sirf kandhe ki haddiyan aage karein; kamar ke upar wale hisse (thoracic spine) ko gol na karein.
Ghutne aur kulhe mod kar squat karein, taangon ke darmiyan baithte hue. Dhad seedha, baazu upar aur kandhe aage rakhein, aur bar apni jagah par rehni chahiye. Squat ke sab se neeche tak jayein, yahan tak ke hamstrings pindliyon ko chhoo lein.
Edi ke agle hisse se zor laga kar aur ghutne aur kulhe seedhe karke wapas khari position mein aa jayein.

Freehand Jump Squat.instructions_ur:
Baazu seene par cross kar lein.
Sar upar aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein.
Kamar seedhi aur seena upar rakhte hue, saans andar lete hue squat mein neeche jayein yahan tak ke raanein zameen ke parallel ya us se neeche hon.
Ab zyada tar paon ke agle hisse (ball) se dabaa kar, raanon ko spring ki tarah istemal karte hue hawa mein jitna ooncha ho sake seedha uchhlein. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein.
Jab dobara zameen ko chhuen to foran squat mein neeche jayein aur phir uchhlein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Frog Hops.instructions_ur:
Haath sar ke peeche rakh kar khare ho jayein, aur dhad seedha aur sar upar rakhte hue squat karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kuch feet aage jump karein, bila wajah zyada ooncha jump karne se bachein. Jaise hi paon zameen ko chhuein, jhatka taangon se jazb karein aur dobara jump karein. Yeh 5-10 dafa dohrayein.

Frog Sit-Ups.instructions_ur:
Farsh (ya exercise mat) par kamar seedhi kar ke let jayein aur taangein saamne seedhi phaila dein.
Ab ghutne mor kar raanon ke bahari hisse ko farsh (ya mat) ki taraf rakhein aur paon ke talve aapas mein mila dein.
Ab dono talvon ko dhakelte hue jitna ho sake apne qareeb layein, aur raanon ke bahari hisse farsh par (ya kam az kam taqreeban chhute hue) rakhein. Tip: Is position mein aap ki taangein diamond ki shakal banayengi.
Ab baazuon ko saamne cross kar ke mukhalif kandhon ko chhuein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kamar ke nichle hisse ko farsh par chapta karein aur dhad ko oopar ki taraf curl karein. Tip: Yeh sit up ki pehli 1/4 harkat jaisa hoga. Oopar ki position mein ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Front Barbell Squat To A Bench.instructions_ur:
Hifazat ke liye yeh exercise squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai. Shuru karne ke liye pehle apne peeche flat bench rakhein aur bar ko rack par apne qad ke mutabiq oonchai par set karein. Sahi oonchai chun kar aur bar par wazan laga kar, baazuon ko bar ke neeche layein, kohniyan oonchi rakhein aur upper arm farsh ke mutawazi se thora ooper ho. Bar ko deltoids (kandhon ke patthon) ke ooper rakhein aur poore control ke liye baazu cross kar ke bar pakrein.
Pehle taangon se zor laga kar aur saath hi dhad seedha karte hue bar ko rack se uthayein.
Rack se hat kar taangon ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par medium stance mein rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf hon. Har waqt sar ooper rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigar jata hai, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. (Note: Yahan hum ooper bataya gaya medium stance istemal karenge jo overall development ke liye hai; lekin aap foot positioning section mein bataye gaye teenon stances mein se koi bhi chun sakte hain.)
Ghutne mor kar aahista aahista bar neeche layein, posture seedha aur sar ooper rakhein. Itna neeche jayein ke glutes bench ko chhoo lein. Is hisse mein saans andar lein. Tip: Agar exercise sahi ki gayi hai to ghutnon ka agla hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banaye ga jo saamne ki taraf amudi (perpendicular) ho. Agar ghutne us khayali line se aage nikal jayein (yaani paon ki ungliyon se aage) to ghutne par bewaja dabao parta hai aur exercise ghalat tareeqe se ki gayi hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue zyada tar aeri se farsh ko dhakel kar bar ooper uthayein, taangein dobara seedhi karein aur shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Front Box Jump.instructions_ur:
Munasib unchai ka box apne saamne 1-2 feet ke faasle par rakh kar shuru karein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Jump ki tayyari mein chhota squat karein, baazu peeche jhulayein.
Is position se uchhal kar, kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue jitna ho sake upar jump karein. Baazu aage aur upar jhulayein.
Ghutne mod kar box par land karein, impact ko taangon ke zariye jazb karein. Aap box se wapas zameen par jump kar sakte hain, ya behtar hai ke ek ek taang kar ke neeche utrein.

Front Cable Raise.instructions_ur:
Low pulley machine par wazan select karein aur low pulley se juda single hand cable attachment baayen haath se pakrein.
Pulley ki taraf peeth kar ke khare hon aur baazu seedha neeche rakhein, cable attachment raanon ke saamne baazu ki poori lambai par ho aur hatheli raanon ki taraf ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Dhad ko sakit rakhte hue (bilkul na jhoolein), baayen baazu ko kohni mein halka sa kham rakh kar saamne ki taraf uthayein, hatheli hamesha neeche ki taraf rahe. Itna ooper le jayein ke baazu farsh ke mutawazi se thora ooper ho jaye. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein aur ooper ek second rukein.
Ab saans andar lete hue baazu ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Is baazu ke tay shuda reps poore hone par baazu badlein aur daayen baazu se exercise karein.

Front Cone Hops (or hurdle hops).instructions_ur:
Cones ya doosri chhoti rukawaton ki ek qataar lagayein, unhein kuch foot ke faasle par rakhein.
Pehle cone ke saamne paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare ho jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dono paon se pehle cone ke upar se jump karke shuru karein, jump karte hue dono baazu jhulayein.
Utarte waqt ghutne mod kar jhatka jazb karein, aur pehli chhalaang se foran agle cone ke upar se jump karein.
Jab tak saare cones ke upar se jump na kar lein, jaari rakhein.

Front Incline Dumbbell Raise.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par baith jayein, incline 30 se 60 degree ke darmiyan ho, aur har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein. Tip: Muscle ko har dafa thora mukhtalif tareeqe se target karne ke liye angle badal sakte hain.
Baazu saamne seedhe phailayein, hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon aur dumbbells raanon se taqreeban 1 inch upar uthe hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan lock rakhte hue dumbbells ko aahista aahista seedha upar uthayein jab tak woh kandhon se thora upar na ho jayein. Upar ek second sukerein aur harkat ke is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Sar ko hamesha bench se laga kar rakhein aur taangein farsh par.
Saans andar lete hue baazu wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Front Leg Raises.instructions_ur:
Kursi ya kisi aur sahare ke paas khare ho jayein, ek haath se pakar lein.
Taang ko seedha rakhte hue aage ki taraf swing karein. Phir neeche ki taraf swing karte hue taang ko utna peeche le jayein jitna aap ki flexibility ijazat de. 5-10 dafa dohrayein, aur phir taang badal lein.

Front Plank.instructions_ur:
Plank ek bodyweight exercise hai. Ek multi-functional harkat hone ki wajah se plank sirf pait ke muscles ko hi nahi balke reerh ki haddi aur kulhon ko bhi target karta hai. Plank poore jism ko mazboot aur tight karta hai, posture aur balance behtar karta hai, jism ki charbi kam karta hai, aur metabolism barhane mein madad kar sakta hai.
"Plank pose" jaisi exercises pait ke stabilizing muscles ki stamina mazboot karne mein madad karti hain. Yeh jism ke stabilizing muscles ke kamzor hone se judi kamar ke dard mein bhi aaram de sakti hain.
Plank ek versatile exercise hai jo jism ke kai ahem muscle groups ko target karti hai, is liye koi bhi ise endurance aur jism ki overall taaqat behtar karne ke liye kar sakta hai.

Front Plate Raise.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho kar, barbell plate ko dono haathon se 3 aur 9 baje ki positions par pakrein. Hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf hon aur baazu seedhe aur lock hon, kohniyon mein halka sa kham ho, aur plate saamne kamar ke qareeb jitna neeche ho sake ho. Tip: Poori exercise ke dauran baazu isi position mein rahenge. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aahista aahista plate ko upar uthayein jab tak woh kandhon ki oonchai se thoda upar na aa jaye. Ek second ke liye sukri hui position rokein. Tip: Dhyan rakhein ke weight ko jhulayein nahi aur kohniyan na moorein. Poori harkat ke dauran dhad bhi saakit rehna chahiye.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista plate ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Front Raise And Pullover.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur barbell ko medium grip se pakrein (haathon ke darmiyan taqreeban 15 inch ka faasla).
Barbell ko raanon ke ooperi hisse par rakhein aur baazu seedhe lock karein, kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakhein.
Pait andar khinchein aur kamar bench par seedhi rakhte hue baazuon ko kaman (arc) ki shakal mein ooper aur sar ke peeche le jayein (jaise reverse pullover kar rahe hon).
Aahista aahista barbell ko raanon par shuruati position mein wapas layein.

Front Squat.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath set up karein, control ke saath harkat karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Front Squat (Clean Grip).instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye pehle bar ko rack mein kandhon se thora neeche set karein. Bar ko deltoids ke upar rakhein, hansli ki haddi par dabate hue, aur woh halka sa gale ko chhoo raha ho. Haath clean grip mein hon, bar ko sirf ungliyon se chhoo kar jagah par rakhne mein madad karein.
Pehle taangon se dhakel kar aur sath hi dhad seedha kar ke bar ko rack se uthayein. Rack se peeche hatein aur paon kandhon ke barabar medium stance mein rakhein, paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf hon. Sar aur kohniyan har waqt upar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne mor kar taangon ke darmiyan neeche baithein. Neeche jate rahein yahan tak ke hamstrings pindliyon par aa jayein. Squat karte hue abductors se ghutnon ko bahar dhakel kar ghutnon ko paon ki seedh mein rakhein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue zyada tar aedi ya paon ke darmiyani hisse se zameen ko dhakel kar bar uthana shuru karein, taangon ko dobara seedha karein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Front Squats With Two Kettlebells.name_ur: Do Kettlebells ke saath Front Squats
Front Squats With Two Kettlebells.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells ko clean kar ke kandhon tak layein. Kettlebells ko kandhon ki taraf kheenchte hue taangon aur kulhon ko seedha kar ke unhein kandhon tak clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalaiyan ghumayein.
Har waqt seedha saamne dekhte hue, jitna neeche ho sake squat karein aur neeche ruk jayein. Neeche squat karte hue ghutnon ko bahar ki taraf dhakelein. Taangon ke darmiyan squat karein, dhad seedha rakhein, aur sar aur seena upar rakhein.
Aediyon se zor laga kar wapas upar uthein aur dohrayein.

Front Two-Dumbbell Raise.instructions_ur:
Do dumbbells uthayein aur seedhe dhad ke saath khare hon, dumbbells raanon ke saamne baazuon ki lambai par hon aur hatheliyan raanon ki taraf. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad ko saakit rakhte hue (koi jhulna nahi), kohni mein halka sa kham rakh kar aur hatheliyan hamesha neeche ki taraf rakhte hue dumbbells ko saamne uthayein. Upar jaate rahein yahan tak ke baazu zameen ke parallel se thora upar hon. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein aur top par ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue dumbbells ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Full Range-Of-Motion Lat Pulldown.instructions_ur:
Ya to khare ho kar ya oonche bench par baith kar, high pulleys se lage do stirrup cables pakrein. Ulte haath se pakrein taa ke baazu aap ke saamne cross hon aur hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon.
Seena upar rakhte hue aur kamar ke nichle hisse mein halka sa kham barqarar rakhte hue, handles ko aise neeche kheenchein jaise aam pulldown karte hain. Harkat ka daira zyada kaman (arc) ki shakal ka hoga. Harkat ke dauran haath ghumayein taa ke neeche wali position mein hatheliyan saamne ke bajaye ek doosre ki taraf hon. Aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur dohrayein.

Gironda Sternum Chins.instructions_ur:
Pull-up bar ko kandhon ke barabar ulti grip se pakrein.
Ab baazu poori tarah seedhe kar ke latak jayein, seena bahar nikaalein aur peeche jhukein. Tip: Poori harkat ke dauran aap peeche jhuke rahenge. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Reedh ki haddi ko kham diye hue aur sar ko bar se jitna door ho sake peeche jhukaye hue, khud ko bar ki taraf kheenchna shuru karein. Harkat ke is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Harkat ke oopari hisse mein aap ke kulhe aur taangein farsh se taqreeban 45 degree ke angle par hongi.
Kheenchte rahein jab tak hansli ki haddi bar se aage na nikal jaye aur seene ka nichla hissa ya sternum wala hissa bar ko na chhoo le. Ek second ke liye sukri hui position rokein. Tip: Jab tak aap harkat ka yeh hissa poora karenge, aap ka sar farsh ke parallel ho chuka hoga.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein jana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Glute Bridge.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Glute Ham Raise.instructions_ur:
Shuru mein equipment ko apne jism ke mutabiq set karein. Ulte let kar paon ko rollers ke darmiyan footplate ke saath laga dein. Ghutne pad ke bilkul peeche hone chahiyein.
Harkat ke neeche wale hisse se shuru karein. Kamar mein kham rakhte hue ghutne mod kar harkat shuru karein. Aisa karte hue paon ki ungliyan footplate mein dabayein. Jism ka upar wala hissa seedha rakhein, aur tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak jism seedha khara na ho jaye.
Neeche aate hue control rakhte hue wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Glute Kickback.instructions_ur:
Farsh ya exercise mat par ghutno ke bal baith jayein aur kulhon se aage jhukein, baazu apne saamne seedhe hon (dhad ke amudi), taake ghutno ke bal push-up wali position ban jaye magar baazu kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Sar saamne dekh raha ho aur ghutnon ka mor hamstrings aur pindliyon ke darmiyan 90 degree ka zaviya banaye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, 90 degree ka mor barqarar rakhte hue daayin taang upar uthayein yahan tak ke hamstrings kamar ki seedh mein aa jayein. Poori harkat ke dauran glutes ko sukerein aur upar contraction ko ek second rokein. Tip: Harkat ke aakhir mein raan farsh ke mutawazi aur pindli farsh ke amudi honi chahiye.
Saans andar lete hue shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur ab baayin taang se dohrayein.
Jab tak saare tay shuda reps mukammal na ho jayein, baari baari taangein badalte rahein.

Goblet Squat.instructions_ur:
Dumbbell ko dono haathon se upar wali plates ki sides se pakdein. Dumbbell ko seene ke saamne, dhad ke qareeb rakhein. Paon taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein, ghutne thode mude rakhein.
Raanein farsh ke mutawazi hone tak squat karein. Kamar seedhi rakhein, kulhe mod kar peeche le jayein taake ghutne paon ke upar rahein. Wapas aayein, ghutne thode mude rakhein. Dohrayein.
Jism ka wazan aedhiyon par rakhein aur saamne ya thoda upar dekhein taake kamar seedhi rahe.

Good Morning off Pins.instructions_ur:
Bar ko rack par taqreeban apne pait ki unchai par rakh kar shuru karein. Bar ke neeche jhukein aur bar ko kandhon ke pichle hisse par rack karein jaise power squat mein karte hain, kandhon ke bilkul upar nahin. Sahi unchai par, jhukne par aap taqreeban zameen ke mutawazi honge. Kamar tight rakhein, shoulder blades aapas mein dabe hon, aur ghutne halke se mude hon. Kamar mehraab numa (arched) rakhein aur gardan ki haddi sahi seedh mein rakhein.
Glutes aur hamstrings ke zariye kulhe seedhe kar ke harkat shuru karein, yahan tak ke aap weight ke saath khare ho jayein. Aahista aahista weight ko wapas pins par neeche layein aur shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Gorilla Chin/Crunch.instructions_ur:
Chin-up bar se ulti grip (hatheliyan aap ki taraf) ke saath latak jayein, grip kandhon ke faasle se thori chauri ho.
Ab ghutnon ko 90 degree ke angle par morein taake pindliyan farsh ke parallel hon aur raanein farsh ke perpendicular rahein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue khud ko oopar kheenchein aur saath hi ghutnon ko oopar crunch karein jab tak ghutne seene ki unchai tak na aa jayein. Jaise hi aap ki naak bar ki seedh mein aaye, oopar jana rok dein. Tip: Is maqaam par pohanch kar crunch bhi saath hi mukammal ho jana chahiye.
Aahista aahista saans andar lena shuru karein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Groin and Back Stretch.instructions_ur:
Farsh par baith jayein, ghutne mor lein aur paon aapas mein mila lein.
Ungliyan aapas mein phansa kar sar ke peeche rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Neeche ki taraf curl karein aur kohniyon ko raanon ke andar ki taraf layein. Zara ruk kar sar oopar aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. 10-20 reps dohrayein.

Groiners.instructions_ur:
Farsh par pushup position mein shuru karein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Dono taangon se aage jump karein aur paon haathon ke bilkul saath land karein. Aisa karte hue sar upar rakhein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur foran harkat dohrayein, 10-20 reps tak jaari rakhein.

Hack Squat.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise Squat ki ek qisam hai jo machine par ki jati hai. Beginners is exercise ko zyada pasand kar sakte hain.
Hack Squat machine par munh ooper kar ke let jayein aur kandhe pad ke saath laga dein.
Paon seedhe saamne ki taraf, kandhon ke faasle se thora kam faasle par rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf hon.
Dock levers chhor dein aur haath hand grips par rakhein.
Pait andar khinchte hue jism ko seedha kar ke khare ho jayein.
Jism ko squat position mein neeche layein taake ghutne aise murein jaise aap baith rahe hon.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Hammer Curl.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath set up karein, control ke saath harkat karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Hammer Curls with Rope and Cable.name_ur: Rope aur Cable ke saath Hammer Curls
Hammer Curls with Rope and Cable.instructions_ur:
Cable machine ke saath rope istemal karne se Hammer Curl ki is qisam mein biceps ko alag se target kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh beginners ke liye achhi exercise hai.
Weight stack ke neeche wali cable pulley par rope laga dein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne thore se mude hon aur pait andar khincha ho. Rope ko tang underhand grip se pakrein (hatheliyan ooper ki taraf). Baazuon ko poori tarah raanon ke ooper tak neeche layein aur sirf kohniyan mor kar rope ko seene ke ooperi hisse tak uthayein. Ek lamha rukein aur phir shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Note: Poori exercise mein kohniyan side par rakhein. Exercise ke dauran kulhe ya kamar na jhulayein.

Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press.name_ur: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par peeche let jayein, dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell raanon ke ooper rakhein. Hatheliyan aamne saamne hon.
Raanon ki madad se dumbbells ooper layein, ek ek baazu se clean karein taake unhein kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakar sakein.
Kandhon ke faasle par aa kar hatheliyan neutral grip mein rakhein (hatheliyan aamne saamne). Kohniyan bahar ki taraf phaili hon, upper arms kandhon ki seedh mein (dhad ke amudi) hon aur kohniyan mor kar upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle banayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ab saans andar lete hue wazan aahista aahista side mein neeche layein. Har waqt dumbbells par poora control rakhein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ke patthon (pectoral muscles) se dumbbells ooper dhakelein. Contracted position mein baazu lock karein, ek second rukein aur phir aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein ooper jane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Khatam hone par dumbbells pehle raanon par aur phir farsh par rakhein. Dumbbells rakhne ka yeh sab se mehfooz tareeqa hai.

Hammercurls on Cable.instructions_ur:
Cable haathon mein pakrein (hatheliyan aamne saamne), jism seedha ho. Baazu mor kar tezi se wazan ooper layein. Baghair ruke aahista aur control ke saath wapas neeche layein, lekin baazu poori tarah seedhe na karein.
Exercise ke dauran jism na jhulayein, saara kaam biceps ko karna chahiye. Kohniyan side par rahein aur na hilein.

Hammerstrength Decline Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Hammerstrength decline chest press machine mein seedhe baith jayein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein aur ediyan ghutnon ke neeche zameen par mazbooti se rakhein.
Back pad hamesha aapke sar, kandhon aur kulhon se laga rehna chahiye.
Handles ko overhand grip se kandhon se thora chaura, seene se bilkul neeche pakrein.
Pait mein saans le kar aur abs ko sukerte hue core ko tight rakhein, hatheliyon se zor laga kar kohniyan seedhi karein aur kohniyon ko dhad se 45 degree ke angle par rakhein.
Jab baazu poori tarah seedhe ho jayein to wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Hamstring Foam roller.instructions_ur: Hamstrings ko aahista aahista foam roller par chalayein

Hamstring Kicks.instructions_ur: Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon aur ek baazu apne saamne seedha karein. Us taraf ki taang ko saamne upar jhulayein aur wapas neeche layein, taang ko jitna ho sake seedha rakhte hue aur paon ki ungliyan upar ki taraf. Doosri taang ke saath dohrayein.

Hamstring Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein, ek taang upar ki taraf seedhi ho aur kulha nabbe degree par ho. Doosri taang zameen par seedhi rakhein.
Belt, band ya rope ko paon ke agle hisse (ball) par lapetein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Belt ko kheench kar pindliyon aur hamstrings mein tension paida karein. Yeh stretch 10-30 second tak rokein, aur doosri taang ke saath dohrayein.

Hamstring-SMR.instructions_ur:
Baith kar taangein foam roll ke oopar phailayein taake woh upper legs ke peeche ho. Wazan sambhalne ke liye haath side par ya peeche rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Haathon ki madad se kulhe farsh se uthayein aur foam roll par wazan ek taang par daal dein. Jis taang ka stretch kar rahe hain uske hamstrings ko dheela chhor dein.
Kulhe ke neeche se ghutne ke peeche ke oopar tak foam par roll karein, tension wali jagahon par 10-30 second ruk jayein. Doosri taang ke liye dohrayein.

Hand Grip.instructions_ur:
Spring wala hand grip trainer jo grip ki taaqat aur forearm flexors banane ke liye hai.
Position: hand grip ko ek haath mein mazbooti se pakrein.
Dabana: jitna zor se ho sake band karein, handles ko aapas mein milane ki koshish karein.
Chhorna: sukerne ko ek ya do second rokein, phir spring ka muqabla karte hue haath aahista aahista aur control ke saath kholein.

Handstand Pushup.instructions_ur: Handstand push-up (press-up), jise vertical push-up (press-up) ya inverted push-up (press-up) bhi kehte hain, aur commandos bhi kaha jata hai, push-up ki aisi qism hai jis mein jism handstand position mein hota hai. Asal handstand ke liye yeh exercise baghair sahare ke, hawa mein ruk kar ki jati hai. Jab tak kaafi balance na ban jaye, taqat tayyar karne ke liye aksar paon deewar se laga diye jate hain, partner pakarta hai, ya kisi aur tareeqe se girne se bachaya jata hai. Handstand pushups ke liye kaafi taqat chahiye hoti hai, aur baghair sahare ke karne par balance aur control bhi.

Hang Clean.instructions_ur:
Kandhon ke barabar, double overhand ya hook grip se shuru karein, bar raan ke darmiyan tak latki ho. Kamar seedhi aur thori aage ki taraf jhuki ho.
Kulhon, ghutnon aur takhnon ko zor se seedha kar ke wazan ko upar dhakelein. Aisa karte hue kandhon ko kaanon ki taraf shrug karein.
Foran ediyon se zor laga kar recover karein, dhad seedha aur kohniyan upar rakhein. Tab tak upar uthte rahein jab tak aap khari position mein na aa jayein.

Hang Clean - Below the Knees.instructions_ur:
Kandhon ke barabar faasle par double overhand ya hook grip se shuru karein, bar ghutnon se bilkul neeche latak raha ho. Kamar seedhi aur thori aage ki taraf jhuki honi chahiye.
Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne poori taqat se seedhe kar ke wazan ko upar dhakelna shuru karein. Sath hi kandhon ko kaanon ki taraf shrug karein. Jab poori extension ho jaye, to zor se shrug karte hue aur kohniyan upar aur bahar rakh kar baazu morte hue third pull mein jayein.
Poori extension par zor se khud ko neeche khinchein, sath hi kohniyon ko bar ke neeche ghumayein. Bar ko front squat position mein pakrein, jis ki gehrai third pull ke aakhir mein bar ki oonchai par munhasir hai. Bar aage nikle hue kandhon par rack ho, halka sa gale ko chhoo raha ho aur haath dheele hon. Neeche squat position tak jate rahein, is se uthne mein madad milegi.
Foran aediyon se zor lagate hue uthein, dhad seedha aur kohniyan upar rakhein. Khari position tak uthte rahein.

Hang Snatch.instructions_ur:
Bar ko chauri grip se, overhand ya hook grip ke saath pakar kar shuru karein. Paon kulhon ke bilkul neeche hon aur paon ki ungliyan bahar ki taraf mudi hon. Ghutne halke se mude hon aur dhad aage ki taraf jhuka ho. Reerh ki haddi poori tarah seedhi aur sar aage ki taraf ho. Bar kulhon par ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taangon aur kulhon ko zor se seedha karein. Poori extension par kandhon ko shrug karein aur kohniyon ko side ki taraf mudne dein.
Paon ko receiving position mein le jate hue, zor se khud ko bar ke neeche kheenchein aur bar ko sar ke oopar le jayein. Bar ko is tarah receive karein ke jism jitna ho sake neeche ho aur baazu sar ke oopar poori tarah seedhe hon.
Weight sar ke oopar rakhte hue khare ho jayein. Phir control ke saath weight ko wapas zameen par rakh dein.

Hang Snatch - Below Knees.instructions_ur:
Bar par chauri grip se, overhand ya hook grip ke saath shuru karein. Paon kulhon ke bilkul neeche hon aur bahar ki taraf mude hon. Ghutne thore se mude hon, aur dhad aage jhuka hua ho. Reerh ki haddi poori tarah seedhi aur sar saamne ki taraf ho. Bar ghutnon se bilkul neeche honi chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taangon aur kulhon ko zor se seedha karein. Poore extension par kandhon ko shrug karein aur kohniyon ko side mein mudne dein.
Paon ko receiving position mein le jate hue, khud ko zor se bar ke neeche khinchein aur bar ko sar ke upar le jayein. Bar ko jitna ho sake neeche jism ke saath aur baazu sar ke upar poori tarah seedhe karke receive karein.
Weight sar ke upar rakhte hue wapas khari position mein aayein, aur phir weight ko control ke saath farsh par wapas rakhein.

Hanging Bar Good Morning.instructions_ur:
Bar ko rack par taqreeban pait ki unchai par rakhein. Bar ko chains ya suspension straps se latkayein.
Bar ke neeche jhukein aur bar ko kandhon ke pichle hisse par rakhein jaise power squat mein rakhte hain, traps ke upar nahi. Sahi unchai par, jhuki hui halat mein aap zameen ke taqreeban parallel hone chahiyein. Kamar tight rakhein, shoulder blades aapas mein dabaye hue, aur ghutne halke mude hue. Kamar mein kham rakhein aur gardan ki haddi (cervical spine) sahi alignment mein rakhein.
Glutes aur hamstrings se kulhe seedhe karte hue harkat shuru karein, yahan tak ke aap wazan ke saath khare ho jayein.
Aahista aahista wazan ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein, jahan woh chains par tika ho.

Hanging Knee Raise.instructions_ur: Pull-up bar ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Hanging Leg Raise.instructions_ur: pull-up bar ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Hanging Pike.instructions_ur:
Chin-up bar se latkein, taangein aur paon saath mila kar, overhand grip (hatheliyan aap se door) ke saath jo kandhon se thori chauri ho. Tip: Bar pakarne mein aasani ke liye aap wrist wraps istemal kar sakte hain.
Ab ghutne 90 degree par moden aur raanon ko aage layein taake pindliyan farsh ke perpendicular hon jabke raanein uske parallel rahein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue taangein upar kheenchein jab tak pindliyon ki saamne wali haddi upar wale bar ko taqreeban na chhoo le. Tip: Top par taangein jitna ho sake seedhi karne ki koshish karein.
Taangein jitna ho sake aahista neeche layein jab tak shuruati position tak na pohanch jayein. Tip: Har waqt jhoolne aur momentum istemal karne se bachein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Head Tilts.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position:
Kamar seedhi rakh kar baith jayein ya khare ho jayein.
Steps:
Sar ko ek taraf jhukayein aur thori dair rokein.
Sar ko neutral position mein wapas layein aur thori dair rokein.
Sar ko doosri taraf jhukayein aur thori dair rokein.
Sar ko ek baar phir neutral position mein wapas layein aur thori dair rokein.
Dohrayein.

Head Turns.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position:
Kamar seedhi aur kandhe neeche rakh kar baithein ya khare hon.
Steps:
Seedhe baithein ya khare hon, kandhe dheele neeche.
Sar ko jitna ho sake side ki taraf ghumayein. Jab rukawat mehsoos ho to ruk jayein aur 5 second rokein.
Beech ki position mein wapas aayein aur side badal kar dohrayein.

Heaving Snatch Balance.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill snatch seekhne mein madad karti hai. Halka weight kandhon ke peeche rakh kar shuru karein. Paon kulhon ke faasle se thore chaure hon aur paon ki ungliyan bahar ki taraf mudi hon, wahi position jis mein aap squat karte hain.
Ghutnon ko halka sa jhuka kar dip karein aur bar ko thori der ke liye halka karne ke liye tezi se wapas oopar uthein. Khud ko bar ke neeche le jayein aur poore squat mein jate hue bar ko sar ke oopar uthayein.
Khare ho kar wapas aa jayein.

Heavy Bag Thrust.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye heavy bag istemal karein. Bag ke saath seedhe stance mein khare hon, paon aage peeche aur kaafi khule hon. Haath bag par taqreeban seene ki unchai par rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kamar se ghoomte hue bag ko jitna zor se ho sake aage dhakelein. Yeh harkat tezi se karein, bag ko apne jism se door dhakelein.
Jab bag wapas jhool kar aaye to inhi qadmon ko ulta karke usay thaam lein.

High Cable Curls.instructions_ur:
Do high pulleys ke darmiyan khare hon aur har haath mein ek handle pakrein. Upper arms ko farsh ke mutawazi rakhein aur hatheliyan apni taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Handles ko apni taraf curl karein jab tak woh kaanon ke paas na aa jayein. Aisa karte hue biceps ko sakht karein aur saans bahar nikaalein. Upper arms sakit rahein aur sirf forearms hilein. Contracted position mein biceps ko daba kar ek second rukein.
Aahista aahista baazu wapas shuruati position par layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

High Knee Jumps.instructions_ur:
Taangein kandhon ki chaurai se thodi zyada khuli rakh kar shuru karein
Bodyweight squat mein neeche jayein
Squat ke bottom par pahunchte hi zor se upar jump karein aur saath hi hawa mein ghutnon ko seene ki taraf samet lein. Jump ki sab se oonchi jagah tak ghutne samete rakhein.
Dono paon par utrein, dhyan rakhein ke ghutne lock na hon taake jodon par zyada dabaao na pade. Jitni jaldi magar control ke saath ho sake agle rep ke liye khud ko sambhaalein.

High Knees.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position: Seedhe khare ho jayein.
Steps:
Ek hi jagah par dauren, ghutnon ko jitna aaram se ho sake utna ooncha layein aur tez raftar se taangein badlein.

High-Cable Cross Tricep Extention - NB.instructions_ur:
High-cable cross tricep extension triceps ko target karne wali ek isolation exercise hai,
khaas tor par long head ko. Is mein cables aur handles ko ulte haathon se pakra jata hai, jis se ek munfarid press wali harkat banti hai jo tricep ki taaqat barhane mein asar daar ho sakti hai. Seedhi bar ya rope wali exercises ke muqable mein yeh tareeqa kalaiyon aur kohniyon ke liye zyada aaramdeh ho sakta hai

High-pulley Pullover.instructions_ur:
Machine ki taraf munh karke khare hon, paon thode khule hon, bar ko overhand grip se pakdein, baazu seedhe hon, haath kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Kamar ko saakit aur pait ke muscles ko sukere hue rakhein, saans andar lein aur baazu seedhe rakhte hue (ya kohniyan thodi mudi hui) bar ko raanon tak neeche layein.
Harkat ke aakhir mein saans bahar nikaalein.

Hindu Pushups.instructions_ur: Kandhon aur seene ke muscles (pectorals) ko mazboot karne ki exercise. Iska naam is wajah se hai ke yeh Yoga ki position "Dog Facing Down" se shuru hoti hai, phir "Cobra" mein jati hai magar taangein ya dhad zameen par tikaye baghair, aur aakhir mein aam push-up par khatam hoti hai. Yeh exercise ulti taraf bhi ki ja sakti hai (wapas shuruati position tak). Doosre tareeqe ke tor par, push-up ke baad kulhe upar utha kar wapas downward facing dog mein aaya ja sakta hai.

Hip Adduction.instructions_ur:
Cable pulley stack ke saath khare hon aur cuff ko pulley aur apne takhne se bandh dein.
Stack se thora door hat jayein aur sahare ke liye stack ko pakar lein.
Jis paon par cable nahi bandhi us par mazbooti se khare ho kar, cuff wale takhne ko aahista aahista sahara dene wali taang ke saamne ki taraf khinchein.
Dohrayein aur takhna badal lein.

Hip Circles (prone).instructions_ur:
Zameen par haathon aur ghutnon ke bal aa jayein. Achha posture barqarar rakhte hue ek mura hua ghutna zameen se uthayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutna mura rakhte hue raan ki haddi ko ek kaus mein ghumayein, ghutne se bara daira banane ki koshish karein.
Yeh aahista aahista kuch reps tak karein, aur doosri side par dohrayein.

Hip Crossover.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein, baazu side par phailaye hue, ghutne mude hue aur taangein aapas mein mili hon.
Kandhe aur baazu farsh par rakhte hue aahista aahista dono ghutnon ko ek side par neeche layein. Aap ko kulhon, glutes aur kamar ke nichle hisse mein stretch mehsoos hona chahiye.
Thori der rokein, ghutnon ko wapas beech mein layein aur doosri side par dohrayein.

Hip Extension with Bands.instructions_ur:
Band ka ek sira kisi post ke nichle hisse se mazbooti se bandhein aur doosra ek takhne se lagayein.
Band ke bandhe hue point ki taraf munh kar ke, khud ko sambhalne ke liye column ko pakrein.
Sar aur seena upar rakhte hue, ghutna seedha rakh kar resistance wali taang ko jitna ho sake peeche le jayein.
Taang ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.

Hip Flexion with Band.instructions_ur:
Band ka ek sira post ke nichle hisse se mazbooti se baandhein aur doosra sira ek takhne se jor dein.
Band ke bandhe hue point ki taraf peeth kar ke khare hon.
Sar aur seena upar rakhte hue ghutne ko 90 degree tak uthayein aur rukein.
Taang ko wapas shuruati position mein le aayein.

Hip Flexor Stretch.instructions_ur:
Lunge position mein ghutno ke bal baithein, ek ghutna farsh par aur doosra paon aage, haath kulhon par.
Dhad seedha rakhein, pichhli taang ke glute ko sukerein aur kulhon ko aage dhakelein jab tak kulhe aur raan ke saamne stretch mehsoos na ho. Rokein, phir side badlein.

Hip Lift with Band.instructions_ur:
Munasib band chunne ke baad, use apne dono taraf secure kar ke rack ke beech mein let jayein. Agar aap ke rack mein pegs nahi hain to band ko bhaari dumbbells ya isi tarah ki cheezon se secure kar sakte hain, bas yaqeeni banayein ke woh hilein nahi.
Apni position aisi adjust karein ke band seedha aap ke kulhon ke oopar ho. Ghutne mor lein aur paon farsh par seedhe rakhein. Haath farsh par ho sakte hain ya band ko position mein pakar sakte hain.
Kandhe zameen par rakhte hue aediyon se zor laga kar kulhe uthayein, band mein jitna ho sake oopar dhakelein.
Harkat ke oopar ruk jayein, aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Hip-Out and Hip-In Lateral Steps.instructions_ur:
Hip-Out aur Hip-In Lateral Steps ka jaiza
Hip-out aur hip-in lateral steps asar daar exercises hain jo hip abductors ko mazboot karne aur side ki stability badhane ke liye banayi gayi hain. Yeh harkatein coordination aur kulhon ke overall kaam ko behtar banane mein faidemand hain.
Exercises ki tafseel
Hip-Out Steps
Harkat: Ek taang se side ki taraf qadam bahar rakhein, doosri taang ko mustahkam rakhein.
Target Muscles: Zyada tar hip abductors ko kaam mein laata hai, jin mein gluteus medius aur minimus shamil hain.
Faide: Kulhon ke hisse mein side ki stability aur taqat badhata hai.
Hip-In Steps
Harkat: Bahar qadam rakhne ke baad taang ko wapas center ki taraf layein.
Target Muscles: Hip abductors ko kaam mein rakhta hai aur saath hi adductors ko bhi active karta hai.
Faide: Kulhe ke jod ki coordination aur control behtar karta hai.
Lateral Steps ke ahem faide
| Faida | Tafseel |
|---|---|
| Hip Abductors ki mazbooti | Kulhe ke jod ke gird muscles ki taqat behtar karta hai. |
| Stability mein izafa | Side ki stability badhata hai, girne ka khatra kam karta hai. |
| Coordination behtar karna | Kulhon mein behtar control aur harkat ke patterns banata hai. |
Hip-out aur hip-in lateral steps ko apni regular exercise routine mein shamil karne se kulhon ki taqat aur stability behtar ho sakti hai, jo mukhtalif jismani sargarmiyon aur rozana ki harkaton ke liye zaroori hai.

Hollow Hold.instructions_ur: Mat par kamar ke bal let jayein. Abs ko sukerein, baazu aur taangein seedhi phaila kar upar uthayein (sar aur kandhe bhi uthe hue hon). Dhyan rakhein ke kamar ka nichla hissa mat se laga rahe.

Hug A Ball.instructions_ur:
Zameen par baith jayein.
Exercise ball ko dono taangon ke darmiyan rakhein aur kulhon ko zameen ki taraf neeche layein.
Jism ko sahara dene ke liye baazuon se ball ko gale lagayein. Taangon ko is tarah set karein ke paon zameen par seedhe hon aur ghutne takhnon ki seedh mein hon. Ball ko achhi tarah pakre rakhein taake woh lurhak kar door na jaye aur aap peeche kulhon ke bal na gir jayein.

Hug Knees To Chest.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein aur dono ghutne seene tak kheenchein.
Baazu ghutnon ke neeche rakhein, upar nahi (is se ghutnon ke joron par zyada dabaao parega).
Aahista aahista ghutnon ko kandhon ki taraf kheenchein. Is se kulhon ke muscles ka bhi stretch hota hai.

Hurdle Hops.instructions_ur:
Hurdles ya doosri chhoti rukawaton ki ek qatar lagayein, unhein kuch feet ke faasle par rakhein.
Pehle hurdle ke saamne paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare ho jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dono paon se pehle hurdle ke upar se chhalang laga kar shuru karein, chhalang lagate hue dono baazu swing karein.
Ghutne mor kar landing ka jhatka jazb karein, aur pehli chhalang se foran uchhal kar agle hurdle ke upar se kood jayein. Tamam hurdles par se koodne tak jari rakhein.

Hyperextensions (Back Extensions).instructions_ur:
Hyperextension bench par munh neeche kar ke let jayein aur takhnon ko footpads ke neeche mazbooti se phansa lein.
Agar mumkin ho to ooper wala pad adjust karein taake raanon ka ooperi hissa chaure pad par seedha tika ho, aur kamar se baghair kisi rukawat ke jhukne ki kaafi jagah ho.
Jism seedha rakh kar baazu saamne cross kar lein (meri pasand) ya sar ke peeche rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. Tip: Zyada resistance ke liye aap cross kiye hue baazuon ke neeche saamne weight plate bhi pakar sakte hain.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue kamar se aahista aahista jitna ho sake aage jhukein. Is harkat mein saans andar lein. Itna aage jhukte rahein ke hamstrings mein achha stretch mehsoos ho aur kamar gol kiye baghair mazeed aage na ja sakein. Tip: Is exercise mein kabhi bhi kamar gol na karein. Kuch log doosron se zyada aage ja sakte hain. Asal baat yeh hai ke kamar gol kiye baghair jitna aap ka jism ijazat de utna jayein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dhad ko wapas shuruati position tak uthayein. Tip: Kamar ko seedhi line se zyada peeche morne se bachein. Kamar ko chot se bachane ke liye kabhi bhi dhad ko na jhulayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Hyperextensions With No Hyperextension B.instructions_ur:
Koi aapki taangein daba kar pakre, aur aap flat bench ke kinare tak khisak jayein yahan tak ke aapke kulhe bench ke kinare se bahar latak jayein. Tip: Aapka poora upar wala jism farsh ki taraf latka hona chahiye. Aap usi position mein honge jaise hyperextension bench par hote hain, lekin flat bench ki unchai hyperextension bench se kam hone ki wajah se range of motion chhoti hogi.
Jism seedha rakhte hue baazu saamne cross karein (meri pasand) ya sar ke peeche rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi. Tip: Mazeed resistance ke liye cross kiye hue baazuon ke neeche saamne weight plate bhi pakar sakte hain.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se aahista aahista jitna ho sake aage jhukein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans andar lein. Aage jhukte rahein jab tak aap farsh ko taqreeban chhoo na lein ya hamstrings mein achha stretch mehsoos na ho (jo bhi pehle ho). Tip: Yeh exercise karte hue kamar kabhi gol na karein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue dhad ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein uthayein. Tip: Kamar ko seedhi line se zyada peeche arch karne se bachein. Kamar ko chot se bachane ke liye dhad ko kabhi jhatka na dein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

IT Band and Glute Stretch.instructions_ur:
Belt, rope ya band ko ek paon ke gird lapaitein, aur zameen par lete hue taang ko seedha rakhte hue use jism ke upar se doosri taraf le jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Paon ko zameen se upar rakhte hue belt ko khinchein, aur tension se paon ki ungliyon ko upar khinchein. 10-20 seconds tak rukein, aur doosri taraf dohrayein.

Iliotibial Tract-SMR.instructions_ur:
Karwat ke bal let jayein, neeche wali taang kulhe aur ghutne ke darmiyan foam roller par rakhein. Doosri taang saamne cross kar sakte hain.
Jitna bardasht ho sake utna wazan neeche wali taang par daalein; neeche wali taang ko zameen se lagaye rakhne ki zaroorat nahi. Jis taang ko stretch kar rahe hain uske muscles dheele rakhein.
Taang ko foam par kulhe se ghutne tak roll karein, tanao wali jagahon par 10-30 seconds rukein. Doosri taang se dohrayein.

Inchworm.instructions_ur:
Paon qareeb qareeb rakh kar khare ho jayein. Taangein seedhi rakhte hue neeche jhukein aur haath bilkul saamne farsh par rakh dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Haathon ko baari baari baayan aur daayan aahista aahista aage chalana shuru karein. Aisa karte hue sirf kulhon se jhukein, taangein seedhi rakhein.
Tab tak chalte rahein jab tak jism push-up position mein zameen ke mutawazi na ho jaye.
Ab haath apni jagah rakhein aur paon se aahista aahista chhote qadam lein, ek waqt mein sirf kuch inch aage barhein.
Tab tak chalte rahein jab tak paon haathon ke paas na aa jayein, aur aisa karte hue taangein seedhi rakhein.

Incline Barbell Bench Press.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath set up karein, control ke saath harkat karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Incline Barbell Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko overhand grip (hatheliyan neeche) se pakrein, haathon ka faasla kandhon ke faasle se thora kam ho.
45 se 75 degree ke darmiyan kisi bhi angle par set incline bench par peeche let jayein.
Baazu seedhe aur kohniyan andar rakh kar bar ko sar ke ooper layein. Baazu sar ke ooper dhad ki seedh mein hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ab bar ko aadhe daire ki shakal mein sar ke peeche neeche layein jab tak forearms biceps ko na chhoo lein. Is harkat mein saans andar lein. Tip: Upper arms har waqt sakit aur sar ke qareeb rakhein. Sirf forearms hilne chahiyein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aur triceps ko sakht karte hue shuruati position par wapas aayein. Contraction ek second rok kar rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Incline Bench Press - Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Yeh flat bench press ki ek qisam hai jo pectoralis major ke clavicular head (seene ke ooperi hisse) par zor dene ke liye banayi gayi hai. Dhad ko jhukane se push ka angle badal jata hai, jis se zyada tension seene ke ooperi hisse aur kandhon par aati hai, aur dhad ki zyada khoobsurat, mutawazan aur teen-dimensional development mein madad milti hai.
Bench Adjustment aur Tayyari: Bench ko 30 se 45 degree ke incline par set karein (45 degree se zyada incline kandhon par bohat zyada zor dalta hai aur seene par asar kam kar deta hai). Har raan par ek dumbbell rakh kar baith jayein.
Shuruati position: Peeche ho kar kamar bench se laga dein, aur ek ke baad ek ghutnon ki madad se dumbbells ko kandhon ki oonchai tak ooper dhakelein.
Jism ka Stabilization: Paon mazbooti se farsh par jama lein. Scapulas ko peeche khinchein (kandhon ki haddiyan aapas mein mila kar bench mein dabayein) taake kandhe mehfooz rahein aur wazan mustehkam rahe.
Eccentric Phase (Neeche lana): Dumbbells ko aahista aahista aur control ke saath seene ke ooperi hisse ki taraf neeche layein. Kohniyan side par poori tarah na phailein (90 degree); dhad ke muqable mein taqreeban 45 se 60 degree ka mehfooz angle rakhein.
Concentric Phase (Ooper uthana): Saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbells ko seedha ooper dhakelein. Thora andar ki taraf milta hua rasta rakhein (ooper dumbbells ko aapas mein lagne na dein). Seene ke ooperi patthon mein tension barqarar rakhne ke liye kohniyan lock hone se zara pehle harkat rok dein.

Incline Bench Press - MP.instructions_ur: Control ke saath harkat karein aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Incline Bench Press with Bands.name_ur: Bands ke saath Incline Bench Press
Incline Bench Press with Bands.instructions_ur:
Band ko flat bench ki taang ke neeche, sar ke qareeb, mazbooti se bandh dein.
Bench par seedhe let jayein aur harkat ko mustehkam rakhne ke liye paon farsh par seedhe rakhein.
Band ka ek ek sira dono haathon mein pakrein aur haath seene ki oonchai par rakh kar shuru karein.
Ooper ki taraf press karein jab tak baazu poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein.
Aahista aur control ke saath shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Incline Bench Pull.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakren aur taqreeban 30 degree par set kiye gaye incline bench par ulte let jayein.
Baazu side mein poori tarah seedhe farsh ki taraf latakne dein.
Kalaiyan ghumayein taake haathon ki grip pronated (hatheliyan neeche) ho jaye.
Ab kohniyan bahar phailayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbells ko upar khinchna shuru karein jaise ulti bench press kar rahe hon. Yeh aap kohniyan mod kar aur upper arms ko upar la kar karenge jab ke forearms latke rahein. Yeh harkat tab tak jari rakhein jab tak upper arms kamar ki oonchai tak na aa jayein. Tip: Kohniyan side mein bahar aayengi aur harkat ke upar upper arms aur dhad angrezi harf "T" jaise nazar aane chahiyein. Upar contraction ko ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas neeche aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Incline Bench Pulldown.instructions_ur: Incline bench par cable machine ki taraf munh kar ke ulte let kar pulldown karein.

Incline Bench Reverse Fly.instructions_ur: Incline dumbbell reverse fly upper body ki exercise hai jo posterior ya rear deltoids aur upper back ke posture wale muscles ko target karti hai. Kyunke yeh chhote muscles ko target karti hai, is liye yeh exercise aam tor par halke wazan aur zyada reps ke saath ki jati hai, jaise har set mein 10-15 reps ya is se zyada.

Incline Cable Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Weight munasib miqdar par set karein aur handles pakar kar baith jayein. Upper arms jism se taqreeban 45 degree par hon, sar aur seena upar. Kohniyan taqreeban 90 degree tak mudi hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan seedhi karte hue handles ko seedha apne saamne ek saath press karke shuru karein. Harkat ke dauran shoulder blades peeche kheenche rakhein.
Poore extension par ruk kar, cables par tension barqarar rakhte hue shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Incline Cable Flye.instructions_ur:
Do cable towers ke darmiyan 45 degree par set incline bench rakhein.
Har haath mein pulley handle pakrein, hatheliyan ooper ki taraf.
Kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakh kar seene ko sakht karein aur cables ko kaman (arc) ki shakal mein khinchein taake woh seene ke beech mein aa milein.
Ek lamha rukein aur phir isi kaman ke raaste aahista aahista haath wapas shuruati position par layein.

Incline Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row.instructions_ur:
Adjustable bench ko 45 degree angle par set karein.
Pait ke bal let jayein aur sar bench ke kinare se bilkul thoda upar latka hua ho.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein aur achi posture banayein - core aur lats active hon aur kandhe neutral hon.
Dumbbells ko pait ke upar wale hisse ki taraf row karein aur rep ke oopar kamar ko sukerein.
Aakhir mein dumbbells ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein aur tamam reps poore hone tak dohrayein.

Incline Crunches.instructions_ur: Incline bench par peeth ke bal let jayein, paon bench ke ek sire par hon. Kisi partner se kahein ya kisi aur cheez (barbell waghera) se paon ko fix kar lein, haath sar ke peeche rakhein. Is position se upper body ko ooper layein yahan tak ke sar ya kohniyan ghutnon ko chhoo lein. Yeh harkat kamar ko roll karte hue karein.

Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing.name_ur: Hatheliyan andar ki taraf ke saath Incline Dumbbell Bench
Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par peeche let jayein, har haath mein ek dumbbell raanon ke oopar ho. Aap ki hatheliyan aamne saamne hongi.
Raanon ki madad se dumbbells oopar le jate hue, ek ek baazu se dumbbells clean karein taake unhein kandhon ke faasle par pakar sakein.
Kandhon ke faasle par aane ke baad hatheliyan neutral grip mein rakhein (hatheliyan aamne saamne). Kohniyan bahar ki taraf rakhein, upper arms kandhon ki seedh mein (dhad ke perpendicular) hon aur kohniyan mud kar upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle banayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans andar lete hue weights ko aahista aahista apni side par neeche layein. Har waqt dumbbells par poora control rakhein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ke muscles se dumbbells ko oopar dhakelein. Contracted position mein baazu lock karein, ek second rokein aur phir aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein oopar jane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Tay shuda reps ke mutabiq harkat dohrayein.
Fariq hone par dumbbells ko pehle raanon par aur phir farsh par rakhein. Dumbbells rakhne ka yeh sab se mehfooz tareeqa hai.

Incline Dumbbell Curl.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Incline Dumbbell Flyes.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein aur aise incline bench par let jayein jiska angle 30 degree se zyada na ho.
Baazu ooper ki taraf seedhe karein, kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakhein.
Ab kalaiyan ghumayein taake hatheliyan aap ki taraf hon. Tip: Chhoti ungliyan aapas mein saath saath hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue, baazu seedhe rakhte hue aahista aahista unhein side mein neeche layein aur saath hi kalaiyan ghumayein jab tak hatheliyan aamne saamne na aa jayein. Tip: Harkat ke aakhir mein baazu side par honge aur hatheliyan chhat ki taraf hongi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue harkat ulat kar dumbbells wapas shuruati position par layein aur haath ghumayein taake chhoti ungliyan dobara saath saath aa jayein. Tip: Yaad rakhein ke harkat sirf kandhe ke joint aur kalai par hogi. Kohni ke joint par koi harkat nahi hoti.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Incline Dumbbell Flyes - With A Twist.name_ur: Incline Dumbbell Flyes - Twist ke saath
Incline Dumbbell Flyes - With A Twist.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein aur aise incline bench par let jayein jiska angle 30 degree se zyada na ho.
Baazu ooper ki taraf seedhe karein, kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakhein.
Ab kalaiyan ghumayein taake hatheliyan aap ki taraf hon. Tip: Chhoti ungliyan aapas mein saath saath hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue, baazu seedhe rakhte hue aahista aahista unhein side mein neeche layein aur saath hi kalaiyan ghumayein jab tak hatheliyan aamne saamne na aa jayein. Tip: Harkat ke aakhir mein baazu side par honge aur hatheliyan chhat ki taraf hongi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue harkat ulat kar dumbbells wapas shuruati position par layein aur haath ghumayein taake chhoti ungliyan dobara saath saath aa jayein. Tip: Yaad rakhein ke harkat sirf kandhe ke joint aur kalai par hogi. Kohni ke joint par koi harkat nahi hoti.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Incline Dumbbell Press.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath set up karein, control ke saath harkat karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Incline Hammer Curls.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell le kar incline bench par baith jayein. Kamar backrest se mazbooti se lagi ho aur paon jure hue hon. Dumbbells ko side mein seedha neeche latakne dein, aur neutral grip se pakren. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upper arm ko saakit rakhne ki koshish karte hue kohni mod kar harkat shuru karein.
Harkat ke upar tak jayein aur rukein, phir aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Incline Inner Biceps Curl.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein incline bench aur twist istemal kar ke Biceps Curls karte hue jism ki position badli jati hai. Yeh harkat Preacher Curl se kaafi milti julti hai.
Incline bench ko 45 degree ke angle par set karein.
Dono haathon mein dumbbells pakrein aur kamar bench se laga kar baith jayein, sahare ke liye paon farsh par rakhein.
Baazuon ko side par neeche latakne dein, hatheliyan jism ki taraf hon.
Kohni seedhi rakhte hue dumbbells ko sar ki taraf ooper uthayein aur biceps ko sakht karein.
Control ke saath wazan neeche layein aur dohrayein.
Note: Is exercise mein harkat mustaqil rakhein, dhyan rakhein ke baazu jhoolne na payein.

Incline Push-Up.instructions_ur:
Bench ya mazboot unche platform ki taraf mun kar ke khare hon. Haath bench ya platform ke kinare par kandhon se thora chaure rakhein.
Paon ke agle hisse ko bench ya platform se peeche rakhein, baazu aur jism seedhe hon. Baazu jism ke perpendicular hon. Jism seedha rakhte hue baazu mod kar seene ko box ya platform ke kinare tak neeche layein.
Baazu seedhe hone tak jism ko upar dhakelein. Dohrayein.

Incline Push-Up Close-Grip.instructions_ur:
Smith machine bar ya munasib unchai ke mazboot unche platform ki taraf mun kar ke khare hon.
Haath bar par ek doosre ke saath saath rakhein.
Paon bar se peeche rakhein, baazu aur jism seedhe hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Jism seedha rakhte hue baazu mod kar seene ko bar tak neeche layein.
Kohniyan seedhi karte hue khud ko wapas upar dhakelein aur shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Incline Push-Up Depth Jump.instructions_ur:
Is drill ke liye aap ko taqreeban 12 inch ooncha box, aur do mote mats ya aerobics steps chahiye honge.
Steps ko kandhon ke bilkul bahar rakhein, aur paon box par rakhein taake aap incline push-up position mein hon, haath steps ke bilkul andar ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan mod kar jism ko neeche laayein, phir tezi se position ulti karke jism ko zameen se upar dhakelein. Zameen se uthte hue haath steps par rakhein, aur jhatka jazb karne ke liye kohniyan moden.
Wapas shuruati position mein aane ke liye yehi harkat dohrayein.

Incline Push-Up Medium.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ke bar ya kisi mazboot ooncha platform ki taraf munh karke khare hon jo munasib unchai par ho.
Haath bar par rakhein, haath taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Paon bar se peeche rakhein, baazu aur jism seedhe hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Jism seedha rakhte hue, baazu mod kar seena bar tak neeche layein.
Kohniyan seedhi karke khud ko wapas upar dhakelte hue shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Incline Push-Up Reverse Grip.instructions_ur:
Smith machine bar ya kisi mazboot oonche platform ki taraf mooh kar ke khare hon, jis ki oonchai munasib ho.
Haath bar par hatheliyan upar kar ke rakhein, haathon ka faasla taqreeban kandhon ke barabar ho.
Paon bar se peeche rakhein aur baazu aur jism seedha rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Jism seedha rakhte hue, baazu mod kar seena bar tak neeche layein.
Kohniyan seedhi karte hue khud ko wapas upar dhakel kar shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Incline Push-Up Wide.instructions_ur:
Smith machine bar ya kisi mazboot unche platform ki taraf munh karke munasib unchai par khare hon.
Haath bar par rakhein, kandhon se zyada chaure.
Paon bar se peeche rakhein, baazu aur jism seedha. Baazu jism ke perpendicular hone chahiyein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Jism seedha rakhte hue, baazu mod kar seena bar tak neeche layein.
Kohniyan seedhi karke, khud ko wapas upar dhakel kar shuruati position mein aayein.

Incline Row - Rings.instructions_ur: Gymnastic rings ke saath row karein, lekin jism ki position khari aur zameen ke parallel ke darmiyan ho. Mushkil banane ke liye zameen ke parallel ke qareeb jayein.

Incline Shoulder Press Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par let jayein, paon farsh par seedhe rakhein aur dumbbells pakrein.
Kohniyan mor kar baazu ooper uthayein jab tak woh kandhon ki seedh mein na aa jayein, yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Pait andar khinch kar dumbbells ko kandhon ke ooper jitna ho sake ooncha uthayein.
Aahista aur control ke saath dumbbells shuruati position tak neeche layein.

Incline Triceps Extensions with Dumbbell.name_ur: Dumbbell ke saath Incline Triceps Extensions
Incline Triceps Extensions with Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein aur incline bench par munh ooper kar ke let jayein, paon mazbooti se farsh par jama kar.
Baazu kandhon ke ooper seedhe karein, hatheliyan aamne saamne hon.
Kohniyan mor kar aahista aahista dumbbells ko sar ke peeche neeche layein.
Control ke saath baazu wapas shuruati position tak ooper layein.

Intermediate Groin Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein aur taangein seedhi rakhein. Ek paon ke gird belt, rope ya band daalein, aur us taang ko jitna ho sake side ki taraf le jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Belt ko narmi se kheenchein taake groin aur hamstring muscles mein tension paida ho. 10-20 seconds rokein, aur doosri side par dohrayein.

Intermediate Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch.name_ur: Intermediate Hip Flexor aur Quad Stretch
Intermediate Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch.instructions_ur:
Zameen par pait ke bal let jayein, ek paon ke gird rope, belt ya band lapeta hua ho.
Jis taang ko stretch karna hai us ka ghutna morein aur kulha peeche ki taraf seedha karein, dono haathon se belt kheenchte hue. Aap ka ghutna aur kulha zameen se uthne chahiyein, jis se hip flexors aur quads mein tension bane. Stretch ko 10-20 second rokein, aur doosri taang par dohrayein.

Internal Rotation with Band.instructions_ur:
Band ko kisi khambe ke gird phanda bana kar baandh dein. Band aap ki kohni ki oonchai par hona chahiye. Daayin side band ki taraf kar ke do teen feet door khare hon.
Daayein haath se band ka sira pakrein, aur kohni ko mazbooti se side ke saath daba kar rakhein. Hamara mashwara hai ke kohni se ek pad ya foam roll daba kar rakhein taake kohni apni jagah mazbooti se rahe.
Baazu ka upar wala hissa apni jagah par rakhte hue, kohni 90 degrees par mudi ho aur haath dhad se door ki taraf ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni ko apni jagah rakhte hue, forehand jaisi harkat mein baazu ko ghuma kar harkat karein.
Jitna door ja sakein jayein, ruk jayein, aur phir wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Inverted Row.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Inverted Row with Straps.instructions_ur:
Rack ya kisi aur mazboot cheez se rope ya suspension straps latkayein. Siray pakrein aur ropes se latakte hue seedhe let kar wali position mein aa jayein. Jism seedha ho, ediyan zameen par hon aur baazu poore seedhe hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni mor kar seene ko haathon ki taraf kheenchte hue shuru karein. Harkat ke dauran shoulder blades peeche kheenchein.
Harkat ke upar ruk jayein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps chahiye utni dafa dohrayein.

Iron Cross.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell le kar low squat stance mein khare hon, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par, baazu saamne phailaye hue aur hatheliyan andar ki taraf.
Seedhe khare hote hue baazuon ko jism se bahar aur door le jayein taake "T" ya "cross" ki shakal ban jaye.
Note: Jab tak harkat mein aasani na ho jaye yeh exercise halke wazan ke saath karein.

Iron Crosses (stretch).instructions_ur:
Zameen par pait ke bal let jayein, baazu side mein phaile hue aur hatheliyan zameen par dabi hui. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Shuru karne ke liye, ek ghutna morein aur us taang ko jism ke peeche se doosri taraf le jayein, aur usay doosre haath ke qareeb zameen se chhoone ki koshish karein.
Foran taang ko shuruati position mein wapas layein, aur jaldi se doosri taang ke saath dohrayein. 10-20 reps tak baari baari karte rahein.

Isometric Chest Squeezes.instructions_ur:
Baith kar ya khare ho kar, baazuon ko 90 degree ke angle par modein aur hatheliyan seene ke saamne aapas mein mila lein. Tip: Haath khule hon, hatheliyan aapas mein mili hon aur ungliyan aage ki taraf hon (dhad ke perpendicular).
Seene ko sukerte hue dono haathon ko ek doosre ke khilaf dabayein. Halki tension se shuru karein aur aahista aahista barhayein. Yeh contraction karte hue normal saans lete rahein.
Jitne seconds tay kiye hain utni dair rokein.
Ab tension ko aahista aahista chhor dein.
Tay kiye gaye waqt tak aaram karein aur dohrayein.

Isometric Neck Exercise - Front And Back.name_ur: Isometric Gardan Exercise - Saamne aur Peeche
Isometric Neck Exercise - Front And Back.instructions_ur:
Sar aur gardan neutral position mein rakhte hue (aam position jis mein sar seedha aur moonh aage ki taraf ho), dono haath sar ke agle hisse par rakhein.
Ab narmi se aage ki taraf dhakelein aur saath gardan ke muscles sukerein lekin sar ko hilne na dein. Halki tension se shuru karein aur aahista aahista barhayein. Yeh sukerna karte hue aam tor par saans lete rahein.
Jitne second tay kiye hain utni dair rokein.
Ab tension aahista aahista chhor dein.
Tay shuda waqt aaram karein aur haath sar ke pichle hisse par rakh kar dohrayein.

Isometric Neck Exercise - Sides.instructions_ur:
Sar aur gardan neutral position mein rakhte hue (aam position, sar seedha aur aage ki taraf), left haath sar ki left side par rakhein.
Ab aaram se left ki taraf dhakelein aur gardan ke left muscles ko sukerein, lekin sar ko hilne na dein. Halki tension se shuru karein aur aahista aahista barhayein. Yeh contraction karte waqt aam tarah saans lete rahein.
Jitne second tay kiye hain utni der rokein.
Ab aahista aahista tension chhor dein.
Tay shuda waqt aaraam karein aur right haath sar ki right side par rakh kar dohrayein.

Isometric Squat to Failure.instructions_ur:
Failure tak Isometric Squat: Ek Strength Training Technique
Tareef
Failure tak isometric squat, squat exercise ki ek qism hai jis mein aap ek khaas zaviye par saakit squat position mein ruke rehte hain, aur yeh position tab tak barqarar rakhte hain jab tak aap ke muscles contraction ko mazeed sambhaal na sakein.

Isometric Wipers.instructions_ur:
Push-up position mein aa jayein, wazan haathon aur paon ki ungliyon par rakhein aur jism seedha rakhein. Haath kandhon se zara chaure hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Jism ka wazan jitna ho sake ek taraf muntaqil karein, us taraf ki kohni ko mudne dein jab aap jism neeche layein.
Mude hue baazu ko seedha kar ke harkat ulat dein, khud ko upar dhakelein aur phir doosri taraf neeche jayein.
Jitne reps chahiye utni dafa dohrayein.

JM Press.instructions_ur:
Exercise bilkul usi tarah shuru karein jaise close grip bench press karte hain. Flat bench par let kar barbell ko baazuon ki poori lambai par (poori tarah seedha) kohniyan andar rakh kar pakrein. Lekin baazuon ko dhad ke amudi rakhne ke bajaye, yaqeeni banayein ke bar seedha seene ke ooperi hisse ke ooper ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ab poori seedhi position se bar ko aise neeche layein jaise lying triceps extension kar rahe hon. Is harkat mein saans andar lein. Aadhe raaste par pohanch kar, upper arms ko taangon ki taraf le ja kar bar ko taqreeban ek inch peeche roll hone dein jab tak upper arms dhad ke amudi na ho jayein. Tip: Upper arms aage laate hue kohniyon ka kham ek jaisa rakhein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps ke zor se bar ko wapas ooper press karein, jaise close grip bench press karte hain.
Ab shuruati position par wapas aayein aur dobara shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Jackknife Sit-Up.instructions_ur:
Zameen (ya exercise mat) par kamar ke bal seedhe let jayein, baazu sar ke peeche seedhe phele hue aur taangein bhi seedhi hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kamar se jhukein aur sath hi taangein aur baazu uthayein taake woh jackknife position mein mil jayein. Tip: Taangein seedhi hon aur zameen se takreeban 35-45 degree ke angle par uthi hon, aur baazu seedhe aur taangon ke parallel hon. Upper dhad zameen se utha hona chahiye.
Saans andar lete hue baazu aur taangein wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Janda Sit-Up.instructions_ur:
Zameen par basic sit-up position mein aa jayein; ghutne nabbe (90) degree ke zaawiye par, paon zameen par seedhe aur baazu ya to seene par cross hon ya side mein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Glutes aur hamstrings ko zor se tight karte hue, phephron mein hawa bharein aur aahista (teen se chhe second ki ginti mein) upar uthte hue aahista aahista saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Glutes aur hamstrings ko tight karna zaroori hai kyun ke is se reciprocal inhibition naam ke amal ke zariye hip flexors ghair faal ho jaate hain, jis ka matlab hai ke sukerne wale muscles ke mukhalif muscles dheele ho jaate hain.
Saans andar lete hue, control ke saath aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Jefferson Squats.instructions_ur:
Yeh kam istemal hone wali exercise hai jo be-shak andaruni raanon ko banane aur shape dene ki behtareen exercises mein se ek hai.
Barbell ko taangon ke darmiyan is tarah rakhein ke woh paon ke amudi ho.
Overhand grip se barbell pakrein, ek haath apne saamne aur ek haath apne peeche.
Squat kar ke neeche jayein taake raanein farsh ke mutawazi hon, phir khare hote hue aahista aahista wazan taangon ke darmiyan ooper uthayein.
Aahista aahista farsh se zara ooper shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Jerk Balance.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill aapko jerk ke dauran kaafi neeche jane ki aadat sikhati hai aur un logon ki ghalti theek karti hai jo harkat ke dauran peeche chale jate hain. Bar ko jerk position mein rack kar ke shuru karein, kandhe aage, dhad seedha aur paon thore split ho kar alag hon.
Harkat aam jerk ki tarah shuru karein, dhad seedha rakhte hue ghutnon se dip karein, aur zor se wapas upar dhakelein, wazan uthane ke liye baazuon ke bajaye momentum istemal karein.
Pichhla paon apni jagah rakhein aur wazan ko jerk karte hue isi paon se jism ko aage poore split mein dhakelein. Wazan sar ke upar rakhte hue khare ho kar recover karein.

Jerk Dip Squat.instructions_ur:
Yeh harkat jerk ke dip hisse ko mazboot karti hai. Bar ko jerk position mein rack kar ke shuru karein, kandhe aage hon taake shelf ban jaye aur bar halka sa gale ko chhu raha ho. Paon kulhon ke bilkul neeche hon aur paon ki ungliyan aaraam ke mutabiq bahar ki taraf mudi hon.
Dhad seedha khara rakhte hue ghutne mor kar dip karein, ghutnon ko aage jane dein aur kulhon ko peeche na le jayein. Dip zyada gehri nahi honi chahiye. Paon se zor laga kar weight ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.

Jogging, Treadmill.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye treadmill par charh jayein aur menu se pasandeeda option select karein. Zyada tar treadmills mein manual setting hoti hai, ya aap koi program chala sakte hain. Aam taur par aap apni umar aur wazan daal kar exercise ke dauran jalne wali calories ka andaza laga sakte hain. Workout ki shiddat badalne ke liye elevation adjust ki ja sakti hai.
Treadmill sahulat aur cardio ke fawaid deti hai, aur aam taur par bahar jogging se kam jhatka lagta hai. 150 lb ka shakhs 30 minute jogging se taqreeban 250 calories jalata hai, jabke running se 450 se zyada. Jogging ke dauran sahi posture rakhein, aur handles sirf zaroorat par pakrein, jaise utarte waqt ya heart rate check karte waqt.

Jump Rope.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Jumping Jack.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Keg Load.instructions_ur:
Kegs load karne ke liye, jitne kegs chahiyein unhein loading platform se kuch faasle par rakhein, aam tor par 30-50 feet.
Pehle keg ka qareebi handle pakad kar shuru karein, usay karwat par jhuka kar keg ke neeche wale hisse ka doosra kinara pakren. Keg ko seene tak uthayein.
Keg ko jitna ooncha rakh sakenge, utni tezi se platform tak ja sakenge. Aam tor par keg ko kandhe par rakhne ki ijazat nahi hoti. Keg ko mazbooti se pakre rakhein. Jitna tez ho sake platform tak jayein, aur kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue usay jitna ooncha ho sake rakh kar load karein.
Agla keg lene ke liye shuruati position par wapas jayein, aur event mukammal hone tak dohrayein.

Kettlebell Arnold Press.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karein. Taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karte hue kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf uthayein aur kandhe tak clean karein. Hatheli andar ki taraf honi chahiye.
Seedha aage dekhte hue kettlebell ko bahar aur sar ke oopar press karein, kalai ko ghumayein taake harkat ke oopar hatheli aage ki taraf ho.
Kettlebell ko shuruati position mein wapas layein, hatheli andar ki taraf ho.

Kettlebell Clean.instructions_ur: kettlebell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Kettlebell Dead Clean.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko paon ke beech rakhein. Shuruati position mein aane ke liye kulhe peeche karein aur seedha aage dekhein.
Kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karein. Taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karte hue kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf uthayein aur kandhe tak clean karein. Aisa karte waqt kalai ghoomni chahiye.
Kettlebell ko neeche layein, kamar seedhi aur kulhe bahar rakh kar hamstrings par wazan barqarar rakhein.

Kettlebell Deadlifts.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position:
Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, kettlebell takhnon ke beech mein ho. Kamar seedhi ho aur sar saamne ki taraf.
Steps:
Kulhon se hinge karein aur ghutne halke se modein taa ke haath kettlebell ke handles par aa jayein. Harkat ke dauran kamar seedhi rehni chahiye.
Kettlebell ke handles pakrein, haathon se mukhalif simt mein zor lagayein jaise handle ko kheench kar alag karna ho.
Pait aur glutes ko sukerte hue seedhe khare ho jayein.
Kettlebell ko wapas neeche laane ke liye dobara kulhon se hinge karein, step 1 ki tarah.
Step 3 se dohrayein.
Tips:
Yaqeeni banayein ke harkatein sahi kar rahe hain, warna chot lag sakti hai. Maslan, kulhon se hinge karne ke bajaye squat na karein, kettlebell tak pohanchte hue kamar gol na karein, aur khare hote hue peeche na jhukein.

Kettlebell Figure 8.instructions_ur:
Ek kettlebell apni taangon ke darmiyan rakhein aur kandhon ki chaurai se zyada khula stance lein. Kulhe peeche dhakel kar aur kamar seedhi rakh kar aage jhukein.
Kettlebell uthayein aur taangon ke darmiyan se doosre haath ko pakdayein. Lene wala haath taangon ke peeche se aaye. Kai reps tak aage peeche karte rahein.

Kettlebell Goblet Squat.instructions_ur: kettlebell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Kettlebell Hang Clean.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko apne paon ke beech rakhein. Shuruati position mein aane ke liye, kulhe peeche dhakelein aur seedha saamne dekhein.
Kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karein. Taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karte hue kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf uthayein aur kandhe tak clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghoomni chahiye.
Hamstrings mein tension barqarar rakhte hue kettlebell ko taangon ke beech latki hui position tak neeche layein. Har waqt sar upar rakhein.

Kettlebell One-Legged Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein kettlebell ko handle se pakrein. Ek taang par khare hon, usi side ki taang par jis haath mein kettlebell hai.
Us ghutne ko thoda mura rakhte hue, kulhon se jhuk kar stiff legged deadlift karein, aur balance ke liye azaad taang ko peeche ki taraf seedha karein.
Kettlebell ko neeche le jaate rahein jab tak aap zameen ke parallel na ho jayein, aur phir wapas seedhi position mein aa jayein.

Kettlebell Pass Between The Legs.instructions_ur:
Ek kettlebell taangon ke beech rakhein aur aaramdeh stance mein khare hon. Kulhe peeche nikaal kar aur kamar seedhi rakh kar jhukein.
Kettlebell uthayein aur taangon ke beech se usay doosre haath mein pass karein, 'W' ki shakal mein. Kai reps tak aage peeche karte rahein.

Kettlebell Pirate Ships.instructions_ur:
Chauri stance mein dono haathon se kettlebell pakren. Baazu seedhe rakh kar usay kamar ki oonchai par latakne dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ek taraf mudte hue harkat shuru karein, kettlebell ko sar ki oonchai tak jhulayein. Harkat ke upar thori der rukein.
Doosri taraf ghoomte hue kettlebell ko neeche aane dein, aur phir se usay sar ki oonchai tak uthayein.
Jitne reps chahiyein utni dafa dohrayein.

Kettlebell Pistol Squat.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko dono haathon se horns (handle ke kinare) se pakar kar uthayein. Ek taang zameen se upar rakhein aur doosri par squat karein.
Ghutna mor kar aur kulhon ko peeche le ja kar squat mein neeche jayein, kettlebell ko apne saamne upar pakre rakhein.
Neeche wali position ek second rokein aur phir harkat ulat dein, eri se zor laga kar aur sar aur seena upar rakhte hue.
Dobara neeche jayein aur dohrayein.

Kettlebell Seated Press.instructions_ur:
Farsh par baith jayein aur taangein aaraam se phaila lein.
Ek kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karein.
Kettlebell ko oopar aur bahar press karein jab tak woh sar ke oopar lock na ho jaye. Shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Kettlebell Seesaw Press.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells ko kandhon tak clean karein.
Ek kettlebell press karein.
Kettlebell neeche layein aur foran doosri kettlebell press karein. Dono taraf barabar reps karna yaqeeni banayein.

Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ki chaurai se zyada khule rakhein, paon ki ungliyan bahar ki taraf hon.
Kamar seedhi rakhein, kandhe peeche aur seena upar.
Ghutne paon ki ungliyon ki simt mein hi jayein aur aage na niklein.
Upar jaate hue exercise ka zyada se zyada asar lene ke liye glutes ko sukerna behtar hai.

Kettlebell Sumo High Pull.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko paon ke beech zameen par rakhein. Paon chauri stance mein rakhein aur dono haathon se kettlebell pakrein. Ghutne mor kar kulhe jitna ho sake peeche le jayein. Seena aur sar oopar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karte hue saath hi kettlebell ko kandhon tak kheenchein, aur aisa karte waqt kohniyan oopar uthayein. Harkat ulat kar shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Kettlebell Swing.instructions_ur: Kettlebell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Kettlebell Thruster.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells ko clean karke kandhon tak layein. Kettlebells ko kandhon tak clean karne ke liye taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karein aur kettlebells ko kandhon ki taraf khinchein. Aisa karte hue kalaiyan ghumayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe aur ghutne mod kar squat shuru karein, kulhon ko taangon ke darmiyan neeche layein. Neeche jaate hue kamar seedhi aur khari rakhein aur jitna neeche ja sakein jayein.
Bottom par simt badlein aur ghutne aur kulhe seedhe karte hue aedhiyon se zor laga kar upar aayein. Aisa karte hue dono kettlebells ko baazu seedhe upar karke sar ke upar press karein, squat ke momentum se wazan ko upar dhakelne mein madad lein.
Agla rep shuru karte hue wazan ko wapas kandhon par layein.

Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up.instructions_ur: Kettlebell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Lunge style).instructions_ur:
Farsh par kamar ke bal let jayein aur kohni seedhi kar ke kettlebell ko upar wali position tak press karein. Kettlebell wali side ka ghutna mod lein.
Kettlebell ko har waqt lock out rakhte hue doosri taraf ghoomein aur khaali baazu ki madad se aage lunge position ki taraf zor lagayein. Khaali haath se khud ko dhakel kar baithi position mein aayein, phir ek ghutne par aa jayein.
Kettlebell ki taraf upar dekhte hue aahista aahista khare ho jayein. Harkat ulti kar ke wapas shuruati position mein aayein aur dohrayein.

Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Squat style).instructions_ur:
Farsh par kamar ke bal let jayein aur kohni seedhi kar ke kettlebell ko oopar ki position tak press karein. Kettlebell wali side ka ghutna mor lein.
Kettlebell ko har waqt lock rakhte hue mukhalif side ki taraf ghoomein aur khaali baazu ki madad se aage barh kar lunge position mein aa jayein.
Khaali haath se dhakel kar baithi position mein aayein, phir paon par aa jayein. Kettlebell ki taraf oopar dekhte hue aahista aahista khare ho jayein. Harkat ulat kar shuruati position mein wapas jayein aur dohrayein.

Kettlebell Windmill.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko aage wale paon ke saamne rakhein aur doosre baazu se use clean kar ke sar ke upar press karein. Kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf kheenchte hue taangon aur kulhon ko seedha kar ke use kandhe tak clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghumayein taake hatheli aage ki taraf ho. Kohni seedhi kar ke use sar ke upar press karein.
Kettlebell ko har waqt lock out rakhte hue, kulhon ko lock out kettlebell ki simt mein bahar dhakelein. Paon ko lock out kettlebell wale baazu se 45 degree ke angle par bahar ki taraf ghumayein. Kulhon se ek taraf jhukte hue, kulhe bahar nikaal kar, aahista aahista itna jhukein ke khaali haath se farsh chhoo sakein. Sar ke upar pakri kettlebell par hamesha nazar rakhein.
Zameen tak pohanch kar ek second rukein aur harkat ulti kar ke wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Kipping Muscle Up.instructions_ur:
False grip ke saath rings pakrein, hatheliyon ka nichla hissa rings ke upar ho.
Taangon ko halka sa peeche jhula kar harkat shuru karein.
Is harkat ka jawab taangon ko aage aur upar jhula kar dein, thodi aur seena jhatke se peeche le jayein, aur saath hi dono baazuon se khud ko upar kheenchein. Pull-up ki top position par pohanch kar, rings ko apni baghlon tak kheenchein aur kandhe aage roll karein, kohniyon ko seedha peeche jaane dein. Is se aap harkat ke dip wale hisse ke liye sahi position mein aa jate hain.
Control aur stability barqarar rakhte hue, kohniyan seedhi karke harkat mukammal karein.
Zameen par neeche aate hue ehtiyat karein.

Knee Across The Body.instructions_ur:
Zameen par let jayein, daayin taang seedhi rakhein. Baayin taang moorein aur use jism ke upar se doosri taraf neeche layein, daayein haath se ghutne ko zameen ki taraf dabaye rakhein. (Agar muscles sakht hain to ghutne ka zameen ko chhoona zaroori nahi.)
