Baayan baazu aaram se apne paas rakhein aur sar baayein taraf ghumayein. Tasawwur karein ke aap ki dum ki haddi (tailbone) se wazan bandha hai. Dum ki haddi ko zameen ki taraf peeche girne dein jabke seena ulti simt mein phele, taake kamar ka nichla hissa stretch ho. Side badal lein.

Knee Circles.instructions_ur:
Taangein jor kar khare hon aur haath kamar par rakhein.
Ab normal saans lete hue ghutnon ko gol daire mein ghumayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Knee Raises.instructions_ur: Bar par 90 degree leg raise ek bohat shadeed exercise hai jis mein pait ke tamam muscles kaam karte hain.

Knee Tuck Jump.instructions_ur:
Aaram deh khari position mein ghutne thore se mod kar shuru karein. Haath saamne seene ki oonchai par rakhein, hatheliyan neeche aur ungliyon ke sire aapas mein jure hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Tezi se quarter squat mein neeche jayein aur foran zor se upar uchhlein. Ghutnon ko seene ki taraf le jayein, aur unhein hatheliyon se chhoone ki koshish karein.
Jitna ooncha ho sake jump karein, ghutne upar uthate hue, aur phir taangein dobara seedhi karke achhi tarah utrein, aur ghutnon ko dobara mudne de kar jhatka jazb karein.

Knee to Chest Stretch.instructions_ur: Ghutna seene tak stretch kamar ke nichle hisse ka tanao door karne aur kulhon ki lachak behtar karne ki ek saada magar asar daar exercise hai. Karne ke liye, kamar ke bal seedhe let jayein aur taangein phaila dein. Ek ghutna seene ki taraf laayein, haath pindli ke gird ya raan ke peeche lapet lein. Doosri taang farsh par seedhi rakhte hue ghutne ko narmi se seene ke mazeed qareeb khinchein. Stretch ko 15-30 seconds rokein, phir side badlein. Zyada gehre stretch ke liye dono ghutne ek saath seene ki taraf khinche ja sakte hain.

Knee/Hip Raise On Parallel Bars.instructions_ur:
Vertical leg raise bench par is tarah aa jayein ke forearms dhad ke saath pads par tike hon aur haathon se handles pakre hon. Baazu 90 degree ke zaawiye par mude honge.
Dhad seedha ho, kamar ka nichla hissa machine ke pad se laga ho aur taangein seedhi zameen ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue, taangein seedhi rakhte hue upar uthayein. Yeh harkat tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak taangein taqreeban zameen ke mutawazi na ho jayein aur phir ek second sukerna rokein. Tip: Is exercise mein koi momentum ya jhoolna istemal na karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Kneeling Arm Drill.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill daurte waqt baazuon ki karkardagi barhane mein madad karti hai. Ghutno ke bal shuru karein, baayan paon aage aur daayan ghutna zameen par. Agli edi se dabao dalein taa ke glutes aur hamstrings active rahein.
Baazuon ko lambe, pendulum jaise jhoolon mein chala kar shuru karein. Baazuon ka zaawiya chhota karein, aur jaise jogging mein karte hain waise baazu chalayein, phir run aur aakhir mein sprint tak le jayein.
Sprint wali harkat mein jaise hi haath kulhe se guzrein, unhein tezi se aage le jayein taa ke woh jitna ho sake tez harkat karein.
Ghutne badlein aur dohrayein.

Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating O.name_ur: Baari baari Oblique Twists ke saath Ghutno ke bal Cable Crunch
Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating O.instructions_ur:
High pulley cable se rope attachment jorein aur us ke saamne zameen par mat bichayein.
Rope ko dono haathon se pakrein aur tower se takreeban do feet peeche ghutno ke bal baith jayein.
Rope ko sar ke peeche rakhein aur haath kaanon ke paas hon.
Haathon ko usi jagah rakhte hue abs sukerein aur crunch ki harkat mein rope ko neeche khinchein yahan tak ke kohniyan ghutnon tak pohanch jayein.
Neeche thora sa rukein aur aahista aur control ke saath upar uthein yahan tak ke shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Wohi neeche wali harkat adhe raste tak dohrayein, phir ek kohni ko ulte ghutne ki taraf ghumana shuru karein.
Phir se neeche thora sa rukein aur aahista aur control ke saath upar uthein yahan tak ke shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Pehle wali harkat dohrayein, lekin is dafa doosri kohni ko ulte ghutne ki taraf layein.
Yeh silsila failure tak jari rakhein.

Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension.name_ur: Ghutno ke bal Cable Triceps Extension
Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
High pulley machine ke saamne bench ko aara (sideways) rakhein.
Straight bar attachment ko sar ke ooper pakrein, haathon ke darmiyan taqreeban 6 inch ka faasla ho aur hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon.
Machine ki taraf peeth kar ke ghutnon ke bal baith jayein.
Sar aur upper arms ka pichla hissa bench par rakhein. Kohniyan mudi hon aur forearms high pulley ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Upper arms har waqt sar ke qareeb aur kohniyan andar rakhte hue, bar ko aadhe daire mein bahar press karein jab tak kohniyan lock na ho jayein aur baazu farsh ke mutawazi na ho jayein. Triceps ko zor se sakht karein aur ek second yeh position rakhein. Is harkat mein saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Kneeling Forearm Stretch.instructions_ur:
Mat par ghutno ke bal baith kar shuru karein, hatheliyan seedhi zameen par aur ungliyan peeche ghutnon ki taraf.
Hatheliyan zameen par seedhi rakhte hue aahista aahista peeche jhukein yahan tak ke kalaiyon aur forearms mein stretch mehsoos ho. 20-30 second rokein.

Kneeling High Pulley Row.name_ur: Ghutno ke bal High Pulley Row
Kneeling High Pulley Row.instructions_ur:
Sar se ooper wali pulley par munasib wazan chunein. Cable se rope jorein aur kuch feet door ghutno ke bal baith jayein, rope ko dono baazu seedhe kar ke apne saamne pakrein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan mor kar aur kandhon ko poori tarah peeche khinch kar harkat shuru karein, kohniyan bahar rakhte hue rope ko seene ke upar wale hisse ki taraf khinchein.
Thora sa rukne ke baad aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Kneeling Hip Flexor.instructions_ur:
Mat par ghutno ke bal baith jayein aur right ghutna aage la kar paon ka talwa farsh par rakhein, aur left taang peeche phaila dein taake paon ka oopri hissa farsh par ho.
Wazan aage le jayein jab tak kulhe mein stretch mehsoos na ho. 15 second rokein, phir doosri side par dohrayein.

Kneeling Jump Squat.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ghutno ke bal baith kar shuru karein, barbell kandhon ke peeche rakha ho, ya yeh exercise apne bodyweight se bhi kar sakte hain. Unrack karna aasaan banane ke liye yeh power rack ke andar bhi ki ja sakti hai.
Kulhon ko peeche le jayein jab tak glutes paon ko na chhoo lein, sar aur seena upar rakhein.
Kulhon se zor se upar uchhlein, itni taaqat paida karein ke paon farsh par seedhe (flat) utrein.
Ediyon se zor laga kar aur ghutne seedhe kar ke squat jaari rakhein aur khari position mein aa jayein.

Kneeling Kickbacks.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position:
Haathon aur ghutnon ke bal aa jayein.
Steps:
Ek paon ko peeche dhakelein jab tak woh poori tarah seedha na ho jaye, aur glute muscles par dhyan dein.
Ek second rukein, phir wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Baari baari paon badal kar dohrayein.

Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row.name_ur: Ghutno ke bal Ek baazu se High Pulley Row
Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row.instructions_ur:
High pulley par single handle lagayein aur wazan chunein.
Cable tower ke saamne ghutno ke bal baith jayein, ek haath se cable pakrein aur baazu seedha ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Hatheli aage ki taraf rakh kar shuru karein, kohni mod kar wazan ko dhad tak neeche kheenchein aur shoulder blade ko peeche khenchein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghumayein taake harkat poori hone par hatheli aapki taraf ho.
Thora rukne ke baad shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Kneeling Squat.instructions_ur:
Power rack mein bar ko sahi unchai par set karein. Bar ke peeche ghutno ke bal baith jayein; ghutnon ke neeche mat bichha lena faidemand ho sakta hai. Bar ke neeche aa kar use kandhon ke peeche rack karein. Shoulder blades peeche kheenche hon aur bar kamar par tight ho. Weight ko rack se uthayein.
Sar saamne dekhte hue, kulhe peeche le ja kar baithein jab tak pindliyon ko na chhoo lein.
Harkat ulti karein, dhad ko wapas seedhi position mein layein.

Kneeling Triceps Concentration Extension.name_ur: Cable ke saath Ghutno ke bal Triceps Concentration Extension
Kneeling Triceps Concentration Extension.instructions_ur:
Cable pulley par stirrup handle laga dein aur pulley ko ooper set karein.
Baayen ghutne ke bal baith jayein, jism ki baayen side machine ki taraf ho, daayen taang mudi ho aur raan ka ooperi hissa farsh ke mutawazi ho.
Daayen kohni aur upper arm ko ghutne se zara ooper andaruni raan ke saath daba kar, cable ko halki kaman ki shakal mein farsh ki taraf neeche khinchein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Dohrayein aur baazu badal lein.
Note: Jis baazu se exercise kar rahe hain us ke ilawa poora jism sakit rakhein.

Landmine 180's.instructions_ur:
Bar ko landmine mein lagayein ya kisi kone mein mazbooti se tika dein. Bar par munasib weight load karein.
Bar ko farsh se uthayein aur dono haathon se kandhon ki oonchai tak le jayein, baazu saamne seedhe phaile hon. Chauri stance apnayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad aur kulhon ko ghumate hue weight ko poori tarah ek taraf neeche jhula kar harkat karein. Poori exercise ke dauran baazu seedhe rakhein.
Harkat ulti karke weight ko poori tarah doosri taraf jhulayein.
Set mukammal hone tak baari baari harkat jari rakhein.

Landmine Linear Jammer.instructions_ur:
Bar ko landmine mein lagayein, ya agar landmine na ho to usay kisi kone mein mazbooti se tika dein. Bar par munasib weight load karein aur handle attachment bar par lagayein.
Bar ko zameen se uthayein aur handles ko kandhon tak le aayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Athletic stance mein, kulhe mor kar aur peeche le ja kar squat karein, baazu mude hue rakhein.
Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne zor se seedhe karte hue harkat ko ulat dein, aur saath hi kohniyan seedhi kar ke baazu seedhe karein. Yeh harkat dhamakedaar honi chahiye, squat se nikal kar jitni taaqat se ho sake poori tarah seedhe ho jayein.
Wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Lat Pulldown.instructions_ur: Cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Lateral Bound.instructions_ur:
Aadhe squat ki position mein aayein, jis simt jaana hai us se 90 degree ke zaviye par munh karke. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Wazan bahar wali taang par daalte hue aagli taang ko andar ki taraf ek countermovement karne dein.
Foran dhakka dein aur seedhe hon, side ki taraf jitna door ho sake bound karne ki koshish karein.
Utarte hi foran mukhalif simt mein dhakka dein aur apni asal shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Kai reps tak aage peeche karte rahein.

Lateral Box Jump.instructions_ur:
Aaraam se khare ho jayein, aur ek chhota box aap ke bagal mein rakha ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Stretch reflex shuru karne ke liye tezi se quarter squat mein dip karein, aur foran direction badal kar oopar aur side ki taraf jump karein.
Ghutne itne oonche layein ke paon box ke oopar se aasani se guzar jayein.
Box ke beech mein land karein, jhatka jazb karne ke liye taangon ka istemal karein.
Ehtiyat se box ki doosri taraf jump kar ke utar jayein, aur kai reps tak aage peeche karte rahein.

Lateral Cone Hops.instructions_ur:
Kai cones ek qataar mein kuch feet ke faasle par rakhein.
Cones ke aakhri siray ke paas khare hon, aur aap ka rukh chalne ki simt se 90 degree par ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Stretch reflex shuru karne ke liye ghutnon ko halka sa mor kar chhalaang shuru karein, aur foran simt badal kar zameen se dhakelein, aur cone ke upar se upar aur side mein koodein.
Utarte waqt taangon se jhatka jazb karein, aur foran agli chhalaang lagayein, cones ki qataar mein aage barhte rahein.

Lateral Lunge with Bicep Curl with Dumbb.name_ur: Dumbbell Bicep Curl ke saath Side Lunge
Lateral Lunge with Bicep Curl with Dumbb.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan ooper ki taraf.
Paon jor kar khare hon, kamar seedhi rakhein aur pait andar khinchein.
Baazuon ko raanon ke saamne poori tarah neeche seedha latakne dein.
Jism seedha rakhte hue ek qadam side mein barhayein aur phir kamar aur ghutna mor kar lunge karein.
Lunge mein jate hue baazuon ko kandhon ki taraf curl karein aur biceps ko sakht karein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein aur taang badal lein.
Note: Kisi Personal Trainer ya Instructor se yeh exercise sahi tareeqe se karna seekh lein.

Lateral Push Off.instructions_ur: Zameen se dhakel kar ek taang par land karein aur doosri taang par jump karne se pehle balance wapas haasil karein

Lateral Raise - With Bands.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye exercise band par is tarah khare hon ke tension baazu ki lambai par shuru ho. Handles ko pronated (hatheliyan raanon ki taraf) grip se pakrein jo kandhon se thori tang ho. Handles raanon ki side par tike hon. Baazu seedhe hon aur kohniyon mein halka sa mor ho, aur kamar seedhi ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ke side wale muscles se handles ko side mein uthayein. Handles ko tab tak uthate rahein jab tak woh parallel se thora upar na ho jayein. Tip: Handles uthate hue haath ko thora sa jhukayein jaise paani undel rahe hon aur baazu seedhe rakhein. Dhad ko saakit rakhein aur harkat ke upar ek second rukein.
Handles ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lateral Rows on Cable, One Armed.name_ur: Cable par Side Rows, Ek baazu se
Lateral Rows on Cable, One Armed.instructions_ur: Cable ko kamar ki oonchai par set karein, baazu pait ke aage se doosri taraf rakh kar shuru karein aur haath ko upar se bahar doosri side tak le jayein, ek waqt mein ek baazu.

Latissimus Dorsi-SMR.instructions_ur:
Farsh par lete hue, foam roller apni kamar ke neeche aur ek side par, baghal ke bilkul peeche rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Jis side ka stretch ho raha hai us baazu ko peeche aur side par rakhein aur apna weight lats par daalein, upper body zameen se upar rakhein. 10-30 seconds rokein, aur side badlein.

Leg Curl.instructions_ur: Leg curl, jise hamstring curl bhi kehte hain, ek isolation exercise hai jo hamstring muscles ko target karti hai. Is exercise mein resistance ke khilaf nichli taang ko kulhon (buttocks) ki taraf mora jata hai. Hamstrings ko mazboot karne ke liye doosri exercises mein glute-ham raise aur deadlift shamil hain.

Leg Extensions.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko leg extension machine istemal karni hogi. Pehle wazan chunein aur machine par baith jayein, taangein pad ke neeche hon (paon saamne ki taraf) aur haathon se side bars pakrein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. Tip: Pad ko adjust karein taake woh nichli taang ke ooper (paon se zara ooper) aaye. Yeh bhi yaqeeni banayein ke nichli aur ooperi taang ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle ho. Agar angle 90 degree se kam ho to iska matlab hai ghutna paon ki ungliyon se aage hai, jis se ghutne ke joint par bewaja dabao parta hai. Agar machine aisi hi bani hai to ya to koi aur machine dhoondein ya exercise karte hue yeh yaqeeni banayein ke 90 degree ke angle par pohanch kar mazeed neeche na jayein.
Quadriceps ka zor laga kar saans bahar nikaalte hue taangein poori tarah seedhi karein. Yaqeeni banayein ke baaqi jism seat par sakit rahe. Contracted position mein ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wazan wapas pehli position par layein, aur dhyan rakhein ke 90 degree ki had se aage na jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Leg Lift.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho kar dono paon saath saath taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein, balance ke liye kisi mazboot cheez jaise squat rack ki sides ya kursi ka upar wala hissa pakad lein.
Ankle weight ke saath ya baghair, ek taang ko peeche ki taraf uthayein jaise khare ho kar leg curl kar rahe hon, doosri taang seedhi rakhein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue uthi hui taang ko aahista aahista wapas farsh par layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Doosri taang se harkat dohrayein.

Leg Press.instructions_ur: Leg press machine ke saath set up karein, control ke saath harkat karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Leg Press on Hackenschmidt Machine.instructions_ur: Movement ko control ke saath karein aur shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.

Leg Pull-In.instructions_ur:
Exercise mat par let jayein, taangein seedhi hon aur haath ya to hatheliyan neeche kar ke jism ke saath hon ya glutes ke neeche. Tip: Mujhe haath jism ke saath rakhna pasand hai. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue ghutne moorein aur raanon ko pait ki taraf kheenchein. Harkat jaari rakhein jab tak ghutne taqreeban seene ki oonchai tak na aa jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue abs ko sukerein aur oopar ek second rokein. Tip: Harkat karte hue taangon ka nichla hissa (pindliyan) hamesha farsh ke parallel rehna chahiye.
Saans andar lete hue wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Leg Raises Pull Up Bar.name_ur: Pull Up Bar par Leg Raises
Leg Raises Pull Up Bar.instructions_ur: Dono haathon se bar ko mazbooti se pakar kar, seedhi taangein upar uthayein, jab tak dhad ke saath 90 degree ka angle na ban jaye.

Leg Raises, Lying.instructions_ur: Bench par let jayein aur balance ke liye haathon se recliner ko pakad lein. Taangein seedhi rakhein aur unhein itna uthayein ke taqreeban 45° ka angle ban jaye. 1 second ka chhota sa pause lein aur aahista aahista neeche shuruati position par aa jayein. Intensity barhane ke liye har 5th rep par 7 seconds ka lamba pause le sakte hain.

Leg-Over Floor Press.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let jayein, ek kettlebell seene par handle se pakri ho. Kaam karne wali side ki taang ko doosri side ki taang ke upar se phailayein. Khaali baazu sahare ke liye side mein phailaya ja sakta hai.
Kettlebell ko lock out position tak press karein.
Wazan ko tab tak neeche layein jab tak kohni zameen ko na chhoo le, kettlebell kohni ke upar rahe. Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal seedhe let jayein, ek ghutna morein aur woh paon zameen par seedha rakhein taa ke reerh ki haddi mustahkam rahe.
Doosri taang hawa mein seedhi karein. Agar aap ke muscles sakht hain to aap isay poora seedha nahin kar payenge. Koi baat nahin. Ghutna seedha karein taa ke uthe hue paon ka talwa chhat ki taraf ho (ya jitna qareeb ho sake).
Aahista aahista taangon ko jitna ho sake seedha karein aur phir taang ko naak ki taraf kheenchein. Side badlein.

Leverage Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Pins par munasib weight lagayein aur seat ko apne qad ke mutabiq set karein. Harkat ke shuru mein handles seene ke muscles ke nichle ya darmiyani hisse ke qareeb hone chahiyein.
Seena aur sar upar hon aur kandhe ki haddiyan (shoulder blades) peeche khinchi hui hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni seedhi karte hue handles ko aage press karein.
Oopar thoda ruk kar, weight ko shuruati position se thoda upar tak wapas layein, aur set poora hone tak weight ko stops par wapas na rakh kar muscles par tension barqarar rakhein.

Leverage Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Pins par munasib weight load karein. Handles ke bilkul beech mein khare ho jayein. Neeche wale handles ko aaraam deh grip se pakrein, phir saans lete hue kulhe neeche layein. Sar se aage dekhein aur seena oopar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Weight ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.

Leverage Decline Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Pins par munasib weight lagayein aur seat ko apne qad ke mutabiq set karein. Harkat ke shuru mein handles seene ke muscles ke nichle hisse ke qareeb hone chahiyein. Seena aur sar upar hon aur kandhe ki haddiyan (shoulder blades) peeche khinchi hui hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni seedhi karte hue handles ko aage press karein.
Oopar thoda ruk kar, weight ko shuruati position se thoda upar tak wapas layein, aur set poora hone tak weight ko stops par wapas na rakh kar muscles par tension barqarar rakhein.

Leverage High Row.instructions_ur:
Pins par munasib weight load karein aur seat ki oonchai is tarah adjust karein ke aap upar lage handles tak bas pahunch sakein. Knee pad adjust karein taake woh aap ko neeche tikaye rakhe. Handles ko pronated grip se pakren. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni modte hue aur kandhe ki haddiyon ko peeche khinchte hue handles ko dhad ki taraf khinchein.
Harkat ke neeche rukein, aur phir aahista aahista handles ko wapas shuruati position mein le jayein.
Kayi reps ke liye, weight ko poori tarah stops tak wapas le jane se bachein taake kaam karne wale muscles par tanao bana rahe.

Leverage Incline Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Pins par munasib weight load karein aur seat apne qad ke mutabiq adjust karein. Harkat ke shuru mein handles pectorals ke upar wale hisse ke qareeb hone chahiyein. Seena aur sar upar aur shoulder blades peeche kheenche hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan seedhi karte hue handles ko aage press karein.
Top par thora ruk kar, weight ko shuruati position se zara upar tak wapas layein, aur set mukammal hone tak weight ko stops par na rakh kar muscles par tension barqarar rakhein.

Leverage Iso Row.instructions_ur:
Pins par munasib wazan load karein aur seat ki unchai aise set karein ke handles seene ki satah par hon. Handles ko neutral ya pronated grip se pakrein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Handles ko dhad ki taraf kheenchein, kohni modte hue shoulder blades peeche kheenchein.
Harkat ke aakhir mein rukein, aur phir aahista aahista handles ko shuruati position mein wapas layein. Zyada reps ke liye, muscles par tension barqarar rakhne ke liye wazan ko poori tarah stops tak wapas na le jayein.

Leverage Shoulder Press.instructions_ur:
Pins par munasib weight lagayein aur seat ko apne qad ke mutabiq set karein. Harkat ke shuru mein handles kandhon ke upar wale hisse ke qareeb hone chahiyein. Seena aur sar upar hon aur handles overhand (pronated) grip se pakre hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni seedhi karte hue handles ko upar press karein.
Oopar thoda ruk kar, weight ko shuruati position se thoda upar tak wapas layein, aur set poora hone tak weight ko stops par wapas na rakh kar muscles par tension barqarar rakhein.

Leverage Shrug.instructions_ur:
Pins par munasib weight load karein. Khud ko handles ke bilkul beech mein rakhein.
Upar wale handles ko aaramdeh grip se pakrein, aur phir saans lete hue kulhe neeche karein. Sar se saamne dekhein aur seena upar rakhein.
Aediyon se farsh par zor lagayein, kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karte hue khare ho jayein. Poori harkat mein baazu seedhe rakhein, aakhir mein kandhe peeche hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kandhon ko kaanon ki taraf shrug karke weight uthayein, seedha upar aur neeche.
Harkat ke top par rukein, aur phir weight ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.

Linear 3-Part Start Technique.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill aap ko ruki hui halat se jitna jaldi ho sake sprint mein raftar pakarne mein madad deti hai. Shuru karne ke liye ek line istemal karna mufeed hai. Dono paon line par rakh kar shuru karein. Baayan paon is tarah rakhein ke us ki ungliyan daayein takhne ke saath hon. Daayan paon baayein se 4-6 inch peeche rakhein.
Daayan haath line par rakhein, aur naak ko baayein ghutne ke qareeb layein.
Aage jhukte hue neeche squat karein, sar kulhon se neecha ho aur wazan baayein taang par ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baayan haath upar layein taake woh zameen ke parallel ho aur peeche ki taraf ishara kare, aur tayyar hone par poori taqat se nikal jayein.

Linear Acceleration Wall Drill.instructions_ur:
Deewar ke saath taqreeban 45 degree par jhuk jayein. Paon aapas mein mile hon aur glutes sukere hue hon.
Daayan ghutna tezi se upar utha kar shuru karein, ruk jayein, aur phir usay seedha neeche zameen par maarein.
Taang badlein, doosra ghutna uthayein, aur phir seedha neeche zameen par maarein.
Ek baar phir daayein taang se dohrayein, aur jaise hi daayan paon zameen par lage, jitna tez ho sake baari baari baayein aur daayein taang tezi se chalayein.

Linear Depth Jump.instructions_ur:
Aap ko do boxes ya benches chahiye honge jo kuch feet ke faasle par hon. Ek box par doosre platform ki taraf munh kar ke khare ho kar shuru karein.
Harkat shuru karne ke liye platforms ke darmiyan aaram se zameen par utar jayein, ghutnon aur kulhon ko mudne dein.
Harkat ulti karein, poori taqat se kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe kar ke doosre platform par chhalang lagayein.
Narmi se land karein, taangon se jhatka jazb karein.

Log Lift.instructions_ur:
Log ko apne saamne rakh kar khare ho kar shuru karein. Handles pakrein, aur log ka clean shuru karein. Clean shuru karne ke liye jhukte waqt, log ko jitna ho sake ooncha le jane ki koshish karein aur use seene ki taraf kheenchein. Kulhe aur ghutne seedhe kar ke use upar layein aur clean poora karein.
Sar peeche kar ke upar dekhein, taake seene par log rakhne ke liye ek shelf ban jaye. Dip kar ke press shuru karein, yani ghutnon ko thoda mod kar harkat ulti karein. Yeh push press log ko upar ki taraf le jane ke liye momentum dega. Phir kohniyan seedhi kar ke log ko sar ke upar press karein. Form ke koi sakht usool nahi hain, is liye jo technique aap ke liye sab se behtar ho woh istemal karein. Log press karte hue, har rep par sar ko aage nikaalein aur saamne dekhein.
Jitni dafa ho sake dohrayein. Log ko wapas zameen par laate hue us ke neeche aane ko control karne ki koshish karein.

London Bridges.instructions_ur:
Climbing rope ko kisi unche beam ya cross member se bandhein. Us ke neeche, yaqeeni banayein ke smith machine ki bar safeties ke saath lock ho aur hil na sake. Doosra tareeqa yeh hai ke koi mazboot box bhi istemal kiya ja sakta hai.
Bar par khare hon, aur rope ki madad se apna balance banayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Jism seedha rakhte hue, peeche jhukein aur rope par aahista aahista ek ke baad ek haath badalte hue jism neeche layein. Tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak aap zameen par amudi na ho jayein.
Jism seedha rakhte hue, harkat ko ulat dein, aur rope par ek ke baad ek haath badalte hue shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Long-Pulley (low Row).instructions_ur: Baith jayein, paon sahare wali jagahon par rakhein aur bar ko chauri grip se pakrein. Wazan ko tez harkat se naaf (belly button) ki taraf kheenchein, us se upar nahi. Harkat ke dauran baazu aur kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakhein. Kandhe aapas mein khinche hon. Wazan ko aahista aahista neeche jane dein jab tak baazu poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein.

Looking At Ceiling.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ghutno ke bal baith jayein aur dono haathon se ediyan pakar lein.
Kulhon ko upar aur aage uthayein aur sar ko peeche le ja kar chhat ki taraf dekhein, taake kamar mein arch ban jaye.

Low Cable Crossover.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position mein aane ke liye pulleys ko neeche wali position par rakhein, resistance chunein aur har haath mein ek handle pakrein.
Aage qadam lein taake pulleys mein tension aa jaye. Hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon, haath kamar se neeche hon aur baazu seedhe hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Baazuon mein halka sa mor rakhte hue haathon ko upar aur jism ki darmiyani line ki taraf layein. Haath seene ke saamne aapas mein milne chahiyein, hatheliyan upar ki taraf hon.
Thora rukne ke baad baazu wapas shuruati position mein le jayein.

Low Cable Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Apna weight select karein aur seated row machine ke bench par, jis par rope lagi ho, chehra oopar kar ke let jayein. Aap ka sar attachment ki taraf hona chahiye.
Rope ke dono siron ko bahar se pakdein, hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf (neutral grip).
Kohniyan 90 degree par mod lein aur upper arms dhad ke saath 90 degree ka angle banayein. Tip: Kohniyan andar ki taraf rakhein aur dhyan rakhein ke upper arms chhat ki taraf hon jabke forearms sar ke oopar wali pulley ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue lower arms ko seedha aur vertical hone tak kholein. Poori movement mein upper arms aur kohniyan apni jagah par rahein. Sirf forearms hilne chahiye. Triceps ko ek second ke liye zor se tight karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Low Pulley Row To Neck.instructions_ur:
Rope attachment wali low pulley row machine par baith jayein.
Rope ke siron ko palms-down grip se pakdein aur kamar seedhi aur ghutne thode mude rakh kar baithein. Tip: Kamar taqreeban bilkul seedhi khari rakhein aur baazu poori tarah saamne phaile hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad ko saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue kohniyan uthayein aur unhein modna shuru karein aur rope ko gardan ki taraf khinchein. Poori harkat mein upar wale baazu farsh ke mutawazi rehne chahiye. Tip: Yeh harkat tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak haath taqreeban kaanon ke paas na aa jayein (harkat ke aakhir mein forearms farsh ke mutawazi nahin honge kyunki woh thoda upar ki taraf jhuke honge) aur kohniyan side se bahar hon.
Sukeri hui position mein ek second rokne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein. Tip: Dobara, harkat ke kisi bhi hisse mein dhad nahin hilna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Low-Cable Cross-Over - NB.instructions_ur: Low-cable cross-over ek isolation exercise hai jo cable stack ke zariye seene ke muscles ke upar wale hisse ko target karti hai. Yeh upper-body aur seene par focus wale muscle-building workouts mein aam hai, aksar doosre angles se presses ya flyes ke saath mila kar ki jati hai taake seene ke tamam hisse target hon.

Lower Back Curl.instructions_ur:
Pait ke bal let jayein, baazu side mein phaile hue hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kamar ke nichle hisse ke muscles istemal karte hue, reerh ki haddi seedhi kar ke seena zameen se uthayein. Khud ko upar dhakelne ke liye baazu istemal na karein. Harkat ke dauran sar upar rakhein. 10-20 reps dohrayein.

Lower Back Extensions.name_ur: Kamar ke nichle hisse ki Extensions
Lower Back Extensions.instructions_ur:
Muscles ko active karein
Kulhon ko thora sa upar uthayein
Control wali harkat
Aahista harkat
Jhatke (momentum) ka istemal na karein
Upper body seedhi rakhein

Lower Back-SMR.instructions_ur:
Baithi hui position mein foam roll ko kamar ke nichle hisse ke neeche rakhein. Baazu saamne cross karein aur kandhon ko aage nikaalein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe farsh se upar uthayein aur peeche jhukein, wazan kamar ke nichle hisse par rakhein. Ab wazan thora sa ek taraf karein, taake wazan reerh ki haddi par nahi balke uske side ke muscles par ho. Kamar ke nichle hisse par roll karein, tanao wali jagahon par 10-30 seconds rukein. Doosri taraf dohrayein.

Lunge Pass Through.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar daayen haath mein kettlebell pakad kar khare ho jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baayen paon se aage qadam rakhein aur kulha aur ghutna mod kar upper body ko neeche laayein, dhad seedha rakhein. Pichla ghutna neeche laayein yahan tak ke woh zameen ko taqreeban chhoo le.
Lunge karte hue kettlebell ko agli taang ke neeche se doosre haath mein de dein.
Paon ki edi se zor laga kar wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Baari baari taangein badalte hue jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Lunge Sprint.instructions_ur:
Smith machine mein bar ko munasib unchai par set karein. Bar ke neeche aa kar use kandhon ke peeche rakhein. Bar ko unrack karein, phir paon ko aage peeche alag karein, ek paon aage aur ek peeche. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Peeche wala ghutna taqreeban zameen tak neeche layein, aisa karte waqt ghutne mor kar kulhe neeche le jayein.
Neeche pohanch kar foran direction badlein. Aage wale paon ki aedi se dhamake se zor lagayein aur peeche wale paon se halka dabao dein. Oopar jump karein aur taangon ki position badal dein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lunge with Twist Stretch.instructions_ur: Exercise samajhne ke liye video dekhein

Lying Bent Leg Groin.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hue aur paon ke talwe aapas mein dabe hue hon. Partner se ghutne pakarwayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutnon ko aapas mein milane ki koshish karein, jabke aap ka partner koi bhi harkat hone se rokay.
10-20 seconds ke baad muscles dheele chhor dein jabke partner aahista se ghutnon ko zameen ki taraf dhakelay. Madadgar ko zaroor batayein ke stretch kaafi ho gaya hai taake chot ya zyada stretch se bacha ja sake.

Lying Bicep Cable Curl.instructions_ur:
Sab se neeche wali setting par lagi cable pulley ke saath chhota bar attach karein.
Mat ya farsh par let jayein aur paon weight stack ko chhoote hon.
Bar ko hatheliyan oopar ki taraf kar ke pakdein.
Baazu poori tarah seedhe aur kohniyan pehluon ke saath rakh kar, bar ko arc mein seene tak kheenchein.
Biceps ko tight karte hue thora ruk jayein, phir shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.

Lying Cable Curl.instructions_ur:
Low pulley se lagi straight bar ya E-Z bar attachment ko dono haathon se ulti grip (hatheliyan upar) se kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakrein.
Weight stack ke saamne exercise mat par kamar ke bal seedhe let jayein, paon pulley machine ke frame ke saath hamwar lage hon aur taangein seedhi hon.
Baazu seedhe hon aur kohniyan jism ke qareeb hon, phir baazuon ko thoda moorein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu ke upar wale hisse ko saakit aur kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue aur biceps ko sukerte hue bar ko aahista aahista seene ki taraf curl karein.
Harkat ke oopar ek second sukerne ke baad, aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Cambered Barbell Row.instructions_ur:
Exercise bench ke neeche cambered bar rakhein.
Exercise bench par ulte let jayein aur bar ko hatheliyan neeche (pronated grip) rakh kar kandhon se zyada chauri grip se pakren. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakh kar bar ko row karein, ya to seene tak, taake kamar ka upar wala darmiyani hissa target ho, ya pait tak agar lats ko target karna aap ka maqsad hai.
Upar ek second rokne ke baad saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche aayein.

Lying Close Grip Biceps Curls with Cable.name_ur: Let kar Tang grip Biceps Curls Cable ke saath
Lying Close Grip Biceps Curls with Cable.instructions_ur:
Cable weight stack ke neeche flat bench rakhein aur pulley ke saath flat bar attach karein.
Sar stack ki taraf kar ke let jayein aur paon farsh par mazbooti se rakhein.
Bar ko hatheliyan neeche ki taraf kar ke, taqreeban 8 inch ke faasle par pakdein, aur baazu seedhe oopar ki taraf kholein.
Bar ko arc mein neeche curl karein yahan tak ke thodi ko chhoo le.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.

Lying Close-Grip Bar Curl On High Pulley.name_ur: High Pulley par Let kar Tang grip Bar Curl
Lying Close-Grip Bar Curl On High Pulley.instructions_ur:
High pulley ya lat pulldown machine ke saamne flat bench rakhein.
Seedhi bar attachment ko underhand grip (hatheliyan upar) se taqreeban kandhon ke barabar pakrein.
Kamar ke bal let jayein, sar bench ke kinare se bahar ho.
Ab baazu kandhon ke upar seedhe phaila dein. Dhad aur baazuon ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle hona chahiye aur kohniyan andar honi chahiyein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko aadhe daire ki shakal mein neeche curl karein yahan tak ke woh thodi ko chhoo le. Top par biceps ko ek second sukerein. Tip: Yeh harkat karte hue sirf forearms hilne chahiyein. Upper arms kisi waqt bhi nahi hilne chahiyein. Poori harkat ke dauran woh seedhe khare (perpendicular) rehne chahiyein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Extensi.name_ur: Let kar Tang grip Barbell Triceps Extension Sar ke peeche
Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Extensi.instructions_ur:
Barbell ya EZ Curl bar ko pronated grip (hatheliyan aage ki taraf) se pakad kar flat bench par kamar ke bal let jayein, sar bench ke kinare ke qareeb ho. Tip: Agar barbell pakda hai to kandhon ke barabar grip lein aur agar E-Z Bar use kar rahe hain to andar wale handles pakdein.
Baazu apne saamne seedhe karein aur bar ko aahista aahista semi circle mein (baazu seedhe rakhte hue) sar ke oopar wali position tak le jayein. Is step ke aakhir mein baazu sar ke oopar aur farsh ke parallel hone chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai. Tip: Kohniyan har waqt andar rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue, upper arm ko apni jagah rakh kar kohniyon se mod kar bar ko neeche layein. Bar ko tab tak neeche layein jab tak forearms farsh ke perpendicular na ho jayein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko semi circle mein oopar dhakel kar shuruati position par layein jab tak lower arms bhi farsh ke parallel na ho jayein. Movement ke oopar triceps ko ek second ke liye zor se tight karein. Tip: Phir se, sirf forearms hilne chahiye. Upper arms har waqt apni jagah par rehne chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Press T.name_ur: Let kar Tang grip Barbell Triceps Press Thodi tak
Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Press T.instructions_ur:
Barbell ya EZ Curl bar ko pronated grip (hatheliyan aage ki taraf) se pakad kar flat bench par kamar ke bal let jayein, sar bench ke kinare se bahar ho. Tip: Agar barbell pakda hai to kandhon ke barabar grip lein aur agar E-Z Bar use kar rahe hain to andar wale handles pakdein.
Barbell ko seene ke oopar pakde hue baazu saamne seedhe karein. Baazu dhad ke perpendicular (90 degree) hone chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue, upper arm ko apni jagah aur kohniyan andar rakh kar, kohniyon se mod kar bar ko semi circle mein neeche layein. Bar ko tab tak neeche layein jab tak woh halka sa thodi ko na chhoo le.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko semi circle mein oopar dhakel kar shuruati position par layein. Movement ke oopar triceps ko ek second ke liye zor se tight karein. Tip: Phir se, sirf forearms hilne chahiye. Upper arms har waqt apni jagah par rehne chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Crossover.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein aur taangein seedhi rakhein.
Ek taang ko ghutna mor kar jism ke oopar se cross karein, ghutne ko zameen se lagane ki koshish karein. Aap ka partner aap ke bagal mein ghutno ke bal baith kar ek haath se aap ka kandha neeche dabaye aur doosre se cross ki hui taang ko control kare. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Mure hue ghutne ko zameen se uthane ki koshish karein jabke partner kisi bhi asal harkat ko roke.
10-20 second ke baad taang ko dheela chhor dein jabke partner aaram se ghutne ko farsh ki taraf dabaye. Doosri side ke saath dohrayein.

Lying Dumbbell Tricep Extension.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur do dumbbells seedha apne saamne pakdein. Baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur dhad aur farsh se 90 degree ka angle banayein. Hatheliyan andar ki taraf aur kohniyan andar dabi hui hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue, upper arms ko apni jagah aur kohniyan andar rakh kar, aahista aahista weight neeche layein jab tak dumbbells kaanon ke qareeb na aa jayein.
Us point par, kohniyan andar aur upper arms apni jagah rakhte hue, triceps ki madad se weight ko wapas shuruati position tak layein aur saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance.name_ur: Ulte let kar Plate Neck Resistance
Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par poora jism seedha rakh kar ulte let jayein aur sar ke peeche weight plate pakrein. Tip: Aapko aise position lena hoga ke kandhe flat bench ke sire se thora aage hon taake upper seena, gardan aur chehra bench se bahar hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Plate ko sar ke peeche mazbooti se rakhte hue saans andar lete hue aahista aahista sar neeche karein (jaise "haan" keh rahe hon).
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aadhe daire ki harkat mein sar wapas shuruati position tak upar layein. Contraction ek second rokein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance.name_ur: Seedhe let kar Plate Neck Resistance
Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par poora jism seedha rakh kar seedhe let jayein aur weight plate apne maathe ke upar pakrein. Tip: Aapko aise position lena hoga ke kandhe flat bench ke sire se thora aage hon taake traps, gardan aur sar bench se bahar hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Plate ko maathe par mazbooti se rakhte hue saans andar lete hue aadhe daire ki harkat mein aahista aahista sar peeche neeche karein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aadhe daire ki harkat mein sar wapas shuruati position tak upar layein. Contraction ek second rokein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Figure Four Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein, dono ghutne mude hue aur paon zameen par seedhe hon. Ek takhna ulte ghutne ke upar rakhein taake taangein figure four ki shakal bana lein.
Khali jagah se haath guzaar kar neeche wali taang ki raan ka pichla hissa ya pindli ki samne wali haddi pakrein, aur use aahista se seene ki taraf khinchein yahan tak ke cross wali taang ke glute aur kulhe ke bahar wale hisse mein stretch mehsoos ho. Sar aur kamar ka nichla hissa zameen par rakhein aur cross wale ghutne ko bahar ki taraf khulne dein. Stretch rokein aur sukoon se saans lein, phir side badal lein.

Lying Glute.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein aur aap ka partner aap ke paas ghutno ke bal baitha ho.
Ek taang ko kulhe se mod kar farsh se uthayein. Taang ko ghumayein taake paon mukhalif kulhe ke upar ho, aur neeche wali taang aap ke jism ke amoodi ho. Aap ka partner ghutne aur takhne ko apni jagah thaam kar rakhe. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Apni taang ko partner ki taraf dhakelne ki koshish karein, jabke partner taang ko asal mein hilne na de.
10-20 second baad poori tarah dheele ho jayein jabke partner aahista se takhne aur ghutne ko aap ke seene ki taraf dhakele. Apne madadgaar ko zaroor batayein ke stretch kaafi ho gaya hai taake chot ya zarurat se zyada stretch na ho.

Lying Hamstring.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein aur taangein seedhi rakhein. Aap ka partner aap ke paas ghutno ke bal baitha ho. Ek taang chhat ki taraf uthayein aur partner se takhna pakarwayein. Zaroorat ho to partner apne kandhe se aap ki taang ko sahara de sakta hai. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Jab partner aap ki taang ko apni jagah pakre rakhe, to ghutna moorne ki koshish karein aur hamstrings ko 10-20 seconds ke liye sukerein.
Phir taang ko dheela chhor dein, aur partner ko taang narmi se aap ke sar ki taraf dhakelne dein. Chot ya zyada stretch se bachne ke liye, jab stretch kaafi ho jaye to apne madadgar ko zaroor batayein. Mukammal hone par side badal lein.

Lying Hamstring Stretch with Band.name_ur: Band ke saath Let kar Hamstring Stretch
Lying Hamstring Stretch with Band.instructions_ur: Exercise samajhne ke liye video dekhein

Lying High Bench Barbell Curl.name_ur: Let kar High Bench Barbell Curl
Lying High Bench Barbell Curl.instructions_ur:
Oonchi flat bench par ulte let jayein aur barbell ko supinated grip (hatheliyan upar ki taraf) se pakrein. Tip: Agar barbell pakar rahe hain to kandhon ke barabar grip lein aur agar E-Z Bar istemal kar rahe hain to andar wale handles se pakrein. Upper body is tarah ho ke seene ka upar wala hissa bench ke kinare par ho aur barbell aap ke saamne latak raha ho, baazu seedhe aur zameen ke perpendicular hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan andar aur upper arms saakit rakhte hue, biceps sukerte aur saans bahar nikaalte hue wazan ko adhe daire ki shakal mein upar curl karein. Harkat ke upar ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. Tip: Wazan par har waqt poora control rakhein aur jhoolne se bachein. Yaad rakhein, poori harkat mein sirf forearms harkat karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying High Bench Biceps Curl with Barbel.name_ur: Let kar High Bench Biceps Curl Barbell ke saath
Lying High Bench Biceps Curl with Barbel.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein biceps ko isolate karne ke liye aap ulte let te hain.
Oonchi bench par ulte let jayein, sar ek kinare par ho aur sahara dene ke liye paon ki ungliyan farsh par dabi hon.
Barbell ko hatheliyan oopar ki taraf kar ke, taqreeban 12 inch ke faasle par pakdein.
Baazu farsh ki taraf seedhe kar ke, unhein halke se arc mein sar ki taraf curl karein yahan tak ke biceps forearm ko chhoo lein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.

Lying Incline Curl with Barbell.name_ur: Let kar Incline Curl Barbell ke saath
Lying Incline Curl with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein Biceps Curls karte waqt jism ki position badalne ke liye incline bench use hoti hai. Yeh movement Preacher Curl se kaafi milti julti hai.
Incline bench ko 45 degree ke angle par set karein.
Barbell ko kandhon ke barabar grip se pakdein aur bench par chehra neeche kar ke tek lagayein, paon sahare ke liye farsh par hon.
Baazu pehluon mein neeche latakne dein.
Kohniyan seedhi rakhte hue bar ko sar ki taraf oopar uthayein aur biceps ko tight karein.
Control ke saath weight neeche layein aur dohrayein.
Note: Is exercise mein movement mustaqil rakhein, dhyan rakhein ke baazu jhoolne na payein.

Lying Leg Curl.instructions_ur: Leg press machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Lying Leg Curls.instructions_ur:
Leg curl machine par ulte let jayein aur aediyan roller pad ke neeche rakhein.
Sahare ke liye haathon se grips pakdein aur aahista aahista takhnon ko kamar ki taraf oopar curl karein.
Thori der hold karein aur phir shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

Lying One-Arm Lateral Raise.name_ur: Let kar Ek baazu se Side Raise
Lying One-Arm Lateral Raise.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein dumbbell pakar kar, flat bench par seene ke bal let jayein. Doosre haath se mazbooti ke liye bench ki taang pakar sakte hain.
Dumbbell wale haath ki hatheli neutral rakhein (hatheli dhad ki taraf) aur baazu seedha rakhein, kohni halki si mudi ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbell wale baazu ko side mein tab tak uthayein jab tak kohni kandhe ki unchai par na aa jaye aur baazu taqreeban zameen ke mutawazi ho. Tip: Poori harkat mein baazu seedha aur dhad par amudi rakhein. Upar ek second sukerna bhi rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell ko shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Prone Quadriceps.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ulte let jayein, partner aapke paas ghutno ke bal baitha ho. Ek ghutna moden aur woh taang zameen se uthayein, paon se glutes ko chhoone ki koshish karein. Partner ghutna aur takhna pakre. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutna seedha karne ki koshish karein jabke partner asal harkat ko rokay.
10-20 seconds ke baad, muscles dheele chhor dein jabke partner narmi se paon ko glutes ki taraf dhakele, quads aur hip flexors ko mazeed stretch karte hue.
10-20 seconds ke baad, side badlein.

Lying Rear Delt Raise.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakar kar flat bench par seene ke bal let jayein.
Hatheliyan neutral rakhein (hatheliyan dhad ki taraf hon) aur baazu seedhe rakhein, kohniyan thori si mudi hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue baazuon ko side par uthayein yahan tak ke kohniyan kandhon ki oonchai par hon aur baazu takreeban zameen ke parallel hon. Tip: Poori harkat mein baazuon ko dhad ke perpendicular aur seedha rakhein. Upar ek second ke liye sukerein bhi.
Saans andar lete hue dumbbells ko aahista aahista shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir doosre baazu par switch karein.

Lying Squat.instructions_ur:
Machine ka shoulder rack is tarah set karein ke paon aaraam se crosspiece tak pahunchein aur ghutnon mein halka sa mod ho.
Shuru karne ke liye paon aage dabayein aur safety locks khol dein.
Aahista aahista weight ko jism ki taraf neeche layein, pet andar khencha rahe aur ghutne paon ki simt mein hi chalein, 90 degree ke angle tak.
Ghutne lock na karein aur weight ko uchhaalein nahi.

Lying Supine Biceps Curl with Dumbbell.name_ur: Let kar Supine Biceps Curl Dumbbell ke saath
Lying Supine Biceps Curl with Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Yeh bhi biceps ki ek exercise hai jis mein kaam karne wale muscles ko isolate karne ke liye let te hain. Yeh advanced exercise hai.
Flat bench par let jayein, sar ek kinare par ho aur paon farsh par mazbooti se jame hon.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell, hatheliyan andar ki taraf, baazu pehluon mein bench se neeche latka dein.
Aahista aahista baazu oopar uthayein jab tak woh seene ke level par na aa jayein.
Hatheliyon ko ghuma kar dumbbells ko curl karein, taake forearms biceps ko chhoo lein.
Aahista aahista baazu shuruati position par neeche layein.
Note: Movement se waqif hone ke liye is exercise ki practice halke weights se karein.

Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par munh upar karke let jayein aur har haath mein ek dumbbell raanon ke upar pakde rakhein.
Dumbbells ko side par layein, baazu seedhe hon aur hatheliyan raanon ki taraf hon (neutral grip).
Baazu dhad ke qareeb aur kohniyan andar rakhte hue, baazuon ko aahista aahista (seedhe rakhte hue, kohniyon mein halka sa mod) farsh ki taraf jitna neeche ja sakein le jayein. Jab mazeed neeche na ja sakein, to upar wale baazuon ko usi position mein lock kar dein, yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, aahista aahista wazan ko curl karna shuru karein aur saath hi kalaiyan ghumayein taake hatheliyan upar ki taraf ho jayein. Curl karte rahein yahan tak ke biceps poori tarah sukerein aur top position par ek second zor se sukerein. Tip: Sirf forearms hilne chahiye. Upar wale baazu saakit rehne chahiye aur poori harkat mein kohniyan andar rehni chahiye.
Bohat aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Lying T-Bar Row.instructions_ur:
T-bar Row Machine par apni marzi ka weight lagayein aur taangon ki oonchai is tarah set karein ke seene ka upar wala hissa pad ke oopar wale kinare par ho. Tip: Kuch machines mein aap sirf munasib step par khare ho sakte hain jis se aap itni oonchai par hon ke seene ka upar wala hissa pad ke oopar wale kinare par ho.
Pad par ulte let jayein aur handles pakrein. Kamar ke jis hisse par zor dena chahte hain us ke mutabiq hatheliyan neeche, hatheliyan upar, ya hatheliyan andar ki taraf wali position istemal kar sakte hain.
Bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu apne saamne seedhe karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aahista aahista weight ko upar kheenchein aur harkat ke oopar kamar ko sukerein. Tip: Kamar ke muscles ko behtar istemal karne ke liye poori harkat ke dauran baazu ke upar wale hisse ko jitna ho sake dhad ke qareeb rakhein. Saath hi, kisi bhi waqt jism ko pad se na uthayein aur weight uthane ke liye biceps istemal karne se parhez karein.
Harkat ke oopar ek second sukerne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Triceps Extension Across Face with.name_ur: Let kar Chehre ke oopar se Triceps Extension Dumbbell ke saath
Lying Triceps Extension Across Face with.instructions_ur:
Yeh advanced exercise hai aur beginners ko is se parhez karna chahiye.
Flat bench par let jayein, sar ek kinare par ho aur paon farsh par mazbooti se jame hon.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell hatheliyan oopar ki taraf kar ke pakdein.
Dumbbells ko jism ke oopar uthayein. Baazu chhat ki taraf honge.
Upper arms aur kohniyan sakit rakhte hue, sirf kohni mod kar dumbbell ko aahista aahista chehre ke oopar se neeche layein.
Aahista aahista dumbbell ko shuruati position par wapas uthayein aur doosre baazu se dohrayein.
Note: Agar baazu thake hue hon to yeh exercise na karein, kyunke aap weight chehre ke oopar utha rahe hain.

Lying Triceps Press.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein, e-z bar (meri pasand) ya straight bar sar ke peeche farsh par rakha ho aur paon farsh par.
Peeche se bar ko medium overhand (pronated) grip se pakrein, aur bar ko baazu ki lambai par apne saamne uthayein. Tip: Baazu dhad aur farsh ke perpendicular hone chahiyein. Kohniyan andar ki taraf hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue, upper arms aur kohniyan saakit rakh kar aahista aahista weight neeche layein jab tak bar halka sa maathe ko na chhoo le.
Us waqt, saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps se weight ko wapas shuruati position tak upar layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Lying Triceps Press with Barbell.name_ur: Let kar Triceps Press Barbell ke saath
Lying Triceps Press with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein, sar ek kinare par ho.
EZ ya Curl bar ko overhand grip se pakdein.
Bar ko seedha kandhon ke oopar uthayein, dhyan rakhein ke kohniyan qareeb rahein.
Aahista aahista bar ko arc mein sar ke oopar neeche layein.
Bar ko shuruati position par wapas layein.
Note: Poori exercise mein baazu seedhe rakhein aur sirf kohniyan hilayein.

Lying Two Arm Triceps Extension with Dum.name_ur: Let kar Dono baazu se Triceps Extension Dumbbell ke saath
Lying Two Arm Triceps Extension with Dum.instructions_ur:
Bench par kamar ke bal seedha let jayein, sar ek kinare par ho.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakdein aur unhein baazu ki poori lambai par kandhon ke oopar uthayein.
Kohniyan mod kar dumbbells ko arc mein neeche layein jab tak forearms biceps ko na chhoo lein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.

Machine Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Chest Press Machine par baith jayein aur weight select karein.
Machine ke lever par paon rakhein, is se handles aage aa jayenge taake aap handles pakad kar baazu poori tarah seedhe kar sakein.
Handles ko hatheliyan neeche wali grip se pakdein aur kohniyan itni uthayein ke upper arms dhad ke pehluon mein farsh ke parallel hon. Tip: Handles pakadne ki wajah se forearms aage ki taraf honge. Handles aage la kar baazu seedhe karne par aap shuruati position mein honge.
Ab saans andar lete hue handles ko apni taraf wapas layein.
Seene (pecs) ko tight karte hue aur saans bahar nikaalte hue handles ko apne se door dhakelein. Shuruati position par wapas jane se pehle contraction ko ek second hold karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Khatam hone par lever par dobara paon rakhein aur aahista aahista handles ko unki asal jagah par wapas le jayein.

Machine Bicep Curl.instructions_ur:
Seat ko munasib oonchai par set karein aur weight select karein. Upper arms pads par rakhein aur handles pakdein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Kohni ko mod kar lower arm ko upper arm ki taraf kheenchte hue movement karein.
Movement ke oopar ruk jayein, phir aahista aahista weight ko shuruati position par wapas layein.
Muscles par tension barqarar rakhne ke liye set khatam hone tak weight ko poori tarah stops tak wapas na le jayein.

Machine Chest Fly.instructions_ur: baith kar machine par, kamar seedhi, aahista exercise

Machine Hip Abduction.instructions_ur:
Technique aur Execution
Shuruati Position
Baithne ki Position: Machine mein baith jayein, kamar pad se lagi ho
Taangon ki Jagah: Raanon ke andar wala hissa machine ke padded resistance points se laga ho
Machine Adjust karein: Seat ki position aisi set karein ke kulhe ka jor machine ke pivot point ki seedh mein ho
Harkat ki Technique
Taangein aapas mein mila kar ya andar wale pads par halka dabao de kar shuru karein
Aahista aahista taangon ko bahar ki taraf dhakelein, unhein alag karein
Tab tak le jayein jab tak zyada se zyada aaraam deh side range na mil jaye
Harkat ke bahar wale maqaam par thori der rukein
Control ke saath aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein
Biomechanical Tafseel
Muscles ka Istemal
Bunyadi Activation: Gluteus Medius (kulhe ki side ka muscle)
Stabilization: Core aur kamar ke nichle hisse ke muscles ko kaam mein lata hai
Functional Harkat: Chalne, sports aur rozmarra kaamon mein taang ki side wali harkat ki naqal karta hai
Fawaid
Taaqat aur Stability
Kulhe ki stability behtar karta hai
Ghutne ki chot ka khatra kam karta hai
Side ki harkat ki salahiyat barhata hai
Aksar nazar andaz hone wale muscle groups ko target karta hai

Machine Lateral Raise.instructions_ur: Machine lateral raise ek isolation exercise hai jo medial (side) deltoid muscle ko target karti hai taake kandhe zyada chaure aur numayan banein. Machine ka tay shuda raasta dumbbells se zyada stability deta hai, is liye yeh beginners ya un logon ke liye behtareen hai jo sirf muscle activation par dhyan dena chahte hain.

Machine Preacher Curls.instructions_ur:
Preacher Curl Machine par baith jayein aur weight select karein.
Upper arms ka pichla hissa (triceps) preacher pad par rakhein aur handles ko underhand grip (hatheliyan oopar ki taraf) se pakdein. Tip: Pad par baazu rakhte waqt kohniyan andar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue aur biceps tight karte hue handles uthayein. Oopar pahunch kar contraction ko ek second hold karein. Tip: Sirf forearms hilne chahiye. Upper arms har waqt pad par aur apni jagah par rehne chahiye.
Saans andar lete hue handles ko aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Machine Shoulder (Military) Press.instructions_ur:
Shoulder Press Machine par baith jayein aur wazan chunein.
Kohniyan mudi hui aur dhad ki seedh mein rakhte hue apni sides par handles pakdein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue handles uthayein aur baazu poori tarah seedhe karein. Top par contraction ko ek second zaroor rokein.
Saans andar lete hue handles ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Machine Side Lateral Raises.instructions_ur:
Machine side lateral raises side (lateral) deltoids ki isolation exercise hai, jo stability ke liye machine par ki jaati hai, aur pads ya handles ko side ki taraf kandhon ki unchai tak utha kar phir aahista neeche la kar kandhe ke bahar wale hisse ko target karti hai, kohniyan thodi mudi aur traps neeche rakhe jaate hain taake delts par tawajjo rahe. Yeh exercise jhoolne se rok kar aur musalsal tension de kar kandhon ki chaurai banane mein madad karti hai, is liye beginners ke liye ya workout ke aakhir mein finisher ke tor par behtareen hai.
Machine Lateral Raises kaise karein
Setup: Seat ko is tarah adjust karein ke aap ke kandhe machine ke pivot point ki seedh mein hon, seena pad ke saath laga ho (ya bahar munh ho to kamar), aur baazu pads/handles ke saath 90 degree ke zaviye par hon.
Shuruati position: Handles ko dheeli grip se pakdein, kohniyan thodi mudi hon, aur kandhe neeche (depressed) kaanon se door hon.
Uthane ka hissa: Saans bahar nikaalein aur baazu side ki taraf uthayein, upar wale baazuon ko side mein le jayein, yahan tak ke woh farsh ke mutawazi ho jayein.
Peak Contraction: Top par thoda rukein, side delts ko sukerein, lekin kandhe upar shrug na karein.
Neeche laane ka hissa: Saans andar lein aur control ke saath wazan ko aahista aahista neeche layein, neeche aate hue wazan ka muqabla karein.

Machine Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Seat ko munasib oonchai par set karein aur weight select karein. Upper arms pads par rakhein aur handles pakdein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Kohni ko seedha kar ke lower arm ko upper arm se door le jate hue movement karein.
Movement poori hone par ruk jayein, phir aahista aahista weight ko shuruati position par wapas layein.
Muscles par tension barqarar rakhne ke liye set khatam hone tak weight ko poori tarah stops tak wapas na le jayein.

Marching High Knees.instructions_ur:
Kam impact wali cardio aur mobility exercise jo hip flexors ko mazboot karti hai aur balance behtar banati hai.
Harkat: Seedhe khare hon aur ek ghutna seene ki taraf jitna aaram se ho sake upar uthayein.
Baazu: Ghutna uthate hue mukhalif baazu aage jhulayein, chalne ki harkat ki tarah.
Core: Seedha posture barqarar rakhne ke liye pait ke muscles engaged rakhein.
Raftaar: Harkat control ke saath karein, taal mein taangein baari baari badlein.

Medicine Ball Biceps Curl on Stability B.name_ur: Stability Ball par Medicine Ball Biceps Curl
Medicine Ball Biceps Curl on Stability B.instructions_ur:
Stability Ball par baith jayein aur paon saamne farsh par mazbooti se rakhein.
Kamar seedhi, kandhe peeche aur pet andar khench kar baithein.
Ek haath mein Medicine Ball pakdein aur forearm ko bicep ki taraf la kar oopar curl karein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein aur baazu badal lein.
Note: Ball ka balance rakhne ke liye Medicine Ball ko ungliyan khol kar pakdein.

Medicine Ball Booklet Crunch.instructions_ur: Medicine ball ko izafi wazan ke tor par istemal karne se exercise bhari ho jayegi.

Medicine Ball Chest Pass.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko partner ki zaroorat hogi. Partner na ho to yeh harkat deewar ke saath bhi ki ja sakti hai.
Partner ki taraf munh karke medicine ball ko dono haathon se dhad ke paas pakad kar shuru karein.
Ball ko seene tak khinchein, aur kohniyan seedhi karte hue harkat ulti karein. Khelon ke liye throw karte hue aap ek qadam bhi le sakte hain.
Partner ball pakde, aur wapas aap ki taraf phenke.
Throw ko dono haathon se seene ki oonchai par pakren.

Medicine Ball Full Twist.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko medicine ball aur ek partner chahiye. Partner ke saath peeth se peeth mila kar 2-3 feet ke faasle par khare hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ball ko dhad ke saamne pakrein. Partner ke saath ek hi waqt mein kulhe kholein aur kandhe ghumayein.
Poori rotation ke liye, aap aur aap ka partner ek hi simt mein ghumein, yani ghari ki suiyon ke ulat (counter-clockwise).
Ball partner ko pass karein, aur ab dono ulti simt mein ghum kar yehi tareeqa dohrayein.

Medicine Ball Scoop Throw.instructions_ur:
Medicine ball haathon mein le kar semi-squat stance mein aa jayein. Baazu is tarah latkein ke ball paon ke qareeb ho.
Taangon ko seedha karte hue kulhon ko aage dhakelein aur upar jump karein.
Aisa karte hue baazuon ko seedha rakh kar sar ke upar ghumayein aur harkat ki chooti par ball chhor dein. Maqsad yeh hai ke ball ko apne peeche zyada se zyada faasle tak phenkein.

Medicine Ball Twist.instructions_ur: Baithi hui position mein dhad ko baghair zor lagaye ek taraf se doosri taraf ghumayein, ghutnon ke qareeb aate hue aur waqtan fawaqtan ball ko zameen se chhuwate hue

Mentzer Pulldown.instructions_ur: Tang grip, saamne ki taraf munh karke Pulldown, Biceps par focus karte hue, poori range mein biceps ki activation barhata hai, Lats ko activate karne se bachein.

Middle Back Shrug.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par ulte let jayein aur har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein. Baazu poori tarah seedhe neeche latke hon aur farsh ki taraf hon. Hatheliyan aamne saamne hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein aur poora ek second contraction rok kar rakhein. Tip: Yeh harkat bilkul gale milne ki ulti harkat jaisi hai, ya aise rear laterals karne jaisi jaise aap ke baazu na hon.
Saans andar lete hue shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Middle Back Stretch.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur haath kulhon par rakh kar khare ho jayein.
Kamar se ghoomein jab tak stretch mehsoos na ho. 10 se 15 seconds rokein, phir doosri taraf ghoomein.

Military Press mit SZ-Bar.instructions_ur: SZ-bar par haath har mor ke bahar ki taraf rakh kar pakren aur baazu seedhe neeche rakh kar khare hon, hatheliyan taangon ki taraf hon. Bar ko (kohniyon se baazu mod kar) seene tak khinchein, phir bar ko sar ke upar dhakelein (baazu jitne seedhe ho sakein). Kohniyon se baazu neeche la kar bar ko wapas seene tak laayein. Bar ko uski asal position mein wapas le jayein (baazu seedhe neeche, hatheliyan taangon ki taraf rakh kar khare hon).

Mixed Grip Chin.instructions_ur:
Kandhon ke faasle se lagbhag 1 inch chauri spacing rakhte hue pull-up bar ko is tarah pakrein ke ek haath ki hatheli aage ki taraf aur doosre haath ki hatheli aap ki taraf ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue khud ko oopar kheenchna shuru karein. Tip: Jis baazu ki hatheli oopar ki taraf hai, us se harkat karne ke liye kamar ke muscles par tawajjuh dein. Us baazu ki kohni dhad ke qareeb rehni chahiye. Doosre baazu, jis ki hatheli aage ki taraf hai, ki kohni door lekin dhad ki seedh mein hogi. Jism ko oopar kheenchne ke liye lats par tawajjuh dein.
Oopar ek second ke contraction ke baad saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Agle set mein grip badal lein; yani agar right haath ki hatheli aap ki taraf aur left haath ki aage ki taraf thi, to agle set mein right haath ki hatheli aage ki taraf aur left ki aap ki taraf hogi.

Modified Pulldown.instructions_ur: Pulldown machine ke saamne incline bench rakh kar, tang grip ke saath lats par focus wale pulldowns karein.

Monster Walk.instructions_ur:
Ek band dono takhnon ke gird aur doosra dono ghutnon ke gird daalein. Itni tension honi chahiye ke jab paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon to bands tight hon.
Shuru karne ke liye, baari baari baayan aur daayan paon aage rakhte hue chhote qadam aage chalein.
Kuch qadmon ke baad, bilkul ulta karein aur peeche ki taraf chal kar wahan wapas aayein jahan se shuru kiya tha.

Mountain Climber.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Moving Claw Series.instructions_ur:
Yeh harkat aap ki running form ko tayyar karne mein madad karti hai taake aap sprinting mein behtar ho sakein. Daudte hue ghutna zaroor modein, aur jab kulha seedha ho to glutes ko kick karne ka nishana rakhein.
Jab taang wapas aage aaye to quad ko dobara tayyar karein, aur agle qadam par zameen par zor se paon maarein.
Daudte hue yaqeeni banayein ke aap baazuon se block karein, aur tezi se 1-2 ki harkat mein punch karte hue aage le jayein.

Muscle Snatch.instructions_ur:
Load ki hui barbell ko raan ke darmiyan ki oonchai par chauri grip se pakad kar shuru karein. Paon kulhon ke bilkul neeche hon, aur zaroorat ke mutabiq bahar ki taraf mude hon. Kulhe neeche karein, seena upar aur sar saamne dekh raha ho. Kandhe bar se thore aage hone chahiyein. Yeh shuruati position hogi.
Edi ke agle hisse se zor laga kar bar uthate hue pull shuru karein. Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue doosre pull mein jayein, aur bar ko jitna tez ho sake upar le jayein. Bar jism ke qareeb rehni chahiye.
Ghutne dobara mode baghair bar ko sar ke upar wali position tak uthate rahein.

Muscle Up.instructions_ur:
Rings ko false grip se pakrein, hatheliyon ka nichla hissa rings ke oopar ho. Kohniyan mor kar unhein side ki taraf neeche kheenchte hue pull up shuru karein.
Pull-up ki oopar wali position par pohanch kar rings ko bagalon tak kheenchein aur kandhon ko aage roll karein, kohniyon ko seedha peeche jane dein. Is se aap harkat ke dip hisse mein jane ki sahi position mein aa jate hain.
Control aur stability barqarar rakhte hue kohni seedhi kar ke harkat mukammal karein.
Zameen par neeche aate waqt ehtiyat karein.

Narrow Parallel Grip Chin-ups.instructions_ur:
Bar ko supinated (overhand) grip se pakdein taake hatheliyan aamne saamne hon.
Baazu seedhe rakh kar jism ko bar se latakne dein.
Aahista aahista apne aap ko oopar kheenchein yahan tak ke thodi bar se oopar chali jaye.
Control ke saath neeche shuruati position par aa jayein.
Dohrayein

Narrow Stance Hack Squats.instructions_ur:
Dhad ka pichla hissa machine ke back pad se lagayein aur kandhe shoulder pads ke neeche fit karein.
Taangein platform par kandhon se kam faasle wale tang stance mein rakhein, paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf. Paon ke darmiyan taqreeban 3 inch ya us se kam faasla ho. Tip: Sar har waqt oopar rakhein aur kamar har waqt pad se lagi rahe.
Haath machine ke side handles par rakhein aur safety bars khol dein (zyada tar machines mein yeh side handles ko saamne se diagonal position mein ghuma kar hota hai).
Ab ghutne lock kiye baghair taangein seedhi karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ghutne mod kar aahista aahista unit ko neeche layein, posture seedha aur sar oopar rakhein (kamar har waqt pad par). Tab tak neeche jayein jab tak upper leg aur calves ke darmiyan angle 90 degree se thora kam na ho jaye (yani raanein farsh ke parallel se neeche chali jayein). Yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, zyada tar aediyon se farsh ko dhakel kar taangein dobara seedhi karein aur unit ko oopar utha kar shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Narrow Stance Leg Press.instructions_ur:
Leg press machine par baith jayein aur taangein seedha saamne platform par kandhon se kam faasle wale tang stance mein rakhein, paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf. Paon ke darmiyan taqreeban 3 inch ya us se kam faasla ho. Tip: Sar har waqt oopar rakhein aur kamar har waqt pad se lagi rahe.
Weighted platform ko rokne wali safety bars neeche karein aur platform ko poora oopar dhakelein jab tak taangein saamne poori tarah seedhi na ho jayein. Tip: Dhyan rakhein ke ghutne lock na hon. Dhad aur taangein bilkul 90 degree ka angle banayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista platform neeche layein jab tak upper aur lower legs 90 degree ka angle na bana lein.
Zyada tar aediyon se dhakel kar aur quads ki madad se saans bahar nikaalte hue shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur khatam hone par safety pins ko achhi tarah lock karein. Aap nahi chahenge ke poore weight wala platform aap par aa gire.

Narrow Stance Squats.instructions_ur:
Lower body ke liye zabardast overall exercise. Squat ka yeh version taangon ke bahar wale muscles ko zyada target aur shape karta hai.
Weight rack se barbell utha kar kandhon par rakhein.
Paon taqreeban 6 inch ke faasle par rakhein, ghutne aur paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf hon.
Pet andar khench kar, ghutnon aur kulhon se mudte hue aahista aahista neeche jayein jaise kursi par baith rahe hon (squat).
Jitna control se ho sake utna neeche jayein, jism ko paon ki ungliyon ki taraf khisakne na dein (is se balance kho sakta hai).
Neeche wali position mein ruk jayein aur aahista aahista seedhe khare ho kar shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Notes: Bar par pad ya kandhon par tauliya rakhne se grip behtar hoti hai aur kamar par bar ki takleef kam hoti hai. Squat ki movement se aaraam dah hone ke liye pehle baghair weight ke practice karein.

Natural Glute Ham Raise.instructions_ur:
Lat pulldown machine ka leg pad ya preacher bench istemal karte hue, khud ko is tarah position karein ke takhne pads ke neeche hon, ghutne seat par hon, aur aap ka mooh machine se doosri taraf ho. Aap seedhe hon aur achi posture barqarar rakhein.
Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi. Control ke saath khud ko neeche layein jab tak ghutne taqreeban poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein.
Control barqarar rakhte hue, khud ko wapas shuruati position tak upar layein.
Agar aap rep poora nahi kar pa rahe, to rep poora karne ke liye band, partner ki madad lein ya kisi box se dhakel kar madad lein.

Neck Press.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur paon farsh par mazbooti se jama lein.
Bar ko kandhon se thora chaura pakdein.
Barbell ko jism ke oopar uthayein aur seene ke oopari hisse par, gardan ke qareeb le jayein.
Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Bar ko neeche layein taake woh bas seene ke oopari hisse ko chhoo le.
Bar ko tab tak oopar uthayein jab tak baazu poori tarah seedhe aur kohniyan lock na ho jayein.
Shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

Neck-SMR.instructions_ur:
Muscle roller ya belan istemal karte hue, roller ko sar ke peeche gardan ke saath rakhein. Dhyan rakhein ke roller ko seedha reedh ki haddi par na rakhein, balke thoda ghuma kar rakhein taake roller reedh ki haddi ke dono taraf ke muscles par dabe. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Gardan ke upar wale hisse se shuru kar ke, aahista aahista gardan ke muscles par neeche ki taraf roll karein, aur tension wali jagahon par 10-30 seconds rukein.

Negative Crunches.instructions_ur: Decline bench par baith jayein aur taangein fix kar lein. Baazu seene par cross karein aur roll karti harkat ke saath upper body ko upar layein, phir baghair ruke aahista harkat ke saath wapas neeche jayein. Exercise ke dauran sar ko hilne na dein.

Neutral-grip Chest Pulldown.instructions_ur:
Lat pulldown kamar ko mazboot karne aur posture behtar banane ke liye ek ahem exercise hai, jo sehatmand zindagi mein madadgar ho sakti hai. Is exercise ko sahi tareeqe se karne aur chot se bachne ke liye kuch ahem steps follow karna zaroori hai:
Cable machine ke saamne is tarah aa jayein ke ghutne halke se mude hon aur paon zameen par hon.
Cable handle ko is tarah pakrein ke hatheliyan aamne saamne hon aur haath kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Handle ko neeche kheenchein jab tak woh seene ko chhoo na le ya us ke qareeb na aa jaye, aur is position ko ek ya do second rokein.
Aahista aahista handle ko wapas shuruati position tak upar le jayein, aur poori harkat ke dauran baazu aur haath seedhe aur kamar seedhi rakhein.

Neutral-grip pull-ups or TRX rows.name_ur: Neutral grip Pull-ups ya TRX Rows
Neutral-grip pull-ups or TRX rows.instructions_ur:
Pull-Up: Vertical Pull - Lats (kamar ki chaurai) par zyada focus karti hai.
TRX Row: Horizontal Pull - Rhomboids/Traps (kamar ke darmiyani hisse ki motai aur posture) par zyada focus karti hai.

Nordic Hamstring Curl.instructions_ur: Bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Oblique Crunches.instructions_ur:
Kamar ka nichla hissa zameen se laga kar seedha let jayein. Is exercise ke liye ek haath sar ke paas aur doosra side mein zameen par rakhna hoga.
Yaqeeni banayein ke paon oonche hon aur kisi seedhi satah par tike hon.
Ab woh kandha uthayein jis taraf ka haath sar ko chhoo raha hai.
Bas kandhe aur jism ko upar uthayein yahan tak ke ghutne ko chhoo lein. Maslan, agar daayan haath sar ke paas hai to jism ko itna upar uthayein ke daayein kohni baayein ghutne ko chhoo le. Yahi tareeqa ulat kar bhi kiya ja sakta hai, baayein kohni se daayein ghutne ko chhoo kar.
Ghutna kohni ko chhoo le to jism ko neeche layein yahan tak ke shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Yaad rakhein ke exercise ke eccentric (neeche jaane wale) hisse mein saans andar lein aur concentric (upar aane wale) hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein.
Isi tarah baari baari karte rahein yahan tak ke har side ke tay kiye hue saare reps mukammal ho jayein.

Oblique Crunches - On The Floor.instructions_ur:
Daayein pehlu ke bal let kar shuru karein, taangein ek doosre ke upar hon. Yaqeeni banayein ke ghutne thore se mude hon.
Baayan haath sar ke peeche rakhein.
Is position mein aa kar, baayein kohni ko upar le jana shuru karein jaise aam crunch karte hain, magar is dafa zyada zor obliques par hai.
Jitna ooncha ho sake crunch karein, ek second sukerein rakhein aur phir aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche aayein.
Yaad rakhein ke exercise ke eccentric (neeche jaane wale) hisse mein saans andar lein aur concentric (upar uthne wale) hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein.

Old School Reverse Extensions.instructions_ur:
Bench par kamar ke bal let jayein, sar ek kinare par ho.
Barbell ko underhand grip se pakdein.
Baazu seedhi line mein rakhte hue sar se peeche le jayein.
Sirf kohniyan mod kar aahista aahista barbell ko neeche aur oopar karein.

Olympic Squat.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko traps ke upar rakh kar shuru karein. Seena upar ho, aur sar saamne ki taraf ho. Kulhon ke barabar stance banayein aur zaroorat ke mutabiq paon bahar ki taraf moorein.
Ghutne mod kar neeche jayein, aur kulhon ko jitna ho sake peeche le jane se bachein. Is ke liye ghutnon ka aage jana zaroori hai; dhyan rakhein ke woh paon ki seedh mein rahein. Maqsad yeh hai ke dhad jitna ho sake seedha rahe. Poora neeche tak jayein, aur weight aedi ke agle hisse par rakhein.
Jis lamhe raanein pindliyon se lagein, harkat ulti karein aur weight ko zor se upar le jayein.

On Your Side Quad Stretch.name_ur: Side par Let kar Quad Stretch
On Your Side Quad Stretch.instructions_ur:
Daayin karwat let kar shuru karein, daayan ghutna 90 degree par muda hua aap ke saamne farsh par tika ho (is se dhad mustahkam rehta hai).
Baayan ghutna peeche modein aur baayan paon baayein haath se pakdein. Hip flexor ko stretch karne ke liye baayan kulha aage dabayein aur baayein paon ko haath mein peeche ki taraf dhakelein. Side badlein.

On-Your-Back Quad Stretch.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ya step par let jayein, aur ek taang aur baazu side se neeche latka dein.
Ghutna mor kar paon ka oopri hissa pakrein. Aisa karte waqt khayal rakhein ke kamar ke nichle hisse mein kham na aaye.
Neutral rehne ke liye naaf ko reerh ki haddi ki taraf kheenchein. Paon ko neeche aur haath mein dabayein. Hip stretch shamil karne ke liye jis taang ko pakra hai us ka kulha chhat ki taraf uthayein.
Side badal lein.

One Arm Against Wall.name_ur: Ek baazu se Deewar ke saath
One Arm Against Wall.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar, mura hua baazu deewar ya darwaze ki chaukhat par rakhein.
Aahista aahista baazu ki taraf jhukein jab tak lats mein stretch mehsoos na ho.

One Arm Bent Row.instructions_ur: Ek baazu se jhuk kar cable par machine ke saath row

One Arm Bicep Concentration on Stability.name_ur: Ek baazu se Stability Ball par Bicep Concentration Dumbbell ke saath
One Arm Bicep Concentration on Stability.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein dumbbell pakdein aur paon khol kar chaurai mein rakh ke Stability Ball par baith jayein.
Kamar se aage ki taraf jhuk jayein.
Dumbbell haath mein liye kohni ko ghutne se laga lein.
Baazu ko neeche le jayein taake woh calves ke saath seedha ho.
Kohni ko sakit rakhte hue baazu ko seene tak oopar curl karein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein aur haath badal lein.

One Arm Bicep Curl with Olympic Bar or B.name_ur: Ek baazu se Bicep Curl Olympic Bar ya Barbell ke saath
One Arm Bicep Curl with Olympic Bar or B.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur ghutne halke se mude rakh kar khare ho jayein.
Olympic bar (khaali bar) ko ek haath se beech mein se pakdein taake bar ka balance barabar rahe.
Sahare ke liye khaali haath pehlu mein rakhein.
Bar ko oopar curl karein taake forearm bicep ko chhoo le.
Aahista aahista bar neeche layein aur baazu badal lein.
Note: Agar Olympic bar bohat bhaari ho to halka barbell use karein.

One Arm Chin-Up.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye, chin-up bar ke ird gird towel daal kar shuru karein.
Chin-up bar ko hatheli apni taraf rakh kar pakrein. Ek haath chin-up bar pakrega aur doosra towel.
Dhad ko taqreeban 30 degree peeche le jayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein kham banate hue aur seena bahar nikal kar. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Kandhon aur upper arms ko neeche aur peeche kheench kar dhad ko upar kheenchein jab tak bar upper seene ko na chhoo le. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Poori contracted position par pohanch kar kamar ke muscles sukerne par dhyan dein. Upper dhad saakit rehna chahiye jab woh harkat kare aur sirf baazu harkat karein. Forearms bar pakarne ke ilawa koi kaam na karein.
