Contracted position par ek second ke baad, saans andar lena shuru karein aur aahista aahista dhad ko shuruati position tak neeche layein jab baazu poori tarah seedhe aur lats poori tarah stretch hon.
Tay kiye gaye reps ke mutabiq yeh harkat dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur harkat dohrayein.

One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press.name_ur: Ek baazu se Dumbbell Bench Press
One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein, ek haath mein dumbbell raan ke oopar rakha ho.
Raan ki madad se dumbbell ko oopar uthayein taake usay apne saamne kandhe ki chaurai par pakad sakein. Jo haath weight nahi utha raha, us ki madad se dumbbell ko apne oopar sahi jagah par set karein.
Kandhe ki chaurai par aa kar kalai ko aage ghumayein taake hatheli aap se door ki taraf ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue weight ko aahista aahista pehlu ki taraf neeche layein. Dumbbell par har waqt poora control rakhein. Tip: Shuru mein thori mushkil ho sakti hai, is liye doosre haath se dumbbell ka balance rakhne mein madad lein. Doosra haath sirf zaroorat par use karein. Warna usay pehlu mein aaraam se rakhein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ke muscles (pecs) se dumbbell oopar dhakelein. Contracted position mein baazu lock karein, seena squeeze karein, ek second hold karein aur phir aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein oopar jane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Apne training program mein jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa movement dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur movement dohrayein.

One Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl.name_ur: Ek baazu se Dumbbell Preacher Curl
One Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl.instructions_ur:
Dayein baazu se dumbbell pakdein aur upper arm ko preacher bench ya incline bench ke oopar rakhein. Dumbbell kandhe ki oonchai par pakda hona chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell neeche layein jab tak upper arm seedha aur biceps poori tarah stretch na ho jaye.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue biceps se weight ko oopar curl karein jab tak biceps poori tarah contract na ho jaye aur dumbbell kandhe ki oonchai par na aa jaye. Yaad rakhein, poora contraction paane ke liye chhoti ungli ko anguthe se ooncha lana zaroori hai.
Contracted position mein biceps ko ek second zor se squeeze karein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur movement dohrayein.

One Arm Flat Bench Fly’s.name_ur: Ek baazu se Flat Bench Fly
One Arm Flat Bench Fly’s.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur khaali haath se bench pakad lein.
Doosre haath mein dumbbell pakdein aur forearm farsh ke parallel rakh kar baazu ko arc mein seene ke beech tak uthayein.
Jab dumbbell seene ki beech wali line par aa jaye, to usi raaste se aahista aahista shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Dohrayein.

One Arm Floor Press.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal seedha let jayein, ghutne mude hue aur paon farsh par mazbooti se rakhein.
Pet andar khenchein aur lats aur glutes ko tight karein.
Partner se bar pakadwayein aur bicep ko farsh ke parallel rakh kar baazu ko oopar utha kar poori tarah seedha karein.
Shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Reps poore karein aur baazu badal lein.

One Arm Lat Pulldown.instructions_ur:
Munasib wazan chunein aur knee pad adjust karein taake woh aapko neeche rakhne mein madad kare. Handle ko pronated grip se pakrein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni modte hue handle ko neeche kheenchein aur kohni ko side ki taraf sukerein.
Harkat ke neeche rukein, phir aahista aahista handle ko shuruati position mein wapas le jayein.
Kai reps ke liye, wazan ko poori tarah wapas jane na dein taake kaam karne wale muscles par tension rahe.

One Arm Low-Pulley Triceps Extension wit.name_ur: Ek baazu se Low-Pulley Triceps Extension Cable ke saath
One Arm Low-Pulley Triceps Extension wit.instructions_ur:
Low cable pulley machine ke saath handle attach karein.
Weight stack ki taraf peeth kar ke khare ho jayein, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par.
Bayein haath ko peeche le ja kar handle pakdein.
Sahare ke liye dayan haath bayein kohni par rakhein.
Bayan baazu seedha chhat ki taraf oopar kholein aur phir shuruati position par neeche layein.
Dohrayein aur baazu badal lein.

One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extens.name_ur: Ek baazu se Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extens.instructions_ur:
Bench par seedhe let jayein aur dumbbell ko baazu seedha kar ke pakrein. Baazu jism ke perpendicular hona chahiye. Hatheli paon ki taraf honi chahiye kyunke is exercise ke liye pronated grip zaroori hai.
Jo haath weight nahi utha raha use sahare ke liye apne bicep par rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell ko neeche lana shuru karein.
Phir triceps ko sukerte hue dumbbell ko upar uthana shuru karein. Concentric hisse (exercise ka uthane wala hissa) ke dauran saans bahar nikaalna yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain woh poore hone tak dohrayein.
Baazu badal kar yehi harkat dohrayein.

One Arm Snatch with Barbell.name_ur: Ek baazu se Snatch Barbell ke saath
One Arm Snatch with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Yeh advanced exercise hai jo jism ke zyada tar muscles ko kaam mein laati hai. Aisi exercises un sports ke liye functional strength banane mein use hoti hain jin mein mazboot haath chahiye hon.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur ghutnon mein halka sa mod rakh kar khare ho jayein.
Bar ko overhead grip se pakdein.
Barbell ghutnon se thora oopar pakad kar shuru karein (hang position), weight ko sar ke oopar uthayein (step 1), phir wapas kandhe ki oonchai tak (step 2) aur aakhir mein ghutnon ke qareeb shuruati position par wapas layein.
Note: Movement ko control karne ke liye weight uthate aur neeche laate waqt ghutne mod lein.

One Arm Supinated Dumbbell Triceps Exten.name_ur: Ek baazu se Supinated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
One Arm Supinated Dumbbell Triceps Exten.instructions_ur:
Bench par seedhe let jayein aur dumbbell baazu ki lambai par pakrein. Baazu jism ke perpendicular hona chahiye. Hatheli chehre ki taraf honi chahiye kyunke is exercise ke liye supinated grip zaroori hai.
Jo haath weight nahi utha raha use sahare ke liye apne biceps par rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell neeche lana shuru karein.
Phir triceps sukerte hue dumbbell upar uthana shuru karein. Concentric (exercise ka uthane wala hissa) ke dauran saans bahar nikaalna yaad rakhein.
Jab tak apne set ke reps poore na kar lein dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur harkat dohrayein.
Dobara baazu badlein aur harkat dohrayein.

One Armed Biased Push Up.name_ur: Ek baazu se Biased Push Up
One Armed Biased Push Up.instructions_ur:
Ball ko is tarah rakhein ke exercise shuru karte waqt ek haath Bosu ball par aur doosra farsh par ho.
Ball ka flat hissa neeche kar ke farsh par rakhein.
Farsh par ghutnon ke bal ho jayein, baazu dome par poori tarah seedhe aur jism seedha ho.
Pet andar khench kar aur jism seedha rakh kar seene ko ball ki taraf neeche layein.
Thori der ruk jayein aur phir shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

One Half Locust.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ulte let jayein.
Baayan haath baayin kulhe ki haddi ke neeche rakhein taake kulhe aur pubic haddi ko sahara mile.
Daayan ghutna moden taake paon daayen haath mein pakad sakein.
Paon ko hawa mein uthayein aur saath hi kandhon ko farsh se upar uthayein. Is se daayen kulhe ka flexor, seena aur kandhe bhi stretch hote hain. Side badlein. Agar is se kamar mein takleef na ho, to dono baazu aur taangon ke saath ek hi waqt mein bhi try kar sakte hain.

One Handed Hang.instructions_ur: Chinup bar ko ek haath se pronated grip ke saath pakdein. Paon farsh ya kisi step par rakhein. Wazan ka zyada hissa us haath se latakne dein, jabke paon zameen par rahein. 10-20 second rokein aur side badlein.

One Knee To Chest.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let kar shuru karein.
Ek taang seedhi phailayein aur doosra ghutna seene tak khinchein. Ghutne ki chapni ko bachane ke liye ghutne ke jor ke neeche se pakren.
Us ghutne ko narmi se naak ki taraf khinchein.
Side badlein. Is se mudi hui taang ki taraf ke kulhe aur kamar ka nichla hissa, aur seedhi taang ka hip flexor stretch hota hai.

One Leg Barbell Squat.instructions_ur:
Flat bench se taqreeban 2 se 3 feet aage, bench ki taraf peeth kar ke khare ho jayein. Barbell aap ke saamne farsh par ho. Tip: Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hone chahiye.
Ghutne mod kar pronated grip se, haath kandhon se zyada chaure rakh kar, barbell ko itna uthayein ke usay seene par tika sakein.
Phir barbell ko sar ke oopar se guzaar kar gardan ke nichle hisse par tika dein. Ek paon peeche le jayein taake us ke panje bench par tike hon. Doosra paon saamne apni jagah par rahe. Sar har waqt oopar rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigad jayega, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Tip: Yeh exercise karte waqt kamar seedhi aur seena bahar ho.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche jayein jab tak raan farsh ke parallel na ho jaye. Is point par ghutna paon ki ungliyon ke oopar hona chahiye. Seena raan ke beech ke bilkul oopar ho.
Seene aur kulhon ko aage rakhte hue aur quads ko tight karte hue, saans bahar nikaalein aur wapas shuruati position tak oopar aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Taang badlein aur movement dohrayein.

One-Arm Dumbbell Row.instructions_ur: dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

One-Arm Flat Bench Dumbbell Flye.name_ur: Ek baazu se Flat Bench Dumbbell Flye
One-Arm Flat Bench Dumbbell Flye.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur ek haath mein dumbbell pakar kar raan ke upar rakhein. Dumbbell wale haath ki hatheli neutral grip mein honi chahiye.
Dumbbell uthane ke liye raanon ki madad lete hue, dumbbell ko clean karein taake use apne saamne pakar sakein aur uthane wala baazu poori tarah seedha ho. Is exercise mein neutral grip barqarar rakhna yaad rakhein. Behtar sahare ke liye doosra haath side par flat bench ko pakre ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Weight wale baazu ki kohni mein halka sa kham hona chahiye taake biceps tendon par zor na pare. Weight wale baazu ko chauri gol harkat mein bahar neeche lana shuru karein jab tak seene mein stretch mehsoos na ho. Harkat ke is hisse mein saans andar lein. Tip: Yaad rakhein ke poori harkat ke dauran uthane wala baazu saakit rahe; harkat sirf kandhe ke jod par honi chahiye.
Seene ke muscles ko sukerte hue aur saans bahar nikaalte hue uthane wale baazu ko wapas shuruati position mein layein. Tip: Weight neeche laane wali gol harkat hi istemal karein.
Sukri hui position par ek second rokein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.
Baazu badal kar exercise dohrayein.

One-Arm High-Pulley Cable Side Bends.name_ur: Ek baazu se High-Pulley Cable Side Bends
One-Arm High-Pulley Cable Side Bends.instructions_ur:
Tower par standard handle lagayein. Cable ko sab se unchi pulley position par le jayein.
Cable ki taraf side kar ke khare hon. Ek haath upar le ja kar handle ko underhand grip se pakrein.
Cable ko neeche kheenchein jab tak kohni side ko na chhoo le aur handle kandhe ke paas na aa jaye.
Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein. Pivot point ka andaza lagane ke liye khaali haath kulhe par rakhein.
Baazu ko static position mein rakhein. Obliques ko sukerte hue side crunch mein wazan neeche layein.
Zyada se zyada contraction par pohanch kar wazan ko aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas chhorein. Aaram ki position mein weight stack kabhi unload nahi hona chahiye. Maqsad set ke dauran musalsal tension hai.
Failure tak dohrayein.
Phir position badal kar doosri taraf yahi tamaam harkatein dohrayein.

One-Arm Incline Lateral Raise.name_ur: Ek baazu se Incline Side Raise
One-Arm Incline Lateral Raise.instructions_ur:
Incline bench par side ke bal let jayein, haath mein dumbbell ho. Yaqeeni banayein ke kandha incline bench se laga ho aur baazu jism ke aar paar ho aur hatheli naaf ke aas paas ho.
Upar wale baazu mein dumbbell pakrein aur use saamne farsh ke parallel seedha rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Dumbbell ko har waqt farsh ke parallel rakhte hue side raise karein. Baazu seedha upar jaye jab tak chhat ki taraf ishara na kare. Tip: Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Dumbbell ko is position mein rokein aur ek second kandhon mein contraction mehsoos karein.
Saans andar lete hue wazan ko jism ke aar paar wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur harkat dohrayein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Clean.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko apne paon ke darmiyan rakhein. Kettlebell pakarne ke liye jhukte hue, kulhe peeche dhakelein aur nazar saamne rakhein.
Kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf uthate hue taangon aur kulhon ko seedha kar ke kandhe tak clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghoomni chahiye.
Weight ko wapas shuruati position mein le jayein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Clean and Jerk.name_ur: Ek baazu se Kettlebell Clean and Jerk
One-Arm Kettlebell Clean and Jerk.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko handle se pakren.
Taangein aur kulhe seedhe karte hue kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf khinch kar clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghumayein, taake hatheli saamne ki taraf ho.
Dhad seedha rakhte hue ghutne mod kar jism ko thora neeche (dip) karein.
Foran simt ulti karein, ediyon se zor lagayein, yani momentum paida karne ke liye goya jump karein. Aisa karte hue baazu seedhe karke kettlebell ko sar ke upar lockout tak press karein, aur weight uthane ke liye jism ka momentum istemal karein.
Weight ke neeche squat position mein aa kar weight ko sar ke upar receive karein.
Weight sar ke upar rakhte hue wapas khari position mein aayein. Agla rep karne ke liye weight ko farsh par neeche laayein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press.name_ur: Ek baazu se Kettlebell Floor Press
One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let jayein aur ek haath mein kettlebell pakrein, upper arm farsh par tika ho. Hatheli andar ki taraf honi chahiye.
Kalai ghumate hue kettlebell ko seedha chhat ki taraf press karein.
Kettlebell ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein aur dohrayein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Jerk.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko handle se pakrein. Taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karte hue kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf kheench kar kandhe tak clean karein. Aisa karte waqt kalai ghumayein taake hatheli aage ki taraf ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad seedha rakhte hue ghutne mor kar jism ko dip karein.
Foran direction badlein, aediyon se zor lagayein, yani momentum banane ke liye jump karein. Aisa karte hue baazu seedhe kar ke kettlebell ko sar ke oopar lockout tak press karein, weight ko hilane ke liye jism ka momentum istemal karein. Weight ke neeche squat position mein wapas ja kar use sar ke oopar receive karein. Weight sar ke oopar rakhte hue khare ho jayein.
Agle rep ke liye weight neeche layein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press To The.name_ur: Ek baazu se Kettlebell Military Press Side ki taraf
One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press To The.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko clean karke kandhe tak layein. Kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karne ke liye taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karein aur kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf khinchein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghumayein taake hatheli andar ki taraf ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kettlebell ki taraf dekhein aur usay upar aur bahar ki taraf press karein yahan tak ke woh sar ke upar lock ho jaye.
Kettlebell ko control ke saath wapas kandhe par layein aur dohrayein. Mazeed stability aur taqat ke liye apne lats, glutes aur pait ko zor se sukerna yaqeeni banayein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Para Press.name_ur: Ek baazu se Kettlebell Para Press
One-Arm Kettlebell Para Press.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko clean karke kandhe tak layein. Kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karne ke liye taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karein aur kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf khinchein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghumayein taake hatheli saamne ki taraf ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kettlebell ko kohni side ki taraf bahar rakh kar pakdein, aur usay upar aur bahar ki taraf press karein yahan tak ke woh sar ke upar lock ho jaye.
Kettlebell ko control ke saath wapas kandhe par layein aur dohrayein. Mazeed stability aur taqat ke liye apne lats, glutes aur pait ko zor se sukerna yaqeeni banayein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Push Press.name_ur: Ek baazu se Kettlebell Push Press
One-Arm Kettlebell Push Press.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko handle se pakdein. Kettlebell ko kandhe tak clean karne ke liye taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karein aur kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf khinchein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghumayein taake hatheli saamne ki taraf ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad seedha rakhte hue ghutne mod kar jism ko thoda neeche (dip) karein.
Foran simt badlein, aedhiyon se zor lagayein, yani momentum paida karne ke liye goya jump karein. Aisa karte hue baazu seedhe karke kettlebell ko sar ke upar lockout tak press karein, wazan hilane ke liye jism ka momentum istemal karein. Agla rep karne ke liye wazan neeche layein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Row.instructions_ur: Kettlebell apne paon ke saamne rakhein. Ghutne halke se moden aur phir shuruati position mein aane ke liye jhukte hue kulhe jitna ho sake peeche nikaalein. Kettlebell pakrein aur use pait tak kheenchein, shoulder blade peeche kheenchte hue aur kohni modte hue. Kamar seedhi rakhein. Neeche layein aur dohrayein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Snatch.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell paon ke darmiyan rakhein. Sahi shuruati position mein aane ke liye ghutne moden aur kulhe peeche dhakelein.
Seedha saamne dekhein aur kettlebell ko taangon ke darmiyan peeche jhulayein.
Foran simt ulti karein aur kulhon aur ghutnon se zor laga kar kettlebell ko tezi se upar le jayein. Jab kettlebell kandhe tak uthe to haath ghumayein aur seedha upar punch karein, momentum ka istemal karte hue weight ko sar ke upar lock karke receive karein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Split Jerk.name_ur: Ek baazu se Kettlebell Split Jerk
One-Arm Kettlebell Split Jerk.instructions_ur:
Kettlebell ko handle se pakrein. Kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf kheenchte hue taangon aur kulhon ko seedha kar ke use kandhe tak clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghumayein taake hatheli aage ki taraf ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad seedha rakhte hue ghutne mod kar jism ko neeche dip karein.
Foran rukh badlein aur ediyon se zor lagayein, yani momentum paida karne ke liye goya jump karein. Aisa karte hue baazu seedha kar ke kettlebell ko sar ke upar lockout tak press karein, wazan uthane ke liye jism ka momentum istemal karein.
Wazan ke neeche squat position mein wapas aa kar wazan ko sar ke upar receive karein, ek taang aage aur ek taang peeche rakhein.
Wazan sar ke upar rakhte hue khari position mein aayein aur paon aapas mein mila lein. Agle rep ke liye wazan neeche layein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Split Snatch.name_ur: Ek baazu se Kettlebell Split Snatch
One-Arm Kettlebell Split Snatch.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein kettlebell handle se pakrein.
Farsh ki taraf squat karein, aur phir harkat ulti karein, kulhe, ghutne aur aakhir mein takhne seedhe karte hue kettlebell ko sar se upar le jayein.
Jism poori tarah seedha karne ke baad, weight ko sar ke upar receive karne ke liye lunge position mein neeche aayein, ek taang aage aur ek peeche. Yaqeeni banayein ke kulhon se zor lagayein aur kettlebell ko ek musalsal harkat mein sar ke upar lock karein.
Weight sar ke upar pakre hue khare ho jayein, aur paon saath layein. Weight neeche la kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

One-Arm Kettlebell Swings.instructions_ur: Control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

One-Arm Long Bar Row.name_ur: Ek baazu se Long Bar Row
One-Arm Long Bar Row.instructions_ur:
Bar ko landmine ya kone mein rakhein taake woh hile nahi. Apne wale sire par munasib weight load karein.
Bar ke saath khare hon, aur ek haath se collar ke qareeb grip lein. Kulhon aur taangon ka istemal karte hue khare ho jayein.
Ghutne mod kar stance lein, kulhe peeche aur seena upar. Baazu seedha hona chahiye. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kandha peeche kheench kar aur kohni mod kar weight ko apni side tak kheenchein. Harkat ke dauran weight ko jhatka na dein ya cheating na karein.
Thora ruk kar, shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

One-Arm Medicine Ball Slam.name_ur: Ek baazu se Medicine Ball Slam
One-Arm Medicine Ball Slam.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar, aage peeche staggered athletic stance mein shuru karein. Medicine ball ek haath mein pakrein, usi side par jis taraf peeche wali taang hai. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu ghuma kar medicine ball ko sar ke upar le ja kar shuru karein. Aisa karte hue, slam ki tayyari ke liye kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karein.
Poore extension par, kandhe, reerh ki haddi aur kulhe mod kar ball ko zor se seedha apne saamne zameen par maarein.
Ball uchhalne par pakrein aur jitne reps chahiye utne jaari rakhein.

One-Arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean.name_ur: Ek baazu se Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
One-Arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean.instructions_ur:
Ek kettlebell paon ke darmiyan rakhein.
Ek haath se handle pakrein aur kettlebell ko tezi se uthayein, use palatne dein taa ke kettlebell ka gola hatheli mein aa jaye.
Kettlebell ko apne saamne uchhalein aur handle ko ek haath se pakar lein.
Kettlebell ko zameen par le jayein aur dohrayein. Dono baazuon se kaam karna yaqeeni banayein.

One-Arm Overhead Kettlebell Squats.name_ur: Ek baazu se Overhead Kettlebell Squats
One-Arm Overhead Kettlebell Squats.instructions_ur:
Ek baazu se kettlebell ko clean aur press karein. Taangein aur kulhe seedhe karte hue kettlebell ko kandhe ki taraf khinch kar clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalai ghumayein. Kohni seedhi karke weight ko sar ke upar press karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Seedha saamne dekhte hue aur kettlebell ko upar lock rakhte hue, ghutne aur kulhe moden aur dhad ko taangon ke darmiyan neeche laayein, sar aur seena upar rakhein.
Neeche wali position mein ek second rukein, phir paon ki ediyon se zor laga kar wapas upar uthein.

One-Arm Side Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Yeh advanced exercise hai jo jism ke zyada tar muscles ko kaam mein laati hai. Aisi exercises un sports ke liye functional strength banane mein use hoti hain jin mein mazboot haath chahiye hon.
Farsh par rakhe barbell ke saath pehlu mein khare ho jayein.
Bar ko beech se overhand grip se pakdein.
Jaise squat karte hain, waise jhuk kar neeche jayein taake raanein farsh ke parallel ho jayein.
Aahista aahista taangein seedhi karte hue jism ko seedha karein, oopar aate hue pet andar khenchein.
Note: Weight lagane se pehle movement se waqif hone ke liye khaali bar ke saath yeh exercise karein.

One-Arm Side Laterals.instructions_ur:
Ek dumbbell uthayein aur usay ek haath mein pakrein. Jo haath weight nahin utha raha us se koi mazboot cheez pakrein jaise incline bench. Weight wale baazu ki taraf aur bench pakre hue haath se door jhukein, is se aap ko balance qaim rakhne mein madad milegi.
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare hon aur dumbbell baazu ki poori lambai par pehlu mein ho, hatheli aap ki taraf. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad ko saakit rakhte hue (koi jhoolna nahin), dumbbell ko side mein uthayein, kohni halki si mudi ho aur haath thora aage jhuka ho jaise glass mein paani daal rahe hon. Jab tak baazu zameen ke mutawazi na ho jaye uthate rahein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur upar ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue dumbbell ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur exercise dohrayein.

One-Legged Cable Kickback.instructions_ur:
Leather ankle cuff ko low cable pulley se jod kar cuff ko apne takhne par bandh lein.
Weight stack se taqreeban do feet ke faasle par us ki taraf munh kar ke khare hon aur sahare ke liye steel frame pakad lein.
Ghutne aur kulhe halke se mude aur pet tight rakhte hue, glutes ko tight kar ke kaam karne wali taang ko semi circle mein aahista aahista peeche "kick" karein, jitna aaraam se oopar ja sake, aur saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Poori extension par peak contraction ke liye glutes ko ek second squeeze karein.
Ab cable ke khinchao ko rokte hue kaam karne wali taang ko aahista aahista aage layein jab tak shuruati position par na pahunch jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Taang badlein aur doosri side ke liye movement dohrayein.

One-handed Kettlebell Curls.instructions_ur: Khare ho kar kettlebell ek haath mein pakdein aur kohni se modein, poori tarah seedhe baazu se shuru karein yahan tak ke haath kandhe ki unchai tak pahunch jaye. Harkat sahi karne ke liye kamar ya jism se zor lagane ki koshish na karein.

Open Palm Kettlebell Clean.instructions_ur:
Ek kettlebell paon ke darmiyan rakhein. Taangein aur kulhe seedhe karte hue kettlebell ko kandhon ki taraf utha kar clean karein.
Kettlebell upar aate hue usay chhor dein, aur usay palatne dein taake kettlebell ka gola hatheliyon mein aa jaye.
Kettlebell ko apne saamne chhor dein aur handle ko dono haathon se pakad lein. Kettlebell ko shuruati position tak neeche laayein aur dohrayein.

Otis-Up.instructions_ur:
Paon fix karein aur zameen par peeche let jayein. Ghutne mude hone chahiyein. Dono haathon se wazan seene par pakrein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe aur reerh ki haddi mor kar dhad ko zameen se upar uthate hue harkat shuru karein.
Upar jaate hue wazan ko press karein taa ke harkat ke top par woh sar ke upar ho.
Sit-up ki harkat ulat'te hue wazan ko wapas seene par layein, aur dhyan rakhein ke poori tarah zameen tak neeche na jayein.

Overhead Cable Curl.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye pulley machine ki dono taraf aaraam dah weight set karein. Note: Dhyan rakhein ke dono taraf barabar weight select ho.
Ab dono taraf pulleys ki oonchai set karein aur dhyan rakhein ke woh aap ke kandhon se oonchi hon.
Dono sides ke beech mein khare ho jayein aur underhand grip (hatheliyan chhat ki taraf) se dono handles pakdein. Baazu poori tarah seedhe aur farsh ke parallel hon aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par. Jism handles ke beech barabar line mein ho. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aahista aahista dono taraf ke biceps squeeze karein jab tak forearms aur biceps aapas mein na chhoo jayein.
Saans andar lete hue forearms ko shuruati position par wapas le jayein. Note: Is exercise mein forearms ke ilawa poora jism apni jagah par rehta hai.
Apne program mein jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Overhead Lat.instructions_ur:
Farsh par seedhe baith jayein aur partner aap ke peeche ho. Ek baazu seedha upar uthayein, aur kohni mod kar haath ko kamar se chhoone ki koshish karein. Aap ka partner aap ke tricep aur kalai ko pakde. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upar wale baazu ko side ki taraf khinchne ki koshish karein jabke partner aap ko asal mein aisa karne se roke.
10-20 second baad baazu dheela chhod dein aur partner ko tricep par halka dabaao de kar lat ko mazeed stretch karne dein. 10-20 second rokein, aur phir side badlein.

Overhead Slam.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon se medicine ball pakrein aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare ho jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ball ko sar ke oopar utha kar aur jism ko poori tarah seedha kar ke countermovement shuru karein.
Harkat ulat dein aur ball ko jitni zor se ho sake apne theek saamne zameen par patkhein.
Uchhalne par ball ko dono haathon se pakrein aur harkat dohrayein.

Overhead Squat.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon se thora zyada chaure rakh kar khare ho jayein, paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf.
Barbell ko chaure snatch grip se pakdein, baazu aur kohniyan poori tarah seedhi hon.
Bar ko sar ke oopar rakhte hue, ghutne mod kar jism ko neeche layein jab tak raanein farsh ke parallel na ho jayein.
Shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Notes: Poori exercise mein paon farsh par mazbooti se jame rakhein. Exercise karte waqt pet andar, kamar tight aur seena oopar rakhein.

Overhead Stretch.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho kar, ungliyan aapas mein phansa lein aur hatheliyan chhat ki taraf khol dein. Baazu upar seedhe karte hue kandhe neeche rakhein.
Poore dhad ki stretch ke liye, aisa karte hue tailbone ko neeche kheenchein aur dhad ko mustahkam rakhein. Dhad ke agle aur pichle dono hisson ke muscles ko stretch karein.

Overhead Triceps.instructions_ur:
Farsh par seedhe baith jayein aur partner aap ke peeche ho. Ek baazu seedha upar uthayein, aur kohni mod kar haath ko kamar se chhoone ki koshish karein. Partner aap ki kohni aur kalai pakde. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu ko seedha hawa mein phailane ki koshish karein jab ke partner aap ko aisa karne se roke.
10-20 seconds ke baad baazu dheela chhor dein aur partner ko kalai par narm dabao de kar tricep ko mazeed stretch karne dein. 10-20 seconds rokein, phir side badlein.

Overhead Triceps Extension.instructions_ur: dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Pallof Press.instructions_ur: cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Pallof Press With Rotation.instructions_ur:
Tower par standard handle lagayein, aur cable ko kandhe ki unchai par set karein.
Cable ki taraf side kar ke, ek haath se handle pakrein aur tower se door qadam lein. Aap pulley se taqreeban ek baazu ke faasle par hon, aur cable par weight ki tension ho. Phaile hue baazu ko cable ki seedh mein rakhein.
Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar, cable ko seene tak kheenchein aur doosre haath se bhi handle pakar lein. Is waqt dono haath handle par hone chahiyein.
Moonh aage ki taraf rakhte hue, cable ko seene se door press karein. Core tight aur active hona chahiye.
Kulhe seedhe rakhte hue, dhad ko pulley se door ghumayein jab tak poora chauthai chakkar (quarter rotation) na ho jaye.
Apna stance mazboot aur baazu seedhe rakhein. Aahista aur control ke saath neutral position mein wapas aayein. Baazu aap ke saamne seedhe hone chahiyein.
Side ki tension se core ko active rakhte hue, haath seene tak layein aur foran bahar ki taraf poori tarah seedhe press karein. Yeh ek rep hai.
Thakan (failure) tak dohrayein.
Phir position badlein aur doosri taraf yahi harkatein dohrayein.

Palms-Down Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Be.name_ur: Bench par Hatheliyan Neeche Dumbbell Wrist Curl
Palms-Down Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Be.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ki ek taraf do dumbbells rakh kar shuru karein.
Dono ghutno ke bal baith jayein taa ke jism flat bench ki taraf ho.
Dono dumbbells ko pronated grip (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) se pakrein aur upar layein taa ke forearms flat bench par tike hon. Kalaiyan kinare se bahar latki honi chahiyein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kalai ko upar ki taraf curl karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista kalaiyan wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Forearms saakit rehne chahiyein kyunke is exercise mein sirf kalai ki harkat chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Palms-Down Wrist Curl Over A Bench.name_ur: Bench par Hatheliyan Neeche Wrist Curl
Palms-Down Wrist Curl Over A Bench.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ki ek taraf barbell rakh kar shuru karein.
Dono ghutno ke bal baith jayein taa ke jism flat bench ki taraf ho.
Barbell ko pronated grip (hatheliyan neeche) se pakrein aur upar layein taa ke forearms flat bench par tike hon. Kalaiyan kinare se bahar latki honi chahiyein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kalai ko upar ki taraf curl karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista kalaiyan wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Forearms saakit rehne chahiyein kyunke is exercise mein sirf kalai ki harkat chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Palms-Up Barbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench.name_ur: Bench par Hatheliyan upar Barbell Wrist Curl
Palms-Up Barbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko flat bench ki ek side par rakh kar shuru karein.
Dono ghutno ke bal baith jayein taake aap ka jism flat bench ki taraf ho.
Baazuon se barbell ko supinated grip (hatheliyan upar) se pakdein aur upar layein taake forearms flat bench par tike hon. Kalaiyan kinare se bahar latak rahi hon.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kalaiyan upar ki taraf curl karein.
Saans andar lete hue kalaiyan aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Forearms saakit rehne chahiye kyunki is exercise mein sirf kalai ki harkat chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Palms-Up Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Benc.name_ur: Bench par Hatheliyan upar Dumbbell Wrist Curl
Palms-Up Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Benc.instructions_ur:
Shuru mein do dumbbells flat bench ki ek side par rakhein.
Dono ghutno ke bal baith jayein taake aap ka mooh flat bench ki taraf ho.
Dono dumbbells ko ulti grip (hatheliyan upar) se pakrein aur upar layein taake forearms flat bench par tike hon. Kalaiyan kinare se bahar latki honi chahiyein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kalai ko upar curl kar ke shuru karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista kalaiyon ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein. Exercise ke is hisse mein saans andar lena zaroori hai.
Forearms saakit rehne chahiyein kyunke is exercise mein sirf kalai ki harkat hoti hai.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Parallel Bar Dip.instructions_ur:
Parallel bars ke darmiyan khare ho jayein. Har bar par ek haath rakhein, aur phir chhota sa jump le kar baazu lock karke shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Kohni mod kar jism ko neeche laayein yahan tak ke baazu 90 degree se neeche chale jayein. Jhoolne se bachein, aur neeche jate hue achha posture barqarar rakhein.
Kohni seedhi karke harkat ulti karein, aur khud ko wapas shuruati position tak upar dhakelein.
Jitne reps chahiyein utni dafa dohrayein.

Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge.instructions_ur:
Paon zameen par rakh kar let jayein, ediyan bilkul ghutnon ke neeche hon.
Kamar ke nichle hisse ko stretch karne ke liye sirf dum ki haddi (tailbone) ko chhat ki taraf uthayein. (Abhi poori reerh ki haddi na uthayein.) Pait andar kheenchein.
Bridge mein jaane ke liye, gardan ke ilawa poori reerh ki haddi uthayein.

Pendular Hack.instructions_ur: Pendulum hack, pendulum machine par kiya jata hai

Peroneals Stretch.instructions_ur:
Baith kar ek paon ke gird belt, rope ya band lapetein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taang seedhi aur aedi zameen se uthi rakhte hue belt ko kheenchein taake paon andar ki taraf mure, aur paon ka andar wala hissa aap ki taraf kheencha jaye. 10-20 second rokein, phir side badal lein.

Peroneals-SMR.instructions_ur:
Karwat ke bal let jayein, apna wazan forearm par aur nichli taang ke bahar wale hisse ke neeche rakhe foam roller par rakhein. Upar wali taang neeche wali taang ke upar ho sakti hai, ya aap use apne saamne cross kar sakte hain. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe zameen se uthayein aur taang ki side par ghutne ke neeche se takhne ke upar tak roll karna shuru karein, tension wali jagahon par 10-30 seconds rukein. Doosri taang par dohrayein.

Physioball Hip Bridge.instructions_ur:
Ball par is tarah let jayein ke upper back ball par ho aur kulhon ko koi sahara na ho. Dono paon zameen par seedhe hon, kulhon ke barabar ya us se zyada faasle par. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Glutes aur hamstrings se kulhe seedhe karna shuru karein, bridge banate hue kulhon ko upar uthayein.
Harkat ke upar rukein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Pigeon Stretch.instructions_ur: Exercise samajhne ke liye video dekhein

Pike Push Ups.instructions_ur: Pike position se kiya jane wala Push Up (paon ooncha rakhna ikhtiyari hai).

Pile Squat with Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon se 2-4 inch zyada chaure rakh kar khare hon, paon ki ungliyan 45 degree ke angle par bahar ki taraf.
Dumbbell ko dono haathon se jism ke beech mein pakdein.
Ghutne halke se mude aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
Aise neeche squat karein jaise kursi par baithne lage hon, raanein farsh ke parallel tak layein.
Control ke saath shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Notes: Poori exercise mein paon farsh par mazbooti se jame rakhein.

Pin Presses.instructions_ur:
Pin presses bench press ka eccentric hissa khatam kar dete hain, jis se shuruati taqat banti hai. Yeh aap ko range of motion ke ek khaas hisse ki training karne dete hain.
Bench ko power rack mein set karein. Pins ko apni range of motion ke matlooba point par set karein, chahe woh sirf lockout ho ya seene se ek inch upar. Bar ko pins par rakh kar uthane ke liye tayyar karein.
Bench par let kar shuru karein, bar aap ki aam bench press ke contact point ke bilkul upar ho. Apne paon apne neeche mod lein aur kamar ko arch karein. Bar ka sahara le kar kandhe bench se uthayein aur unhein peeche khinchein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein. Paon ki madad se traps ko bench mein dabayein. Poori harkat ke dauran jism ki yeh tight position barqarar rakhein.
Aap aam bench grip le sakte hain, ya triceps par tawajjo ke liye kandhon ke barabar grip. Bar, kalai aur kohni har waqt ek seedh mein rehni chahiye. Bar ko zor se dabane aur usay alag alag khinchne ki koshish par tawajjo dein.
Poori taqat se bar ko upar dhakelein. Lockout tak kohniyan andar ki taraf rehni chahiye.
Bar ko wapas pins par rakhein, aur agla rep shuru karne se pehle rukein.

Piriformis-SMR.instructions_ur:
Foam roll ke upar kulhon ke bal baith jayein. Ghutne moorein, aur phir ek taang ko is tarah cross karein ke takhna ghutne ke upar ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Weight ko cross ki hui taang ki side par le jayein, aur kulhe par roll karein jab tak glute ke upar wale hisse mein tension mehsoos na ho. Ek haath se mude hue ghutne ko seene ki taraf kheench kar stretch mein madad kar sakte hain. Is position ko 10-30 seconds rokein, aur phir side badal lein.

Pistol Squat.instructions_ur:
Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par, paon ki ungliyan aage ki taraf aur seena oopar rakh kar khare ho jayein.
Apni taang seedhi aage phailayein; dono baazu saamne kandhon ki unchai par phailayein. Core ko sakht karein aur seedha aage dekhein.
Aahista aahista neeche squat karein.
(ikhtiyari) neeche ruk jayein.
Poore waqt (khaali) taang aur baazu seedhe phailaye rakhein.

Plank.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Plank Shoulder Taps.instructions_ur: Sahi plank position mein, paon kandhon se thore chaure rakhein. Baari baari ek haath uthayein aur mukhalif kandhe ko chhooen.

Plantarflexion Stretch with Band.instructions_ur: Yeh stretch takhnon ke liye hai, aur saath hi Tibialis anterior ke liye.

Plate Pinch.instructions_ur:
Do chaure kinare wali plates lein aur unhein is tarah mila kar rakhein ke hamwar sides bahar ki taraf hon
Ungliyon se plate ke bahar wale hisse ko aur angoothe se doosri side ko pakrein, is tarah dono plates ko saath pakre rakhein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Ungliyon aur angoothe se plate ko dabayein. Is position ko jitni der ho sake rokein.
Apne program mein jitne sets tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badal kar yehi harkat dohrayein.

Plate Twist.instructions_ur:
Farsh ya exercise mat par let jayein, taangein poori seedhi aur upper body seedhi uthi hui. Plate ko dono haathon se sides se pakar kar pait ke saamne rakhein, baazu halke se mude hon.
Aahista aahista taangon ko takhnon ke qareeb cross karein aur zameen se upar uthayein. Ghutne bhi halke se mude hon. Note: Is exercise ke dauran balance barqarar rakhne ke liye upper body thora peeche karein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Plate ko left side le jayein aur use farsh se chhua dein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Saans andar lete hue shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur phir harkat dohrayein lekin is dafa jism ki right side ki taraf. Tip: Har waqt aahista aur control wali harkat karein. Jhatke wali harkatein kamar ko zakhmi kar sakti hain.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Platform Hamstring Slides.instructions_ur:
Is harkat ke liye lakri ka farsh ya is jaisi koi satah chahiye. Kamar ke bal let jayein aur taangein seedhi rakhein. Edi ke neeche gym towel ya halka weight rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutna mor kar harkat shuru karein, doosri taang seedhi rakhein.
Edi ko farsh par slide karte hue apne qareeb laate rahein.
Ghutna poora mudne par, harkat ko ulat kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Plie Dumbbell Squat.instructions_ur:
Dumbbell ko neeche wale hisse se dono haathon se pakrein aur seedhe khare ho jayein. Taangein kandhon ke faasle se zyada chauri karein aur ghutne thore se mude hon.
Paon ki ungliyan bahar ki taraf hon. Note: Exercise karte hue baazu saakit hone chahiye. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Aahista aahista ghutne moorein aur neeche jayein yahan tak ke raanein zameen ke parallel hon. Zaroor saans andar lein kyunke yeh exercise ka eccentric hissa hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue zyada tar paon ki aedi se dhakel kar jism ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Plyo Kettlebell Pushups.instructions_ur:
Zameen par ek kettlebell rakhein. Pushup position mein aa jayein, paon ki ungliyon par, ek haath zameen par aur ek haath se kettlebell pakre hue, kohniyan seedhi hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue jitna neeche ho sake jayein.
Jaldi aur zor se rukh badlein, khud ko upar dhakel kar kettlebell ki doosri taraf le jayein, aur sath hi haath badal lein. Neeche ja kar aur aage peeche yeh harkat dohra kar jari rakhein.

Plyo Push-up.instructions_ur:
Zameen par ulte let kar position lein, apna wazan haathon aur paon ki ungliyon par rakhein.
Baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur haath takreeban kandhon ke faasle par hon. Poori harkat mein jism seedha rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni mor kar neeche jayein, seene ko zameen ki taraf layein.
Neeche pohanch kar jitna jaldi ho sake kohniyan seedhi kar ke khud ko upar dhakelein aur harkat ulti karein. Upper body ko itna upar dhakelne ki koshish karein ke haath zameen se uth jayein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein aur exercise dohrayein.
Mazeed mushkil banane ke liye hawa mein hote hue taaliyan bajayein.

Posterior Tibialis Stretch.instructions_ur:
Baithi hui position mein, ek paon ke gird belt, rope ya band daalein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taang seedhi rakhte hue aur aedi zameen se uthi hui ho, belt ko is tarah kheenchein ke paon bahar ki taraf mure, yani paon ka bahar wala hissa aap ki taraf khinche. 10-20 seconds rokein, aur phir side badal lein.

Power Clean.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ki chaurai se thode zyada khule rakh kar khare hon aur paon ki ungliyan thodi bahar ki taraf hon.
Squat karke neeche jayein aur bar ko band, pronated grip se pakdein. Haath kandhon ki chaurai se thode zyada khule, ghutnon ke bahar hon aur kohniyan poori tarah seedhi hon.
Bar ko pindliyon se taqreeban 1 inch aage aur paon ke panjon ke upar rakhein.
Kamar seedhi ya thodi arch ho, seena upar aur bahar ho aur shoulder blades peeche khinche hon.
Sar ko neutral position mein rakhein (reerh ki haddi ki seedh mein, jhuka ya ghooma hua na ho) aur nazar seedhi saamne ho. Is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kulhon aur ghutnon ko zor se seedha karke bar ko farsh se uthayein. Tip: Dhad ke upar wale hisse ka zaviya wahi rehna chahiye. Abhi kulhon se na jhukein aur kulhon ko kandhon se pehle upar na uthne dein (aisa karne se glutes hawa mein uth jayenge aur hamstrings khinch jayenge).
Kohniyan poori tarah seedhi, sar neutral position mein aur kandhe bar ke upar rakhein.
Jaise jaise bar upar aaye usay pindliyon ke jitna qareeb ho sake rakhein.
Jab bar ghutnon se guzre, kulhe aage dhakelein aur ghutnon ko lock hone se bachane ke liye thoda modein. Tip: Is waqt aap ki raanein bar ke saath lagi honi chahiye.
Kamar seedhi ya thodi arch, kohniyan poori tarah seedhi aur sar neutral rakhein. Tip: Agle hisse tak saans roke rakhein.
Saans andar lein aur phir zor aur tezi se kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karein aur panjon par khare ho jayein.
Bar ko jism ke jitna qareeb ho sake rakhein. Tip: Kamar seedhi ho, kohniyan side ki taraf bahar hon aur sar neutral position mein ho. Saath hi kandhe bar ke upar aur baazu jitni dair ho sake seedhe rakhein.
Jab jism ke nichle hisse ke jod poori tarah seedhe ho jayein, kohniyan mude baghair kandhon ko tezi se upar shrug karein. Harkat ke is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein.
Jab kandhe apni sab se oonchi jagah par pahunchein to kohniyan mod kar jism ko bar ke neeche khinchna shuru karein.
Baazuon ko jitna ooncha aur jitni dair ho sake khinchte rahein. Tip: Is hisse ki dhamakedaar nature ki wajah se aap ka dhad seedha ya kamar arch hogi, sar thoda peeche jhuka hoga aur paon farsh se uth sakte hain.
Jab nichla jism poori tarah seedha ho jaye aur bar taqreeban zyada se zyada unchai tak pahunch jaye, jism ko bar ke neeche khinchein aur baazuon ko bar ke gird aur neeche ghumayein.
Saath hi kulhe aur ghutne mod kar quarter squat position mein aa jayein.
Jab baazu bar ke neeche aa jayein, saans andar lein aur phir kohniyan uthayein taake upar wale baazu farsh ke mutawazi hon. Bar ko hansli ki haddiyon aur kandhon ke saamne wale muscles par rack karein.
Bar ko seedhe aur tight dhad, neutral sar aur farsh par seedhe paon ke saath pakdein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karke poori tarah khare ho jayein.
Baazuon ka tanaao aahista aahista kam karke bar ko control ke saath raanon tak neeche layein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans andar lein.
Saath hi kulhe aur ghutne modein taake raanon par bar ka jhatka kam ho.
Kohniyan poori tarah seedhi rakhte hue squat karke neeche jayein yahan tak ke bar farsh ko chhoo le.
Phase 1 se dobara shuru karein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Power Clean from Blocks.instructions_ur:
Barbell pasandeeda unchai ke boxes par ho, taangon ke bilkul bahar grip lein. Kulhe neeche layein, wazan aediyon par ho, kamar seedhi, sar aage, seena oopar, aur kandhe bar se thore aage hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Pehla pull aediyon se zor laga kar ghutne seedhe karte hue shuru karein. Kamar ka angle wahi rehna chahiye aur baazu seedhe rehne chahiyein. Jab bar raan ke darmiyan tak pohanche, kulhon ko seedha karna shuru karein.
Jump jaisi harkat mein kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe kar ke raftaar barhayein aur bar ko tezi se oopar le jayein. Weight ki raftaar barhane ke liye baazuon se kheenchne ki zaroorat nahi honi chahiye. Doosre pull ke aakhir mein jism poori tarah seedha ho, halka sa peeche jhuka ho, aur baazu ab bhi seedhe hon.
Jab poori extension ho jaye to teesre pull mein jayein, zor se shrug karein aur kohniyan oopar aur bahar karte hue baazu morein. Poori extension par khud ko bar ke neeche itna kheenchein ke bar kandhon par rack ho sake, aur kohniyan bar ke neeche ghumayein. Bar aage nikle hue kandhon par tiki ho, halka sa gale ko chhuti ho aur haath dheele hon.
Foran aediyon se zor laga kar uthein, dhad seedha aur kohniyan oopar rakhein. Tab tak uthte rahein jab tak poori tarah khare na ho jayein, aur weight ko wapas boxes par rakh kar rep mukammal karein.

Power Jerk.instructions_ur:
Weight ko kandhon ke saamne rack kar ke khare hon, aur dip se shuru karein. Paon seedha kulhon ke neeche rakh kar, kulhe peeche le jaaye baghair ghutne morein. Sirf thora sa neeche jayein, aur jitni taaqat se ho sake simt badlein.
Ediyon se zor laga kar jitni ho sake raftaar aur taaqat paida karein, aur jab bar kandhon se uthe to sar ko raaste se hata lein.
Isi lamhe jab paon zameen se uthein, paon ko jitni jaldi ho sake receiving position mein rakhna hai. Jis mukhtasar lamhe mein paon platform par zor nahin laga rahe hote, bar ko upar dhakelne ki koshish athlete ko neeche le jaati hai. Paon thore chaure stance mein hon, aur ghutne thore mude hon.
Bar ko sar ke upar baazu lock kar ke receive karein.
Wapas khari position mein aa jayein.

Power Partials.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare hon aur har haath mein ek dumbbell baazuon ki lambai par pakrein. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb honi chahiyein.
Hatheliyan dhad ki taraf honi chahiyein. Paon taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu seedhe aur dhad saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue wazan ko side mein uthayein yahan tak ke woh taqreeban kandhon ki unchai par aa jayein.
Ek second sukerna mehsoos karein aur saans andar lete hue wazan ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche laana shuru karein. Tip: Wazan uthate aur neeche laate hue hatheliyan neeche rakhein aur chhoti ungli thori oonchi rakhein, is se zyada tar zor kandhon par rahega.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Power Snatch.instructions_ur:
Farsh par loaded barbell se shuru karein. Bar pindliyon ke qareeb ho ya unhein chhoo raha ho, aur bar par chauri grip lein. Paon bilkul kulhon ke neeche hon, aur zaroorat ke mutabiq bahar ki taraf mude hon. Kulhe neeche layein, seena upar ho aur sar saamne dekh raha ho. Kandhe bar se thoda aage hone chahiyein. Yeh shuruati position hogi.
Aediyon ke agle hisse se zor laga kar pehla pull shuru karein aur bar ko zameen se uthayein. Jab tak bar ghutnon se aage na nikal jaye, kamar ka angle wahi rehna chahiye.
Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue doosre pull mein jayein, aur bar ko jitni tezi se ho sake upar le jayein. Bar jism ke qareeb rehna chahiye. Poori extension par, kandhon ko shrug karein aur kohniyon ko side ki taraf mudne dein.
Jab paon receiving position mein, yani thodi chauri position mein le jayein, to bar ko sar ke upar uthate hue khud ko bar ke neeche kheenchein. Bar ko partial squat mein receive karna chahiye. Bar ko sar ke upar wali position tak uthate rahein, aur bar ko sar ke upar lock out kar ke receive karein.
Weight sar ke upar rakhte hue wapas khari position mein aa jayein.

Power Snatch from Blocks.instructions_ur:
Loaded barbell ko pasandeeda unchai ke boxes ya stands par rakh kar shuru karein. Bar par chauri grip lein. Paon seedha kulhon ke neeche hon, aur zaroorat ke mutabiq bahar ki taraf mude hon. Kulhe neeche karein, seena upar aur nazar aage. Kandhe bar se thora aage hon, aur kohniyan bahar ki taraf. Yeh shuruati position hogi.
Ediyon ke agle hisse se zor laga kar pehla pull shuru karein, aur bar ko boxes se uthayein.
Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe kar ke doosre pull mein jayein, aur bar ko jitni tezi se ho sake upar le jayein. Bar jism ke qareeb rahe. Poora seedha hone par kandhe shrug karein aur kohniyon ko side mein mudne dein.
Paon ko receiving position mein le jaate hue, zor se khud ko bar ke neeche kheenchein aur bar ko sar ke upar le jayein. Paon kulhon se thora bahar hon, zaroorat ke mutabiq bahar ki taraf mude hue. Bar ko full squat se upar aur sar ke upar poore seedhe baazuon ke saath receive karein.
Bar ko ediyon ke agle hisse ki seedh mein rakhte hue, sar aur seena upar, ediyon se zor laga kar khari position mein aayein. Ehtiyat se weight ko wapas boxes par rakhein.

Power Stairs.instructions_ur:
Power stairs mein saaman ko seedhiyon par upar le jaya jata hai. Training ke liye yeh tire ya box ke saath ki ja sakti hai.
Saaman ko dono haathon se pakar kar shuru karein. Paon chaure rakhein, sar aur seena upar. Ediyon se zameen ko dhakelein, ghutne aur kulhe seedhe kar ke weight zameen se uthayein.
Peeche jhukte hue, weight ko seedhi par jhulane ki koshish karein, jo aam tor par taqreeban 16-18" unchi hoti hai. Weight ko seedhi par dhakelne ke liye taangon ki madad bhi le sakte hain.
3-5 reps dohrayein, aur bhaari weight ke saath jaari rakhein, jitni tezi se ho sake.

Preacher Curl.instructions_ur:
Is movement ke liye aap ko preacher bench aur E-Z bar chahiye. E-Z curl bar ko andar wale tang handles se pakdein (behtar hai ke koi aap ko bar pakdaye, ya phir zyada tar preacher benches ke saamne diye gaye bar rest se bar utha lein). Hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon aur bar ki shape ki wajah se halki si andar ki taraf jhuki hon.
Upper arms preacher bench ke pad par aur seena us ke saath laga kar, E-Z Curl Bar ko kandhe ki oonchai par pakdein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista bar neeche layein jab tak upper arm seedha aur biceps poori tarah stretch na ho jaye.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue biceps se weight oopar curl karein jab tak biceps poori tarah contract na ho jaye aur bar kandhe ki oonchai par na aa jaye. Biceps ko zor se squeeze karein aur is position ko ek second hold karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Preacher Hammer Dumbbell Curl.instructions_ur:
Dono baazuon ka oopari hissa preacher bench ke oopar rakhein aur har haath mein ek dumbbell hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf (neutral grip) kar ke pakdein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbells neeche layein jab tak upper arm seedha aur biceps poori tarah stretch na ho jaye.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue biceps se weight oopar curl karein jab tak biceps poori tarah contract na ho jaye aur dumbbells kandhe ki oonchai par na aa jayein.
Contracted position mein biceps ko ek second zor se squeeze karein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Press Sit-Up.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye, bench par let jayein aur barbell seene par rakha ho. Taangon ko abdominal bench ki extension par mazbooti se phansa lein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue abs aur glutes ko tight karein. Saans bahar nikaalte hue ek saath dhad ko sit-up ki tarah curl karein aur barbell ko sar ke upar wali position tak press karein. Tip: Is exercise mein barbell ko bahar dhakelne ke liye baazu istemal karein lekin dhyan abs ke muscles par hi rakhein.
Jism ka upar wala hissa wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein aur saath hi barbell ko wapas dhad tak layein. Jism neeche laate hue saans andar lena yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Prone Incline Biceps Curl with Dumbbell.name_ur: Ulte let kar Incline Biceps Curl Dumbbell ke saath
Prone Incline Biceps Curl with Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein Biceps Curls karte waqt jism ki position badalne ke liye incline bench use hoti hai. Yeh movement Preacher Curl se kaafi milti julti hai.
Incline bench ko 45 degree ke angle par set karein.
Har haath mein dumbbell pakdein aur bench par chehra neeche kar ke tek lagayein, paon sahare ke liye farsh par hon.
Baazu pehluon mein neeche latakne dein.
Kohni seedhi rakhte hue dumbbells ko sar ki taraf oopar uthayein aur biceps ko tight karein.
Control ke saath weight neeche layein aur dohrayein.
Note: Is exercise mein movement mustaqil rakhein, dhyan rakhein ke baazu jhoolne na payein.

Prone Manual Hamstring.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko partner ki zaroorat hogi. Taangein seedhi rakh kar munh ke bal let jayein. Aap ka madadgaar apna haath aap ki aedhi par rakhega.
Shuru karne ke liye ghutna mod kar taang ko upar curl karein. Aap ka partner muqabla (resistance) de, halke se shuru kare aur harkat mukammal hone tak dabaao badhaye. Munasib resistance ka andaza lagane ke liye apne partner se baat karte rahein.
Top par rukein, aur taang ko wapas shuruati position mein layein jabke partner doosri simt mein resistance de.

Prowler Sprint.instructions_ur:
Sled ko munasib surface par rakhein, munasib weight load karke. Sled itni resistance de ke mehnat lage, lekin itna bhaari na ho ke aap ki raftaar bohat kam ho jaye.
Is exercise ke liye aap upar wale ya neeche wale handles istemal kar sakte hain. Baazu seedhe rakh kar haath handles par rakhein, implement par jhukte hue.
Achhe posture ke saath, baari baari chhote qadmon se zameen par zor lagayein. Thore faasle ke liye jitna tez ho sake chalein.

Pull Ups on Machine.instructions_ur: Control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Pull-Up.instructions_ur: Pull up bar ko chauri grip se pakdein, jism azaadi se latka hua ho. Seena bahar rakhein aur apne aap ko tab tak oopar kheenchein jab tak thodi bar tak na pahunch jaye, ya agar aap peeche ki taraf pull karna chahte hain to bar gardan ko chhoo le. Aahista aur control ke saath neeche aayein, seena hamesha bahar rakhein.

Pullover On Stability Ball With Weight.name_ur: Stability Ball par Pullover Weight ke saath
Pullover On Stability Ball With Weight.instructions_ur:
Barbell ya Dumbbell pakdein aur paon farsh par mazbooti se rakh kar Ball par baith jayein.
Jism ko neeche le jayein taake sirf pet ka oopari hissa Ball par tika ho.
Baazu seedhe rakh kar Barbell ya Dumbbell ko seene tak layein.
Arc ki shakal mein Barbell ya Dumbbell ko sar ke oopar se peeche farsh ki taraf le jayein.
Shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

Pullups.instructions_ur:
Pull-up bar ko hatheliyan saamne ki taraf rakh kar tay ki gayi grip se pakdein. Grips ke baare mein Note: Chauri grip ke liye haathon ka faasla kandhon ki chaurai se zyada ho. Darmiyani grip ke liye haathon ka faasla kandhon ki chaurai ke barabar ho aur tang grip ke liye kandhon ki chaurai se kam ho.
Jab dono baazu seedhe hon aur chuni hui grip par bar pakda ho, to dhad ko taqreeban 30 degree peeche le jayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein kham banayein aur seena bahar nikaalein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Kandhon aur upar wale baazuon ko neeche aur peeche khinchte hue dhad ko upar khinchein yahan tak ke bar seene ke upar wale hisse ko chhoo le. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Poori tarah sukeri position mein pahunch kar kamar ke muscles ko sukerne par tawajjo dein. Dhad ka upar wala hissa saakit rehna chahiye aur sirf baazu hilne chahiye. Forearms ka kaam sirf bar pakadna hai, is ke ilawa kuch nahin.
Sukeri position mein ek second ke baad, saans andar lena shuru karein aur aahista aahista dhad ko wapas shuruati position mein layein jab baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur lats poori tarah stretch hon.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa yeh harkat dohrayein.

Push Press.instructions_ur: Control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Push Press - Behind the Neck.instructions_ur:
Wazan ko kandhon ke peeche rack karke khare hon, aur dip se shuru karein. Paon bilkul kulhon ke neeche rakh kar, kulhe peeche kiye baghair ghutne modein. Sirf thoda sa neeche jayein, aur poori taqat se simt badlein. Aedhiyon se zor laga kar jitni ho sake raftaar aur taqat paida karein, bar ko seedhe amoodi raste par le jayein.
Paida hone wale momentum ko istemal karte hue baazu seedhe karke wazan ko sar ke upar press karna mukammal karein.
Wapas shuruati position mein aayein, jhatka jazb karne ke liye taangon ka istemal karein.

Push Up to Side Plank.name_ur: Push Up se Side Plank tak
Push Up to Side Plank.instructions_ur:
Paon ki ungliyon par pushup position mein aa jayein, haath kandhon ke faasle se thore bahar hon.
Kohniyon ko mudne de kar pushup karein. Neeche jate hue jism seedha rakhein.
Ek pushup karein aur upar aate hue wazan jism ki baayein taraf daal dein, side par ghumein aur daayan baazu chhat ki taraf utha kar side plank mein aa jayein.
Baazu ko wapas zameen par layein, ek aur pushup karein aur phir doosri taraf ghumein.
Yeh silsila har side baari baari karte hue 10 ya zyada reps tak dohrayein.

Push Up with Feet Elevated.name_ur: Paon oonche kar ke Push Up
Push Up with Feet Elevated.instructions_ur:
Yeh aam Push Up jaisi hi movement hai, bas paon oonche hote hain jis se range of motion zyada milti hai aur regular Push Up ke muqable mein seene ke muscles (pecs) alag tarah target hote hain.
Paon zameen se kam az kam 18” oonche bench par rakhein.
Dhyan rakhein ke paon ka oopari hissa bench ke saath barabar laga ho.
Haath farsh par kandhon se thora chaure rakhein.
Haath bilkul kandhon ke neeche rakh kar farsh se oopar push karein, kamar aur gardan seedhi line mein rakhein taake poori exercise mein aap saamne dekh rahe hon.
Baazu poori tarah seedhe hone par ruk jayein aur phir aahista aur control ke saath dobara farsh ki taraf neeche aayein.

Push-Up.instructions_ur:
Basic push up se shuru karein, farsh ya mat par ulte let jayein; paon ek saath aur ungliyan halki si mudi hon taake aap paon ke panjon par uth sakein.
Haath kandhon ke barabar faasle par seene ke dono taraf rakhein.
Pet andar khenchein.
Saans andar lete hue jism ko tab tak oopar uthayein jab tak baazu seedhe na ho jayein.
Sar aur gardan jism ki seedh mein rakhein (oopar ya neeche na dekhein) aur kamar ko oopar uthne ya neeche girne na dein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue jism ko wapas zameen ki taraf neeche layein.
Dohrayein.

Push-Up Wide.instructions_ur:
Haath chaure rakh kar, plank position mein paon ki ungliyon aur haathon par jism sambhalein. Kohniyan seedhi aur jism seedha ho. Kulhe neeche na latakne dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Shuru karne ke liye, kohniyan mudne dein aur saans andar lete hue seena zameen ki taraf neeche layein.
Seene ke muscles istemal karte hue, kohniyan seedhi kar ke upper body ko wapas shuruati position tak press karein. Yeh step karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Sukeri hui position mein ruk kar, jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Push-Ups - Close Triceps Position.instructions_ur:
Zameen par ulte let jayein aur haath kandhon ke faasle se qareeb rakhein taake haathon ki position tang ho. Yaqeeni banayein ke dhad seedhe baazuon par utha hua ho.
Saans andar lete hue neeche jayein yahan tak ke seena zameen ko taqreeban chhoo le.
Triceps aur seene ke kuch muscles istemal karte hue upper body ko wapas shuruati position mein upar dhakelein aur seene ko sukerein. Yeh step karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Sukri hui position mein ek second rukne ke baad, jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Push-Ups With Feet Elevated.instructions_ur:
Farsh par munh ke bal let jayein aur haath ek doosre se taqreeban 36 inch ke faasle par rakhein, dhad ko baazuon ki lambai par upar rakhein.
Paon ki ungliyan flat bench ke upar rakhein. Is se aap ka jism ooncha ho jayega. Note: Flat bench jitna ooncha hoga, exercise ki resistance utni zyada hogi.
Saans andar lete hue itna neeche jayein ke seena taqreeban farsh ko chhoo le.
Seene ke muscles ka istemal karte hue upar wale jism ko wapas shuruati position tak press karein aur seene ko sukerein. Yeh qadam karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Sukeri position mein ek second rukne ke baad, jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Push-Ups With Feet On An Exercise Ball.name_ur: Paon Exercise Ball par rakh kar Push-Ups
Push-Ups With Feet On An Exercise Ball.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ulte (mun neeche) let jayein aur haathon ko taqreeban 36 inch ke faasle par rakhein, aur baazu seedhe kar ke dhad ko upar uthaye rakhein.
Apne paon ki ungliyan exercise ball ke upar rakhein. Is se aap ka jism upar utha rahega.
Saans andar lete hue apne aap ko neeche layein yahan tak ke seena farsh ko taqreeban chhoo le.
Seene ke muscles ka istemal karte hue upar wala jism wapas shuruati position tak upar dhakelein aur seene ko daba kar sikorein. Is step ke dauran saans bahar nikaalein.
Sikri hui position mein ek second ruk kar, jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Push-Ups | Decline.instructions_ur:
Decline push-ups roayati push-up ka ek aur badla hua version hain jo upper body ke muscles ko alag tareeqe se target karte hain. Decline push-up karne ke liye, paon kisi unchi surface jaise bench, chair ya step par rakhein, aur haath push-up position mein zameen par. Kandhon se takhnon tak seedhi line barqarar rakhte hue jism zameen ki taraf neeche layein, aur phir wapas shuruati position tak upar dhakelein.
Incline push-up ke bar-aks, decline push-up kandhon aur triceps par zyada zor deta hai, jabke seene ke muscles bhi kuch kam had tak kaam karte hain. Paon unche karne se upper body par zyada weight aata hai aur exercise mushkil ho jati hai, jis se kandhon aur triceps ko jism wapas upar dhakelne ke liye zyada mehnat karni parti hai. Decline push-up upper body ki taqat ko challenge karne aur doosre push-up variations behtar karne ka zabardast tareeqa ho sakta hai. Har exercise ki tarah, sahi form istemal karein aur aisi unchai se shuru karein jo aapki taqat aur fitness level ke mutabiq ho.

Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions).name_ur: Pushups (Tang aur Chauri Haathon ki Position)
Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions).instructions_ur:
Farsh par ulte let jayein, jism seedha ho aur paon ki ungliyan farsh par hon; chauri position ke liye haath kandhon ke faasle se chaure aur tang position ke liye kandhon ke faasle se qareeb rakhein. Yaqeeni banayein ke aap ne dhad ko baazuon ki lambai par utha rakha hai.
Saans andar lete hue khud ko itna neeche layein ke seena taqreeban farsh ko chhu le.
Seene ke muscles se upper body ko wapas shuruati position tak oopar dhakelein aur seene ko sukerein. Yeh step karte waqt saans bahar nikaalein.
Contracted position par ek second ruk kar, tay shuda reps ke mutabiq harkat dohrayein.

Pyramid.instructions_ur:
Shuru mein dhad ko aage ball par roll karein taake kulhe ball ke upar tik jayein aur jism ka sab se ooncha hissa ban jayein.
Haath aur paon farsh par rakhein. Ball ke size, aap ki lachak, aur baazuon aur taangon ki lambai ke mutabiq baazu aur taangein thodi mudi ya seedhi ho sakti hain. Is se dhad aur kandhon mein mustahkam rakhne wali taaqat bhi barhti hai.

Quad Stretch.instructions_ur:
Karwat le kar let jayein. Upar wale paon ke gird belt, rope ya band daalein. Ghutna moorein aur kulha seedha karein, paon se glutes ko chhoone ki koshish karein, aur belt ko haathon se pakre rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Belt ko kandhe ke upar se ya sar ke upar se pakar kar, narmi se kheenchein taake quadriceps mein stretch barhe. 10-20 seconds rokein, aur phir side badal lein.

Quadriceps Stretch.instructions_ur: Ek taang par khare ho jayein (zaroorat ho to deewar ka sahara lein). Haath se doosri taang ka takhna pakrein aur ehtiyat se edi ko kulhon ki taraf kheenchein. Yaqeeni banayein ke ghutne aapas mein qareeb rahein aur pelvis ko thora aage dhakelein (kamar ko arch karne se bachein).

Quadriceps-SMR.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ulte let jayein, wazan haathon ya forearms par ho. Foam roll ko ek taang ke quadriceps ke neeche rakhein, aur paon zameen se upar rakhein. Taang ko jitna ho sake dheela chhorein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Jitna bardasht ho sake utna wazan stretch hone wali taang par daalein, aur ghutne ke upar se kulhe ke neeche tak foam par rol karein, tension wali jagahon par 10-30 seconds rokein. Side badlein.

Quadriped Arm and Leg Raise.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein, crawling position mein mukhalif baazu aur taang ek saath uthane se kamar ke muscles aur taang aur baazu ke pichle hisse ke muscles activate hote hain. Yeh balance aur proprioception bhi behtar karti hai. Harkat dono taraf barabar ki jati hai.
Crawling posture mein aa jayein. 2. Pait andar kheenchein, phir right taang aur left baazu uthayein. 3. Pait 8 seconds tak andar rakhein. 4. 8 seconds ke baad, aahista aahista baazu aur taang neeche layein. 5. Phir muscles dheele chhor dein.

Quick Alternating Biceps Curls with Band.name_ur: Band ke saath tez Baari baari Biceps Curls
Quick Alternating Biceps Curls with Band.instructions_ur:
Band ko apne paon ke neeche rakhein aur handles ko is tarah pakrein ke hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hon aur pet andar khincha hua ho.
Jism seedha rakhte hue baazuon ko baari baari upar neeche curl karein.
Jaise jaise harkat mein aasani ho, raftaar barhaate jayein.
Note: Baazu upar curl karte waqt biceps ko sikorein.

Quick Leap.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aapko box chahiye hoga.
Box ki taraf munh karke us ke kinare se 1-2 feet door khare ho kar shuru karein.
Kulhon ka istemal karte hue, box par uchhal kar dono taangon par land karein. Yaqeeni banayein ke taangein mudi hon aur paon seedhe tike hon.
Land karte hi foran poora jism seedha karein aur baazu sar se upar jhula kar box se dhamake ke saath uchhlein. Land karte waqt impact ko taangon se jazb karein.

Rack Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Yeh deadlift Smith machine ya free rack par ki jaati hai. Bar ya barbell ghutne ki chapni (knee cap) se zara neeche honi chahiye. Glutes aur aerhiyon ke zor se uthayein, phir 2 seconds mein control ke saath shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Yeh exercise zyada tar kamar ke nichle hisse aur glutes par kaam karti hai.

Rack Delivery.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill barbell ko kandhon par rack position mein pohanchana sikhati hai. Bar ko scarecrow position mein pakar kar shuru karein, upper arms zameen ke parallel aur forearms neeche latke hue hon. Hook grip istemal karein, ungliyan angoothon ke upar lipti hon.
Kohniyon ko bar ke gird ghuma kar bar ko kandhon tak pohanchayein. Jab kohniyan aage aayein to grip dheeli kar dein. Kandhe aage nikle hue hon taake bar ke liye shelf ban jaye, aur bar halka sa gale ko chhoo raha ho.
Zaroori hai ke bar har waqt jism ke qareeb rahe, kyunke zyada wazan ke saath zara sa faasla bhi na-pasandida takkar ka sabab banega. Jab harkat smooth ho jaye to aage barhne se pehle raftar aur wazan barhaya ja sakta hai.

Rack Pull.instructions_ur: barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Rack Pull with Bands.instructions_ur:
Power rack mein bar ko pins par rakh kar set up karein. Pins pasandeeda jagah par set hon; ghutnon se zara neeche, zara oopar, ya raan ke darmiyan. Bands ko rack ke base se bandhein, ya dumbbells se secure karein. Doosra sira bar se bandhein. Tension ke liye shayad bands ko choke karna pare.
Deadlift ki sahi position mein bar ke saath khare ho jayein. Paon kulhon ke neeche, grip kandhon ke barabar, kamar mein kham, aur hamstrings ko engage karne ke liye kulhe peeche hon. Kyunke weight aam taur par bhaari hota hai, weight pakarne mein madad ke liye mixed grip, hook grip ya straps istemal kar sakte hain.
Sar aage dekhte hue kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karein, weight ko oopar aur peeche lockout tak kheenchein. Harkat mukammal karte waqt kandhe peeche kheenchna yaqeeni banayein. Weight ko wapas pins par rakhein aur dohrayein.

Rear Delt Fly.instructions_ur: dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Rear Delt Raises.instructions_ur: Bench par baith kar, dumbbells zameen par rakh kar, 45 degree par aage jhukein aur phir aahista aahista har dumbbell ko kandhon ki unchai tak uthayein aur shuruati position mein neeche laane se pehle kuch second rokein.

Rear Deltoid Row Barbell.instructions_ur:
Barbell par munasib weight laga kar usay apne saamne farsh par rakhein.
Ghutne mod kar aur kamar seedhi rakh kar bar ko chauri overhand grip (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) se pakrein.
Seena mustahkam rakhein aur baazu seene ke saath amudi (perpendicular) rakhein.
Bar ko jitna ho sake seene ki taraf upar khinchein.
Ek lamha ruk kar bar ko control ke saath neeche layein.
Dohrayein.

Rear Deltoid Row Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Daayan paon farsh par rakhein, aur baayan ghutna aur baayan haath flat bench par tikayein.
Aage jhukein taake jism ka wazan baayein baazu aur ghutne par ho.
Kamar seedhi (flat) rakhte hue neeche haath barha kar daayein haath se dumbbell uthayein.
Daayein baazu ko jitna ho sake seene ke qareeb upar uthayein, aur kohni ko mod kar jitna peeche le ja sakein le jayein.
Upar ek lamha ruk kar dumbbell ko control ke saath shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Ulti position bana kar baazu badlein.
Dohrayein.

Rear Leg Raises.instructions_ur:
Exercise mat par haathon aur ghutnon ke bal aa jayein. Sar saamne dekh raha ho aur ghutnon ka mor hamstrings aur pindliyon ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle banaye. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ek taang upar aur peeche seedhi karein. Ghutna aur kulha dono seedhe hon. 5-10 reps dohrayein, aur phir side badlein.

Rear Lunges with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko rack par seene ki oonchai par rakhein.
Barbell ko rack se utha kar kandhon par rakhein, aur bar ko kandhon ke faasle se thoda chaura pakrein.
Paon taqreeban 8 inch ke faasle par rakh kar khare hon, paon ki ungliyan seedhi saamne ki taraf hon.
Aahista aahista daayein taang se ek qadam peeche lein.
Pet andar khinch kar aur upar wala jism seedha rakh kar jism ko neeche layein yahan tak ke baayan ghutna taqreeban zameen ko chhoo le. Chahein to ghutne ke neeche mat ya towel rakh sakte hain.
Ek lamha ruk kar shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Recumbent Bike.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye bike par baith jayein aur seat ko apne qad ke mutabiq adjust karein.
Menu se pasandeeda option chunein. Machine on karne ke liye shayad aap ko pedal chalana shuru karna pare. Aap manual setting istemal kar sakte hain, ya koi program chun sakte hain. Aam tor par aap apni umar aur wazan daal kar exercise ke dauran jalne wali calories ka andaza laga sakte hain. Workout ke dauran resistance ka level badla ja sakta hai. Handles ke zariye dil ki dharkan check ki ja sakti hai taake aap munasib intensity par rahein.
Recumbent bikes aasani, dil aur saans ke fawaid deti hain, aur doosri activities ke muqable mein jism par kam asar daalti hain. 150 lb ka shakhs darmiyani raftaar se 30 minute cycling karke taqreeban 230 calories jalata hai, jab ke daurne mein 450 ya us se zyada calories jalti hain.

Remo Maquina Agarre Estrecho.instructions_ur: Machine par tang grip bar ke saath row

Remo Maquina Agarre Estrecho Supino.instructions_ur: Machine ya pulley par tang ulti grip ke saath row

Return Push from Stance.instructions_ur:
Is drill ke liye aap ko partner chahiye hoga.
Athletic 2 ya 3 point stance mein shuru karein.
Ishara milne par partner ka pass pakarne ki position mein aa jayein.
Medicine ball ko dono haathon se pakrein aur foran wapas partner ki taraf phenk dein.
Mukhtalif routes par daur kar is drill ko badal sakte hain.

Reverse Band Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Power rack ke andar bench rakhein, aur bar ko sahi oonchai par set karein. Bands ko band pegs ya rack ke upar wale hisse se baandh kar shuru karein. Yaqeeni banayein ke aap bands ke neeche sahi position mein honge. Doosra sira barbell se jor dein.
Bench par let jayein, paon apne neeche mor lein aur kamar ko arch karein. Bar se wazan sambhalne mein madad lete hue kandhe bench se uthayein aur peeche khinchein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein. Paon se zor laga kar traps ko bench mein dabayein. Poori harkat mein jism ki yeh tight position barqarar rakhein. Grip jitni bhi chauri ho, woh bar par bane ring ko cover kare.
Kandhon ko aage nikale baghair bar ko rack se nikaalein. Bar ko zor se dabane aur use alag khinchne ki koshish par dhyan dein. Bar ko seene ke nichle hisse ya pait ke upar wale hisse tak neeche layein. Bar, kalai aur kohni har waqt seedh mein rahein.
Jab barbell dhad ko chhoo le to rukein, aur phir jitni taqat se ho sake bar ko upar dhakelein. Lockout tak kohniyan andar ki taraf rahein.

Reverse Band Box Squat.instructions_ur:
Power rack mein shuru karein, peeche munasib oonchai par box rakha ho. Bands ko ya to band pegs par ya rack ke upar lagayein, aur yaqeeni banayein ke squat ke dauran woh bar ke bilkul upar honge. Doosra sira bar se lagayein.
Bar ke neeche aa kar usay kandhon ke peeche rakhein. Kandhe ki haddiyon ko aapas mein sukerein aur kohniyan aage ghumayein, jaise bar ko kandhon par modne ki koshish kar rahe hon. Bar ko rack se utarein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein sakht kham banayein, aur peeche qadam le kar position mein aa jayein. Kamar, glutes, adductors aur hamstrings par zyada zor ke liye paon zyada chaure rakhein, ya quads ki zyada growth ke liye qareeb rakhein. Sar saamne ki taraf rakhein.
Kamar, kandhe aur core sakht rakhte hue ghutne aur kulhe bahar dhakelein aur neeche jana shuru karein. Kulhon ke saath peeche baithte jayein yahan tak ke box par baith jayein. Behtar yeh hai ke pindliyan zameen ke amudi hon. Box par pahunch kar rukein, aur hip flexors ko dheela chhorein. Box se kabhi uchhal kar na uthein.
Weight ediyon par rakhte hue aur paon aur ghutne bahar dhakelte hue box se zor laga kar upar uthein, aur harkat ki rehnumai sar se karein. Sar se paon tak sakhti barqarar rakhte hue upar uthte rahein. Barbell ko ehtiyat se rack mein wapas rakhein.

Reverse Band Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Bar ko power rack mein set karein. Bands ko rack ke upar band pegs ya frame ke saath bandhein. Bands ka doosra sira bar se bandhein.
Bar ke paas is tarah aayein ke woh aapke paon ke beech mein ho. Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Kulhon se jhuk kar bar ko kandhon ke barabar pakrein, aur shoulder blades ko aage aane dein. Aam taur par overhand grip, ya bhaari sets par over/under grip istemal ki jaati hai.
Paon aur grip set kar ke gehri saans lein, phir kulhe neeche karein aur ghutne modein jab tak pindliyan bar ko na chhoo lein. Sar se aage dekhein, seena upar aur kamar arch mein rakhein, aur ediyon se zor laga kar wazan upar uthana shuru karein.
Bar ghutnon se guzarne ke baad use zor se peeche kheenchein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein milayein aur kulhon ko aage bar ki taraf dhakelein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar bar ko farsh tak le ja kar neeche layein.

Reverse Band Power Squat.instructions_ur:
Power rack mein pins aur bar ko munasib oonchai par set kar ke shuru karein. Bar par wazan lagane ke baad bands ko rack ke upar wale hisse se baandhein, pegs ya frame ke zariye. Bands ka doosra sira bar se jor dein.
Bar ke neeche aa kar use kandhon ke pichle hisse par rakhein. Shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerein aur kohniyan aage ghumayein, jaise bar ko kandhon par morne ki koshish kar rahe hon. Bar ko rack se uthayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein tight arch banayein, aur peeche qadam le kar position mein aa jayein. Kamar, glutes, adductors aur hamstrings par zyada zor ke liye paon chaure rakhein.
Sar seedha aage ki taraf rakhein. Kamar, kandhe aur core tight rakhte hue ghutne aur kulhe bahar dhakelein aur neeche jana shuru karein. Jitna ho sake kulhon ko peeche le kar baithein. Behtar yeh hai ke pindliyon ki haddi zameen ke perpendicular ho. Bar neeche rakhne ki surat mein bar ko aediyon ke upar rakhne ke liye dhad ko zyada jhukana parta hai. Parallel se neeche jane tak jari rakhein, yaani kulhe ki lakeer ghutne ke upar wale hisse ki seedh mein aa jaye.
Wazan aediyon par rakhte hue aur paon aur ghutne bahar dhakelte hue, sar se harkat ki rehnumai karte hue upar zor lagayein. Sar se paon tak tightness barqarar rakhte hue upar jate rahein yahan tak ke shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Reverse Band Sumo Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Power rack ke andar farsh par load kiye hue bar se shuru karein. Bands ko rack ke oopar pegs ya frame se bandhein. Doosra sira barbell se bandhein.
Bar ke paas is tarah aayein ke bar paon ke darmiyan se guzre. Paon bohat chaure hon, collars ke qareeb. Bar pakarne ke liye kulhon se jhukein. Baazu kandhon ke bilkul neeche, taangon ke andar hon, aur aap pronated grip, mixed grip ya hook grip istemal kar sakte hain. Kandhon ko dheela chhorein, is se aap ke baazu lambe ho jate hain.
Saans lein, phir kulhe neeche layein, sar se aage dekhein aur seena oopar rakhein. Farsh mein zor lagayein, paon ko alag ki taraf dhakelte hue, wazan paon ke peeche wale aadhe hisse par ho. Kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karein.
Jab bar ghutnon se guzre to peeche jhukein aur kulhon ko bar ki taraf dhakelein, shoulder blades ko aapas mein kheenchein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar aur neeche aate waqt weight ko control karte hue use wapas zameen par rakhein.

Reverse Barbell Curl.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare ho jayein aur barbell ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakren, kohniyan dhad ke qareeb hon. Hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon (pronated grip). Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upper arms saakit rakhte hue biceps ko sukerte hue weight ko curl karein aur saans bahar nikaalein. Sirf forearms harkat karein. Harkat tab tak jari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah sukar na jayein aur bar kandhon ki oonchai par na aa jaye. Muscle ko sukerte hue contracted position ko ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista bar ko wapas shuruati position mein laana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Barbell Preacher Curls.instructions_ur:
