EZ-bar ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par hatheliyan neeche ki taraf (pronated) grip se pakrein.
Ab dono baazuon ka upar wala hissa preacher bench ke upar rakhein aur baazu seedhe rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue biceps se wazan upar curl karein yahan tak ke biceps poori tarah sukre hon aur barbell kandhon ki oonchai par ho. Sukri hui position mein ek second ke liye biceps ko zor se sukerein.
Saans andar lete hue barbell ko aahista aahista neeche layein yahan tak ke upper arms seedhe hon aur biceps poori tarah stretch ho.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Cable Curl.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare ho jayein aur low pulley se lagi bar attachment ko pronated (hatheliyan neeche) aur kandhon ke barabar grip se pakrein. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Upar ke baazu saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte aur biceps ko sukerte hue wazan ko curl karein. Sirf forearms hilne chahiyein. Harkat tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah contract na ho jayein aur bar kandhon ki unchai par na aa jaye. Muscle ko sukerte hue contracted position ko ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista bar ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Crunch.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let jayein, taangein poori tarah seedhi hon aur baazu dhad ki side par hatheliyan farsh par rakh kar hon. Poori exercise mein baazu saakit rehne chahiye.
Taangein upar layein taake raanein farsh ke amoodi hon aur paon aapas mein mile hue aur farsh ke mutawazi hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue taangon ko dhad ki taraf layein, pelvis ko peeche rol karein aur kulhe farsh se uthayein. Is harkat ke aakhir mein aap ke ghutne seene ko chhoo rahe honge.
Contraction ko ek second rokein aur saans bahar nikaalte hue taangein wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Flyes.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye incline bench par is tarah let jayein ke seena aur pait incline se lage hon. Dono haathon mein dumbbells pakrein, hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf hon (neutral grip).
Baazu apne saamne seedhe karein taake woh bench ke angle ke perpendicular hon. Taangein saakit rahein aur paon ki ungliyon ke agle hisse se dabao dein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Kohniyon ka halka sa mor barqarar rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue weights ko kaman ki shakal mein bahar aur ek doosre se door (side ki taraf) le jayein. Tip: Is exercise ka behtareen nateeja paane ke liye shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerne ki koshish karein.
Baazuon ko itna uthayein ke woh zameen ke parallel ho jayein.
Sukerna mehsoos karein aur saans andar lete hue weights ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Flyes With External Rotation.name_ur: External Rotation ke saath Reverse Flyes
Reverse Flyes With External Rotation.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye, 30 degree par set incline bench par is tarah let jayein ke seena aur pait incline se lage hon.
Har haath mein dumbbell ho aur hatheliyan neeche zameen ki taraf. Baazu aap ke saamne is tarah hon ke bench ke zaawiye par amudi hon. Tip: Kohniyon mein halka sa kham ho. Taangein saakit rahein aur paon ki ungliyon ke agle hisse se dabao dalein (ediyan zameen ko na chhooyein). Yeh shuruati position hai.
Kohniyon ka halka kham barqarar rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue weights ko kamaan numa harkat mein bahar aur ek doosre se door le jayein.
Weight uthate hue, kalai ko 90 degree bahar ki taraf ghumayein taa ke hatheliyan neeche (pronated) wali grip se hatheliyan aamne saamne (neutral) wali grip ho jaye. Tip: Is exercise ka behtareen nateeja paane ke liye shoulder blades ko aapas mein sukerne ki koshish karein.
Baazu tab tak uthayein jab tak woh sar ki seedh mein na aa jayein.
Sukerna mehsoos karein aur saans andar lete hue aahista aahista weights ko shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Grip Barbell Curls.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko overhand grip (hatheliyan neeche) se taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakrein. Kamar seedhi rakhein, kandhe thode peeche kheenchein, aur baazu poori tarah seedhe rakhein.
Kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakhte hue, control ke saath barbell ko seene ki taraf upar curl karein. Harkat hamwar ho, jhulane ya momentum ke baghair.
Jab barbell seene ki oonchai par aa jaye, to thoda rukein taake biceps aur forearms mein zyada se zyada sukerna ho.
Control ke saath aahista aahista barbell ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein, aur baazu poori tarah seedhe karein.

Reverse Grip Bent-Over Rows.instructions_ur:
Ghutne mod kar aur kamar seedhi rakh kar barbell ke upar halke se zaviye par jhukein.
Bar ko ulti grip (hatheliyan upar ki taraf) se pakrein aur kohniyan pehluon ke qareeb rakhte hue aahista aahista barbell ko pet ki taraf khinchein.
Upar ek lamha rukein.
Barbell ko shuruati position par wapas layein.
Dohrayein.

Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown.instructions_ur:
Pehle high pulley machine par bar attachment (seedha ya e-z) lagayein.
Bar attachment ki taraf mun kar ke usay kandhon ke faasle par hatheliyan upar ki taraf (supinated grip) rakh kar pakrein. Lats ka istemal karte hue bar ko neeche layein yahan tak ke baazu pehluon ke saath poori tarah seedhe ho jayein. Tip: Kohniyan pehluon ke saath andar hon aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue bar attachment ko aahista aahista upar layein taake woh seene ki seedh mein aa jaye. Sirf kalaiyon se kohni tak ka hissa (forearms) hile, kohniyan aur upar wale baazu har waqt pehluon ke saath saakit rahein.
Phir saans bahar nikaalte hue aur triceps ko zor se sikorte hue cable bar ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Hyperextension.instructions_ur:
Munasib wazan load karne ke baad paon pads ke darmiyan rakhein. Upar wale pad par let jayein, kulhe peeche latakne dein, aur position sambhalne ke liye handles pakrein.
Harkat shuru karne ke liye kulhe modein, taangon ko aage kheenchte hue.
Kulhe seedhe kar ke harkat ulat dein, taang ko peeche kick karte hue. Is harkat mein kulhe ko zaroorat se zyada extend na karna bohat zaroori hai, apni poori range of motion se pehle hi ruk jayein.
Dobara kulha mor kar wapas aayein, carriage ko jitna ho sake aage kheenchte hue.
Jitne reps chahiye utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Lunge.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Reverse Machine Flyes.instructions_ur:
Handles ko aise adjust karein ke woh poori tarah peeche hon. Munasib weight chunein aur seat ki unchai aise adjust karein ke handles kandhon ki satah par hon. Haath andar ki taraf rakh kar handles pakrein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Aadhe daire ki harkat mein, haathon ko side aur peeche kheenchein, rear delts sukerte hue.
Poori harkat mein baazu halke se mude rakhein, saari harkat kandhe ke jor par ho.
Harkat ke peeche wale hisse par rukein, aur aahista aahista weight ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.

Reverse Nordic Curl.instructions_ur: Natural Leg Extension, Leg Extension machine ka baghair equipment wala mutabadil hai.

Reverse Plate Curls.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho kar dono haathon se weight plate pakar kar shuru karein, baazu poori tarah seedhe hon. Pronated grip (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) istemal karein aur yaqeeni banayein ke ungliyan plate ki khurdari side aur angootha chikni side pakre. Note: Behtareen nataij ke liye plate ko 11:00 aur 1:00 baje ki position par pakrein.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon aur weight plate raanon ke jor ke qareeb ho. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kohniyan andar aur upper arms saakit rakhte hue aahista aahista plate oopar uthayein jab tak biceps aur forearms aapas mein na chhu jayein. Is waqt plate dhad ke saath barabar seedh mein honi chahiye.
Ek second contraction mehsoos karein aur saans andar lete hue weight ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche lana shuru karein
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Reverse Plate Curls with Weight.name_ur: Weight ke saath Reverse Plate Curls
Reverse Plate Curls with Weight.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par, ghutne halke se mude aur pet andar khincha hua rakh kar khare hon.
Plate ko hatheliyan neeche ki taraf rakh kar 11 aur 1 baje wali jagah se pakrein.
Kohniyan aur baazu pehluon ke saath rakhte hue plate ko aahista aahista sar ki taraf upar curl karein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Reverse Triceps Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par is tarah letein ke sar ek kinare par ho aur paon mazbooti se farsh par jame hon.
Barbell ko taqreeban 16 inch ke faasle par, hatheliyan sar ki taraf rakh kar pakrein.
Bar ko seene ke upar layein (nipples se taqreeban 1 inch neeche).
Baazu poori tarah seedhe kar ke bar ko poora upar uthayein aur phir bar ko shuruati position tak neeche layein.

Reverse V-Squat.instructions_ur:
V-squat machine mein pad ki taraf munh karke dakhil hon, aam V-squat se ulti taraf, taake seena pad se laga ho aur kandhe shoulder pads ke neeche hon. Paon platform par taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein aur safety hata dein.
Core ko tight karein aur ghutne mod kar aur kulhe peeche dhakel kar neeche jayein yahan tak ke raanein taqreeban platform ke mutawazi ho jayein. Ghutne lock kiye baghair aedhiyon se zor laga kar wapas upar aayein.
Aam V-squat ke muqable mein, ulti position zor ko glutes aur hamstrings ki taraf le jaati hai.

Reverse Wrist Curl.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Rhomboids-SMR.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal zameen par let jayein. Foam roller upper back ke neeche rakhein, aur baazu saamne cross karein, kandhon ko aage phailate hue. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe zameen se uthayein aur wazan foam roller par daalein. Wazan ek waqt mein ek taraf muntaqil karein, kamar ke darmiyani aur upar wale hisse par roll karte hue. Tension wale points par 10-30 second rukein.

Rickshaw Carry.instructions_ur:
Frame ko starting point par rakhein aur munasib wazan load karein. Frame ke beech mein khare ho kar handles pakrein aur eriyon se zor laga kar frame uthayein. Yaqeeni banayein ke seena aur sar upar hon aur kamar seedhi ho.
Foran chhote, control wale qadmon ke saath tezi se chalna shuru karein. Seena upar aur sar saamne rakhein, aur saans lete rehna yaqeeni banayein. End point par pohanch kar frame ko zameen par rakh dein.

Rickshaw Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Frame par pasandeeda weight load karein. Handles ke beech mein khare hon. Paon taqreeban kulhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Kulhon se jhuk kar handles pakrein, aur shoulder blades ko aage khulne dein.
Paon aur grip set kar ke, gehri saans lein aur phir kulhe neeche aur ghutne morein. Sar se aage dekhein, seena upar aur kamar arched rakhein, aur ediyon se zor laga kar weight upar uthana shuru karein. Jaise weight upar aaye, shoulder blades aapas mein kheenchein aur kulhe aage dhakelein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar weight ko zameen tak guide karte hue neeche layein.

Ring Dips.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek ring pakren, aur phir chhota sa jump le kar baazu lock karke shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Kohni mod kar jism ko neeche laayein yahan tak ke baazu 90 degree se neeche chale jayein. Jhoolne se bachein, aur neeche jate hue achha posture barqarar rakhein.
Kohni seedhi karke harkat ulti karein, aur khud ko wapas shuruati position tak upar dhakelein.
Jitne reps chahiyein utni dafa dohrayein.

Rocket Jump.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar aaram se khare hon aur baazu jism ke qareeb rakhein.
Harkat shuru karne ke liye, aadha squat karein aur tezi se jitna ooncha ho sake uchhlein.
Poore jism ko seedha karein, aur baazuon ko jitna ho sake sar ke upar le jayein. Zameen par utarte hue jhatka taangon se jazb karein.

Rocking Standing Calf Raise.name_ur: Rocking Khare ho kar Calf Raise
Rocking Standing Calf Raise.instructions_ur:
Kandhon par bar rakh kar khare hon.
Paon farsh par seedhe rakh kar, paon ko upar aur aage uthayein jaise calf raise kar rahe hon.
Phir takhnon par peeche ki taraf "jhoolein" taake paon ki ungliyan upar mur kar farsh se uth jayein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Note: Yeh exercise karte waqt running ya cross training joote pehnein. Harkat se waqif hone ke liye pehle yeh exercise baghair weight ke kar ke dekhein.

Rocky Pull-Ups/Pulldowns.instructions_ur:
Pull-up bar ko chauri grip se pakrein, hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon.
Dono baazu saamne seedhe hon aur bar chuni hui grip width par pakri ho, dhad ko taqreeban 30 degree peeche le jayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein kham banayein aur seena bahar nikaalein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Kandhon aur upar ke baazuon ko neeche aur peeche kheenchte hue dhad ko upar uthayein jab tak bar seene ke upar wale hisse ko na chhoo le. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Poori contracted position par pohanch kar kamar ke muscles ko sukerne par dhyan dein. Upar wala dhad harkat ke dauran saakit rehna chahiye aur sirf baazu hilne chahiyein. Forearms ka kaam sirf bar pakarna hai, aur kuch nahi.
Contracted position par ek second ke baad saans andar lena shuru karein aur aahista aahista dhad ko shuruati position mein neeche layein jab baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur lats poori tarah stretch hon.
Ab upar bataye gaye tareeqe se hi harkat dohrayein, lekin is dafa upar jate hue dhad seedha rahega aur bar seene ke upar wale hisse ke bajaye gardan ke peeche chhuega. Tip: Sar ko thora aage jhukayein, is se exercise ka yeh hissa sahi tareeqe se karne mein madad milegi.
Shuruati position mein wapas neeche aa kar, apne program mein jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa exercise dohrayein.

Romanian Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko zameen par apne paon ke saamne rakhein.
Barbell ko kandhon ke faasle se thoda chauri grip se pakrein.
Ghutne halke se modein, kulhe aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
Khare hote hue kulhon ke istemal par dhyan de kar bar ko seedha upar uthayein.
Bar ko raanon ke saath tika kar khare ho jayein.
Ghutnon mein halka sa mor rakhte hue aur balance ke liye kulhe peeche dhakelte hue bar ko farsh tak neeche layein.

Romanian Deadlift from Deficit.instructions_ur:
Bar ko baazuon ki poori lambai par apne saamne pakar kar khare ho kar shuru karein. Range of motion barhane ke liye aap kisi uche platform par khare ho sakte hain.
Ghutne halke se mor kar shuru karein, phir kulhon se jhukein, kulhe jitna ho sake peeche le jayein, aur dhad ko jitna lachak ijazat de neeche layein. Kamar har waqt poori seedhi rahe, aur bar taangon se lagi rahe. Agar sahi kiya jaye to hamstrings mein kaafi tension mehsoos honi chahiye.
Harkat ko ulat kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Rope Climb.instructions_ur:
Rope ko dono haathon se sar ke upar pakrein. Chhoti si chhalang lagate hue rope ko neeche khinchein.
Rope ko ek taang ke gird lapaitein, paon se rope ko dabayein. Baazuon se jitna ooncha ho sake haath barhayein aur rope ko mazbooti se pakrein.
Baazuon se khud ko upar khinchte hue paon se rope chhor dein, aur ghutnon ko seene ki taraf layein.
Paon ko dobara rope par jama lein, aur phir khare ho kar rope ko aur ooncha pakrein. Rope ke upar tak pohanchne tak jari rakhein.
Neeche aane ke liye paon ki pakar dheeli karein aur baari baari haath badalte hue neeche phisal aayein.

Rope Crunch.instructions_ur:
Cable system ke saamne 1-2 feet ke faasle par ghutno ke bal baith jayein jis par rope lagi ho.
Munasib wazan chun kar, rope ko dono haathon se sar ke upar pakrein. Shuruati position mein dhad seedha hona chahiye.
Shuru karne ke liye reerh ki haddi ko modein, cable ko neeche kheenchte hue pasliyon ko taangon ki taraf laane ki koshish karein.
Harkat ke neeche rukein, aur phir aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Obliques par kaam ke liye yeh twist ke saath ya side ki taraf bhi kiye ja sakte hain.

Rope Jumping.instructions_ur:
Rope ka ek ek sira har haath mein pakrein. Rope ko apne peeche zameen par rakhein. Baazu upar uthayein aur rope ko sar ke upar se ghuma kar saamne neeche layein. Jab woh zameen tak pohanche to us par se jump karein. Ghumane ki aisi raftaar dhoondein jo qaim rakh sakein. Tabdeeli ke liye mukhtalif speeds aur techniques istemal ki ja sakti hain.
Rope jumping dilchasp hai, coordination ko challenge karti hai aur bohat energy maangti hai. 150 lb ka shakhs 30 minute rope jumping se taqreeban 350 calories jalata hai, jabke daurne se 450 se zyada calories jalti hain.

Rope Pullover/row.instructions_ur: Cable row machine ke saamne bench lagayein. Bench par jhuk kar rope ke saath row/pullover karein jo lats ko target karta hai. Tasveer dekhein.

Rope Straight-Arm Pulldown.instructions_ur:
High pulley par rope lagayein aur weight select karein. Pulley se do teen feet peeche paon aage peeche rakh kar khare hon aur dono haathon se rope pakrein. Kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se aage jhukein, baazu saamne oopar ki taraf seedhe hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue kandhe se harkat kar ke rope ko raanon tak neeche kheenchein.
Harkat ke neeche ruk jayein aur lats ko sukerein.
Weight ko stack par poori tarah rakhne diye baghair shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Round The World Shoulder Stretch.instructions_ur:
Taangein saath mila kar seedhe khare hon, bodybar ya jhaaru ka danda pakre hue.
Danda kulhon ke peeche kandhon se chauri grip mein pakrein. Hatheliyan neeche aur angoothe bahar ki taraf hon.
Aahista aahista baazu sar ke peeche upar uthayein. Agar mazeed uthana mushkil ho jaye to zabardasti na karein.

Rowing Seated, Narrow Grip.instructions_ur:
Muscles tight rakhein
Control wali harkat
Aahista harkat
Upper body seedha rakhein
Peeche na jhukein
Seene ki taraf khinchein

Rowing, Stationary.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye rower par baith jayein. Yaqeeni banayein ke aediyan aaraam se foot pedals ke base se lagi hon aur straps bandhe hon. Agar ho to jo program istemal karna chahte hain select karein. Seedhe baithein aur kulhon se aage jhukein.
Rower par harkat ke teen marhale hain. Pehla marhala tab hai jab aap rower par aage aate hain. Ghutne mure hue aur seene ke saath hon. Upper body halki si aage jhuki ho lekin posture achha rahe. Phir foot pedals ko dhakelein aur taangein seedhi karein, saath hi haathon ko pait ke oopri hisse tak layein, aur kandhon ko peeche sukerein. Kamar par zor se bachne ke liye zyada tar taangon aur kulhon ke muscles istemal karein.
Recovery marhale mein bas baazu seedhe karein, ghutne morein, aur jism ko wapas aage layein jab aap dobara pehle marhale mein jate hain.

Rowing, T-bar.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise aam bent over rowing jaisi hi hai, bas yahan bar ek jagah fixed hoti hai.
Barbell ko chauri grip (kandhon se thoda zyada chaura) se pakrein aur aage jhukein. Upar wala jism farsh ke bilkul mutawazi nahi balki halka sa zaviya banata hai. Poori exercise ke dauran seena bahar nikla rahe. Ab barbell ko tezi se naaf (belly button) ki taraf khinchein, us se upar nahi. Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas jayein. Jism ko jhulayein nahi aur baazu jism ke qareeb rakhein.

Rubber Band Glute Kickback.instructions_ur: Rubber band glute kickback haathon aur ghutnon ke bal ki jane wali exercise hai, jis mein resistance band ko paon se bandh kar eri ko peeche aur upar kick kiya jata hai, harkat ke top par glute ko sukerte hue, aur core mustahkam aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue taa ke glute muscles ko target kar ke mazboot kiya ja sake.

Runner's Stretch.instructions_ur:
Is stretch mein aana sab se aasan hai agar aap khare ho kar shuru karein, ek taang peeche rakhein, aur aahista aahista dhad ko zameen ki taraf neeche layein.
Saamne wali eri zameen par rakhein (agar woh uthe to doosri taang ko aur peeche khiska dein).
Haath saamne wali taang ke dono taraf rakhein. Is stretch ka zyada faida lene ke liye kulhe chhat ki taraf upar dhakelein, aur phir dheere dheere wapas zameen ki taraf neeche layein. Is se pichli taang ka hip flexor aur saamne wali taang ka hamstring aur kulhe stretch honge.

Runners Lunge Stretch.instructions_ur: Exercise samajhne ke liye video dekhein

Running, Treadmill.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye treadmill par chadhein aur menu se apni marzi ka option chunein. Zyada tar treadmills mein manual setting hoti hai, ya aap daurne ke liye koi program chun sakte hain. Aam taur par aap apni umar aur wazan daal kar exercise ke dauran jalne wali calories ka andaza laga sakte hain. Workout ki intensity badalne ke liye elevation adjust ki ja sakti hai.
Treadmills sahulat aur cardiovascular faide deti hain, aur aam taur par bahar daurne ke muqable mein jism par kam asar dalti hain. 150 lb ka shakhs 8 miles per hour par 30 minute daur kar 450 se zyada calories jalata hai. Daurte hue sahi posture qaim rakhein, aur handles sirf zaroorat par pakrein, jaise utarte waqt ya dil ki dharkan check karte waqt.

Russian Push Ups.instructions_ur:
Russian Push-Ups
Normal push-up position mein shuru karein, haath kandhon se thora chaure. Seena farsh ki taraf neeche layein, phir seena zameen ke qareeb rakhte hue jism ko aage sarkayein. Baazu seedhe karke shuruati position mein wapas aayein, phir harkat ko aaram se ulta karein. Poori exercise mein core tight rakhein aur harkat control mein rakhein.

Russian Twist.instructions_ur: dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Sandbag Load.instructions_ur:
Sandbags ya doosri cheezein load karne ke liye, implements ko loading platform se kuch faasle par rakh kar shuru karein, aam taur par 50 feet.
Sandbag utha kar shuru karein. Sandbags bohat bedhange hote hain, aur unhein uthane ka tareeqa istemal hone wale sandbag ke hisaab se badal sakta hai. Jitna ho sake us ke ird gird haath le jayein, kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karte hue use unchai tak kheenchein. Kandhe par rakhna aam taur par allowed nahi hota.
Jitna tez ho sake platform tak jayein, aur load karein, kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue use jitna ho sake upar le jayein. Use platform par rakhein, yaqeeni banayein ke woh gire nahi.
Agla sandbag lene ke liye shuruati position mein wapas aayein, aur event mukammal hone tak dohrayein.

Scapular Pull-Up.instructions_ur:
Pull-up bar ko overhand (pronated) grip se pakrein.
Latki hui position se, baazu istemal kiye baghair khud ko kuch inch upar uthayein. Aisa karne ke liye kandhon ko neeche dabayein, jaise ulta shrug kar rahe hon.
Harkat poori hone par rukein, aur mazeed reps karne se pehle aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Scapular Pushups.instructions_ur: Seedhe baazu wale plank mein shuru karein, haath kandhon ke neeche hon. Kohniyan lock rakhein aur sirf shoulder blades ko hilayein: seene ko thoda neeche dhansne dein, phir farsh ko door dhakel kar shoulder blades ko phailayein. Aaram deh aur control wali range mein harkat karein.

Scissor Kick.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye, farsh par ya exercise mat (agar chahein) par kamar laga kar let jayein. Baazu side par poori tarah phaile hon aur hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon. Note: Baazu poore waqt saakit rehne chahiyein.
Ghutnon mein halka sa kham rakhte hue, taangein itni uthayein ke aediyan zameen se taqreeban 6 inch upar hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Ab baayin taang ko taqreeban 45 degree ke angle tak upar uthayein jabke daayin taang ko itna neeche layein ke aedi zameen se taqreeban 2-3 inch upar ho.
Harkat badlein, daayin taang upar uthayein aur baayin taang neeche layein. Yeh exercise karte hue saans lete rehna yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Scissors Jump.instructions_ur:
Lunge stance mein aa jayein, ek paon aage aur ghutna mura hua, aur pichla ghutna taqreeban zameen ko chhoota hua.
Yaqeeni banayein ke saamne wala ghutna paon ke beech ke upar ho. Dono taangein seedhi karte hue jitna ooncha ho sake uchhlein, unchai paane ke liye baazu jhulayein.
Jitna ooncha ho sake uchhalte hue taangon ki position badal dein, saamne wali taang peeche aur pichli taang aage.
Utarte hue lunge position mein aa kar taangon se jhatka jazb karein, aur dohrayein.

Seated Ab Crunch with Cable.name_ur: Baith kar Cable ke saath Ab Crunch
Seated Ab Crunch with Cable.instructions_ur:
High cable pulley par rope lagayein.
Cable weight stack ke saamne bench rakhein.
Rope ko kandhon ke upar se pakrein aur stack ki taraf kamar kar ke baith jayein.
Paon mazbooti se farsh par rakh kar aur kulhe saakit rakhte hue kamar se jhukein aur kohniyan ghutnon ki taraf layein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Note: Yeh exercise aahista aur control ke saath karein.

Seated Back Extension Machine.instructions_ur:
Seat aur back pad ko is tarah set karein ke pad kandhe ki haddiyon (shoulder blades) ya kamar ke darmiyani hisse ki oonchai par ho.
Machine mein baith jayein, kulhe aur kamar ka nichla hissa seat aur backrest se lage hon aur paon platform par hon. Baazu seene par cross kar lein ya handles pakar lein.
Saans bahar nikaalein aur kamar ke nichle hisse ke muscles se pad ko peeche dhakelein jab tak reedh ki haddi kulhon ki seedh mein na aa jaye. Aakhri position par ek second rukein.
Saans andar lein aur weight stack ko zor se girne diye baghair aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Seated Band Hamstring Curl.instructions_ur:
Band ko zameen ke qareeb mazbooti se baandhein aur us se kuch feet door bench rakhein.
Bench par baith jayein aur band ko takhnon ke peeche lagayein, taangein seedhi rakh kar shuru karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne moorein, paon ko bench ki taraf layein. Paon ko zameen se takrane se bachane ke liye shayad thora peeche jhukna pare.
Harkat mukammal hone par rukein, aur phir aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Seated Barbell Military Press.instructions_ur:
Military Press Bench par baithein, bar sar ke peeche ho, aur ya to spotter se bar pakarwayein (is tarah rotator cuff ke liye behtar hai) ya khud ehtiyat se pronated grip (hatheliyan saamne ki taraf) se uthayein. Tip: Grip kandhon ke faasle se chauri honi chahiye aur barbell neeche aate waqt forearm aur upar wale baazu ke darmiyan 90 degree ka zaviya banna chahiye.
Sahi grip ke saath barbell uthane ke baad, baazu lock kar ke bar ko sar ke upar uthayein. Bar ko taqreeban kandhon ki oonchai par aur sar se thoda aage rokein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue bar ko aahista aahista hansli ki haddi (collarbone) tak neeche layein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko wapas shuruati position tak upar uthayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Barbell Twist.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke kinare par baith kar shuru karein, barbell raanon ke upar rakha ho. Paon ek doosre se kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Bar ko hatheliyan neeche ki taraf rakh kar pakrein aur haath kandhon se zyada chaure hon. Barbell ko sar ke upar uthana shuru karein jab tak baazu poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein.
Ab barbell ko sar ke peeche neeche layein jab tak woh gardan ke nichle hisse par na tik jaye. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Paon aur sar saakit rakhte hue kamar ko ek taraf se doosri taraf ghumayein taake obliques mein contraction mehsoos ho. Sirf utna hi ghoomein jitna kamar ijazat de. Zyada stretch ya zyada ghoomne se chot lag sakti hai. Tip: Aahista aur control wali harkat karein.
Jism ko side mein ghumate hue saans bahar nikaalna aur shuruati position mein wapas aate hue saans andar lena yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Tricep.name_ur: Baith kar Jhuk kar Ek baazu se Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Tricep.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke kinare par baith jayein, ek haath mein dumbbell neutral grip (hatheli aapki taraf) se pakri ho.
Ghutne thore modein aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se jhuk kar dhad ko aage layein jab tak woh farsh ke taqreeban parallel na ho jaye. Sar upar rakhna yaqeeni banayein.
Dumbbell wala upar ka baazu dhad ke qareeb aur us ki seedh mein ho (farsh ke parallel hone tak utha hua, jabke forearm farsh ki taraf ho aur haath wazan pakre hue ho). Tip: Forearm aur upar ke baazu ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle hona chahiye. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Upar ka baazu saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps se wazan uthayein jab tak forearm farsh ke parallel na ho jaye aur poora baazu seedha na ho jaye. Baazu ki kai doosri exercises ki tarah sirf forearm hilta hai.
Upar ek second contraction ke baad saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell ko shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur exercise dohrayein.

Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise.name_ur: Baith kar Jhuk kar Rear Delt Raise
Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke saamne do dumbbells aage ki taraf rukh kar ke rakhein.
Bench ke kinare par taangein mila kar baith jayein aur dumbbells pindliyon ke peeche hon.
Dumbbells uthane ke liye kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se aage jhukein. Uthate waqt hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad aage aur saakit rakhte hue, aur baazu kohniyon se thore mude hue, dumbbells ko seedha side par uthayein yahan tak ke dono baazu zameen ke parallel hon. Weights uthate hue saans bahar nikaalein. (Note: Dhad ko jhulane ya baazuon ko side ke bajaye peeche le jane se bachein.)
Upar ek second sukerne ke baad dumbbells ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Tricep.name_ur: Baith kar Jhuk kar Dono baazu se Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Seated Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Tricep.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke kinare par baith jayein aur dono haathon mein dumbbell neutral grip (hatheliyan aap ki taraf) se pakrein.
Ghutne thode moorein aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se aage jhuk kar dhad ko aage layein jab tak woh farsh ke taqreeban parallel na ho jaye. Sar upar rakhna zaroori hai.
Dumbbells wale baazuon ke upar wale hisse dhad ke qareeb aur us ki seedh mein hon (itne upar uthe hon ke farsh ke parallel hon, jabke weights pakre haathon ke saath forearms farsh ki taraf hon). Tip: Forearms aur baazu ke upar wale hisse ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle hona chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baazu ke upar wale hisse ko saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps se weight uthayein jab tak forearms farsh ke parallel na ho jayein aur poora baazu seedha na ho jaye. Baazuon ki bohat si doosri exercises ki tarah, sirf forearm hilta hai.
Oopar ek second sukerne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbells ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Seated Bicep Curl with Dumbbell.name_ur: Baith kar Dumbbell ke saath Bicep Curl
Seated Bicep Curl with Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Bench par baithein, paon mazbooti se farsh par aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf hon.
Dumbbells ko pehluon ki taraf neeche layein aur aahista aahista baazu upar curl karein taake hatheliyan upar ki taraf ho jayein.
Upar biceps ko daba kar sikorein aur aahista aahista shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Note: Agar mumkin ho to posture behtar rakhne ke liye chhoti back wala bench istemal karein.

Seated Biceps.instructions_ur:
Zameen par ghutne mor kar baithein aur aap ka partner aap ke peeche khara ho. Baazu seedhe peeche phaila dein, hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf. Aap ka partner aap ki kalaiyan pakrega. Yeh shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan modne ki koshish karein, jabke aap ka partner asal harkat ko rokta hai.
10-20 second baad baazu dheele chhor dein jabke partner aahista se kalaiyan upar kheench kar biceps ko stretch kare. Chot ya zaroorat se zyada stretch se bachne ke liye partner ko zaroor batayein ke stretch kab munasib hai.

Seated Cable Row.instructions_ur: Cable machine set karein, harkat control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Seated Cable Shoulder Press.instructions_ur:
Wazan munasib miqdar par set karein aur handles pakar kar baith jayein. Upar ke baazu jism se taqreeban 90 degree par hon, sar aur seena upar hon. Kohniyan bhi taqreeban 90 degree tak mudi hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan seedhi karte hue handles ko sar ke upar press karein aur aapas mein milayein.
Upar rukne ke baad handles ko wapas shuruati position mein layein. Cables par tension qaim rakhna yaqeeni banayein.
Yeh harkat kamar ko pad se hata kar aur baari baari haathon se bhi ki ja sakti hai.

Seated Cable chest fly.instructions_ur:
Do cable pulleys ke darmiyan bench rakhein aur pulleys ko is tarah adjust karein ke baithne par woh seene/kandhon ki oonchai par hon.
Handles ko neutral grip se pakren aur seedhe backrest se tek laga lein.
Seene ke muscles ko sukerne par focus karte hue baazuon ko control ke saath seene ke saamne aapas mein milayein. Poori harkat ke dauran kohniyan thori mudi rakhein.
Upar wali position mein thori der rukein.
Harkat par control barqarar rakhte hue aahista aahista baazuon ko wapas shuruati position mein le jayein.
Reps ke mutabiq dohrayein.

Seated Calf Raise.instructions_ur: Baith kar dumbbell calf raise nichli taang ke muscles ko mazboot karne ki ek khaas exercise hai. Is ki harkat machine wale version jaisi hi hai: aap weight ghutnon par rakhte hain, aur takhnon ko seedha aur mor kar weight ko hilate hain.

Seated Calf Raise using Machine.name_ur: Baith kar Machine se Calf Raise
Seated Calf Raise using Machine.instructions_ur:
Calf raise machine par baithein.
Paon ke panjon (balls) ko footpad par rakhein.
Raanon ko ghutnon ke upar leg pad ke neeche rakhein.
Bar ko unlock karein aur aahista aahista aerhiyan jitna ho sake upar uthayein.
Ek lamha ruk kar shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Note: Is exercise mein aahista aur sahi harkat ki mashq karein.

Seated Calf Stretch.instructions_ur:
Exercise mat par seedhe baith jayein.
Ek ghutna moden aur dhad ko sambhalne ke liye woh paon farsh par rakhein.
Doosri taang seedhi karein aur takhna moden.
Band, towel, ya agar haath pohanch sake to haath se, paon ki ungliyan apni taraf kheenchein. 10 se 20 seconds rokein, phir side badlein.

Seated Close-Grip Concentration Barbell.name_ur: Baith kar Tang grip Concentration Barbell Curl
Seated Close-Grip Concentration Barbell.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par baithein, barbell ya E-Z Bar aap ke saamne taangon ke darmiyan ho. Taangein khuli hon, ghutne mude hue aur paon farsh par hon.
Baazuon se barbell uthayein aur upar wale baazuon ka pichhla hissa andar wali raanon ke upar rakhein (ghutne ke agle hisse se taqreeban saarhe teen inch door). Is exercise ke liye kandhon ke faasle se tang supinated grip chahiye. Tip: Baazu poore seedhe hon aur barbell farsh se upar ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upar wale baazu saakit rakhte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur biceps ko sikorte hue weight aage curl karein. Sirf forearms hilne chahiye. Harkat jaari rakhein yahan tak ke biceps poori tarah sikur jayein aur weight kandhon ki oonchai par aa jaye. Sikri hui position mein ek second rukein aur biceps ko dabayein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista barbell ko shuruati position par wapas layein. Tip: Kisi bhi waqt jism ko jhulayein nahi.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Dumbbell Curl.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par baith jayein, har haath mein ek dumbbell baazu ki lambai par pakre hue. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb hon.
Hatheliyan ghumayein taake woh dhad ki taraf hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Upper arm saakit rakhte hue, weights ka curl karein aur jab dumbbells raanon se guzar jayein to kalaiyan ghumana shuru karein taake harkat ke aakhir mein hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon. Saans bahar nikaalte hue biceps sukerein aur yaqeeni banayein ke sirf forearms harkat karein. Harkat jaari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah sukar na jayein aur dumbbells kandhon ki satah par na hon. Biceps sukerte hue contracted position ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aur kalaiyan wapas neutral grip mein ghumate hue aahista aahista dumbbells ko shuruati position mein wapas lana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Dumbbell Inner Biceps Curl.name_ur: Baith kar Dumbbell Inner Biceps Curl
Seated Dumbbell Inner Biceps Curl.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke kinare par baithein, dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell baazu seedhe kar ke latkayein. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb hon.
Hatheliyon ko ghuma kar andar ki taraf neutral position mein layein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upar wale baazu saakit rakhte hue dumbbells ko bahar aur upar curl karein, uthate waqt hatheliyan bahar ki taraf ghumayein aur forearms ko kandhon ke bahari hisse (outer deltoids) ki seedh mein rakhein. Tips:
Sirf forearms hilne chahiye. Harkat jaari rakhein yahan tak ke biceps poori tarah sikur jayein aur dumbbells kandhon ki oonchai par aa jayein. Sikri hui position mein ek second rukein aur biceps ko dabayein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbells ko shuruati position par wapas layein. Dumbbells neeche laate waqt baazu ghumana yaad rakhein taake wapas neutral grip mein aa sakein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Dumbbell Palms-Down Wrist Curl.name_ur: Baith kar Dumbbell Hatheliyan neeche Wrist Curl
Seated Dumbbell Palms-Down Wrist Curl.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke saamne zameen par do dumbbells rakh kar shuru karein.
Flat bench ke kinare par baith jayein, taangein takreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Paon zameen par hi rakhein.
Baazuon se dono dumbbells pakrein aur upar layein taake forearms raanon par tike hon aur hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon. Kalaiyan raanon ke kinare se bahar latki honi chahiye.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kalai ko upar curl karna shuru karein.
Saans andar lete hue kalaiyon ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein. Exercise ke is hisse mein saans zaroor andar lein. Tip: Forearms saakit rahein kyunke is exercise mein sirf kalai ki harkat chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Khatam hone par dumbbells ko bas zameen par rakh dein.

Seated Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist Curl.name_ur: Baith kar Dumbbell Hatheliyan Upar Wrist Curl
Seated Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist Curl.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke saamne zameen par do dumbbells rakh kar shuru karein.
Flat bench ke kinare par baith jayein, taangein taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par. Paon zameen par rakhna yaqeeni banayein.
Dono dumbbells pakrein aur upar layein taa ke forearms raanon par tike hon aur hatheliyan upar ki taraf hon. Kalaiyan raanon ke kinare se bahar latki honi chahiyein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kalai ko upar ki taraf curl karein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista kalaiyan wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein. Is hisse mein saans andar lena yaqeeni banayein. Tip: Forearms saakit rehne chahiyein kyunke is exercise mein sirf kalai ki harkat chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Mukammal hone par dumbbells ko aaram se zameen par rakh dein.

Seated Dumbbell Press.instructions_ur:
Do dumbbells lein aur military press bench ya aisi utility bench par baith jayein jis mein kamar ka sahara ho, aur dumbbells ko raanon ke upar khara rakhein.
Raanon ki madad se dumbbells ko ek ek karke clean karke dono taraf kandhon ki unchai tak layein.
Kalaiyan ghumayein taake hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbells ko upar dhakelein yahan tak ke woh top par aapas mein chhoo jayein.
Ek second rukne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Flat Bench Leg Pull-In.name_ur: Baith kar Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
Seated Flat Bench Leg Pull-In.instructions_ur:
Bench par baith jayein, taangein saamne ki taraf parallel se thoda neeche seedhi phaili hon aur baazuon se bench ki sides pakri hon. Dhad bench se taqreeban 45 degree ke angle par peeche jhuka ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutnon ko apni taraf andar layein aur saath hi dhad ko un ke qareeb le jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Ek second ruk kar, saans andar lete hue wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch.name_ur: Baith kar Zameen par Hamstring Stretch
Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch.instructions_ur:
Mat par baith jayein, daayein taang saamne seedhi phaili ho aur baayein taang mudi hui, paon daayein andar wali raan se laga ho.
Kulhon se aage jhukein aur takhne tak pohanchein yahan tak ke hamstring mein stretch mehsoos ho. 15 second rokein, phir doosri side ke saath dohrayein.

Seated Front Deltoid.instructions_ur:
Farsh par seedhe baith jayein, taangein mudi hui, partner aapke peeche khara ho. Baazu seedhe sides par phailayein, hatheliyan zameen ki taraf. Unhein jitna ho sake peeche le jaane ki koshish karein, jabke partner aapki kalaiyan pakre. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan seedhi rakhte hue, baazuon ko aage le jaane ki koshish karein, jabke partner narmi se 10-20 seconds tak aapko rokay taake asal harkat na ho.
Ab muscles dheele chhor dein aur partner ko narmi se kandhon aur seene ka stretch barhane dein. 10 se 20 seconds rokein.

Seated Glute.instructions_ur:
Ghutne mor kar baithi hui position mein ek takhna ulte ghutne ke upar rakhein. Aap ka partner aap ke peeche khara hoga. Ab aage jhukein jabke partner haathon se aap ke kandhon ko sahara de. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
10-20 seconds tak dhad ko peeche dhakelne ki koshish karein, jabke partner dhad ki asal harkat ko rokay.
Ab muscles dheele chhor dein jabke partner 10-20 seconds tak aahista se dhad ko aage dhakel kar stretch barhaye.

Seated Good Mornings.instructions_ur:
Power rack mein ek box rakhein. Pins munasib oonchai par set hone chahiyein. Shuru mein bar ke neeche aa kar use kandhon ki pichli taraf rakhein, traps ke upar nahi. Kandhe ki haddiyon (shoulder blades) ko aapas mein sukerein aur kohniyan aage ghumayein, jaise bar ko kandhon par mod rahe hon.
Bar ko rack se uthayein, aur kamar ke nichle hisse mein tight kham banayein. Sar saamne ki taraf rakhein. Kamar, kandhe aur core tight rakhte hue, ghutne aur kulhe bahar ki taraf dhakelein aur neeche jana shuru karein. Kulhon ko peeche le ja kar baithte jayein jab tak box par na baith jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Bar ko tight rakhte hue, kulhon se jitna ho sake aage jhukein. Agar aap pins ko parallel wali oonchai par set karein, to na sirf fail hone par safety hogi, balke yeh bhi pata chalega ke kab rukna hai.
Pins se bilkul thoda upar rukein aur harkat ulti karein jab tak dhad seedha na ho jaye.

Seated Hamstring.instructions_ur:
Taangein seedhi kar ke baithi hui position mein partner ko apne peeche khara karein. Ab aage jhukein jabke partner haathon se aap ke kandhon ko sahara de. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
10-20 seconds tak dhad ko peeche dhakelne ki koshish karein, jabke partner dhad ki asal harkat ko rokay.
Ab muscles dheele chhor dein jabke partner 10-20 seconds tak aahista se dhad ko aage dhakel kar stretch barhaye.

Seated Hamstring Stretch.instructions_ur: Baghair equipment ke tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Seated Hamstring and Calf Stretch.name_ur: Baith kar Hamstring aur Calf Stretch
Seated Hamstring and Calf Stretch.instructions_ur:
Belt, rope ya band ko ek paon ke gird lapetein. Dono taangein seedhi phaila kar baith jayein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Thora aage jhukte hue belt ko kheenchein taake paon ki ungliyan peeche ki taraf aayein. Is position ko 10-20 seconds rokein aur phir doosri taang se dohrayein.

Seated Head Harness Neck Resistance.name_ur: Baith kar Head Harness Neck Resistance
Seated Head Harness Neck Resistance.instructions_ur:
Flat bench ke kinare par zameen par neck strap rakhein. Wazan chun kar, flat bench ke kinare par baith jayein, paon kandhon se zyada chaure faasle par. Paon ki ungliyan bahar ki taraf honi chahiyein.
Aahista aahista dhad ko aage le jayein yahan tak ke woh zameen ke taqreeban parallel ho. Dono haathon se neck strap ko sar ke gird mazbooti se set karein. Tip: Yaqeeni banayein ke wazan abhi bhi zameen par pare hon taa ke gardan par koi zor na pare. Ab dono haathon se wazan pakrein aur dhad ko wapas uthayein yahan tak ke woh zameen ke taqreeban seedha khara (perpendicular) ho. Note: Is exercise ke liye sar aur dhad thora aage jhuka hona chahiye.
Ab dono haath ghutnon ke upar rakhein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista gardan neeche layein yahan tak ke thodi seene ke upar wale hisse ko chhoo le.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue gardan ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Hip Adduction.instructions_ur: Shuruati position: Machine par baith jayein, ghutne andar ki taraf aur pads ke saath lage hon. Pads ko kholne ke liye pin khinchein. Sides par lage handles pakad lein.

Seated Knee Tuck.instructions_ur: Zameen ya mat par baith jayein. Baazu thora peeche rakhein. Taangein uthayein. Ab taangein seedhi karein aur wapas kheenchein.

Seated Leg Curl.instructions_ur: Leg press machine set karein, harkat control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Seated Leg Tucks.instructions_ur:
Bench par baith jayein, taangein saamne phaili hui parallel se thori neeche aur baazu bench ki sides pakre hue. Dhad bench se taqreeban 45 degree ke angle par peeche jhuka ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne apni taraf layein aur saath hi dhad ko un ke qareeb le jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Ek second ruk kar, saans andar lete hue shuruati position mein wapas jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated One Arm Triceps Extension with Du.name_ur: Baith kar Ek baazu se Dumbbell ke saath Triceps Extension
Seated One Arm Triceps Extension with Du.instructions_ur:
Bench ke kinare par baithein, paon farsh par seedhe jame hon.
Daayein haath mein dumbbell pakrein.
Daayan baazu pehlu ki taraf upar layein taake dumbbell taqreeban seene ke mutawazi ho, aur neeche wala baazu (forearm) amudi (seedha khara) rahe.
Baazu ko gol daire (arc) mein peeche dhakelein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein, dohrayein aur baazu badlein.

Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Palms-Down Wrist.name_ur: Baith kar Ek baazu se Dumbbell Hatheli neeche Wrist Curl
Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Palms-Down Wrist.instructions_ur:
Daayen haath mein dumbbell le kar flat bench par baith jayein.
Paon farsh par seedhe rakhein, kandhon ke faasle se thora zyada door.
Aage jhukein aur daayan forearm daayin raan ke upar wale hisse par rakhein, hatheli neeche ki taraf ho. Tip: Dhyan rakhein ke kalai ki pusht ghutnon ke upar ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dumbbell ko mazbooti se pakad kar jitna ho sake neeche laayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans andar lein.
Ab forearms ko sukerte hue aur saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbell ko jitna ho sake upar curl karein. Dobara neeche laane se pehle contraction ko ek second rokein. Tip: Sirf kalai harkat kare.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utne karein, baazu badlein aur harkat dohrayein.

Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist C.name_ur: Baith kar Ek baazu se Dumbbell Hatheli upar Wrist Curl
Seated One-Arm Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist C.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par baith jayein aur daayein haath mein dumbbell pakrein.
Paon farsh par hamwar rakhein, kandhon ke barabar se thode zyada faasle par.
Aage jhukein aur daayan forearm daayin raan ke upar wale hisse par rakhein, hatheli upar ho. Tip: Dhyan rakhein ke kalai ka agla hissa ghutnon ke upar ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dumbbell par mazboot grip rakhte hue use jitna ho sake neeche layein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans andar lein.
Ab forearms ko sukerte hue aur saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbell ko jitna ooncha ho sake curl karein. Dobara neeche laane se pehle ek second ke liye sukri hui position rokein. Tip: Harkat sirf kalai par honi chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa karein, baazu badlein aur harkat dohrayein.

Seated One-arm Cable Pulley Rows.name_ur: Baith kar Ek baazu se Cable Pulley Rows
Seated One-arm Cable Pulley Rows.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position mein aane ke liye pehle machine par baith jayein aur paon saamne wale platform ya crossbar par rakhein, dhyan rakhein ke ghutne thore mude hon aur lock na hon.
Kamar ki qudrati seedh barqarar rakhte hue aage jhukein aur single handle attachment ko baayen baazu se hatheli neeche wali grip se pakren.
Baazu seedha rakh kar peeche khinchein yahan tak ke dhad taangon ke saath 90 degree ka zaviya banaye. Kamar mein halka sa kham ho aur seena bahar nikla hua ho. Saamne handle pakre hue lat mein achha stretch mehsoos hona chahiye. Daayan baazu kamar ke paas rakha ja sakta hai. Yeh exercise ki shuruati position hai.
Dhad saakit rakhte hue handle ko dhad ki taraf peeche khinchein, baazu uske qareeb rakhein aur kalai ghumayein, taake jab haath pait ke paas pahunche to woh neutral position mein ho (hatheli dhad ki taraf). Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Us waqt aap kamar ke muscles ko zor se sukerein.
Contraction ko ek second rokein aur saans andar lete hue aahista aahista asal position mein wapas jayein. Tip: Shuruati position mein wapas jate hue kalai ghumana yaad rakhein taake hatheli dobara neeche ki taraf ho jaye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein aur phir yehi harkat daayen haath se karein.

Seated Overhead Stretch.instructions_ur:
Exercise mat par seedhe baith jayein.
Paon ke talwe aapas mein milayein, paon kulhon se chhe se aath inch aage hon.
Ek haath bagal mein farsh par rakhein aur doosra haath sar ke peeche rakhein.
Kohni ko chhat ki taraf uthayein aur dhad ko doosri taraf jhukayein. 10 se 20 seconds rokein, phir side badlein.

Seated Overhead Triceps Extension with B.name_ur: Baith kar Barbell ke saath Overhead Triceps Extension
Seated Overhead Triceps Extension with B.instructions_ur:
Chhoti seedhi back wali kursi par baithein, paon mazbooti se farsh par aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
EZ ya Curl bar, ya barbell ko taqreeban 6 inch ke faasle wali grip se pakrein.
Bar ko baazu seedhe kar ke sar ke upar uthayein aur phir gol daire (arc) mein sar ke peeche farsh ki taraf neeche layein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Seated Palm-Up Barbell Wrist Curl.name_ur: Baith kar Hatheli upar Barbell Wrist Curl
Seated Palm-Up Barbell Wrist Curl.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko dono haathon se pakrein, hatheliyan upar ki taraf; haath taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par.
Paon zameen par seedhe rakhein, kandhon ke faasle se thora zyada door.
Aage jhukein aur forearms raanon ke upar rakhein, hatheliyan upar. Tip: Yaqeeni banayein ke kalaiyon ka agla hissa ghutnon ke upar ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue aur grip mazboot rakhte hue bar ko jitna ho sake neeche layein.
Ab forearms sukerte hue aur saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko jitna ho sake upar curl karein. Upar ek second sukerna rokein aur Tip: Sirf kalai harkat kare.

Seated Palms-Down Barbell Wrist Curl.name_ur: Baith kar Hatheliyan Neeche Barbell Wrist Curl
Seated Palms-Down Barbell Wrist Curl.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko dono haathon se hatheliyan neeche ki taraf rakh kar pakrein; haathon ka faasla taqreeban kandhon ke barabar ho.
Paon farsh par seedhe rakhein, kandhon se thore zyada chaure faasle par.
Aage jhukein aur forearms ko hatheliyan neeche rakhte hue raanon ke upar wale hisse par rakhein. Tip: Yaqeeni banayein ke kalaiyon ki pichhli taraf ghutnon ke upar ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue aur grip mazboot rakhte hue bar ko jitna ho sake neeche layein.
Ab forearms ko sukerte aur saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko jitna ho sake upar curl karein. Upar contraction ko ek second rokein. Tip: Sirf kalai hilni chahiye.

Seated Rear Delt Rise.instructions_ur: Baith kar, 45 degree aage jhuk kar. Baazu poori tarah seedhe, baazuon ko kandhon ki unchai tak upar uthayein aur wapas neeche layein

Seated Rear Lateral Cable Raise.name_ur: Baith kar Rear Side Cable Raise
Seated Rear Lateral Cable Raise.instructions_ur:
Bench ke kinare par baithein, paon saamne farsh par hon.
Kamar seedhi rakh kar seena raanon par tikayein, aur cable pulleys ko ulte haathon se pakrein (daayan haath baayein cable ko, baayan haath daayein cable ko).
Upar wale baazuon ko kandhon ki oonchai tak uthayein. Upar ek lamha rukein.
Baazuon ko control ke saath shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Dohrayein.

Seated Row (Machine).instructions_ur:
Seena upar rakhein aur aakhir mein shoulder blades ko sukerein.
Pull ke dauran aage na jhukein aur kamar gol na karein.

Seated Side Lateral Raise.instructions_ur:
Do dumbbells uthayein aur flat bench ke kinare par baith jayein, paon farsh par mazbooti se jame hon. Dumbbells ko hatheliyan andar ki taraf rakh kar pakrein aur baazu side mein seedhe neeche latke hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad saakit rakhte hue (koi jhoolna nahi), kohni mein halke mor ke saath dumbbells ko side mein uthayein aur haath thore aage jhuke hon jaise glass mein paani daal rahe hon. Upar jate rahein jab tak baazu farsh ke parallel na ho jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur upar ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue dumbbells ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Triceps Press.instructions_ur:
Chhote, seedhi back wale bench par baithein, paon mazbooti se farsh par jame hon.
Pet andar khinch kar dumbbell ko dono haathon se hatheliyan upar wali grip se pakrein.
Weight ko sar ke upar uthayein, yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Dumbbell ko sar ke upar se gol daire (arc) mein kamar ke peeche neeche layein.
Aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist.name_ur: Baith kar Dono baazu se Hatheliyan oopar Low-Pulley Wrist Curl
Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist.instructions_ur:
Low pulley machine ke saamne bench rakhein jis par barbell ya EZ Curl attachment laga ho.
Bench ko itna door rakhein ke jab handle ko raanon ke oopar layein to weight stack oopar uthne ki wajah se cable par tension ban jaye.
Ab handle ko dono haathon se, hatheliyan oopar, kandhon ke barabar grip se pakrein.
Peeche hat kar bench par baith jayein, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par mazbooti se farsh par hon.
Aage jhukein aur forearms raanon par rakhein, kalaiyon ki pusht ghutnon ke oopar ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue aur grip mazboot rakhte hue bar ko jitna ho sake neeche layein.
Ab forearms ko sukerte hue bar ko jitna ho sake oopar curl karein. Tip: Sirf kalai hilni chahiye; forearms nahi.
Oopar ek second contraction ke baad saans andar lete hue shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Seated Two-Arm Triceps Extension with Du.name_ur: Baith kar Dono baazuon se Dumbbell ke saath Triceps Extension
Seated Two-Arm Triceps Extension with Du.instructions_ur:
Bench ke kinare par baithein, paon farsh par seedhe jame hon.
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein.
Baazu pehluon ki taraf upar layein taake dumbbell taqreeban seene ke mutawazi ho, aur neeche wala baazu (forearm) amudi (seedha khara) rahe.
Baazu ko gol daire (arc) mein kamar ki taraf peeche dhakelein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein, dohrayein aur baazu badlein.

Seated W Curl.instructions_ur:
60 degree incline wale bench par baith jayein
Dumbbells ko jism ke saath zameen ke qareeb pakrein, hatheliyan bahar ki taraf, baazu poore seedhe
Sirf biceps istemal karte hue aur momentum ke baghair dumbbells upar layein

See-Saw Press (Alternating Side Press).instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein aur seedhe khare ho jayein.
Dumbbells ko seene/kandhon ki oonchai tak clean karein (uthayein) aur phir kalaiyan ghumayein taake hatheliyan aap ki taraf hon, jaise Arnold Press ki tayyari kar rahe hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab baayan baazu sar ke upar seedha karna shuru karein aur upar jaate hue kalai ghumayein taake hatheli saamne ki taraf ho jaye. Weight uthate hue kohniyan bhi bahar ki taraf aani chahiyein. Saath hi, aap kulhe se ulti side ki taraf jhukenge. Tip: Agar exercise sahi kar rahe hain, to aisa lagega jaise aap baayein baazu se jism ki daayin side par sar ke upar kisi cheez tak pahunchne ki koshish kar rahe hain. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Oopar wali position par pahunch kar saans andar lein. Phir, weight sar ke upar poori tarah seedha ho aur aap daayin side par jhuke hon, to baayin side ki harkat shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Shotgun Row.instructions_ur:
Neeche wali cable par single handle lagayein.
Sahi weight chunne ke baad, chaure split stance ke saath kuch feet peeche khare hon. Baazu seedha aur kandha aage ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kandha peeche kheench kar aur kohni mor kar harkat karein. Kheenchte hue kalai ko ghumayein (supinate), hatheli ko upar ki taraf mor dein.
Thora ruk kar, shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Shoulder Circles.instructions_ur:
Kandhe dheele aur baazu aaram se side mein latke hue (ya agar baithe hain to god mein) rakh kar, kandhon ko narmi se aage, upar, peeche aur neeche ghumayein.
Simt ulti karein. Yeh exercise baari baari ek ek kandhe se ya dono se ek saath kar sakte hain.

Shoulder Press - With Bands.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye, exercise band par is tarah khare hon ke tension baazu ki lambai par shuru ho. Handles pakrein aur unhein uthayein taa ke haath dono taraf kandhon ki unchai par hon.
Kalaiyan ghumayein taa ke hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon. Kohniyan mudi hon, aur upper arms aur forearms dhad ki seedh mein hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, handles ko upar uthayein jab tak baazu sar ke upar poore seedhe na ho jayein.

Shoulder Raise.instructions_ur: Baazu dheele chhor kar pehluon mein rakhein aur kandhe kaanon ki taraf upar uthayein, phir wapas neeche layein.

Shoulder Shrug.instructions_ur: Shoulder shrug (jise aam taur par sirf shrug kaha jata hai) weight training ki exercise hai jo trapezius muscle ke upar wale hisse ko mazboot karne ke liye ki jaati hai. Seedhe khare ho jayein, haath taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein, kandhon ko jitna ho sake upar uthayein aur phir neeche layein, is dauran kohniyan na modein aur jism ko bilkul na hilayein. Ho sakta hai harkat ki range utni bari na ho jitni lachak (flexibility) ke liye kiye jaane wale aam shrug mein hoti hai. Aam taur par sahi form tab maani jaati hai jab upar wali position mein kandhon ki dhalaan ufqi (horizontal) ho.

Shoulder Stretch.instructions_ur: Left baazu ko jism ke aar paar le jayein aur use seedha pakar kar rakhein.

Shrugs on Multipress.instructions_ur: Control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Side Bridge.instructions_ur: Control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Side Crunch.instructions_ur: Ek haath mein weight pakrein. Side mein ghutne ki taraf jhukein. Obliques (pet ke side muscles) ke zor se wapas seedhe khare ho jayein.

Side Hop-Sprint.instructions_ur:
Cone ya hurdle ke side mein khare hon.
Rukawat ke upar se side mein hop kar ke yeh drill shuru karein, aur utarte hi uchhal kar wapas wahan hop karein jahan se shuru kiya tha.
Tay shuda reps tak jitni tezi se ho sake hop karein, aur aakhri hop par utarte hi thori doori tak sprint kar ke drill khatam karein.

Side Jackknife.instructions_ur: Control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Side Lateral Raise.instructions_ur:
Do dumbbells uthayein aur dhad seedha rakh kar khare ho jayein, dumbbells baazu seedhe karke side mein hon aur hatheliyan aap ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad saakit rakhte hue (jhoole baghair), kohni mein halka sa kham rakh kar aur haath thore aage jhuka kar, jaise glass mein paani daal rahe hon, dumbbells ko side mein uthayein. Tab tak upar le jayein jab tak baazu farsh ke mutawazi na ho jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur upar ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue dumbbells ko aahista aahista shuruati position tak neeche laayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Side Laterals to Front Raise.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar dumbbells ka joda apni side par pakdein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohniyan thodi mudi rakhte hue, wazan ko seedha apne saamne kandhon ki unchai tak uthayein, jhoolne ya cheating se bachein.
Exercise ke top par wazan ko saamne se bahar ki taraf le jayein, baazu seedhe rakhein.
Control ke saath wazan neeche layein.
Agle rep par wazan ko saamne kandhon ki unchai tak uthayein aur phir side ki taraf le jayein.
Wazan ko shuruati position mein neeche layein.

Side Leg Raises.instructions_ur:
Kursi ke paas khare ho jayein, jise aap sahare ke liye pakar sakte hain. Ek taang par khare hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taang ko seedha rakhte hue use jitna ho sake side ki taraf bahar uthayein, aur wapas neeche swing karein, use doosri taang ke aage se cross hone dein.
Yeh swing wali harkat 5-10 dafa dohrayein, sath sath range of motion barhate jayein.

Side Lying Groin Stretch.name_ur: Side par Let kar Groin Stretch
Side Lying Groin Stretch.instructions_ur:
Daayein side par let kar shuru karein aur dhad ko sambhalne ke liye daayan ghutna apne saamne mod lein.
Sar ko daayein haath ya kandhe par tikayein. Baayein taang upar uthayein aur use ghutne ke peeche se (aasaan) ya paon se (mushkil) pakrein.
Baayein ghutne ko baayein kandhe ki taraf kheenchein aur saath hi paon ya ghutne ko farsh ki taraf dabayein. Stretch ko barhane ke liye baayein taang seedhi karein. Side badlein.

Side Neck Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kandhe dheele rakh kar shuru karein, aur narmi se sar ko kandhe ki taraf jhukayein.
Sar ki side par halka sa kheench kar stretch mein madad karein.

Side Plank.instructions_ur: Apne jism ke wazan (bodyweight) ke saath position banayein, harkat control ke saath karein, aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Side Squats with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Barbell kandhon par rakhein aur chauri grip se pakrein.
Paon kaafi khol kar khare hon, jis taang ki taraf jhukenge us paon ka rukh bahar ki taraf ho.
Aage wali taang ka kulha aur ghutna mod kar jism ka nichla hissa us paon ki taraf layein, aur doosri taang ko kaafi had tak seedha rakhein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein aur taang badlein.

Side Standing Long Jump.instructions_ur:
Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar athletic stance mein khare ho kar shuru karein. Sar aur seena upar, ghutne aur kulhe halke se mude hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Right taraf jhukte hue, kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karke hawa mein jump karein. Harkat ki rehnumai baazuon se karein, jitna ho sake right taraf door jump karein.
Usi simt munh karke land karein, paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par, impact ko lower body se jazb karein.

Side Stretch.instructions_ur: Exercise samajhne ke liye video dekhein

Side To Side Chins.instructions_ur:
Pull-up bar ko chauri grip se pakrein, hatheliyan saamne ki taraf.
Dono baazu saamne phaile hue aur bar chauri grip se pakre hue, dhad ko taqreeban 30 degree peeche le jayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein kham banate hue aur seena bahar nikaalte hue. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baayein taraf jhukte hue dhad ko upar kheenchein yahan tak ke bar taqreeban seene ke upar wale hisse ko chhoo le, kandhon aur upper arms ko neeche aur peeche laate hue. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Poori tarah sukerne wali position par pohanch kar kamar ke muscles ko sukerne par dhyan dein. Upper dhad hawa mein harkat karte hue saakit rehna chahiye (koi jhulna nahi) aur sirf baazu hilne chahiyein. Forearms ka kaam sirf bar pakarna hai, aur kuch nahi.
Ek second sukerne ke baad saans andar lete hue shuruati position mein wapas jayein.
Ab daayein taraf jhukte hue dhad ko upar kheenchein yahan tak ke bar taqreeban seene ke upar wale hisse ko chhoo le, kandhon aur upper arms ko neeche aur peeche laate hue. Is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Poori tarah sukerne wali position par pohanch kar kamar ke muscles ko sukerne par dhyan dein. Upper dhad hawa mein harkat karte hue saakit rehna chahiye aur sirf baazu hilne chahiyein. Forearms ka kaam sirf bar pakarna hai, aur kuch nahi.
Ek second sukerne ke baad saans andar lete hue shuruati position mein wapas jayein.
Steps 3-6 dohrayein yahan tak ke har side ke tay kiye hue reps mukammal ho jayein.

Side Wrist Pull.instructions_ur:
Yeh stretch khare ho kar behtar hota hai. Baayein baazu ko jism ki darmiyani line ke aar paar le jayein aur baayein kalai ko daayein haath se kulhon ki unchai par pakrein. Stretch mude hue baayein baazu se shuru karein.
Aahista aahista baazu seedha karein, kheenchein aur kandhon ki unchai tak uthayein, jaisa tasveer mein hai. Yeh stretch kamar mein mehsoos hona chahiye, kandhon mein nahi, aur kandhe ke joint par zyada zor se na kheenchein. Side badlein.

Side to Side Box Shuffle.instructions_ur:
Box ki ek taraf khare hon aur baayan paon box ke beech mein tika ho.
Shuru karne ke liye box ke upar se doosri taraf jump karein, daayan paon box ke upar aur baayan paon farsh par utrein. Harkat mein madad ke liye baazu jhulayein.
Box ke aar paar aage peeche shuffle karte rahein.

Side-Lying Floor Stretch.instructions_ur:
Pehle baayin karwat let jayein, aur dhad ko mustahkam rakhne ke liye baayan ghutna apne saamne mod lein (seedha rehne ke liye abs ke muscles bhi istemal karein).
Daayin taang seedhi karein aur daayan paon baayein paon ke peeche farsh par rakhein. Daayan baazu sar ke upar seedha karein aur daayin kalai ko narmi se kheench kar jism ki poori daayin side ko stretch karein. Side badal lein.

Side-laying Interior Rotation.name_ur: Side par let kar Interior Rotation
Side-laying Interior Rotation.instructions_ur: Side par let kar, bench ke qareeb wala baazu istemal karte hue kohni par 90 degree ka mor barqarar rakhein aur weight ko bench se aage zameen ki taraf jitna aaraam se ho sake neeche girne dein. Sirf kandhe ki rotation se weight ko mukhalif kandhe ki taraf oopar layein.

Single Arm Plank to Row.name_ur: Ek baazu se Plank to Row
Single Arm Plank to Row.instructions_ur: Row ki position se shuru karein, plank tak seedhe hon aur wapas aayein. Row par khatam karein aur dohrayein

Single Arm Pronated Triceps Extension wi.name_ur: Ek baazu se Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Single Arm Pronated Triceps Extension wi.instructions_ur:
Yeh ek advanced exercise hai jo triceps (baazu ke pichhle hisse) ke muscles ko alag kar ke kaam karti hai.
Bench par seedhe letein, sar ek kinare par ho aur paon mazbooti se farsh par jame hon.
Ek haath mein dumbbell pakar kar seene ke upar uthayein, hatheli paon ki taraf ho.
Khaali haath ko kandhe ke neeche rakh kar doosre baazu ko sahara dein.
Sirf forearm aur kohni ko seene ki taraf aur seene se door hilate hue aahista aahista weight neeche layein.
Doosre baazu se dohrayein.
Note: Harkat ki aadat daalne ke liye yeh exercise halke weight se practice karein.

Single Arm Row.instructions_ur: Zameen par baith kar, high cable ko ek haath ki grip se istemal karte hue lat pulldowns karein, lats mein lambe stretch par focus ke saath.

Single Arm Supinated Triceps Extension w.name_ur: Ek baazu se Supinated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Single Arm Supinated Triceps Extension w.instructions_ur:
Bench par seedhe letein, sar ek kinare par ho aur paon mazbooti se farsh par jame hon.
Ek haath mein dumbbell pakar kar seene ke upar uthayein, hatheli farsh ki taraf ho.
Khaali haath ko kandhe ke neeche rakh kar doosre baazu ko sahara dein. Sirf forearm aur kohni hilate hue aahista aahista kohni ko mod kar weight sar ke upar ki taraf layein.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein aur doosre baazu se dohrayein.
Note: Harkat ki aadat daalne ke liye yeh exercise halke weight se practice karein.

Single Dumbbell Raise.instructions_ur:
Chauri stance mein ek dumbbell ko dono haathon se pakren, handle ke bajaye dumbbell ka sira pakren. Baazu seedhe aur kamar ki oonchai par latke hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue weight ko kandhon ki oonchai se upar tak uthayein. Poori harkat ke dauran dhad aur kulhe saakit rehne chahiyein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Single Leg Butt Kick.instructions_ur:
Ek taang par khare ho kar shuru karein, mura hua ghutna upar utha ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Countermovement jump istemal karte hue, zameen wali taang ka kulha, ghutna aur takhna seedha kar ke upar uchhlein.
Foran ghutna modein aur jump wali taang ki eri se apne kulhe ko chhoone ki koshish karein.
Taang ko kulhon ke neeche aadhi mudi position mein wapas layein aur utrein. Poori drill ke dauran doosri taang taqreeban usi position mein rehni chahiye.

Single Leg Glute Bridge.instructions_ur:
Farsh par let jayein, paon seedhe farsh par aur ghutne mude hon.
Ek taang zameen se uthayein, ghutne ko seene ki taraf khinchein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Aedhi se zor laga kar harkat karein, kulhe ko upar ki taraf seedha karein aur glutes ko zameen se uthayein.
Jitna ho sake upar jayein, rukein aur phir wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Single Leg Push-off.instructions_ur:
Zameen par khare hon aur ek paon box par rakhein, eri kinare ke qareeb.
Box ke upar wale paon se push off karein, kulha aur ghutna seedha kar ke jitni unchai ho sake hasil karne ki koshish karein.
Usi paon ke saath box ke upar utrein, aur doosra paon wapas shuruati position mein le aayein.

Single Leg Squat with Barbell.name_ur: Ek taang par Barbell ke saath Squat
Single Leg Squat with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Yeh ek advanced exercise hai aur basic squat ki badli hui shakal hai. Yeh exercise karne se pehle squat mein maharat hasil kar lena behtar hai.
Barbell ko kamar ke upar, kandhon par chauri grip ke saath rakhein.
Ek taang ka nichla hissa sahara dene wali taang (jis taang se squat karenge) ke ghutne ke upar cross kar ke rakhein.
Jitna neeche ja sakein squat karein.
Kulha aur ghutna seedha karte hue aahista aahista seedhi position mein wapas aayein.
Taang badlein aur dohrayein.

Single-Arm Cable Crossover.instructions_ur:
Pulleys ko unchi position par le ja kar shuru karein, resistance chunein aur har haath mein ek handle pakrein.
Dono pulleys ke saamne aage qadam lein, baazu saamne phaile hon aur haath aapas mein mile hon. Aage jhukte hue sar aur seena upar hon, aur paon aage peeche (staggered) hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Baayan baazu apni jagah rakhte hue daayein baazu ko side mein phailne dein, kohni mein halka mor qaim rakhein. Daayan baazu taqreeban kandhon ki unchai par jism ke perpendicular hona chahiye.
Haath ko jism ki darmiyani line ki taraf wapas kheench kar baazu ko shuruati position mein layein.
Shuruati position par ek second rokein aur doosri taraf harkat dohrayein. Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa baari baari karte rahein.

Single-Arm Linear Jammer.instructions_ur:
Bar ko landmine mein lagayein ya kisi kone mein mazbooti se tika dein. Bar par munasib weight load karein.
Bar ko zameen se uthayein aur ek ya dono haathon se kandhon tak le aayein. Chauri stance apnayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni seedhi kar ke weight ko upar press karte hue harkat karein. Dhamakedaar tareeqe se harkat karein, aur zyada se zyada taaqat ke liye kulhe aur ghutne poore seedhe karein.
Wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Single-Arm Push-Up.instructions_ur:
Zameen par ulte let kar shuru karein. Aisi position mein aayein jahan wazan paon ki ungliyon aur ek baazu par ho. Kaam karne wala baazu kandhe ke bilkul neeche, poori tarah seedha ho. Taangein seedhi hon, aur is harkat ke liye shayad aap ko zyada chauri bunyad chahiye ho, yani paon aam push-up se zyada door rakhein.
Achha posture barqarar rakhein, aur khali haath kamar ke peeche rakh lein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni ko mudne de kar khud ko neeche laayein yahan tak ke zameen ko chhoo lein.
Aahista aahista neeche jayein, aur baazu seedha karke simt ulti karte hue shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Single-Cone Sprint Drill.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill paon ki tez harkat sikhati hai. Aap ko sirf ek cone chahiye. Cone ke paas khare ho kar shuru karein, ek baazu peeche aur ek baazu aage ho.
Paon jitna tez ho sake chalayein, baazuon se blocking karein. Cone ke gird chakkar lagayein, ghutne upar rakhein, aur paon ki harkat bohat tez ho.
Cone ke gird teen chakkar lagane ke baad aaram karein.

Single-Leg Calf Raise.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Single-Leg Deadlift with Dumbbell.name_ur: Dumbbell ke saath Ek taang par Deadlift
Single-Leg Deadlift with Dumbbell.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position: Ghutnon mein halka kham rakh kar seedhe khare hon, ek ya dono haathon mein dumbbell pakre hue. Wazan sahara dene wali taang (maslan daayein taang) par daalein aur doosra paon zameen se thora upar uthayein.
Hinge: Kamar seedhi aur core engaged rakhte hue, kulhon se hinge karein, glutes ko peeche dhakelte hue. Jaise jaise dhad neeche aaye, tawazun ke liye doosri taang ko seedha peeche phailayein, kulhe zameen ke seedh mein barabar rakhte hue. Dumbbell(s) sahara dene wali taang ki seedh mein zameen ki taraf neeche aane chahiyein.
Range of Motion: Dhad ko neeche laate rahein yahan tak ke woh zameen ke taqreeban parallel ho, ya sahara dene wali taang ke hamstring mein shadeed stretch mehsoos ho, aur poori harkat ke dauran kamar neutral rakhna yaqeeni banayein.
Wapas aana: Neeche rukein, phir glutes aur hamstrings ko sukerte hue aahista aahista dhad ko wapas shuruati position tak uthayein. Doosri taang sahara dene wali taang ki seedh mein wapas aani chahiye.
Side badalna: Ek side par jitne reps chahiye mukammal karne ke baad, wazan badlein aur doosri taang par harkat dohrayein.

Single-Leg High Box Squat.name_ur: Ek taang par High Box Squat
Single-Leg High Box Squat.instructions_ur:
Rack mein box rakhein. Box ke upar band ya rope mazbooti se baandh dein.
Us ke saamne khare ho kar, box par qadam rakh kar poori tarah khare ho jayein, doosri taang ko baghair sahare ke rehne dein. Balance ke liye band pakar lein
. Doosri side par jaane se pehle usi taang se upar neeche qadam lete rahein.

Single-Leg Hop Progression.instructions_ur:
Apne saamne cones ki ek line lagayein. Aaram se ek taang par balance kar ke khare hon. Doosri taang ka ghutna uthayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Aage hop karein, usi taang se cone ke upar se kood kar utrein.
Countermovement jump se ek cone se doosre cone tak hop karein.
Aakhir mein mur jayein aur doosri taang par wapas jayein.

Single-Leg Lateral Hop.instructions_ur:
Cone ya hurdle ki ek taraf khare hon. Shuruati position mein aane ke liye ek taang par khare hon, ghutna thora sa mura hua.
Shuru karne ke liye counterjump kar ke cone ke upar se side ki taraf hop karein.
Jump wali taang par utrein, aur foran usi se wapas shuruati position ki taraf uchhal jayein.
Aage peeche hop karte rahein.

Single-Leg Leg Extension.instructions_ur:
Machine mein baith jayein aur use aise adjust karein ke aap sahi position mein hon. Pad pindli ke nichle hisse par ho lekin takhne ko na chhoo raha ho. Seat aise adjust karein ke pivot point ghutne ki seedh mein ho. Apni salahiyat ke mutabiq weight chunein.
Achha posture barqarar rakhte hue, ek taang poori seedhi karein, harkat ke top par rukein.
Weight ko rukne diye baghair shuruati position mein wapas aayein, muscle par tension barqarar rakhein.
Jitne reps chahiye utni dafa dohrayein.

Single-Leg Lunge with Kettlebell:.name_ur: Kettlebell ke saath Ek taang par Lunge
Single-Leg Lunge with Kettlebell:.instructions_ur:
Ek taang par kettlebell lunge kaise karein
Tayyari: Paon mila kar khare ho jayein. Kettlebell ko handle se dono haathon se pakar kar seene ke qareeb rakhein, ya ek haath se pakrein (kaam karne wali taang ki taraf wale haath se).
Qadam aur neeche: Ek taang se bara qadam aage lein (ya peeche, jo ghutnon ke liye zyada mehfooz hai), kulhe neeche layein yahan tak ke dono ghutne 90 degree ka angle bana lein.
Dhyan: Wazan agli (ya mudi hui) taang par daalein, kamar seedhi aur dhad seedha rakhein.
Wapsi: Agli taang se dhakel kar shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Single-Leg Soft-Landing Holds.instructions_ur:
Ek taang par Soft-Landing Holds
Ek taang par soft-landing holds aisi exercises hain jo ek taang par naram andaz mein utar kar position rokne ke zariye balance aur stability par focus karti hain. Yeh exercise proprioception behtar karti hai aur rehabilitation aur athletic training ke liye faidemand ho sakti hai.
Overview
Ek taang par soft-landing holds balance, stability aur proprioception barhane ke liye banayi gayi exercises hain. Inmein ek taang par naram andaz mein utar kar thori dair us position ko qaim rakha jata hai. Yeh exercise khaas taur par rehabilitation mein aur un athletes ke liye mufeed hai jo apni performance behtar karna chahte hain.
Faide
Balance behtar karti hai: Jism ko ek taang par wazan ki taqseem control karna sikha kar stability barhati hai.
Proprioception barhati hai: Jism ki position ka ehsaas barhati hai, jo chot se bachne ke liye bohat zaroori hai.
Rehabilitation mein madad: Muscles mazboot kar ke aur joints ki stability behtar kar ke nichle jism ki choton se recover karne mein madad karti hai.
Ek taang par Soft-Landing Holds kaise karein
Steps
Tayyari: Mazboot satah ya box par khare hon.
Takeoff: Ek taang ke saath box ya satah se qadam utaarein, yaqeeni banayein ke aap jump na karein.
Landing: Target taang par naram andaz mein utrein, ghutne aur kulhe ko thora mudne dein.
Position rokein: Utarne wali position mein 2 seconds tak balance qaim rakhein.
Reset: Shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur dohrayein.
Yaad rakhne wali ahem baatein
Behtar stability ke liye seena upar rakhein aur core engage karein.
Landing ke dauran yaqeeni banayein ke ghutna paon ki darmiyani line ki seedh mein ho.
Impact kam karne ke liye control ke saath neeche aane par dhyan dein.
Nateeja
Ek taang par soft-landing holds ko apni training routine mein shamil karne se balance aur stability kaafi behtar ho sakti hai, jis se yeh rehabilitation aur athletic performance dono ke liye qeemti exercise hai.

Single-Leg Stride Jump.instructions_ur:
Box ki ek taraf khare hon, andar wala paon box ke upar kinare ke qareeb rakhein.
Baazu upar jhulate hue upar wali taang se zor lagayein aur jitna ooncha ho sake uchhlein. Doosre ghutne ko upar le jaane ki koshish karein.
Usi position mein utrein jis mein shuru kiya tha, andar wali taang se jhatka kam karte hue.

Single-arm Dumbbell Shoulder Press.name_ur: Ek baazu se Dumbbell Shoulder Press
Single-arm Dumbbell Shoulder Press.instructions_ur: Dumbbell ko control ke saath seedha sar ke upar press karein yahan tak ke baazu poori tarah seedha ho jaye, kohni lock kiye baghair. Dumbbell ko aahista aahista wapas kandhe ki unchai par shuruati position mein layein.

Single-arm Preacher Curl.instructions_ur: Preacher curl bench par baith jayein aur ek haath mein dumbbell le kar bicep curl karein. Doosra haath aaraam se rakh sakte hain, ya curl karne wale baazu ki kohni ke neeche rakh sakte hain.

Single-leg Side Glute Press.name_ur: Ek taang par Side Glute Press
Single-leg Side Glute Press.instructions_ur:
