Ek taang par Side Glute Press leg press machine ka ek variation hai jis mein aap pad par jism ko side ki taraf angle karte hain, ek paon upar aur halka sa angle par rakh kar weight press karte hain, jo bahar wale glute (gluteus medius/minimus) aur hamstrings ko zabardast tareeqe se target karta hai taake taangon ki mutawazin nashonuma aur stability ho, aur is mein aedi se dhakelne aur lockout kiye baghair control barqarar rakhne par focus zaroori hai.
Kaise karein:
Setup: Leg press machine mein baithein, jism ko ek kulhe ki taraf ghumayein, ek paon platform par upar taqreeban 45 degree ke angle par rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar/aage ki taraf hon.
Position: Kulha, ghutna aur takhna ek seedh mein rakhein, aur yaqeeni banayein ke kamar ka nichla hissa pad par rahe.
Neeche aana: Aahista aahista weight neeche layein, ghutne ko gehrai tak mudne dein (90 degree ke qareeb), glute aur hamstring mein stretch mehsoos karein.
Press: Aedi se (ungliyon se nahi) zor laga kar weight wapas upar press karein, glutes aur hamstrings sukerte hue, taang poori seedhi hone se zara pehle ruk jayein.
Control: Uchhalne se bachein aur kamar ke nichle hisse ko pad se uthne na dein; poori harkat mein tension barqarar rakhein.

Sissy Squat.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Sit Squats.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne aur kulhe mod kar, kulhon ko peeche le jaate hue baithne ki tarah harkat shuru karein.
Kuch hissa neeche squat karne tak jaari rakhein, lekin parallel se upar rahein, aur tezi se harkat ulti karke shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. 5-10 reps dohrayein.

Sit Up Elbow Thrust.instructions_ur:
Yeh
upar se neeche ki taraf rotation wali harkat hai, aur yeh thori zyada
dhamakedaar bhi hai.
Ghutne mude aur paon zameen par rakh kar let jayein, upar baithein aur phir baayein kohni ko poore jism ke aar paar daayein taraf dhakelein, phir wapas
beech mein aayein aur aakhir mein khud ko neeche le jayein. Phir doosri taraf karein.

Sit-Up.instructions_ur:
Zameen par let jayein aur paon ya to kisi aisi cheez ke neeche phansayein jo hile nahin ya partner se pakarwayein. Taangein ghutnon se mudi hon.
Haath sar ke peeche rakhein aur ungliyan aapas mein phansa kar lock karein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Upper body ko itna uthayein ke woh raanon ke saath ek khayali V shakal banaye. Exercise ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Ek second sukerna mehsoos karne ke baad, saans andar lete hue upper body ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Sitting Calf Raises.instructions_ur: Calf raises ke liye bench par baithein aur check karein ke paon aadhe khule hon aur aap pindliyon ke muscles ko poori tarah neeche stretch kar sakein. Pindliyon ko upar kheenchein, jitna upar ja sakein. Sab se unche point par 1 ya 2 seconds ka chhota sa waqfa karein aur neeche aayein.

Sitting Calf Stretch (Dorsiflexion).instructions_ur: Yeh pindli ke liye halka stretch hai jo rehab ke liye bohat achha hai.

Skating.instructions_ur:
Roller skating ek mazedaar activity hai jo dil aur saans ki fitness aur muscles ki bardasht behtar karne mein mufeed ho sakti hai. Is ke liye kaafi achha tawazun aur coordination chahiye. Skating ki buniyadi baatein, jaise murna aur rukna, seekhna aur mumkina chot se bachne ke liye hifazati saaman pehenna zaroori hai.
Aap 30 minute musalsal aaram de raftaar se skate kar sakte hain. Agar cardio ka challenge chahiye to interval skating karein - har paanch minute mein se do minute tez skate karein, aur baqi teen minute recover karne ke liye istemal karein. 150 lb ka shakhs aaram de raftaar par 30 minute skating mein aam tor par taqreeban 175 calories jalata hai, jo tez chalne ke barabar hai.

Skull Crusher.instructions_ur: barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Skullcrusher Dumbbells.instructions_ur:
Dumbbells pakar kar flat bench par is tarah let jayein ke sar ka taqreeban 1/4 hissa kinare se bahar ho. Baazu seedhe upar phailayein aur phir dumbbells ko paon ki taraf se door 10-20 degree ke angle par jhukayein. Poori exercise mein upper arm ko isi angle par rakhein. Dumbbell ka rukh aap ke sar ki taraf nahi, balke sar ke upar se door hona chahiye. Is se exercise ka zyada se zyada faida hoga aur triceps par har waqt wazan rahega.
Kohniyon aur baazuon par dhyan dein: sirf triceps kaam kar rahe hon, baqi baazu nahi hilne chahiyein.

Sled Drag - Harness.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye sled par apni marzi ka wazan load karein aur pulling strap lagayein. Aap handles se kheench sakte hain, harness istemal kar sakte hain, ya pulling strap ko weight belt se laga sakte hain.
Chahe aage kheench rahe hon ya peeche, chalne ki simt mein jhukein aur kulhon aur ghutnon ko seedha karte hue aage barhein.

Sled Overhead Backward Walk.instructions_ur:
Sled ke saath rope ya chain se jude do handles lagayein. Sled par halka wazan load karein.
Sled ki taraf munh karein, aur peeche hatein yahan tak ke line mein thoda tanaao aa jaye. Haath seedhe sar ke upar rakhein aur kohniyan seedhi hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu sar ke upar uthaye rakhte hue peeche ki taraf chalein. Jhatke wali harkaton se bachein.

Sled Overhead Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Chain ya rope ke zariye sled par dual handles lagayein. Sled par munasib weight load karein.
Sled ki taraf peeth karke, aage chalein jab tak line mein tension na aa jaye. Haath sar ke upar uthayein, saath mila kar, hatheliyan aamne saamne. Kohniyan upar ki taraf aur mudi hui hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni seedhi karke baazu seedha karein. Triceps ko isolate karne ke liye yaqeeni banayein ke upper arm apni jagah par rahe.
Poore extension par, line ki dheel nikaalne ke liye aage qadam lein. Zyada stability ke liye paon aage peeche rakh sakte hain.

Sled Push.instructions_ur:
Pushing sled par pasandeeda weight load karein.
Athletic posture apnayein, baazu poori tarah seedhe karke sled par jhukein aur handles pakren. Sled ko jitna tez ho sake dhakelein, aur posterior chain ko mazboot karne ke liye kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karne par focus karein.

Sled Reverse Flye.instructions_ur:
Rope ya chain se jure sled par do handles lagayein. Sled par halka wazan load karein.
Sled ki taraf mun karein aur peeche hatein jab tak line mein kuch tension na aa jaye. Dono handles ko baazu ki lambai par taqreeban kamar ki unchai par pakrein. Ghutne thore modein aur seena aur sar upar rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni mode baghair handles ko upar aur alag alag kheenchein, thori external rotation ke saath reverse fly karein. Aisa karte hue hatheliyan aage ki taraf honi chahiyein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aayein, aur line ka dheela pan khatam karne ke liye do qadam peeche lein.

Sled Row.instructions_ur:
Rope ya chain se jure sled par do handles lagayein. Sled par munasib wazan rakhein. Sled ki taraf munh kar ke peeche hatein yahan tak ke line mein kuch tension aa jaye.
Har haath mein ek handle le kar ghutne thore se moorein, sar aur seena upar rakhein, aur baazu seedhe rakh kar shuru karein.
Harkat shuru karne ke liye shoulder blades peeche khinchte hue kohni moorein, aur sled ko apni taraf khinchein.
Line mein tension laane ke liye ek do qadam peeche lein aur dohrayein.

Sledgehammer Swings.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye aap ko ek tire aur ek sledgehammer chahiye hoga. Tire ke saamne takreeban do feet door staggered stance mein khare ho jayein. Sledgehammer pakrein.
Agar aap daayein haath se kaam karte hain to baayan haath handle ke neeche wale hisse par ho, aur daayan haath upar sar (head) ke qareeb ho.
Sledge ko upar uthate hue daayan haath head ki taraf phislega; neeche swing karte hue daayan haath neeche phisal kar baayein haath se mil jayega. Use poori taqat se tire par maarein. Tire se hammer ke uchhalne ko control karein.
Doosri taraf dohrayein.

Sliding Lateral Lunge.instructions_ur: Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar seedhe khare hon, kettlebell ko goblet position mein seene ke qareeb pakre hue. Ek paon slider, gliding disc ya towel par rakhein. Seena ooncha aur core engaged rakhein. Aahista aahista paon ko side ki taraf bahar slide karein jabke doosra ghutna modein, kulhon ko side lunge mein neeche layein. Kaam karne wali taang ka ghutna paon ki ungliyon ki seedh mein rakhein aur use andar girne na dein. Doosri taang seedhi rehti hai aur zameen par aaram se slide karti hai. Mudi hui taang ki eri se zor laga kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein, kettlebell par control barqarar rakhte hue.

Sloper Hanging.instructions_ur: Fingerboard ke sloper holds par kuch second ke liye latakna

Slow Squat.instructions_ur:
Ek tempo wala squat jo control wali harkat se muscles ka tanaao badhata hai aur jism ke nichle hisse ki stability behtar karta hai.
Neeche: 3 second mein aahista aahista neeche jayein.
Rukein: Bottom par 1 second rokein.
Khare hon: Aam raftaar se shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Form: Seena upar rakhein aur wazan aedhiyon par rakhein.

Smith Incline Shoulder Raise.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ke neeche incline bench rakhein. Barbell ko aisi oonchai par rakhein jahan let kar baazu taqreeban poori tarah seedhe karne par aap pahunch sakein. Zaroorat ka weight chunne ke baad incline bench par let jayein aur yaqeeni banayein ke kandhe barbell ke bilkul neeche hon.
Kandhon ke barabar faasle par pronated (hatheliyan aage) grip se bar ko rack se uthayein aur kohniyon mein halka sa kham rakh kar seedha apne upar pakren. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko upar uthayein yahan tak ke baazu poori tarah seedhe ho jayein. Note: Contraction kandhon ke aas paas mehsoos honi chahiye.
Ek second rukne ke baad saans andar lete hue bar ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche laayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.
Jab mukammal ho jayein to bar ko wapas rack mein rakh dein.

Smith Machine Behind the Back Shrug.name_ur: Smith Machine Kamar ke Peeche Shrug
Smith Machine Behind the Back Shrug.instructions_ur:
Bar ko raan ki unchai par rakh kar, munasib weight load karein.
Bar apne peeche rakh kar khare hon, kandhon ke barabar pronated grip se bar pakrein aur weight ko hook se nikaalein. Aap seedhe khare hon, sar aur seena upar aur baazu seedhe. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Kandhon ko seedha upar shrug karke harkat shuru karein. Harkat ke dauran baazu ya kalai na moden.
Thora ruk kar weight ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.
Jitne reps chahiye utni dafa dohrayein, phir hooks laga kar weight rack karein.

Smith Machine Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ke neeche flat bench rakhein. Ab barbell ko itni oonchai par rakhein ke letne par baazu taqreeban poore seedhe hon aur aap usay pakar sakein. Zaroorat ka weight select karne ke baad flat bench par let jayein. Kandhon ke faasle se chauri pronated grip se bar ko rack se unlock karein aur baazu lock kar ke usay apne upar seedha rokein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aayein yahan tak ke bar seene ke beech wale hisse ko mehsoos ho.
Ek second ruk kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue aur seene ke muscles se bar ko dhakelte hue wapas shuruati position par layein. Sikri hui position mein baazu lock karein, ek second rukein aur phir dobara aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein upar jaane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.
Khatam hone par bar ko wapas rack mein lock kar dein.

Smith Machine Bent Over Row.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ke barbell ko ghutnon se taqreeban 2 inch neeche ki unchai par set karein.
Ghutne halke se moden aur kulhon se aage jhukein, kamar seedhi rakhte hue jab tak woh farsh ke taqreeban parallel na ho jaye. Tip: Sar upar rakhein.
Ab barbell ko overhand (pronated) grip se pakrein aur smith machine rack se unlock karein. Phir use seedha apne saamne latakne dein jabke baazu farsh aur dhad ke perpendicular seedhe latke hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Dhad saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue barbell uthayein, kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakhein aur weights pakarne ke ilawa forearm se koi zor na lagayein. Top contracted position par kamar ke muscles sukerein aur ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista weight ko dobara shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Smith Machine Calf Raise.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ke bar ke neeche ek block ya weight plate rakhein. Bar ko apne qad ke hisaab se behtareen position par set karein. Sahi unchai chun kar aur bar load karke, paon ke panjon se plates par chadh jayein aur bar ko kandhon ke peeche rakhein.
Bar ko dono haathon se pakdein, hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon. Bar ko ghuma kar rack se nikaalein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Paon ke panjon se zor laga kar aedhiyan jitni oonchi ho sakein uthayein, contraction ke top par pindli ko sukerein. Ghutne seedhe rehne chahiye. Neeche jaana shuru karne se pehle sukeri position ko ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aedhiyan neeche karte hue aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press.name_ur: Smith Machine Tang grip Bench Press
Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ke neeche flat bench rakhein. Barbell ko itni oonchai par rakhein ke letne par baazu taqreeban poore seedhe hon aur aap usay pakar sakein. Zaroorat ka weight select karne ke baad flat bench par let jayein. Taqreeban kandhon ke barabar tang aur pronated grip (hatheliyan saamne ki taraf) se bar ko rack se unlock karein aur baazu lock kar ke usay apne upar seedha rokein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aayein yahan tak ke bar seene ke beech wale hisse ko mehsoos ho. Tip: Aam bench press ke baraks, triceps ko zyada se zyada kaam mein laane ke liye kohniyan har waqt dhad ke qareeb rakhein.
Ek second ruk kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue aur triceps ke muscles se bar ko dhakelte hue wapas shuruati position par layein. Sikri hui position mein baazu lock karein, ek second rukein aur phir dobara aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein upar jaane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.
Khatam hone par bar ko wapas rack mein lock kar dein.

Smith Machine Dead Lifts.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar is tarah khare hon ke paon bar ke neeche hon.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue kamar se jhukein, ghutnon mein thoda mor aane dein.
Bar ko overhand grip se taqreeban 16 inch ke faasle par pakrein.
Bar ko seedhe baazuon mein pakre hue kamar seedhi kar ke khare ho jayein.
Dobara jhukein aur bar ko farsh se zara upar tak neeche layein.

Smith Machine Good Mornings.instructions_ur:
Barbell kandhon par rakhein.
Sar upar aur kamar bilkul seedhi rakhte hue kamar se jhukein yahan tak ke kamar farsh ke mutawazi ho jaye.
Shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Dohrayein.

Smith Machine Hack Squat.instructions_ur:
Yeh basic Squat ki ek aur shakal hai jo Smith Machine par ki jaati hai aur zyada tar quads, yaani raan ke muscles par focus karti hai.
Bar ko neeche, takhnon se zara upar wali setting par set karein.
Bar farsh par aap ki taangon ke bilkul peeche ho, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur paon ki ungliyan seedhi saamne ki taraf rakh kar khare hon.
Paon mazbooti se farsh par jama kar neeche jhukein aur peeche se bar ko overhand grip se pakrein.
Kulhe aur ghutne seedhe kar ke bar uthayein, khayal rakhein ke ghutne lock na hon.
Neeche (squat) jayein yahan tak ke raanein farsh ke mutawazi ho jayein.
Aahista aahista upar shuruati position tak aayein.
Note: Ghutne usi rukh mein harkat karein jis rukh mein paon hain.

Smith Machine Hang Power Clean.instructions_ur:
Bar ko ghutnon ki oonchai par set karein aur munasib weight lagayein.
Bar ko kandhon se chauri overhand (pronated) grip se pakrein aur bar ko machine se unhook karein. Baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur sar aur seena upar hon. Kohniyan bahar ki taraf hon aur kandhe peeche aur neeche hon. Kulhe peeche hon, taake hamstrings mein tension aaye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe aur ghutne zor se seedhe kar ke harkat shuru karein aur bar mein tezi laayein. Harkat ke is hisse mein baazu seedhe rakhna zaroori hai.
Poori tarah seedha hone par, receiving position neeche karne ke liye kulhe aur ghutne dobara moorein.
Is waqt baazuon ko mudne dein, aur kohniyon ko bar ke gird ghuma kar bar ko kandhon par receive karein.
Harkat poori karne ke liye kulhe aur ghutne seedhe kar ke khare ho jayein, aur bar kandhon par tika ho.

Smith Machine Hip Raise.instructions_ur:
Rack mein bench rakhein aur bar par munasib wazan load karein. Bench par let jayein, paon ke talwe bar se lagayein. Bar unlock karein aur taangein seedhi karein. Shayad aap ko haathon se madad leni pare. Zyada mustahkami ke liye Smith Machine ke dono kinare pakrein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Pelvis ko ghuma kar aur reerh ki haddi mor kar kulhe bench se upar uthate hue harkat shuru karein. Poori harkat ke dauran ghutnon mein halka sa kham rakhein.
Thore se waqfe ke baad kulhe wapas bench par layein.
Jitne reps chahiye utni dafa dohrayein.

Smith Machine Incline Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ke neeche incline bench rakhein. Barbell ko itni oonchai par rakhein ke letne par baazu taqreeban poore seedhe hon aur aap usay pakar sakein. Zaroorat ka weight select karne ke baad incline bench par let jayein aur yaqeeni banayein ke seene ka upar wala hissa barbell ki seedh mein ho. Kandhon ke faasle se chauri pronated grip (hatheliyan saamne ki taraf) se bar ko rack se unlock karein aur baazu lock kar ke usay apne upar seedha rokein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aayein yahan tak ke bar seene ke upar wale hisse ko mehsoos ho.
Ek second ruk kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue aur seene ke muscles se bar ko dhakelte hue wapas shuruati position par layein. Sikri hui position mein baazu lock karein, ek second rukein aur phir dobara aahista aahista neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein upar jaane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.
Khatam hone par bar ko wapas rack mein rakh dein.

Smith Machine Leg Press.instructions_ur:
Smith machine ki bar ko zameen se do teen feet upar rakhein. Yaqeeni banayein ke woh safeties par tiki ho. Bar par munasib wazan load kar ke bar ke neeche let jayein. Paon ka beech wala hissa bar par rakhein, ghutne seene ki taraf mode hue. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Paon se zor laga kar bar ko upar dhakelte hue harkat shuru karein, kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karte hue. Ghutne lock na karein.
Harkat ke top par thora sa rukein phir shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Smith Machine One-Arm Upright Row.name_ur: Smith Machine Ek baazu se Upright Row
Smith Machine One-Arm Upright Row.instructions_ur:
Bar ko raan ki unchai par rakh kar, munasib weight load karein.
Bar par chauri grip lein aur weight ko unhook karein, phir doosra haath bar se hata lein. Seedhe khare hon, baazu seedha ho aur sar aur seena upar. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni mor kar harkat shuru karein, upper arm uthayein aur kohni bahar ki taraf rakhein. Jab tak upper arm zameen ke mutawazi na ho jaye jaari rakhein.
Thora ruk kar, weight ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.
Jitne reps chahiye utni dafa dohrayein, phir hooks laga kar weight ko rack karein.

Smith Machine Overhead Shoulder Press.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye smith machine ke neeche flat bench (ya behtar hai ke back support wali bench) rakhein. Barbell ko is oonchai par rakhein ke flat bench par baith kar barbell tak pohanchne ke liye baazuon ko taqreeban poori tarah seedha karna pare.
Sahi oonchai set hone ke baad barbell ke thora peeche baithein taake naak ki noak se barbell tak ek khayali seedhi line bane. Paon saakit hon. Barbell ko hatheliyan aage ki taraf rakh kar pakrein, unlock karein aur upar uthayein taake baazu poori tarah seedhe hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista barbell ko neeche layein yahan tak ke woh thodi ki seedh mein aa jaye.
Phir saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon se barbell ko wapas shuruati position tak uthayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Smith Machine Pistol Squat.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye bar ko apne qad ke mutabiq position par set karein. Uske neeche aa jayein aur bar ko kandhon ke peeche rakhein.
Hatheliyan aage ki taraf rakhte hue bar pakrein, unlock karein aur taangein seedhi kar ke rack se utha lein.
Ek paon bar se lagbhag 12 inch aage le jayein. Doosri taang saamne phaila kar zameen se oopar rakhein. Har waqt aage dekhein aur reerh ki haddi neutral ya halki si kham daar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Achha posture barqarar rakhte hue ghutna aur kulha mor kar neeche jayein, jitna flexibility ijazat de.
Neeche thori der ruk kar paon ki aedi se zor lagate hue, ghutna aur kulha seedha kar ke shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Smith Machine Rear Deltoid Row.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise rear deltoid, kandhon, biceps aur kamar ko mazboot karne ke liye hai.
Bar ko sab se neechi setting par set karein.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein aur ghutnon mein halka sa mor rakhein.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue kamar se jhukein yahan tak ke seena farsh ke mutawazi ho.
Bar ko kandhon se thoda chaura overhand grip se pakrein, baazu seedhe hon aur kohniyon mein halka sa mor ho.
Kohniyan mod kar aur upar utha kar control ke saath bar ko seene ke nichle hisse tak uthayein.
Ek lamha ruk kar shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Dohrayein.

Smith Machine Reverse Calf Raises.instructions_ur:
Smith machine par barbell ko apne qad ke mutabiq set karein aur bar ke bilkul neeche ek ooncha platform rakhein.
Platform par is tarah khare hon ke aerhiyan platform par jami hon aur paon ke panje (balls) platform se bahar niklen. Paon ki ungliyan seedhi saamne hon aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Ab paon isi position mein rakhte hue kandhe barbell ke neeche layein aur kulhe aur ghutne seedhe kar ke barbell upar dhakelein yahan tak ke dhad seedha khara ho jaye. Ghutnon mein halka sa mor rahe; kabhi lock na hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi. Tip: Kamar par barbell sirf balance ke liye hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue paon ke panje upar uthayein, ungliyan jitna ho sake upar karein aur calf ko sikorein. Yaqeeni banayein ke ghutna har waqt saakit rahe. Kisi bhi waqt ghutna nahi mudna chahiye. Wapas neeche jaane se pehle sikri hui position mein ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue paon ke panje aur ungliyan neeche kar ke aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Smith Machine Shoulder Shrugs.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko kamar (waist) ki oonchai par rakhein.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur pet andar khincha hua rakh kar khare hon.
Bar ko overhand grip aur seedhe baazuon se pakrein.
Bar uthate hue weight ko kandhe neeche khinchne dein, phir kandhon ko upar aur peeche ki taraf shrug karein.
Ek lamha ruk kar shuruati position par wapas aayein.

Smith Machine Slight Incline Press.instructions_ur:
Tareeqa
Shuruati position:
Bar ko rack se nikaalein aur baazu poori tarah seedhe karke seene ke upar wale hisse ke upar pakdein.
Shoulder blades ko peeche khinch kar bench mein dabaye rakhein.
Neeche laane ka hissa (eccentric):
Bar ko aahista aahista hansli ki haddi ke bilkul neeche ya seene ke upar wale hisse tak layein.
Control barqarar rakhein — bar ko uchhaalein nahin.
Press karne ka hissa (concentric):
Bar ko seedhi line mein upar dhakelein yahan tak ke baazu poori tarah seedhe ho jayein.
Top par seene ke upar wale hisse ko sukerne par tawajjo dein.
Lock karein aur dohrayein:
Apne reps mukammal karein, phir hifazat se bar ko wapas hooks mein rack kar dein.

Smith Machine Split Squat.instructions_ur:
"Smith Machine Split Squat" ek strength exercise hai
jo Smith machine par ki jati hai, aur taangon aur glutes ko target karne ke liye behtareen hai.
Is mein ek paon aage aur doosra peeche rakh kar,
jism ko tab tak neeche laya jata hai jab tak aage wali raan zameen ke parallel na ho jaye, jabke bar
machine par seedha oopar neeche chalta hai. Yeh exercise
stability behtar karne, muscles ka adam tawazun theek karne aur kamar par dabao kam karne mein madad karti hai,
aur strength training ke liye mehfooz mahaul faraham karti hai.

Smith Machine Squat.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye pehle bar ko apne qad ke hisaab se munasib oonchai par set karein. Sahi oonchai chunne aur bar par weight lagane ke baad, bar ke neeche aayein aur kandhon ka pichhla hissa (gardan se zara neeche) bar ke saath laga dein.
Dono baazuon se bar ko dono taraf se pakrein (hatheliyan saamne ki taraf), usay unlock karein aur pehle taangon se dhakel kar aur saath hi dhad seedha kar ke rack se uthayein.
Taangon ko kandhon ke barabar darmiyani stance mein rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf hon. Sar har waqt upar rakhein aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi. (Note: Is bayan mein hum darmiyani stance istemal kar rahe hain jo majmooi development par kaam karti hai; lekin aap foot stances wale hisse mein bataye gaye teeno stances mein se koi bhi chun sakte hain).
Seedha posture aur sar upar rakhte hue ghutne mod kar aahista aahista bar neeche lana shuru karein. Neeche jaate rahein yahan tak ke raan aur pindli (calf) ke darmiyan zaviya 90 degree se thoda kam ho jaye (yani raanein farsh ke mutawazi se neeche chali jayein). Harkat ka yeh hissa karte waqt saans andar lein. Tip: Agar exercise sahi ki gayi hai to ghutnon ka agla hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi lakeer banayega. Agar ghutne us khayali lakeer se aage (paon ki ungliyon se aage) chale jayein to ghutne par ghair zaroori dabao parta hai aur exercise ghalat ki gayi hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aerhi se farsh ko dhakelein aur taangein dobara seedhi karte hue bar upar uthayein aur shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Smith Machine Stiff-Legged Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye smith machine par bar ko takreeban raanon ke darmiyan ki oonchai par set karein. Sahi oonchai chunne aur bar par wazan lagane ke baad bar ko pronated (hatheliyan aage) grip se kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakrein. Zyada wazan istemal karne ki surat mein shayad wrist wraps ki zaroorat pare.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue baazu poori tarah seedhe kar ke bar uthayein. Dhad seedha rakh kar khare hon aur taangein kandhon ke barabar ya us se tang stance mein hon. Ghutne thore se mude hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ghutne saakit rakhte hue, kamar seedhi rakh kar kulhon se aage jhukein aur barbell ko paon ke upar tak neeche layein. Aage jate rahein jaise zameen se kuch uthane wale hon, yahan tak ke hamstrings mein stretch mehsoos ho. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein
Jaise hi hamstrings mein stretch mehsoos ho, kulhe aur kamar seedhe kar ke dhad ko dobara seedha upar lana shuru karein yahan tak ke shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Smith Machine Upright Row.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye smith machine par bar ko taqreeban raanon ke beech ki oonchai par set karein. Sahi oonchai chunne aur bar par weight lagane ke baad, bar ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par pronated (hatheliyan saamne ki taraf) grip se pakrein. Agar kaafi zyada weight istemal kar rahe hain to wrist wraps ki zaroorat par sakti hai.
Barbell uthayein aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue baazu poore seedhe kar lein. Kohniyon mein halka sa mor hona chahiye. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ke side wale hisse se bar uthayein. Upar le jaate waqt bar jism ke qareeb rahe. Uthate rahein yahan tak ke bar taqreeban thodi (chin) ko chhoo le. Tip: Harkat kohniyon se honi chahiye. Bar uthate waqt kohniyan hamesha forearms se ooncha rahein. Saath hi dhad saakit rakhein aur harkat ke upar ek second rukein.
Bar ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte waqt saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Smith Single-Leg Split Squat.name_ur: Smith Ek taang par Split Squat
Smith Single-Leg Split Squat.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye, smith machine se 2-3 feet peeche flat bench rakhein. Phir bar ko aisi unchai par set karein jo aapke qad se behtareen milti ho. Sahi unchai chun kar aur bar load karke, bar ke neeche aayein aur kandhon ka pichla hissa (gardan se zara neeche) bar par rakhein.
Dono baazuon se har side par bar pakrein (hatheliyan aage ki taraf), use unlock karein aur pehle taangon se zor laga kar aur saath hi dhad seedha karte hue rack se uthayein.
Ek paon bar ke neeche thora aage rakhein aur doosri taang peeche le ja kar paon ka upar wala hissa bench par rakhein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi
Sar upar rakh kar seedha posture barqarar rakhte hue ghutna mod kar aahista aahista bar neeche lana shuru karein. Neeche jaate rahein jab tak raan aur pindli ke darmiyan angle 90 degree se thora kam na ho jaye (yani jab raanein farsh ke parallel se neeche hon). Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein. Tip: Agar aapne exercise sahi ki hai to ghutne ka saamne wala hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banayega jo saamne ke perpendicular ho. Agar ghutna us khayali line se aage hai (agar woh paon ki ungliyon se aage hai) to aap ghutne par ghair zaroori dabao daal rahe hain aur exercise ghalat hui hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue zyada tar paon ki aedi se farsh ko dhakel kar bar uthana shuru karein, taang dobara seedhi karte hue shuruati position mein wapas jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Taang badlein aur harkat dohrayein.

Snatch.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar stance mein rakhein aur barbell paon ki ungliyon aur baqi paon ke jor ke bilkul upar ho.
Hatheliyan neeche ki taraf wali grip se, ghutne moorein aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue bar ko kandhon se zyada chauri grip se pakrein. Kulhe neeche layein aur yaqeeni banayein ke jism aise neeche aaye jaise kursi par baithne wale hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Paon se zameen ko aise dhakelna shuru karein jaise woh harkat karta platform ho aur sath hi barbell ko taangon ke qareeb rakhte hue uthana shuru karein.
Jab bar raanon ke darmiyan tak pohanche, taangon se zameen ko dhakelein aur explosive harkat mein jism ko poori tarah seedha karein.
Bar ko upar laate hue kandhon ko shrug ki harkat mein peeche uthayein, kohniyan side par bahar uthayein aur jitni der ho sake unhein bar ke upar rakhein.
Ab bohat tez magar taqatwar harkat mein, jab barbell itni oonchai par pohanch jaye jahan use control kiya ja sake, jism ko us ke neeche le jayein aur neeche girte hue baazu lock karein aur barbell ko sar ke upar pakar kar squat position mein aa jayein.
Squat position se upar uth kar lift mukammal karein. Lift ke aakhir mein dono paon ek line mein hon aur baazu poori tarah seedhe ho kar barbell sar ke upar pakre hon.

Snatch Balance.instructions_ur:
Paon pulling position mein, bar kandhon ke pichle hisse par rack ki hui, aur haath chauri snatch grip mein rakh kar shuru karein.
Ghutnon ki achanak dip aur drive se bar ko uchhalein, aur zor se bar ke neeche jayein, paon ko receiving position mein le aayein.
Bar ko squat ke neeche wale hisse ke qareeb sar ke upar baazu lock kar ke receive karein. Dhad seedha (vertical) rahe, aur kulhe taangon ke beech neeche jayein.
Poori gehraai tak neeche jaate rahein, aur wapas khari position mein aayein. Ehtiyat se weight neeche layein.

Snatch Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Snatch deadlift snatch ke pehle pull ko mazboot karti hai. Barbell platform par rakh kar chauri snatch grip se shuru karein. Paon bilkul kulhon ke neeche hon aur bahar ki taraf mude hon. Bar tak neeche squat karein, kamar ko mukammal taur par seedha (extension mein) rakhein aur sar ka rukh aage ho.
Ediyon se zor laga kar aur kulhe utha kar harkat shuru karein. Jab tak bar ghutnon se na guzre, kamar ka angle wahi rehna chahiye.
Us point par, peeche ki taraf jhukte hue kulhon ko bar ki taraf aage dhakelein. Harkat ulti kar ke bar ko wapas platform par rakhein.

Snatch Pull.instructions_ur:
Barbell farsh par pindliyon ke qareeb ho, chauri snatch grip lein. Kulhe neeche karein aur wazan aedhiyon par ho, kamar seedhi, sar saamne, seena upar, aur kandhe bar se thoda aage hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Aedhiyon se zor laga kar aur ghutne seedhe karke pehla pull shuru karein. Kamar ka zaviya wahi rehna chahiye, aur baazu seedhe rehne chahiye. Ghutnon se upar tak jaate hue wazan ko control ke saath hilayein.
Phir doosra pull aata hai, jo pull mein raftaar ka asal zariya hai. Jaise hi bar raan ke darmiyan tak pahunche, kulhon ko seedha karna shuru karein. Jump jaisi harkat mein kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karke raftaar badhayein, aur raftaar se bar ko upar le jayein.
Wazan ki raftaar badhane ke liye baazuon se khinchne ki zaroorat nahin honi chahiye; doosre pull ke aakhir mein jism poori tarah seedha ho, thoda peeche jhuka hua. Poora extension zordaar aur achanak hona chahiye, aur yaqeeni banayein ke extension ko zarurat se zyada lamba na karein.

Snatch Shrug.instructions_ur:
Chauri grip se shuru karein, bar raan ke darmiyan tak latak raha ho. Aap hook ya overhand grip istemal kar sakte hain. Kamar seedhi aur thodi aage jhuki honi chahiye.
Kandhon ko kaanon ki taraf shrug karein. Halaanke is exercise mein aam tor par snatch se zyada wazan load kiya ja sakta hai, itna zyada wazan na daalein ke harkat ki raftaar dheemi ho jaye.

Snatch from Blocks.instructions_ur:
Loaded barbell ko matlooba unchai wale boxes ya stands par rakh kar shuru karein. Bar par chauri grip lein. Paon bilkul kulhon ke neeche hon, aur zarurat ke mutabiq bahar ki taraf mude hon. Kulhe neeche karein, seena upar aur sar saamne dekhta ho. Kandhe bar se thoda aage hon, aur kohniyan bahar ki taraf hon. Yeh shuruati position hogi.
Aedhiyon ke aagle hisse se zor laga kar pehla pull shuru karein, bar ko boxes se uthayein.
Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karke doosre pull mein jayein, bar ko jitni tezi se ho sake upar le jayein. Bar jism ke qareeb rehna chahiye. Poore extension par kandhe shrug karein aur kohniyon ko side ki taraf mudne dein.
Paon ko receiving position mein le jaate hue, bar ko sar ke upar uthate hue zor se khud ko bar ke neeche khinchein. Paon kulhon se thoda bahar aayein, zarurat ke mutabiq bahar mude hon. Bar ko jism jitna neeche ho sake aur baazu sar ke upar poori tarah seedhe rakh kar pakdein.
Bar ko aedhiyon ke aagle hisse ki seedh mein rakhte hue, sar aur seena upar, aedhiyon se zor laga kar khare ho jayein. Ehtiyat se wazan wapas boxes par rakhein.

Speed Band Overhead Triceps.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye band ko zameen se bandh dein. Humne incline bench istemal kiya aur band ko us ke base se bandha, aur bench ke upar khare hue. Doosra tareeqa yeh hai ke band par khare ho kar bhi yeh kiya ja sakta hai.
Shuru karne ke liye, band ko sar ke peeche kheenchein, pronated grip se pakar kar aur kohniyan upar rakh kar. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Harkat ke liye, kohni seedhi kar ke baazu seedhe karein, aur yaqeeni banayein ke upper arm apni jagah par rahe.
Ruk jayein, aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Speed Box Squat.instructions_ur:
Bar par bands lagayein jo zameen ke qareeb mazbooti se bandhe hon. Munasib tension ke liye bands ko choke karna par sakta hai.
Is exercise ke liye munasib unchai ka box istemal karein. Bar par aisa weight load karein jo mehnat maange, lekin itna bhaari na ho ke speed par asar pare. Aam taur par, yeh aapke one rep max ka 50-70% hota hai.
Bar ko upper kamar par rakhein, shoulder blades peeche kheenche hue, kamar arch aur sar se paon tak sab kuch tight. Yeh shuruati position hogi.
Bar ko rack se uthayein aur box ke saamne position lein. Kulhe peeche le ja kar baithein jab tak box par na baith jayein, yaqeeni banayein ke control ke saath neeche aayein aur surface par dhar se na giren.
Thora rukein, aur kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karte hue dhamake ke saath box se uthein.

Speed Squats.instructions_ur:
Squat ki is shakal mein khaali barbell istemal hoti hai aur harkat aam squat se tez hoti hai. Yeh daurne aur koodne wale khelon ke liye speed aur conditioning banane ki achhi exercise hai.
Paon kandhon ke faasle se thoda zyada khol kar rakhein, ghutne aur paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf hon.
Pet andar khinch kar ghutne aur kulhe mod kar aahista aahista neeche jayein jaise baith rahe hon (squat).
Jitna control ke saath neeche ja sakein jayein, lekin jism ka wazan paon ki ungliyon ki taraf na jaane dein (is se balance bigar jayega).
Neeche wali position mein rukein aur aahista aahista seedhe ho kar shuruati position par wapas aayein.
Note: Poori exercise ke dauran paon mazbooti se farsh par jame rakhein.

Spell Caster.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pronated grip se pakrein. Paon chaure hon aur kulhe aur ghutne seedhe hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad ko ghumate hue dono dumbbells ko ek side par kulhe ke paas kheench kar harkat shuru karein.
Baazu seedhe aur dumbbells zameen ke parallel rakhte hue, dhad ko ghuma kar weights ko mukhalif side ki taraf jhulayein.
Baari baari ek side se doosri side ghumate rahein jab tak set mukammal na ho jaye.

Spider Crawl.instructions_ur:
Farsh par ulte let kar shuru karein. Wazan haathon aur paon ki ungliyon par rakhein, paon aapas mein mile hon aur jism seedha ho. Baazu 90 degree tak mude hone chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ek paon zameen se utha kar harkat shuru karein. Taang ko bahar ki taraf ghumayein aur ghutne ko kohni ki taraf, jitna aage ho sake, layein.
Is taang ko wapas shuruati position mein layein aur doosri side par dohrayein.

Spider Curl.instructions_ur:
Bar ko preacher bench ke us hisse par rakh kar shuru karein jahan aap aam tor par baithte hain. Barbell ko theek se rakhein taake woh balance mein ho aur gire nahi.
Preacher bench ke saamne wale hisse (jahan aam tor par baazu rakhe jate hain) ki taraf jayein aur khud ko 45 degree ke jhukao par is tarah rakhein ke dhad aur pait preacher bench ke saamne wale hisse se lage hon.
Dhyan rakhein ke paon (khaas kar paon ki ungliyan) farsh par achhi tarah jame hon aur upper arms preacher bench ke andar wale hisse par lage pad ke upar rakhein.
Baazuon se barbell ko supinated grip (hatheliyan upar) se taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par ya thora qareeb pakren.
Aahista aahista barbell ko upar uthana shuru karein aur saans bahar nikaalein. Biceps ko sukerte hue contracted position ko ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista barbell ko wapas shuruati position mein laana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Spider Curl with Barbell.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein Preacher Curl bench ki seedhi side istemal hoti hai taake harkat ki range barh jaye.
Preacher Curl bench ko ulta ghuma dein taake aap uski dhalwan (angled) side se tek laga sakein.
Barbell ko hatheliyan upar rakh kar taqreeban 6 inch ke faasle par pakrein.
Bench se tek laga kar bar ko bench ki seedhi side ke saath neeche layein aur baazu poori tarah seedhe kar lein.
Baazu upar curl karein yahan tak ke biceps forearms ko chhoo lein.
Aahista aahista bar ko shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Note: Is exercise ki harkat ki aadat daalne ke liye halka weight istemal karein.

Spinal Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kursi par is tarah baithein ke kamar seedhi ho aur paon farsh par jame hon.
Ungliyan aapas mein phansa kar sar ke peeche rakhein, kohniyan bahar aur thodi neeche ho.
Upar wale jism ko ek taraf jitna ho sake taqreeban 3 dafa ghumayein. Phir aage jhukein aur dhad ko ghuma kar kohni ko ghutne ki andar wali taraf farsh tak le jayein.
Seedhi position mein wapas aayein aur phir doosri taraf dohrayein.

Split Clean.instructions_ur:
Barbell farsh par pindliyon ke qareeb rakh kar, taangon ke bilkul bahar overhand grip lein. Kulhe neeche layein, weight aediyon par, kamar seedhi, sar saamne, seena upar, aur kandhe bar se thora aage. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Aediyon se zor laga kar aur ghutne seedhe karte hue first pull shuru karein. Kamar ka angle wahi rehna chahiye, aur baazu seedhe rehne chahiyein. Ghutnon se upar tak jaate hue weight ko control ke saath harkat dein.
Is ke baad second pull aata hai, jo clean mein raftaar ka asal zariya hai. Jab bar raan ke beech ki position ke qareeb aaye, kulhe seedhe karna shuru karein. Jump jaisi harkat mein, kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karke raftaar barhayein, speed se bar ko upar le jayein. Weight ki raftaar barhane ke liye baazuon se kheenchne ki zaroorat nahi honi chahiye; second pull ke aakhir mein jism poori tarah seedha ho, halka sa peeche jhuka hua, aur baazu ab bhi seedhe hon.
Jab poora extension ho jaye, zor se shrug karte hue aur kohniyan upar aur bahar mod kar third pull mein jayein. Poore extension par, zor se khud ko neeche kheenchein, aur saath hi kohniyan bar ke neeche ghumayein.
Paon split karke bar receive karein, tezi se ek paon aage aur ek peeche le jayein. Bar aage nikle hue kandhon par rack ho, gale ko halka sa chhoota hua aur haath dheele. Bottom position tak neeche jaate rahein, is se recovery mein madad milegi.
Foran aediyon se zor laga kar recover karein, dhad seedha aur kohniyan upar rakhein. Khare hote hue paon saath layein.

Split Jerk.instructions_ur:
Weight kandhon ke saamne rack karke khare hon, aur dip se shuru karein. Paon seedha kulhon ke neeche rakh kar, kulhe peeche le jaye baghair ghutne moden.
Sirf thora neeche jayein, aur jitna zor ho sake laga kar simt badlein. Aediyon se zor laga kar jitni ho sake speed aur taqat paida karein, aur bar kandhon se nikalte waqt sar ko raaste se hatana yaqeeni banayein. Is lamhe jab paon farsh se uthein, paon ko jitna jaldi ho sake receiving position mein rakhna zaroori hai.
Jis chhote se lamhe mein paon platform par zor nahi laga rahe hote, bar ko upar dhakelne ki athlete ki koshish use neeche le jayegi. Paon split stance mein le jayein, ek paon aage, ek peeche, ghutne thore mude hue. Baazu sar ke upar lock karke bar receive karein.
Paon saath laate hue khare ho jayein.

Split Jump.instructions_ur:
Lunge stance position lein, ek paon aage ghutna mura hua, aur peeche wala ghutna zameen ko taqreeban chhoota hua.
Yaqeeni banayein ke aage wala ghutna paon ki darmiyani line ke upar ho.
Dono taangon ko seedha karte hue, jitna ho sake upar jump karein, unchai ke liye baazu jhulayein.
Jump karte hue, paon saath layein, aur land karte hue unhein wapas apni pehli position mein le jayein.
Wapas shuruati position mein aate hue impact jazb karein.

Split Snatch.instructions_ur:
Zameen par load kiye hue barbell se shuru karein. Bar pindliyon ke qareeb ya unhein chhoota hua ho, aur bar par chauri grip leni chahiye. Paon bilkul kulhon ke neeche hon, zaroorat ke mutabiq paon bahar ki taraf mude hue. Kulhe neeche karein, seena upar aur sar saamne dekhta hua. Kandhe bar se zara aage hone chahiyein. Yeh shuruati position hogi.
Eriyon ke agle hisse se zor laga kar pehla pull shuru karein, bar ko zameen se uthate hue. Bar ghutnon se guzarne tak kamar ka angle wahi rehna chahiye.
Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karte hue doosre pull mein jayein, bar ko jitna tez ho sake upar le jate hue. Bar jism ke qareeb rehni chahiye. Poori extension par kandhe shrug karein aur kohniyon ko side mein mudne dein.
Paon ko receiving position mein le jate hue, bar ko sar ke upar uthate waqt khud ko zor se bar ke neeche kheenchein. Paon zor se split position mein jane chahiyein, ek paon aage ek peeche. Bar ko jitna ho sake neeche jism ke saath aur baazu sar ke upar poori tarah seedhe rakh kar pakrein.
Bar ko eriyon ke agle hisse ki seedh mein rakhte hue, sar aur seena upar, paon ki eriyon se zor laga kar khari position mein aayein, paon milate hue.
Ehtiyat se wazan ko wapas zameen par rakhein.

Split Squat with Dumbbells.instructions_ur:
Staggered stance mein aa jayein, pichhla paon upar utha hua aur aagla paon aage ho.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein aur unhein side mein latakne dein. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutna aur kulha mod kar jism ko neeche layein. Poori harkat ke dauran achha posture qaim rakhein. Exercise karte hue aagla ghutna paon ki seedh mein rakhein.
Harkat ke neeche, edi se zor laga kar ghutna aur kulha seedha karein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Split Squats.instructions_ur:
Khari position mein rahein. Jump karke split leg position mein aayein, ek taang aage aur ek peeche, aur aisa karte hue ghutne mod kar kulhe thore neeche karein.
Neeche aate hi foran simt ulti karein, wapas khare ho kar jump karein aur taangon ki position badal dein. Har taang par 5-10 dafa dohrayein.

Squat Jerk.instructions_ur:
Weight ko kandhon ke agle hisse par rack kar ke khare hon, aur dip se shuru karein. Paon bilkul kulhon ke neeche rakh kar, kulhe peeche le jaye baghair ghutne moorein. Sirf thoda neeche jayein, aur jitni taaqat se ho sake simt ulti karein. Aediyon se zor laga kar jitni ho sake raftaar aur taaqat paida karein, aur jab bar kandhon se uthe to sar ko raaste se hata lein.
Isi lamhe jab paon farsh se uthein, paon ko jitni jaldi ho sake receiving position mein rakhna hai. Jis thode se lamhe mein paon platform par zor nahi laga rahe hote, bar ko upar dhakelne ki koshish athlete ko neeche le jati hai. Paon zor se kulhon se bilkul thoda bahar tak jayein, aur zaroorat ke mutabiq bahar ki taraf mude hon. Bar ko full squat mein receive karein aur baazu sar ke upar poori tarah seedhe hon.
Bar ko aediyon ke agle hisse ki seedh mein rakhte hue, sar aur seena upar rakh kar, aediyon se zor laga kar khare ho jayein. Ehtiyat se weight ko wapas farsh par rakhein.

Squat with Bands.instructions_ur:
Bands ko bar ki sleeves par lagayein aur unhein band pegs, rack ya dumbbells ke saath is tarah baandhein ke munasib tension ho.
Bar ke neeche aa kar usay kandhon ke pichhle hisse par rakhein. Shoulder blades ko aapas mein dabayein aur kohniyan aage ki taraf ghumayein, jaise bar ko kandhon par mod rahe hon. Kamar ke nichle hisse mein mazboot kham (arch) bana kar bar ko rack se uthayein aur peeche qadam le kar position mein aayein. Kamar, glutes, adductors aur hamstrings par zyada zor ke liye paon chaure rakhein. Sar seedha saamne ki taraf rakhein.
Kamar, kandhe aur core tight rakh kar ghutne aur kulhe bahar ki taraf dhakelte hue neeche jaana shuru karein. Kulhon ke saath jitna ho sake peeche baithein. Behtar hai ke pindliyan (shins) zameen ke saath amudi hon. Bar neeche rakhi ho to bar ko aerhiyon ke upar rakhne ke liye dhad ko zyada aage jhukana parta hai. Parallel se neeche tak jayein, yani kulhe ki silwat (crease) ghutne ke upar wale hisse ki seedh mein aa jaye.
Wazan aerhiyon par rakhte hue aur paon aur ghutne bahar dhakelte hue, sar se harkat ki rehnumai karte hue upar zor lagayein. Sar se paon tak jism tight rakhte hue upar aate rahein yahan tak ke shuruati position par wapas aa jayein.

Squat with Chains.instructions_ur:
Chains set karne ke liye, leader chain ko bar ki sleeves par loop karke shuru karein. Bhaari chain snap hook se lagani chahiye. Lead chain ki lambai aise adjust karein ke harkat ke top par bhi kuch kariyan farsh par rahein.
Bar ke neeche aa kar aur use kandhon ke peeche rakh kar shuru karein. Shoulder blades aapas mein sukerein aur kohniyan aage ghumayein, jaise bar ko kandhon par mor rahe hon. Bar ko rack se nikaalein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein tight arch banayein, aur peeche qadam le kar position mein aayein. Kamar, glutes, adductors aur hamstrings par zyada zor ke liye paon chaure rakhein. Sar saamne rakhein.
Kamar, kandhe aur core tight rakhte hue, ghutne aur kulhe bahar nikaalein aur neeche aana shuru karein. Jitna ho sake kulhe peeche le ja kar baithein. Behtar hai ke pindliyan zameen ke perpendicular hon. Bar ki neechi position mein bar ko aediyon ke upar rakhne ke liye dhad ko zyada jhukana parta hai. Parallel tootne tak jaari rakhein, yani kulhe ka mor ghutne ke top ki seedh mein aa jaye.
Weight aediyon par rakhte hue aur paon aur ghutne bahar dhakelte hue, sar se harkat ki rehnumai karte hue upar zor lagayein. Sar se paon tak tightness barqarar rakhte hue upar jaate rahein, jab tak shuruati position mein wapas na aa jayein.

Squat with Plate Movers.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye pehle bar ko rack par kandhon se thora neeche set karein. Rack se kuch feet peeche zameen par ek weight plate rakhein. Bar par wazan lagane ke baad us ke neeche aayein aur kandhon ka pichla hissa us par rakhein.
Bar ko dono haathon se pakrein aur pehle taangon se dhakel kar aur sath hi dhad seedha kar ke use rack se uthayein.
Rack se peeche hatein aur chauri stance banayein, paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf hon, aur ek paon weight plate par ho. Sar har waqt upar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne aur kulhe mor kar aahista aahista bar neeche lana shuru karein. Neeche jate rahein yahan tak ke raan aur pindli ke darmiyan angle 90 degree se thora kam ho jaye.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aediyon se zameen ko dhakel kar aur kulhe aur ghutne seedhe kar ke bar uthayein.
Harkat ke upar side step lein, aur paon ko plate ki doosri taraf aapas mein mila lein.
Andar wale paon se weight plate ko dhakelein, use zameen par phisla kar wahan le jayein jahan aap abhi khare the.
Andar wala paon weight plate par rakhein, aur agle rep ke liye chauri stance banayein.

Squats on Multipress.instructions_ur: Control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Stability Ball Abdominal Crunch.instructions_ur:
Is crunch mein Stability Ball istemal hoti hai. Ball reerh ki haddi ke saath behtar dhal jaati hai is liye harkat ki range behtar milti hai.
Exercise ya stability ball ke upar baithein aur sahare ke liye paon mazbooti se farsh par rakhein.
Apne aap ko is tarah set karein ke kamar ka nichla hissa ball ke beech mein ho.
Peeche let jayein aur haath seene par cross kar ke rakhein, ya sar ke dono taraf (kaanon ke upar) rakhein.
Sar, seena aur kandhe upar uthayein aur abs ko crunch karte hue seedhe baith jayein.
Ek lamha ruk kar shuruati position tak neeche aayein.
Note: Behtar nataij ke liye is exercise mein harkat ki poori range istemal karein.

Stairmaster.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye stairmaster par chadhein aur menu se matlooba option chunein. Aap manual setting chun sakte hain, ya koi program chala sakte hain. Aam tor par exercise ke dauran jalne wali calories ka andaza lagane ke liye aap apni umar aur wazan daal sakte hain.
Ek tay rhythm mein taangein upar neeche chalayein, pedals ko neeche dabayein lekin bilkul farsh tak nahin. Mashwara hai ke handles pakde rakhein taake aap girein nahin. Handles se aap apni dil ki dhadkan check kar sakte hain taake munasib intensity mein rahein.
Stairmasters aasaan hain, cardio ke faide dete hain, aur aam tor par bahar daudne se kam jhatka dete hain. Yeh aam tor par doosre cardio equipment se kaafi mushkil hote hain. 150 lb ka shakhs aam tor par 30 minute mein 300 se zyada calories jalata hai, jabke chalne mein taqreeban 175 calories.

Standing Alternating Dumbbell Press.name_ur: Khare ho kar Baari baari Dumbbell Press
Standing Alternating Dumbbell Press.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell le kar khare ho jayein. Dumbbells ko kandhon tak uthayein, hatheliyan aage ki taraf aur kohniyan bahar ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ek baazu seedha kar ke dumbbell ko seedha oopar press karein, doosra haath apni jagah par rakhein. Harkat ke dauran jhukein ya weight ko jhatka na dein.
Zara ruk kar weight ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.
Doosri side ke liye dohrayein, aur baari baari baazu badalte rahein.

Standing Barbell Calf Raise.name_ur: Khare ho kar Barbell Calf Raise
Standing Barbell Calf Raise.instructions_ur:
Hifazat ke liye yeh exercise squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai. Shuru karne ke liye pehle bar ko rack par apne qad ke hisaab se munasib oonchai par set karein. Sahi oonchai chunne aur bar par weight lagane ke baad, bar ke neeche aayein aur bar ko kandhon ke pichhle hisse (gardan se zara neeche) par rakhein.
Dono baazuon se bar ko dono taraf se pakrein aur pehle taangon se dhakel kar aur saath hi dhad seedha kar ke rack se uthayein.
Rack se hat kar taangon ko kandhon ke barabar darmiyani stance mein rakhein aur paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf hon. Sar har waqt upar rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigar jayega, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Ghutnon mein halka sa mor rahe; kabhi lock na hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi. Tip: Harkat ki behtar range ke liye aap paon ke panje lakri ke block par bhi rakh sakte hain, lekin ehtiyat karein kyunke is mein zyada balance aur mazboot block chahiye.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue takhne seedhe kar ke aerhiyan jitna ho sake upar uthayein aur calf ko sikorein. Yaqeeni banayein ke ghutna har waqt saakit rahe. Kisi bhi waqt ghutna nahi mudna chahiye. Wapas neeche jaane se pehle sikri hui position mein ek second rukein.
Saans andar lete hue aerhiyan neeche karein aur takhne modte hue aahista aahista shuruati position par wapas aayein yahan tak ke calves stretch ho jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Barbell Press Behind Neck.name_ur: Khare ho kar Gardan ke peeche Barbell Press
Standing Barbell Press Behind Neck.instructions_ur:
Yeh exercise squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai taa ke bar uthana aasaan ho. Shuru karne ke liye, pehle bar ko rack par apne qad ke mutabiq unchai par rakhein. Sahi unchai chun kar aur bar load kar ke, bar ke neeche aayein aur kandhon ka pichla hissa (gardan se thora neeche) us par rakhein.
Dono baazuon se dono taraf bar pakrein aur pehle taangon se dhakel kar aur saath hi dhad seedha kar ke usay rack se uthayein.
Rack se peeche hatein aur taangon ko kandhon ke barabar medium stance mein rakhein, paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf. Yeh exercise karte hue kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue baazu poore seedhe kar ke barbell ko sar ke upar uthayein.
Ek second sukerna rokein aur saans andar lete hue barbell ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Tric.name_ur: Khare ho kar Jhuk kar Ek baazu se Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Standing Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Tric.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein dumbbell aur hatheli dhad ki taraf rakh kar, ghutne halke se morein aur kulhon se aage jhukein, kamar seedhi rakhte hue, jab tak dhad taqreeban zameen ke mutawazi na ho jaye. Sar upar rakhna yaqeeni banayein.
Upper arm dhad ke qareeb aur zameen ke mutawazi ho jabke forearm zameen ki taraf ho aur haath mein weight ho. Tip: Forearm aur upper arm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka zaawiya hona chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Upper arms ko saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps se weight uthayein jab tak forearms zameen ke mutawazi na ho jayein aur poora baazu seedha ho jaye. Baazu ki doosri kai exercises ki tarah, sirf forearm harkat karta hai.
Upar ek second sukerne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell ko shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur exercise dohrayein.

Standing Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Tric.name_ur: Khare ho kar Jhuk kar Dono baazu se Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Standing Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Tric.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein dumbbell aur hatheliyan dhad ki taraf rakh kar, ghutne thore se moorein aur kamar seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se aage jhuk kar dhad ko aage layein yahan tak ke woh zameen ke taqreeban parallel ho. Sar upar rakhna yaqeeni banayein. Upper arms dhad ke qareeb aur zameen ke parallel hon jabke forearms zameen ki taraf hon aur haath weights pakre hon. Tip: Forearms aur upper arm ke darmiyan 90 degree ka angle hona chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Upper arms saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps se weights uthayein yahan tak ke forearms zameen ke parallel hon aur poore baazu seedhe hon. Baazuon ki kai doosri exercises ki tarah sirf forearm harkat karta hai.
Upar ek second sukerne ke baad saans andar lete hue dumbbells ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Standing Biceps Cable Curl.name_ur: Khare ho kar Biceps Cable Curl
Standing Biceps Cable Curl.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare ho jayein aur low pulley se juri cable curl bar pakar lein. Cable bar ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakrein aur kohniyan dhad ke qareeb rakhein. Hatheliyan oopar ki taraf honi chahiye (supinated grip). Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baazu ka oopri hissa sakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue biceps ko sukerte hue weight ko curl karein. Sirf forearms harkat karein. Yeh harkat tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah sukar na jayein aur bar kandhon ki oonchai tak na aa jaye. Muscle ko daba kar is position ko ek second ke liye rokein.
Saans andar lete hue curl bar ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Biceps Stretch.instructions_ur:
Haathon ko kamar ke peeche hatheliyan mila kar jor lein, baazu seedhe karein aur phir unhein ghumayein taake hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon.
Baazuon ko oopar uthayein aur tab tak rokein jab tak biceps mein stretch mehsoos na ho.

Standing Biceps Stretch Left.name_ur: Khare ho kar Biceps Stretch Baayan
Standing Biceps Stretch Left.instructions_ur: Baayan baazu deewar ke qareeb rakh kar khare ho jayein. Baayan baazu seedha karke baayan haath deewar par rakhein, phir narmi se jism ko daayin taraf ghumayein.

Standing Biceps Stretch Right.name_ur: Khare ho kar Biceps Stretch Daayan
Standing Biceps Stretch Right.instructions_ur: Daayan baazu deewar ke qareeb rakh kar khare hon. Daayan baazu seedha karein aur daayan haath deewar par rakhein, phir narmi se jism ko baayin taraf ghumayein.

Standing Bradford Press.instructions_ur:
Loaded bar ko rack mein kandhon ki unchai par rakhein. Kandhon ke barabar pronated grip ke saath, bar ko kandhon ke saamne rack karke shuru karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Kohniyan seedhi karke bar ko sar ke upar press karke lift shuru karein. Wazan ko sar ke peeche le jaate hue kohni ko lock karne se bachein.
Bar ko sar ke peeche neeche layein yahan tak ke kohni 90 degree ka zaviya bana le.
Kohniyan seedhi karke bar ko wapas sar ke upar uthayein
Bar ko shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Isi tarah baari baari karte rahein jab tak jitne reps tay kiye hain woh mukammal na ho jayein.

Standing Cable Chest Press.name_ur: Khare ho kar Cable Chest Press
Standing Cable Chest Press.instructions_ur:
Dono pulleys ko seene ki unchai par set karein aur munasib wazan chunein. Cables se ek do foot aage khare hon, har haath mein ek cable pakri ho. Behtar stability ke liye stance aage peeche (stagger) kar sakte hain.
Upar ke baazu ko 90 degree ke angle par rakhein aur shoulder blades aapas mein mile hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Baqi jism saakit rakhte hue kohniyan seedhi karein aur handles ko aage press karte hue saamne aapas mein milayein.
Harkat ke aakhir mein rukein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Standing Cable Lift.instructions_ur:
Tower par standard handle lagayein, aur cable ko sab se neechi pulley position par le jayein.
Cable ki taraf side kar ke, ek haath se handle pakrein aur tower se door qadam rakhein. Aap pulley se taqreeban ek baazu ke faasle par hon, aur cable par weight ki tension ho. Aap ka phaila hua baazu cable ki seedh mein ho.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar, squat karein aur dono haathon se handle pakrein. Baazu ab bhi poori tarah seedhe hon.
Ek hi harkat mein, handle ko upar aur jism ke aar paar kheenchein jab tak baazu sar ke upar poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein.
Kamar seedhi rakhein aur baazu jism ke qareeb rakhein, aur poori range of motion ke liye pichle paon ko ghumayein aur taangein seedhi karein.
Pehle baazu aur phir jism ko wapas layein. Aahista aahista aur control ke saath neutral position mein wapas aa jayein.
Tab tak dohrayein jab tak mazeed na kar sakein.
Phir position badal kar doosri side par yehi harkatein dohrayein.

Standing Cable Wood Chop.name_ur: Khare ho kar Cable Wood Chop
Standing Cable Wood Chop.instructions_ur:
Tower se standard handle jorein, aur cable ko sab se oonchi pulley position par le jayein.
Cable ki taraf side kar ke, ek haath se handle pakrein aur tower se door hatein. Aap pulley se takreeban ek baazu ke faasle par hon, aur cable par wazan ki tension ho. Phela hua baazu cable ki seedh mein ho.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar doosra haath upar barhayein aur handle ko dono haathon se pakrein. Baazu ab bhi poori tarah seedhe hon.
Ek hi harkat mein dhad ghumate hue handle ko neeche aur jism ke aar paar agle ghutne tak khinchein.
Kamar aur baazu seedhe aur core tight rakhein jabke poori range of motion ke liye pichle paon ko ghumayein aur ghutne moorein.
Stance aur seedhe baazu barqarar rakhein. Aahista aur control ke saath neutral position mein wapas aa jayein.
Failure tak dohrayein.
Phir position badlein aur doosri taraf yahi silsila dohrayein.

Standing Calf Raise.instructions_ur: bodyweight ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Standing Calf Raises.instructions_ur:
Is exercise mein sahi form ke liye machine istemal hoti hai.
Paon ki ungliyan machine ke footpad par rakh kar khare hon aur kandhe oopar wale pads ke neeche set karein.
Paon ke panjon par oopar uthein aur aediyan pad se utha lein.
Thori der rokein aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Standing Calf Stretch.instructions_ur: Baghair equipment ke tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Standing Concentration Curl.instructions_ur:
Kaam karne wale haath mein dumbbell le kar aage jhukein. Kaam karne wale baazu ko zameen ke perpendicular latakne dein aur kohni bahar ki taraf ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Upar ka baazu saakit rakhte hue kohni mod kar wazan curl karein. Rep ke upar biceps ko sukerein aur rukein.
Dumbbell ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise.name_ur: Khare ho kar Dumbbell Calf Raise
Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare hon, do dumbbells haathon mein sides par pakre hue. Paon ka panja ek mazboot aur stable lakri ke board par rakhein (jo taqreeban 2-3 inch ooncha ho) jabke aediyan bahar nikal kar farsh ko chhoo rahi hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Paon ki ungliyan ya to seedhi (tamaam hisson par barabar asar ke liye), andar ki taraf (bahar wale head par zor ke liye) ya bahar ki taraf (andar wale head par zor ke liye) rakh kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue pindliyan sukerte hue aediyan farsh se uthayein. Top contraction ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue, aahista aahista aediyan neeche karke shuruati position mein wapas jayein.
Jitni dafa tay kiya hai utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Dumbbell Press.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon aur har haath mein ek dumbbell lein. Dumbbells ko sar ki unchai tak uthayein, kohniyan bahar aur taqreeban 90 degree par hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Sakht technique ke saath, taangon se zor lagaye ya peeche jhuke baghair, kohniyan seedhi kar ke wazan ko ek saath sar ke bilkul upar uthayein.
Rukein, aur aahista aahista wazan ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.

Standing Dumbbell Reverse Curl.name_ur: Khare ho kar Dumbbell Reverse Curl
Standing Dumbbell Reverse Curl.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye seedhe khare ho jayein aur har haath mein pronated grip (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) se dumbbell pakrein. Baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Upper arms saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte waqt biceps ko sukerte hue weights ko curl karein. Sirf forearms hilne chahiyein. Tab tak harkat jari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah contract na ho jayein aur dumbbells kandhon ki unchai par na aa jayein. Muscle ko sukerte hue contracted position ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbells ko shuruati position mein wapas lana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Dumbbell Straight-Arm Front Del.name_ur: Khare ho kar Seedhe baazu Dumbbell Saamne Delt Raise Sar ke upar tak
Standing Dumbbell Straight-Arm Front Del.instructions_ur:
Dumbbells raanon ke saamne pakrein, hatheliyan raanon ki taraf.
Baazu seedhe rakhein, kohniyon mein halka sa kham ho lekin unhein lock rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue dumbbells ko aadhe daire (semicircle) wali harkat mein sar ke upar baazuon ki poori lambai tak uthayein.
Saans andar lete hue usi raaste se aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension.name_ur: Khare ho kar Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye dono haathon mein ek dumbbell pakar kar khare ho jayein. Paon taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Aahista aahista dono haathon se dumbbell pakar kar sar ke oopar uthayein jab tak dono baazu poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein.
Weight hatheliyon mein tika ho aur angoothe uske gird lipte hon. Hatheliyan oopar chhat ki taraf hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baazu ka oopri hissa sar ke qareeb rakhein, kohniyan andar aur farsh ke perpendicular rakhein, aur weight ko sar ke peeche aadhe daire ki shakal mein neeche layein jab tak forearms biceps ko na chhoo lein. Tip: Baazu ka oopri hissa sakit rahe aur sirf forearms harkat karein. Yeh qadam karte hue saans andar lein.
Triceps ka istemal karte hue dumbbell utha kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein. Yeh qadam karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Dumbbell Upright Row.name_ur: Khare ho kar Dumbbell Upright Row
Standing Dumbbell Upright Row.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein dumbbell pronated (hatheliyan aage) grip se pakrein jo kandhon ke faasle se thori kam ho. Dumbbells raanon ke upar tike hon. Baazu seedhe hon aur kohniyon mein halka sa mor ho, aur kamar seedhi ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ke side wale hisse se dumbbells uthayein. Upar le jate hue dumbbells jism ke qareeb hon aur kohniyan harkat ki rehnumai karein. Unhein uthate rahein yahan tak ke woh taqreeban thodi ko chhoo lein. Tip: Kohniyan harkat ki rehnumai karein. Dumbbells uthate hue kohniyan hamesha forearms se oonchi honi chahiye. Dhad saakit rakhein aur harkat ke upar ek second rukein.
Dumbbells ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Elevated Quad Stretch.name_ur: Khare ho kar Elevated Quad Stretch
Standing Elevated Quad Stretch.instructions_ur:
Bench ya step se takreeban do se teen feet door us ki taraf peeth kar ke khare ho kar shuru karein.
Ek taang peeche uthayein aur paon step par rakhein, ya to paon ke upar wale hisse par ya paon ke agle hisse par, jo bhi aap ko zyada aaram deh lage.
Sahara dene wala ghutna thora sa mora hua rakhein aur us ghutne ko paon ki ungliyon se aage na jane dein. Side badal lein.

Standing Front Barbell Raise Over Head.name_ur: Khare ho kar Saamne Barbell Raise Sar ke Upar
Standing Front Barbell Raise Over Head.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye barbell haathon mein le kar seedhe khare ho jayein. Bar ko hatheliyan neeche ki taraf rakh kar kandhon se tang grip se pakrein.
Paon ek doosre se kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Kohniyan thori mudi hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue barbell ko uthayein jab tak woh sar ke bilkul upar na aa jaye. Har rep karte hue kohniyan thori mudi rakhna yaqeeni banayein.
Contraction mehsoos hone par saans andar lete hue barbell ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche lana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Gastrocnemius Calf Stretch.name_ur: Khare ho kar Gastrocnemius Calf Stretch
Standing Gastrocnemius Calf Stretch.instructions_ur:
Daayein edi ko step par rakhein, ghutna seedha ho, aur aage jhuk kar daayein haath se daayein paon ki ungliyan pakrein. Baayan ghutna thora mura ho aur kamar seedhi ho.
Wazan baayein taang par rakhein aur baayan haath baayein raan par rakhein.
Daayein paon ki ungliyon ko ghutne ki taraf kheenchein jab tak pindli mein stretch mehsoos na ho.

Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch.name_ur: Khare ho kar Hamstring aur Calf Stretch
Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch.instructions_ur:
Ek paon ke ird gird belt, band ya rope loop karke shuru karein. Khare hote hue, woh paon aage rakhein.
Peeche wali taang moden, jabke aage wali seedhi rakhein. Ab aage wale paon ki ungliyan zameen se uthayein aur aage jhukein.
Belt ki madad se paon ke upar wale hisse ko kheenchein taake pindli mein stretch barhe. 10-20 seconds rokein aur doosre paon se dohrayein.

Standing Hip Circles.instructions_ur:
Ek taang par khare ho kar shuru karein, kisi khare sahare ko pakad kar.
Bina sahare wale ghutne ko 90 degree tak uthayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhe ko jitna ho sake kholein, ghutne se ek bada daira banane ki koshish karein.
Yeh harkat kuch reps tak aahista aahista karein, aur doosri side par dohrayein.

Standing Hip Flexors.instructions_ur:
Reerh ki haddi seedhi rakh kar seedhe khare ho jayein, baayan paon daayein se thora aage ho.
Dono ghutne moorein aur pichli aedi zameen se uthayein aur sath hi daayan kulha aage dabayein. Lekin is position mein poora, gehra stretch nahi mil sakta, kyunke hip flexor ko dheela chhorna aur sath hi us par khare hona mushkil hai. Side badal lein.

Standing IT Band Stretch.name_ur: Khare ho kar IT Band Stretch
Standing IT Band Stretch.instructions_ur: Exercise samajhne ke liye video dekhein

Standing Inner-Biceps Curl.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hon aur pait andar khencha ho.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan aamne saamne hon, aur baazu side par poori tarah seedhe rakhein.
Baazuon ko oopar aur bahar ki taraf curl karein, uthate waqt hatheliyan oopar aur bahar ki taraf ghumayein.
Aahista aahista dumbbells ko shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Note: Weight uthate waqt koshish karein ke forearms kandhon ki seedh mein rahein.

Standing Lateral Stretch.instructions_ur:
Kulhon ke faasle se thora chaura stance lein, ghutne halke se mude hon.
Reerh ki haddi ko sahara dene ke liye right haath right kulhe par rakhein.
Left baazu seedhi line mein upar uthayein aur left haath sar ke peeche rakhein. Use wahin rakhte hue dhad ko right taraf jhukayein.
Weight dono taangon mein barabar taqseem rakhein (left kulhe par zor na daalein). Side badlein.

Standing Leg Curl.instructions_ur:
Machine ka lever apne qad ke mutabiq set karein aur dhad ko kamar se aage ki taraf taqreeban 30-45 degrees jhuka kar letein (kyunke jhuki hui position hamstrings ko behtar kaam mein laati hai), lever ka pad daayin taang ke peeche (calves se kuch inch neeche) ho aur daayin taang ka saamne wala hissa machine ke pad par ho.
Dhad aage jhuka rakhte hue yaqeeni banayein ke taang poori tarah seedhi ho aur machine ke side handles pakar lein. Paon ki ungliyan seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue daayin taang ko jitna ho sake oopar curl karein, raan ko pad se uthaye baghair. Poori tarah sukri hui position par pohanch kar ek second rokein.
Saans andar lete hue taangon ko wapas shuruati position mein layein. Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Ab yehi exercise baayin taang ke liye karein.

Standing Long Jump.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill ret ya kisi aur naram satah par karna behtar hai. Yaqeeni banayein ke aap faasla naap sakein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar aadhe squat stance mein khare hon.
Baazuon ki bari swing aur taangon ki countermovement istemal karte hue jitna door ho sake aage ki taraf uchhlein.
Paon apne saamne rakh kar utarne ki koshish karein, taangon se jitna door ho sake pohanchein.
Utarne ki jagah se shuruati point tak faasla naapein aur nataij ka record rakhein.

Standing Low-Pulley Deltoid Raise.name_ur: Khare ho kar Low-Pulley Deltoid Raise
Standing Low-Pulley Deltoid Raise.instructions_ur:
Low pulley row ki right side par khare ho kar shuru karein. Left haath ko jism ke aar paar le ja kar low pulley se lage single handle ko pronated grip (hatheliyan neeche) se pakrein. Baazu apne saamne aaram se rakhein. Behtar sahare aur balance ke liye right haath se machine pakrein.
Yaqeeni banayein ke kamar seedhi ho aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue left haath ko jism ke aar paar bahar le jayein jab tak woh kandhe ki unchai tak na uth jaye.
Top par ek second contraction mehsoos karein aur saans andar lete hue aahista aahista handle ko wapas asal shuruati position tak neeche lana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur exercise dohrayein.

Standing Low-Pulley One-Arm Triceps Exte.name_ur: Khare ho kar Low-Pulley Ek baazu se Triceps Extension
Standing Low-Pulley One-Arm Triceps Exte.instructions_ur:
Low pulley machine ke paas left baazu se single handle pakrein. Machine se munh pher lein, handle jism ki side par ho aur baazu poori tarah seedha ho. Ab dono haathon se single handle ko seedha sar ke oopar uthayein, hatheli aage ki taraf ho. Upper arm bilkul khara (farsh ke perpendicular) rakhein aur use saakit rakhne ke liye right haath left kohni par rakhein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Upper arms sar ke qareeb (kohniyan andar) aur farsh ke perpendicular rakhte hue resistance ko sar ke peeche aadhe daire ki shakal mein neeche layein jab tak forearms biceps ko na chhu lein. Tip: Upper arms saakit rehne chahiyein aur sirf forearms hilne chahiyein. Yeh step karte waqt saans andar lein.
Triceps se single handle ko oopar utha kar shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein. Yeh step karte waqt saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badal kar exercise dohrayein.

Standing Military Press.instructions_ur:
Squat rack par taqreeban seene ki unchai par barbell rakh kar shuru karein. Wazan chun kar barbell ko pronated (hatheliyan saamne ki taraf) grip se pakrein. Bar ko kandhon se zyada chaura pakarna yaqeeni banayein.
Ghutne thore se modein aur barbell ko hansli ki haddi par rakhein. Barbell ko seene par tika hua rakh kar uthayein. Ek qadam peeche lein aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakhein.
Sahi grip ke saath barbell utha kar, baazu lock karte hue bar ko sar ke upar uthayein. Taqreeban kandhon ki satah par aur sar se thora aage rokein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista bar ko hansli ki haddi tak neeche layein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue bar ko wapas shuruati position tak uthayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Olympic Plate Hand Squeeze.name_ur: Khare ho kar Olympic Plate Hand Squeeze
Standing Olympic Plate Hand Squeeze.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye seedhe khare ho jayein aur har haath mein weight plate ko uske kinare se baazu ki lambai par neutral grip (hatheliyan andar ki taraf) se pakrein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Plates ko itna neeche layein ke ungliyan taqreeban seedhi ho jayein lekin weights ab bhi pakre rahein. Plates neeche laate waqt saans andar lein.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue haath band kar ke plates ko wapas shuruati position mein uthayein.
Apne program mein jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing One Arm Bicep Curl with Cable.name_ur: Khare ho kar Ek baazu se Biceps Curl Cable ke saath
Standing One Arm Bicep Curl with Cable.instructions_ur:
Yeh biceps cable curl ka ek baazu wala version hai. Cable machines muscle banate hue sahi form seekhne mein bohat madadgar hain.
Low cable pulley par stirrup handle laga lein.
Weight stack ki side par khare hon, taangein kandhon ke barabar faasle par, ghutne halke se mude aur pait andar khencha ho.
Stirrup ko ek haath mein pakrein, hatheli oopar ki taraf ho.
Stirrup ko raan ke oopri hisse tak neeche layein.
Kohniyan sakit rakhte hue stirrup ko seene ki taraf curl karein.
Aahista aahista stirrup ko shuruati position mein neeche layein.

Standing One-Arm Cable Curl.name_ur: Khare ho kar Ek baazu se Cable Curl
Standing One-Arm Cable Curl.instructions_ur:
Low pulley machine ke paas single handle pakar kar shuru karein. Machine se itna door hon ke aap ka baazu weight sambhal raha ho.
Yaqeeni banayein ke upper arm saakit ho, zameen par amudi, kohniyan andar aur hatheliyan aage ki taraf. Jo baazu weight nahin utha raha woh kamar pakre. Is se aap ko balance qaim rakhne mein madad milegi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, upper arm saakit rakhte hue single handle ko aahista aahista upar curl karein jab tak forearm bicep ko na chhoo le. Tip: Sirf forearm harkat kare.
Bicep ko sukerte hue sukeri hui position rokein aur phir saans andar lete hue single handle ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Yeh exercise karte hue baazu badlein.

Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Curl Over Incl.name_ur: Khare ho kar Ek baazu se Dumbbell Curl Incline Bench par
Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Curl Over Incl.instructions_ur:
Incline bench ke peeche wali taraf aise khare hon jaise aap kisi ke spotter hon. Ek haath mein dumbbell pakrein aur supinated (hatheli oopar) grip ke saath baazu incline bench par tika dein.
Doosra haath incline bench ke kone ya side par rakhein. Seena incline ke oopri hisse se laga ho aur paon chauri stance mein farsh par mazbooti se jame hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Baazu ka oopri hissa sakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue biceps ko sukerte hue dumbbell ko oopar curl karein. Sirf forearm harkat kare. Yeh harkat tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah sukar na jayein aur dumbbell kandhe ki oonchai tak na aa jaye. Is position ko ek second ke liye rokein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbell ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Yeh exercise karte hue baazu badal lein.

Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extens.name_ur: Khare ho kar Ek baazu se Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extens.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye, ek haath mein dumbbell pakar kar khare hon. Paon taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Ab dumbbell wala baazu sar ke upar poora seedha karein. Tip: Haath ki chhoti ungli chhat ki taraf aur hatheli aage ki taraf honi chahiye. Dumbbell sar ke upar hona chahiye.
Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Upper arm ko sar ke qareeb (kohniyan andar) aur zameen par amudi rakhte hue, weight ko aadhe daire wali harkat mein sar ke peeche neeche layein jab tak forearm bicep ko na chhoo le. Tip: Upper arm saakit rahe aur sirf forearm harkat kare. Yeh step karte hue saans andar lein.
Triceps se dumbbell upar utha kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein. Yeh step karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur exercise dohrayein.

Standing Overhead Barbell Triceps Extens.name_ur: Khare ho kar Overhead Barbell Triceps Extension
Standing Overhead Barbell Triceps Extens.instructions_ur:
