Shuru karne ke liye barbell ya e-z bar ko pronated grip (hatheliyan aage ki taraf) se pakar kar khare hon, haath kandhon ke faasle se thore qareeb hon. Paon taqreeban kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Ab barbell ko sar ke oopar uthayein jab tak baazu poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein. Kohniyan andar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baazu ka oopri hissa sar ke qareeb aur kohniyan andar, farsh ke perpendicular rakhte hue, weight ko sar ke peeche aadhe daire ki shakal mein neeche layein jab tak forearms biceps ko na chhoo lein. Tip: Baazu ka oopri hissa sakit rahe aur sirf forearms harkat karein. Yeh qadam karte hue saans andar lein.
Triceps ka istemal karte hue barbell utha kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein. Yeh qadam karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Palm-In One-Arm Dumbbell Press.name_ur: Khare ho kar Hatheli andar Ek baazu se Dumbbell Press
Standing Palm-In One-Arm Dumbbell Press.instructions_ur:
Ek haath mein dumbbell pakad kar shuru karein, baazu neutral grip ke saath side par poori tarah seedha ho. Balance ke liye doosre haath se incline bench pakad lein.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Ab aahista aahista dumbbell uthayein yahan tak ke baazu 90 degree ka zaviya bana le. Note: Forearm farsh ke amoodi hona chahiye. Poori exercise mein neutral grip barqarar rakhein.
Aahista aahista dumbbell uthayein yahan tak ke baazu poori tarah seedha ho jaye. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue wazan neeche layein yahan tak ke baazu dobara 90 degree ke zaviye par ho.
Ek second contraction mehsoos karein aur phir saans bahar nikaalte hue wazan ko wapas shuruati position ki taraf uthayein. Exercise ke dauran balance ke liye incline bench pakde rakhna aur paon sahi jagah rakhna yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Baazu badlein aur exercise dohrayein.

Standing Palms-In Dumbbell Press.name_ur: Khare ho kar Hatheliyan Andar Dumbbell Press
Standing Palms-In Dumbbell Press.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein aur neutral grip ke saath baazu side mein poori tarah seedha rakhein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Ab aahista aahista dumbbells ko upar uthayein yahan tak ke baazuon se 90 degree ka angle ban jaye. Note: Forearms zameen ke seedhe khare (perpendicular) hone chahiyein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Poori exercise ke dauran neutral grip barqarar rakhein. Aahista aahista dumbbells ko upar uthayein yahan tak ke baazu poori tarah seedhe ho jayein.
Saans andar lete hue wazan ko neeche layein yahan tak ke baazu dobara 90 degree ke angle par aa jaye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Palms-Up Barbell Behind The Bac.name_ur: Khare ho kar Hatheliyan upar Barbell Kamar ke peeche Wrist Curl
Standing Palms-Up Barbell Behind The Bac.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho kar barbell ko glutes ke peeche baazu seedhe karke pronated grip se pakren (hatheliyan glutes se door peeche ki taraf hongi), aur haath kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Seedha saamne dekhein aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kalai ko aadhe daire ki shakal mein chhat ki taraf curl karte hue barbell ko aahista aahista upar uthayein. Note: Is exercise mein sirf kalai harkat kare.
Contraction ko ek second rokein aur saans andar lete hue barbell ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche laayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Mukammal hone par ghutne mod kar barbell ko squat rack ya farsh par neeche rakh dein. Tip: Sab se aasan yeh hai ke usay squat rack se uthayein ya partner aap ko pakra de.

Standing Pelvic Tilt.instructions_ur:
Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar shuru karein.
Ghutne halke se moden taake woh narm aur lachakdar rahein.
Is stretch mein tailbone ko aage rokne se pehle aap pelvis ko kuch dafa aage peeche harkat dena chahein to de sakte hain.

Standing Quad Stretch.instructions_ur: Baghair equipment ke tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Standing Rope Crunch.instructions_ur:
High pulley par rope lagayein aur munasib weight select karein.
Cable tower ki taraf peeth kar ke khare ho jayein. Dono haathon se rope ko kandhon ke oopar se pakrein aur seene ke oopri hisse se laga kar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Reerh ki haddi ko mor kar harkat karein, weight ko jitna ho sake neeche crunch karein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aane se pehle peak contraction ek lamhe ke liye rokein.

Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch.name_ur: Khare ho kar Soleus aur Achilles Stretch
Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch.instructions_ur:
Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ek paon doosre se thoda aage ho.
Dono ghutne modein, peeche wali aedhi farsh par rakhein. Side badlein.

Standing Toe Touches.instructions_ur:
Aise khare hon ke aap ke aage aur peeche kuch jagah ho.
Taangein seedhi rakhte hue kulhon se aage jhukein, yahan tak ke aap dheele ho kar upper body ko saamne neeche latakne de sakein. Baazu aur haath qudrati tor par neeche latakne dein. 10 se 20 seconds rokein.

Standing Towel Triceps Extension.name_ur: Khare ho kar Towel Triceps Extension
Standing Towel Triceps Extension.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye khare ho kar dono baazu sar ke oopar poori tarah seedhe karein aur dono haathon se towel ka ek sira pakrein. Kohniyan andar hon aur baazu farsh ke perpendicular hon, hatheliyan aamne saamne hon aur paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Ab apne partner ko batayein ke woh towel ka doosra sira pakar kar resistance de. Baazu ka oopri hissa sar ke qareeb (kohniyan andar) aur farsh ke perpendicular rakhte hue, weight ko sar ke peeche aadhe daire ki shakal mein neeche layein jab tak forearms biceps ko na chhoo lein. Tip: Baazu ka oopri hissa sakit rahe aur sirf forearms harkat karein. Yeh qadam karte hue saans andar lein.
Triceps ka istemal karte hue towel utha kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein. Yeh qadam karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Standing Two-Arm Overhead Throw.name_ur: Khare ho kar Dono baazu se Overhead Throw
Standing Two-Arm Overhead Throw.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon aur dono haathon mein medicine ball pakrein. Shuru karne ke liye, ghutne thode moorte hue aur peeche jhukte hue medicine ball ko sar ke peeche door tak le jayein.
Kulhon se jhukte hue aur poore jism ka istemal karte hue ball ko poori taaqat se aage phenkein.
Medicine ball partner ko ya deewar par phenki ja sakti hai, aur wapas aane par use pakar lein.

Star Jump.instructions_ur:
Aaramdeh stance mein shuru karein, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur baazu jism ke qareeb.
Harkat shuru karne ke liye, aadha squat karein aur jitna ho sake zor se upar uchhlein. Poora jism phaila dein, taangein aur baazu jism se door kholein.
Utarte waqt, haath paon wapas andar layein aur taangon se jhatka jazb karein.

Static Neck Flexion and Extension.instructions_ur:
Gardan ke saamne aur peeche ke muscles banane ya warm-up karne ki exercise.
Khare ho kar ya baith kar sar ko neutral position mein rakhein.
Dono haath maathe par rakhein.
Sar ko haathon ke khilaf dabayein aur gardan ke muscles sukerein.
Sar ko aage jaane se rokein. Kam az kam 30 seconds tak rokein.
Phir haath sar ke peeche rakh kar unke khilaf dabate hue dohrayein.

Static Neck Side Flexion.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar ya baith kar sar ko neutral position mein rakhein.
Baayan haath sar ki baayin taraf, kaan ke oopar rakhein.
Sar ko haath ke khilaf dabayein, sar ko hilaye baghair.
Phir daayen haath se, sar ki daayin taraf dohrayein.

Stationary Abdominal Draw In.instructions_ur:
Mat par haathon aur ghutno ke bal aa jayein, char points se ek rectangle ya square ki shakal banayein.
Kamar seedhi rakhein aur kulhe aur pelvis neutral position mein rakhein.
Pait ko andar khenchein, kamar ko sakit rakhte hue abs ko crunch karein.
Thori der rokein aur phir dheela chhor kar shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

Stationary Bike Cardio.instructions_ur:
Stationary Bike Cardio ke faide
Stationary bike cardio exercise ki behtareen qism hai jo sehat aur tandrusti ke liye kai faide deti hai. Yeh rahe kuch sab se numayan faide:
Dil ki behtar sehat
Dil ko mazboot karta hai: Baqaida exercise dil ki karkardagi behtar karti hai aur dil ki bimariyon ka khatra kam karti hai.
Khoon ki gardish barhata hai: Yeh khoon ke bahao ko behtar karta hai, jo blood pressure kam karne mein madad de sakta hai.
Calories jalana aur wazan kam karna
Calories jalane mein mufeed: Shiddat ke hisaab se aap ek ghante mein 400 se 600 calories jala sakte hain.
Wazan kam karne mein madad: Mutawazin khoraak ke saath, stationary bike cardio wazan kam karne mein mufeed ho sakta hai.
Muscles ki mazbooti
Taangon ko tone karta hai: Yeh zyada tar taangon ke muscles par kaam karta hai, jin mein quadriceps, hamstrings aur calves shamil hain.
Muscles ki bardasht barhata hai: Waqt ke saath aap taangon ki bardasht aur taaqat barha sakte hain.
Zehni sehat ke faide
Stress kam karta hai: Exercise se endorphins kharij hote hain, jo mood behtar aur stress kam kar sakte hain.
Energy barhata hai: Baqaida jismani activity energy ki satah barha sakti hai aur neend ka miyaar behtar kar sakti hai.

Step Jack.instructions_ur:
Step Jack ek low-impact, plyometric jaisi harkat hai jo jump karne ke joron par dabao ke baghair cardio ke fawaid deti hai. Yeh poore jism par kaam karti hai, khaas taur par taangon, core aur kandhon ko target karti hai. Yeh harkat beginners, joron ki hassasiyat wale logon, ya heart rate aahista aahista barhane ke liye dynamic warm-up ke taur par behtareen hai.
Notes (Hidayat):
Seedhe khare ho jayein, paon aapas mein mile hon aur baazu side par hon.
Right paon ko side ki taraf bahar rakhein aur saath hi dono baazu jhula kar sar ke oopar le jayein.
Right paon ko wapas beech mein layein aur baazu neeche kar lein.
Foran harkat dohrayein, is baar left paon bahar rakhein.
Ek jaisi, rhythm wali raftaar se baari baari sides badalte rahein.

Step Mill.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye stepmill par chadhein aur menu se pasandeeda option chunein. Aap manual setting chun sakte hain, ya koi program chala sakte hain. Aam tor par aap apni umar aur wazan daal kar exercise ke dauran jalne wali calories ka andaza laga sakte hain. Seedhiyan chadhte hue ehtiyat karein taake thokar na lage. Mashwara hai ke handles par grip barqarar rakhein taake gir na jayein.
Stepmills aasani, dil aur saans ke fawaid deti hain, aur aam tor par bahar daurne se kam jhatka deti hain jab ke calories taqreeban utni hi jalti hain. Yeh aam tor par doosre cardio equipment se kaafi zyada mushkil hoti hain. 150 lb ka shakhs aam tor par 30 minute mein 300 se zyada calories jalata hai, jab ke chalne mein taqreeban 175 calories jalti hain.

Step Up Single Leg Balance with Bicep Cu.name_ur: Step Up Ek taang par Balance Biceps Curl ke saath Dumbbells se
Step Up Single Leg Balance with Bicep Cu.instructions_ur:
Yeh advanced exercise hai. Is exercise mein step up aur biceps curl dono shamil hain.
Apne saamne ek box ya bench rakhein.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan oopar ki taraf hon.
Kamar seedhi rakhein, kandhe peeche aur pait andar khencha ho.
Ek taang se box par chadhein aur doosri taang oopar uthayein (jaise agla qadam le rahe hon).
Step ke oopar pohanch kar baazuon ko curl karein, biceps ko kandhon ki taraf layein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur taang badal lein.

Step-Up.instructions_ur: Bench ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Step-up with Knee Raise.instructions_ur:
Munasib unchai ke box ya bench ki taraf munh kar ke paon aapas mein mila kar khare ho jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Left paon bench ke oopar rakh kar step up karte hue harkat shuru karein. Aage wali taang ke kulhe aur ghutne ko seedha kar ke box par khare ho jayein. Jab left taang par box par khare hon, to right ghutna aur kulha mor kar ghutne ko jitna ho sake oopar layein.
Harkat ulat kar box se neeche utrein, aur phir doosri taang par yeh silsila dohrayein.

Stiff Leg Barbell Good Morning.instructions_ur:
Hifazat ke liye yeh exercise squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai. Shuru karne ke liye bar ko rack par apne qad ke mutabiq set karein. Sahi unchai chun kar aur bar load kar ke, bar ke neeche aa jayein aur kandhon ka peechla hissa (gardan se zara neeche) us par rakhein.
Dono baazuon se bar ko dono taraf pakrein aur pehle taangon se dhakel kar aur saath hi dhad seedha kar ke use rack se utha lein.
Rack se hat jayein aur taangein kandhon ke barabar darmiyani stance mein rakhein. Har waqt sar oopar rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigar sakta hai, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Taangein saakit rakhte hue, saans andar lete waqt kulhon se jhuk kar dhad ko aage le jayein. Dhad ko tab tak neeche layein jab tak woh farsh ke parallel na ho jaye.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue dhad ko wapas shuruati position tak utha kar bar uthana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Stiff-Leg Deadlift.instructions_ur: barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Stiff-Legged Barbell Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Bar ko overhand grip (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) se pakrein. Agar kaafi zyada wazan istemal kar rahe hain to wrist wraps ki zaroorat par sakti hai.
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare hon aur taangein kandhon ke barabar ya us se tang stance mein hon. Ghutne thore mude hon. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Ghutne saakit rakhte hue, kamar seedhi rakh kar kulhon se jhukein aur barbell ko paon ke upar tak neeche layein. Aage jhukte rahein jaise farsh se koi cheez uthane wale hon, jab tak hamstrings mein stretch mehsoos na ho. Yeh harkat karte hue saans andar lein.
Kulhe seedhe karte hue dhad ko dobara seedha upar layein jab tak wapas shuruati position mein na aa jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Do dumbbells pakar kar unhein baazu seedhe kar ke jism ki side par rakhein.
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare hon aur taangon ka faasla kandhon ke barabar ya us se tang stance mein ho. Ghutne thode mude hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ghutnon ko saakit rakhte hue, kamar seedhi rakh kar kulhon se aage jhukein aur dumbbells ko paon ke upar tak neeche layein. Aage jhukte rahein jaise farsh se kuch uthane wale hon jab tak hamstrings mein stretch mehsoos na ho. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein
Kulhe aur kamar seedhe karte hue dhad ko dobara seedha upar lana shuru karein jab tak wapas shuruati position mein na aa jayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Stomach Vacuum.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar seedhe khare ho jayein. Haath kulhon par rakhein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Ab aahista aahista jitni ho sake hawa andar lein aur phir jitni ho sake saans bahar nikaalna shuru karein, saath hi pait ko jitna ho sake andar khenchein aur is position ko rokein. Tasawwur karein ke aapki naaf reerh ki haddi ko chhoo rahi hai.
Ek isometric contraction taqreeban 20 seconds ka hota hai. 20 second hold ke dauran normal saans lene ki koshish karein. Phir saans andar lein aur pait ko wapas shuruati position mein le aayein.
Jab is exercise ki practice ho jaye to ise 20 seconds se zyada karne ki koshish karein. Tip: Aap aahista aahista 40-60 seconds tak pohanch sakte hain.
Jitne sets tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Stork Stance Bicep Curl with Dumbbells.name_ur: Stork Stance Biceps Curl Dumbbells ke saath
Stork Stance Bicep Curl with Dumbbells.instructions_ur:
Dono haathon mein ek ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan oopar ki taraf hon.
Ek paon par khare ho kar doosra paon peeche ki taraf seedha karein (tasveer dekhein) aur baazu neeche seedhe karein taake woh taang ke saamne latke hon.
Ek paon par rehte hue biceps sukerte hue baazuon ko oopar curl karein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aayein aur taang badal lein.
Note: Yeh exercise sahi tareeqe se karna kisi Personal Trainer ya Instructor se seekhein.

Straight Arm Push Down.instructions_ur:
Wide grip pull down bar ko chauri grip se pakrein taake haath bar ke us hisse par hon jo neeche ki taraf mudta hai.
Pait andar khench kar seedhe khare hon.
Kohniyon mein halka sa mor aur kalaiyan mazboot rakhte hue bar ko shuruati position se raanon ke oopri hisse tak neeche khenchein.
Control ke saath bar ko wapas shuruati position tak oopar layein.

Straight Bar Bench Mid Rows.instructions_ur:
Loaded barbell ko bench ke sire par rakhein. Bar ke peeche bench par khare ho kar darmiyani, pronated grip lein. Kulhe peeche aur seena upar rakh kar khare hon, reerh ki haddi neutral rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Shoulder blades peeche khinch kar aur kohniyan mod kar bar ko dhad tak row karein. Control wali harkat karein, koi jhatka na ho.
Thoda rukne ke baad, aahista aahista bar ko shuruati position mein wapas layein, aur poora neeche tak jana yaqeeni banayein.

Straight Bar Cable Curls.instructions_ur: Cable Tower ke saamne seedhe khare ho kar straight bar istemal karein

Straight Raises on Incline Bench.instructions_ur:
Incline bench ke sar wale hisse ke peeche zameen par bar rakhein.
Bench par ulte let jayein. Pronated grip ke saath, baazu seedhe rakhte hue barbell ko zameen se uthayein. Bar ko seedha neeche latakne dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Shuru karne ke liye baazu seedhe rakhte hue barbell ko sar ke saamne upar uthayein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par ek dumbbell khara kar ke rakhein.
Yaqeeni banayein ke dumbbell bench ke oopar mazbooti se rakha ho, phir bench ke perpendicular let jayein (dhad bench ke aar paar, jaise cross ban raha ho) aur sirf kandhe bench par hon. Kulhe bench se neeche hon aur taangein mudi hon, paon farsh par mazbooti se jame hon. Sar bhi bench se bahar hoga.
Dumbbell ko dono haathon se pakrein aur seene ke oopar baazu seedhe kar ke thamein. Dono hatheliyan dumbbell ki ek side ke neeche wale hisse ko daba rahi hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ehtiyat: Hamesha yaqeeni banayein ke is exercise ke liye istemal hone wala dumbbell mehfooz ho. Dheeli plates wala dumbbell khul kar aap ke chehre par gir sakta hai.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue saans andar lein aur weight ko aahista aahista sar ke peeche gol daire mein neeche layein jab tak seene mein stretch mehsoos na ho.
Us point par dumbbell ko usi daire ke raaste wapas shuruati position mein layein jis se neeche kiya tha, aur yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Weight ko shuruati position par ek second rokein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Straight-Arm Pulldown.instructions_ur: cable machine ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Stride Jump Crossover.instructions_ur:
Box ki side par khare hon aur andar wala paon box ke upar kinare ke qareeb rakhein.
Baazu upar jhulate hue upar wali taang se zor lagayein aur jitna ooncha ho sake jump karein. Mukhalif ghutne ko upar le jaane ki koshish karein.
Shuru wali position ke ulat, box ki doosri side par utrein. Jo paon pehle box par tha woh ab zameen par hoga, aur doosra paon ab box par hoga.
Harkat dohrayein, wapas doosri side par cross karein.

Sumo Deadlift.instructions_ur: Barbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Sumo Deadlift with Bands.instructions_ur:
Chhote bands ke saath deadlift karne ke liye, shuru karne se pehle unhein bas bar ke upar daal dein, aur set up karne ke liye un ke andar qadam rakhein. Yaqeeni banayein ke woh paon ke pichle aadhe hisse ke neeche hon, bilkul wahan jahan aap farsh par zor laga rahe hain.
Zameen par load ki hui bar se shuru karein. Bar ke paas is tarah aayein ke bar paon ke beech se guzre. Paon bohat chaure, collars ke qareeb rakhein. Kulhon se jhuk kar bar pakren. Baazu kandhon ke bilkul neeche, taangon ke andar hon, aur aap pronated grip, mixed grip ya hook grip istemal kar sakte hain.
Saans lein, aur phir kulhe neeche karein, sar se saamne dekhein aur seena upar rakhein. Farsh par zor lagayein, paon ko bahar ki taraf phailate hue, wazan paon ke pichle aadhe hisse par rakhein. Kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karein.
Jab bar ghutnon se guzre, to peeche jhukein aur kulhon ko bar ki taraf dhakelein, kandhe ki haddiyon ko aapas mein milayein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar aur neeche aate hue weight ko control karte hue weight ko wapas zameen par rakhein.

Sumo Deadlift with Chains.instructions_ur:
Aap chains ko bar ki sleeves se laga sakte hain, ya un ka darmiyani hissa bar ke upar latka sakte hain taake uthate hue weight zyada barhe. Chains ke siron ko plates se door rakhne ki koshish karein taake weight neeche laate hue woh plates se na takrayein.
Zameen par load ki hui bar se shuru karein. Bar ke paas is tarah aayein ke bar paon ke beech se guzre. Paon bohat chaure, collars ke qareeb rakhein. Kulhon se jhuk kar bar pakren. Baazu kandhon ke bilkul neeche, taangon ke andar hon, aur aap pronated grip, mixed grip ya hook grip istemal kar sakte hain. Kandhe dheele chhorein, is se darasal aap ke baazu lambe ho jate hain.
Saans lein, aur phir kulhe neeche karein, sar se saamne dekhein aur seena upar rakhein. Farsh par zor lagayein, paon ko bahar ki taraf phailate hue, wazan paon ke pichle aadhe hisse par rakhein. Kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karein.
Jab bar ghutnon se guzre, to peeche jhukein aur kulhon ko bar ki taraf dhakelein, kandhe ki haddiyon ko aapas mein milayein.
Kulhon se jhuk kar aur neeche aate hue weight ko control karte hue weight ko wapas zameen par rakhein.

Superman.instructions_ur:
Pait ke bal seedhe let jayein aur baazu saamne ki taraf phaila dein.
Baazu aur taangein farsh se oopar uthayein aur is position ko 2 seconds rokein.
Farsh par shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Dohrayein.

Supine Chest Throw.instructions_ur:
Yeh drill chest passes ke liye zabardast hai jab aapke paas partner ya kaafi mazboot deewar na ho. Zameen par kamar ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude hue.
Ball ko seene par rakh kar shuru karein, dono haathon se neeche se pakre hue.
Dhamake ke saath upar, kohni seedhi karte hue ball ko seedha apne upar jitna ho sake ooncha phenkein.
Neeche aate hue ball ko dono haathon se pakrein.

Supine One-Arm Overhead Throw.name_ur: Seedhe let kar Ek baazu se Overhead Throw
Supine One-Arm Overhead Throw.instructions_ur:
Zameen par kamar ke bal let jayein aur ghutne mor lein. Ek haath se ball pakrein aur baazu ko sar ke peeche poori tarah seedha karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kandhe se harkat shuru karein, aur uthte hue ball ko seedha apne saamne phenkein, zyada se zyada faasle ki koshish karein.
Ball partner ki taraf phenki ja sakti hai ya deewar se takra kar wapas li ja sakti hai.

Supine Two-Arm Overhead Throw.name_ur: Seedhe let kar Dono baazu se Overhead Throw
Supine Two-Arm Overhead Throw.instructions_ur:
Zameen par kamar ke bal let jayein aur ghutne mude hon.
Ball ko dono haathon se pakrein, aur baazu sar ke peeche poori tarah seedhe karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Harkat kandhe se shuru karein, aur uthte hue ball ko seedha apne saamne phenkein, zyada se zyada door phenkne ki koshish karein.
Ball partner ko phenki ja sakti hai ya deewar se takra kar wapas li ja sakti hai.

Supported Calf Stretch.instructions_ur: Exercise samajhne ke liye video dekhein

Suspended Crossess.instructions_ur: Seene ki training ke liye TRX ke saath suspension exercise

Suspended Fallout.instructions_ur:
Straps ko is tarah adjust karein ke handles munasib oonchai par, kamar se neeche hon.
Khare ho kar handles pakad kar shuru karein. Straps par jhukte hue incline push-up position mein aa jayein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu seedhe rakhte hue suspension straps par mazeed jhukein, jism ko zameen ke qareeb le jayein, kandhon ko khulne dein aur baazuon ko upar aur sar ke upar le jayein.
Reerh ki haddi neutral rakhein aur baqi jism seedha rakhein; sirf kandhon ke jor harkat karein.
Poore contraction par rukein, aur phir wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Suspended Push-Up.instructions_ur:
Suspension straps ko rack ke upar ya kisi aur cheez se mazbooti se bandhein.
Straps ki taraf jhukte hue, har haath mein ek handle lein aur push-up plank position mein aa jayein. Baazu poore seedhe rakhte hue aur achha posture barqarar rakhte hue, jitna ho sake zameen ke mutawazi hon.
Dhad seedha aur sakht rakhte hue, kohniyan mudne de kar aahista aahista neeche jayein.
Jab tak kohniyan 90 degree se zyada na mur jayein jaari rakhein, phir ruk kar seedha karte hue shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Suspended Reverse Crunch.instructions_ur:
Suspension straps ko is tarah lagayein ke handles zameen se takreeban ek foot upar latke hon. Rack ki taraf peeth kar ke pushup plank position mein aa jayein.
Paon handles mein daal dein. Posture seedha rakhein, kulhon ko neeche latakne na dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutne aur kulhe mor kar harkat shuru karein, ghutnon ko dhad ki taraf layein. Sath hi pelvis ko aage ki taraf jhukayein, taake reerh ki haddi mud sake.
Control wali harkat ke upar pohanch kar shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Suspended Row.instructions_ur:
Straps ko taqreeban seene ki unchai par latkayein. Har haath mein ek handle pakrein aur peeche jhukein. Jism seedha aur sar aur seena upar rakhein. Baazu poori tarah seedhe hone chahiyein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kohni mor kar harkat shuru karein. Saath hi shoulder blades ko aage phailayein.
Harkat mukammal hone par rukein, aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Suspended Split Squat.instructions_ur:
Straps ko aise latkayein ke handles zameen se 18-30 inch upar hon.
Setup se munh pher kar, pichla paon peeche wale handle mein rakhein. Sar saamne aur seena upar rakhein, ghutna thora mura hua. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ghutna aur kulhe mor kar zameen ki taraf neeche jayein. Wazan paon ki eri par rakhein aur poori exercise ke dauran posture barqarar rakhein.
Harkat ke neeche, harkat ulat dein, kulha aur ghutna seedha karte hue shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

Svend Press.instructions_ur:
Khare ho kar shuru karein.
Do halki plates ko haathon se aapas mein dabayein. Plates ko seene ke qareeb aapas mein dabaye rakhein taa ke seene ke muscles mein isometric contraction paida ho. Ungliyan saamne ki taraf honi chahiyein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Plates ko hatheliyon ke darmiyan sukerein aur control ke saath baazu seedhe apne saamne phailayein.
Harkat ke top par rukein, aur phir aahista aahista shuruati position mein wapas aayein.

T-Bar Row with Handle.instructions_ur:
Bar ko landmine mein ya kone mein rakhein taake woh hile nahi. Apni taraf wale sire par munasib weight lagayein.
Bar ke upar khare hon, aur collar ke qareeb bar ke gird Double D row handle lagayein. Kulhon aur taangon ki madad se khare ho jayein.
Chauri stance banayein, kulhe peeche aur seena upar rakhein. Baazu seedhe hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kandhe ki haddiyon (shoulder blades) ko peeche kheench kar aur kohniyan mod kar weight ko pait ke upar wale hisse tak kheenchein. Harkat ke dauran weight ko jhatka na dein aur cheating na karein.
Thoda ruk kar, wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

TRX Rows.instructions_ur: Yeh exercise Pull Ups ki tayyari ke liye hai.

Talons Fesses.instructions_ur: Ediyon ko kulhon se chhuayein, ek jagah khare rehte hue ya chalte hue

Tate Press.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein, har haath mein ek dumbbell raanon ke oopar ho. Hatheliyan aamne saamne hon.
Raanon ki madad se dumbbells ko oopar layein, ek ek baazu se clean karein taake unhein apne saamne kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakar sakein. Note: dumbbells saamne pakarte waqt yaqeeni banayein ke baazu kandhon ke faasle se zyada khule hon aur grip pronated (hatheliyan aage) ho. Kohniyan bahar ki taraf rahne dein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Baazu ka oopri hissa sakit rakhte hue, saans andar lete hue dumbbells ko aahista aahista andar aur neeche aadhe daire ki shakal mein layein jab tak woh seene ke oopri hisse ko na chhoo lein. Dumbbells par hamesha poora control rakhein, baazu ka oopri hissa na hilayein aur dumbbells seene par na tikayein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue triceps se dumbbells ko usi aadhe daire ki shakal mein ulta oopar le jayein. Oopar jaate hue dumbbells ko saath rakhne ki koshish karein. Sukri hui position mein baazu lock karein, ek second rokein aur phir aahista aahista dobara neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein oopar jaane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Apne training program ke mutabiq jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

The Straddle.instructions_ur:
Seedhe baith kar shuru karein. Taangein apne saamne V ki shakal mein phaila lein.
Haath farsh par rakh kar jitna ho sake aage jhukein. 10 se 20 second rokein.

Thigh Abductor.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye abductor machine par baith jayein aur aisa weight chunein jis mein aap aaram mehsoos karein. Taangein sahi position mein set ho jayein to dono taraf ke handles pakar lein. Poora oopri jism (kamar se oopar) sakit rahe. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aahista aahista taangon se machine ko dabayein taake taangein ek doosre se door hon.
Ek second tak contraction mehsoos karein aur saans andar lete hue taangon ko wapas shuruati position mein lana shuru karein. Note: Chot se bachne ke liye oopri jism ko sakit rakhna yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Thigh Adductor.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye adductor machine par baith jayein aur aisa weight chunein jis mein aap aaram mehsoos karein. Taangein machine ke leg pads par sahi position mein set ho jayein to dono taraf ke handles pakar lein. Poora oopri jism (kamar se oopar) sakit rahe. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue aahista aahista taangon se machine ko dabayein taake taangein ek doosre ki taraf aayein.
Ek second tak contraction mehsoos karein aur saans andar lete hue taangon ko wapas shuruati position mein lana shuru karein. Note: Chot se bachne ke liye oopri jism ko sakit rakhna aur tez jhatkon wali harkat se bachna yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Tire Flip.instructions_ur:
Tire ke nichle hisse ko tread se pakar kar shuru karein, aur paon thore peeche rakhein. Aap ka seena tire mein zor laga raha ho.
Tire uthane ke liye kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karein, tire mein aur upar zor lagate hue.
Jab tire 45 degree ke angle par pohanche to aage qadam rakhein aur ek ghutna tire mein maarein. Saath hi grip ko tire ke upar wale hisse par badlein aur use jitna zor se ho sake aage dhakel kar palat dein. Zaroorat ke mutabiq dohrayein.

Toe Touchers.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye farsh ya exercise mat par let jayein, kamar farsh ke saath dabi ho. Baazu side par pade hon aur hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon.
Taangein aapas mein mili hon. Aahista aahista taangein hawa mein uthayein yahan tak ke woh taqreeban farsh ke amoodi hon aur ghutnon mein halka sa mod ho. Paon farsh ke mutawazi hone chahiye.
Baazuon ko is tarah karein ke woh farsh se 45 degree ke zaviye par poori tarah seedhe hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Kamar ka nichla hissa farsh ke saath daba rakhte hue, aahista aahista dhad uthayein aur haathon se paon ki ungliyan chhoone ki koshish karein. Exercise ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalna yaad rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dhad aur baazuon ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein. Baazu seedhe paon ki ungliyon ki taraf rakhna yaad rakhein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Torso Rotation.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho kar exercise ball ko dono haathon se pakrein. Baazu phailayein taake ball bilkul saamne seedhi ho. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Dhad ko ek taraf ghumayein, harkat karte hue nazar ball par rakhein. Ab wapas doosri simt mein ghumayein. 10-20 reps dohrayein.

Torso Twist.instructions_ur: Khare ho kar Torso Twist Workout. Is dynamic khari exercise se apne core ko target karein aur flexibility behtar karein! Khare ho kar Torso Twist Workout mein paon aur kulhe mustahkam rakhte hue dhad ko ghumaya jata hai, jis se obliques kaam karte hain aur poore upar wale jism ka stretch hota hai. Yeh harkat in cheezon mein madad karti hai: core muscles mazboot karna, reerh ki haddi aur dhad mein flexibility badhana, posture aur balance behtar karna, aur overall athletic performance badhana. Is asar daar aur kaar aamad workout ke faide mehsoos karne ke liye 10-15 reps ke 3 sets karein, har side par ghoomte hue!

Trail Running/Walking.instructions_ur:
Trails par daurna ya hiking karna khoon ki gardish aur dil ki dharkan foran tez kar deta hai. Yaqeeni banayein ke aap ke joote achhe hon. Pahari par charhte hue aap pindliyon aur kulhon ke muscles istemal karte hain, jabke neeche utarte hue zyada tar jhatke ghutne, jor aur takhne jazb karte hain. Neeche utarte hue chhote qadam lein, jhatka kam karne ke liye ghutne mude hue rakhein aur girne se bachne ke liye raftar kam rakhein.
150 lb wazan wala shakhs pahari par 30 minute chal kar 200 se zyada calories jala sakta hai, jabke seedhi zameen par 175. Agar trail par daurein to 150 lb wazan wala shakhs 30 minute mein 500 se kaafi zyada calories jala sakta hai.

Trap Bar Deadlift.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye zameen par rakhe trap bar, jise hex bar bhi kehte hain, par munasib wazan lagayein. Apparatus ke beech mein khare ho jayein aur dono handles pakrein.
Kulhe neeche layein, sar se aage dekhein aur seena upar rakhein.
Aediyon se zor lagate hue aur kulhe aur ghutne seedhe karte hue harkat shuru karein. Har waqt kamar golai mein morne se bachein.
Harkat mukammal hone par wazan ko control ke saath wapas zameen par layein.

Trap Press.instructions_ur: Seedhe let kar baazu seedha upar ki taraf ho aur kohni poori tarah seedhi ho, sirf kandhe se wazan ko jitna aaram se ho sake upar uthayein aur wapas aaram ki position mein layein.

Treadmill Cardio.instructions_ur:
Yeh treadmill par kiya jaane wala cardio workout hai jo stamina barhata hai, calories jalata hai aur dil ki sehat ko behtar banata hai. Is ke kai faide hain, jaise speed aur incline ko aasani se badalna, jis se mukhtalif workouts mumkin hain, unchai par walking se le kar high-intensity interval training (HIIT) aur tempo runs tak. Behtareen nataij ke liye apne workouts badalte rehna zaroori hai.
Treadmill Cardio ke Faide:
Dil ki Behtar Sehat:
Treadmill par baqaida aerobic exercise dil aur phephron ko mazboot karti hai, jo dil ki beemari se bachao mein madad kar sakti hai.
Wazan Kam Karna:
Calories jala kar, treadmill training wazan kam karne aur sehatmand wazan barqarar rakhne ka asar daar zariya ho sakti hai.
Muscles Mazboot Karna:
Yeh taangon aur glutes ke muscles ko mazboot karti hai, aur muscles ki kami se bachane mein madad karti hai, jo umar ke saath khaas tor par ahem hai.
Training mein Lachak:
Aap speed, incline aur intervals badal sakte hain, jis se workout zyada dynamic aur mukhtalif fitness levels ke mutabiq ban jata hai.
Treadmill Training ki Qismein:
Hill Walking:
Treadmill ka incline barha kar tez qadmon se chalna stamina behtar karta hai aur taangon ke muscles par kaam karta hai.
Endurance Jog:
Aaramdeh, ek jaisi raftaar se daurna jo dil ki dharkan ko target zone (jaise Zone 2) mein rakhe taa ke stamina bane.
Interval Training:
Zyada shiddat (tez daurna) aur kam shiddat (aaram se chalna ya jogging) ke waqfe baari baari karna taa ke zyada se zyada calories jalein aur dil ki sehat behtar ho.
Tempo Run:
Ek jaisi, musalsal raftaar se daurna jo aam jog se thori tez ho, jo lambe arse tak zyada shiddat wali koshish barqarar rakhne ki salahiyat ko challenge karti hai.

Treadmill Run.instructions_ur: treadmill ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Treadmill Walk.instructions_ur: treadmill ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Tricep Dips using Body Weight.instructions_ur:
Parallel bars pakrein aur khud ko oopar dhakel kar shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakhte hue khud ko neeche layein jab tak triceps farsh ke parallel na ho jayein.
Aahista aahista khud ko wapas shuruati position tak oopar uthayein.
Note: Is exercise ke dauran pait andar khencha aur jism seedha rakhein.

Tricep Dips using Machine.instructions_ur:
Machine ki seat aise set karein ke handles aap ki kohniyon ke barabar hon.
Handles pakar kar barabar zor ke saath neeche dabayein jab tak baazu poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein.
Ruk kar phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Tricep Dumbbell Kickback.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan dhad ki taraf hon. Kamar seedhi rakhein, ghutne halke se mude hon aur kamar se aage jhukein. Dhad taqreeban farsh ke parallel ho. Sar oopar rakhna yaad rakhein. Baazu ka oopri hissa dhad ke qareeb aur farsh ke parallel ho. Weight pakarte waqt forearms farsh ki taraf hon. Forearm aur baazu ke oopri hisse ke darmiyan 90-degree ka angle bane. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ab baazu ka oopri hissa sakit rakhte hue saans bahar nikaalein aur triceps se weight uthayein jab tak baazu poora seedha na ho jaye. Dhyan forearm ko hilane par rakhein.
Oopar contraction par thora ruk kar saans andar lein aur aahista aahista dumbbells ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Tricep Rope Pushdowns.instructions_ur:
Cable machine ke saamne khare hon aur high pulley par rope laga lein.
Rope ko hatheliyan neeche ki taraf rakh kar pakrein.
Pait andar khenchein aur kamar seedhi rakhein.
Kohniyan side par rakhte hue rope ko raanon ki taraf neeche dhakelein, ho sake to neeche pohanch kar rope ko “alag” kar dein.
Thori der rokein aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Note: Behtar stance ke liye aap ek paon doosre se thora aage rakh sakte hain.

Tricep Side Stretch.instructions_ur: Daayan baazu jism ke aar paar le ja kar baayen kandhe ke upar laayein, baayen haath se kohni pakren, yahan tak ke tricep mein stretch mehsoos ho. Phir doosre baazu se dohrayein.

Triceps Extensions on Cable.instructions_ur: Cable pakrein, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, kamar seedhi rakhein aur thora sa aage jhukein. Bar ko neeche dhakelein, yaqeeni banayein ke exercise ke dauran kohniyan na hilein. Bilkul aakhir mein haathon ko bahar ki taraf ghumayein aur baghair ruke shuruati position mein wapas jayein.

Triceps Pushdown.instructions_ur: Cable rope push-down triceps muscles ke liye ek mashhoor exercise hai. Ise seekhna aur karna aasaan hai, is liye beginners se le kar advanced lifters tak sab ise pasand karte hain. Yeh aam taur par upper-body ya arms wale workout mein moderate se high reps, jaise har set mein 8-12 reps ya zyada, ke saath ki jaati hai.

Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment.instructions_ur:
High pulley par rope attachment lagayein aur neutral grip (hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf) se pakrein.
Dhad seedha aur bohat thora sa aage jhuka rakh kar seedhe khare hon, upper arms jism ke qareeb aur zameen ke seedhe khare (perpendicular) rakhein. Forearms pulley ki taraf upar hon aur rope ko hatheliyan ek doosre ki taraf kar ke pakre hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Triceps istemal karte hue rope ko neeche layein aur rope ke dono siron ko raanon ke pehluon tak le jayein. Harkat ke aakhir mein baazu poori tarah seedhe aur zameen ke perpendicular hon. Upper arms hamesha dhad ke paas saakit rehne chahiyein aur sirf forearms hilne chahiyein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Sukerne wali position mein ek second rokne ke baad, rope ko aahista aahista shuruati point tak upar layein. Yeh step karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Triceps Pushdown - V-Bar Attachment.instructions_ur:
High pulley par V-Bar lagayein aur kandhon ke barabar overhand grip (hatheliyan neeche) se pakrein.
Dhad seedha aur bohat thoda aage jhuka rakh kar khare hon, baazu ke upar wale hisse jism ke qareeb aur farsh ke perpendicular layein. Bar pakarte hue forearms upar pulley ki taraf hon. Angoothe chhoti ungli se ooncha hona chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Triceps ki madad se bar ko neeche layein jab tak woh raanon ke agle hisse ko na chhoo le aur baazu farsh ke perpendicular poori tarah seedhe na ho jayein. Baazu ke upar wale hisse hamesha dhad ke saath saakit rahein aur sirf forearms hilein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Sukri hui position par ek second rok kar, V-Bar ko aahista aahista shuruati jagah tak upar layein. Is step ke dauran saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Triceps Pushdown with V Bar and Cable.instructions_ur:
