Triceps Stretch.instructions_ur: Haath sar ke peeche le jayein, kohni pakrein aur aahista se kheenchein. 10 se 20 second rokein, phir side badlein.

Triceps Stretch Left.instructions_ur: Baayan haath kamar par rakhein, daayen haath se baayin kohni pakad kar narmi se khinchein. Is position ko kuch seconds rokein.

Triceps Stretch Right.instructions_ur: Daayan haath kamar par peeche rakhein, baayein haath se daayein kohni pakrein aur ehtiyat se kheenchein. Is position ko kuch seconds rokein.

Tuck Crunch.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye, farsh ya exercise mat par kamar ko farsh se laga kar let jayein. Baazu side par hon aur hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon.
Ek takhne ko doosre ke gird lapet kar taangein cross karein. Aahista aahista taangein hawa mein uthayein jab tak raanein farsh ke perpendicular na ho jayein aur ghutnon mein halka sa kham ho. Note: Raanon ke bajaye ghutne aur paon ki ungliyan farsh ke parallel honi chahiyein.
Baazu farsh se utha kar cross karein taake woh seene par tike hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Kamar ka nichla hissa farsh se laga rakhte hue, aahista aahista dhad uthayein. Exercise ke is hisse mein saans bahar nikaalna yaad rakhein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dhad ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche lana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Tuck Planche.instructions_ur: Full planche ke liye bunyadi calisthenics progression

Two-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl.name_ur: Dono baazu se Dumbbell Preacher Curl
Two-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl.instructions_ur:
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein aur baazu ka oopri hissa preacher bench ya incline bench ke oopar rakhein. Dumbbell kandhon ki oonchai par pakra ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista dumbbells neeche layein jab tak baazu ka oopri hissa seedha na ho jaye aur biceps poori tarah stretch na ho jayein.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue biceps se weight ko oopar curl karein jab tak biceps poori tarah sukar na jayein aur dumbbells kandhon ki oonchai par na aa jayein.
Sukri hui position mein biceps ko ek second zor se dabayein aur jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Two-Arm Kettlebell Clean.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells apne paon ke darmiyan rakhein. Shuruati position mein aane ke liye kulhe peeche dhakelein aur seedha saamne dekhein.
Taangein aur kulhe seedhe karte hue kettlebells ko kandhon ki taraf utha kar clean karein. Aisa karte hue kalaiyan ghumayein.
Kettlebells ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche laayein aur dohrayein.

Two-Arm Kettlebell Jerk.instructions_ur: Do kettlebells ko kandhon tak clean karein. Taangon aur kulhon ko seedha karte hue kettlebells ko kandhon ki taraf jhula kar kandhon tak clean karein. Aisa karte waqt kalaiyan ghumayein taake hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon. Kuch inch neeche squat karein aur tezi se harkat ulat kar dono kettlebells ko sar ke oopar le jayein. Shuruati push ke foran baad dobara neeche squat karein aur kettlebells ke neeche aa jayein. Jab kettlebells lock ho jayein to exercise mukammal karne ke liye seedhe khare ho jayein.

Two-Arm Kettlebell Military Press.name_ur: Dono baazu se Kettlebell Military Press
Two-Arm Kettlebell Military Press.instructions_ur:
Do kettlebells ko kandhon tak clean karein. Taangein aur kulhe seedhe karte hue kettlebells ko kandhon ki taraf jhula kar kandhon tak clean karein. Saath hi kalaiyan ghumayein taa ke hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon.
Kettlebells ko upar aur bahar ki taraf press karein. Jab kettlebells sar se guzrein, weights ki taraf jhukein taa ke kettlebells sar ke peeche rack ho jayein. Zyada mazbooti ke liye lats, kulhe aur pait ke muscles sukerna yaqeeni banayein.

Two-Arm Kettlebell Row.instructions_ur:
Paon ke saamne do kettlebells rakhein. Ghutne thore modein aur phir aage jhukte hue kulhe jitna ho sake peeche nikaalein taa ke shuruati position mein aa jayein.
Dono kettlebells pakrein aur unhein pait ki taraf kheenchein, shoulder blades peeche kheenchte hue aur kohniyan modte hue. Kamar seedhi rakhein. Neeche layein aur dohrayein.

Underhand Pull down.instructions_ur:
Seedhe baith kar pait andar khench lein aur Pull Down bar ko ulti grip se kandhon ke barabar faasle par pakrein.
Kohniyan jism ke qareeb rakhte hue bar ko neeche khenchein jab tak bar seene ke oopri hisse tak na pohanch jaye.
Aahista aahista bar ko shuruati position mein wapas layein.
Dohrayein.

Unilateral Cable row.instructions_ur: Cable row machine ke saamne vertical seated bench rakhein. Use is tarah rakhein ke aap ek side par focus kar sakein, aur phir aahista pulls karein, lats par focus karte hue aur stretched position mein un muscles mein tension yaqeeni banate hue.

Upper Back Stretch.instructions_ur: Ungliyan aapas mein phansayein, angoothe neeche ki taraf hon, aur haathon ko aage le jate hue kandhon ko gol karein.

Upper Back-Leg Grab.instructions_ur:
Baithe hue, aage jhukein aur dono baazuon se raanon ko neeche se gale lagayein.
Ghutne saath rakhein aur taangein aage seedhi rakhte hue seene ko ghutnon tak neeche layein. Raanon ko pakre hue kamar ko ghutnon se door kheench kar kamar ke darmiyani hisse ko bhi stretch kar sakte hain.

Upright Band Rows.instructions_ur:
Band par aise khare hon ke handles raan ke oopri hisse ke barabar hon.
Kamar seedhi aur pait andar khench kar haathon ko oopar hasli ki haddi (collarbone) tak uthayein.
Kohniyan aur baazu farsh ke parallel hone chahiyein.
Aahista aahista baazu neeche layein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Upright Cable Row.instructions_ur:
Low pulley se juri straight bar cable attachment ko pronated (hatheliyan raanon ki taraf) grip se pakrein jo kandhon ke faasle se thori kam ho. Bar raanon ke oopar tiki ho. Baazu seedhe hon aur kohniyon mein halka sa mor ho, aur kamar seedhi ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ke side wale hisse se cable bar oopar uthayein. Oopar le jaate hue bar jism ke qareeb rahe. Ise tab tak uthayein jab tak yeh taqreeban thodi ko na chhoo le. Tip: Harkat kohniyon se honi chahiye. Bar uthate waqt kohniyan hamesha forearms se oonchi rahein. Dhad ko bhi sakit rakhein aur harkat ke oopar ek second ruk jayein.
Bar ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Upright Row.instructions_ur:
Barbell ko overhand grip se pakrein jo kandhon ke faasle se thori kam ho. Bar raanon ke oopar tiki ho, baazu seedhe hon aur kohniyon mein halka sa mor ho. Kamar bhi seedhi ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ab saans bahar nikaalein aur kandhon ke side wale hisse se bar uthayein, kohniyan oopar aur side ki taraf le jayein. Uthate waqt bar jism ke qareeb rakhein. Bar ko tab tak uthayein jab tak yeh taqreeban thodi ko na chhoo le. Tip: Harkat kohniyon se honi chahiye aur kohniyan hamesha forearms se oonchi rahein. Dhad ko sakit rakhna aur harkat ke oopar ek second rukna yaad rakhein.
Bar ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Upright Row - With Bands.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye exercise band par is tarah khare hon ke baazu ki lambai par tanaao shuru ho. Handles ko pronated grip (hatheliyan raanon ki taraf) se pakdein jo kandhon ki chaurai se thodi kam ho. Handles raanon ke upar tike hon. Baazu seedhe hon aur kohniyon mein halka sa mod ho aur kamar seedhi ho. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon ke side wale hisse se handles uthayein. Upar le jaate hue handles jism ke qareeb rehne chahiye. Handles uthate rahein yahan tak ke woh taqreeban thodi ko chhoo lein. Tip: Harkat kohniyon se chalni chahiye. Handles uthate hue kohniyan hamesha forearms se oonchi honi chahiye. Saath hi dhad ko saakit rakhein aur harkat ke top par ek second rukein.
Handles ko aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Upright Row w/ Dumbbells.instructions_ur: Har haath mein ek dumbbell jism ke saamne pakrein. Hatheliyan jism ki taraf rakhein. Haathon ko seedha upar uthayein jab tak haath thodi ke neeche na aa jayein, phir neeche layein. Exercise dohrayein.

Upright Row, SZ-bar.instructions_ur: Seedhe khare ho jayein, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. SZ-bar ko overhand grip se raanon par pakrein, baazu seedhe hon. Bar ko jism ke qareeb rakhte hue thodi tak uthayein. Kohniyan bahar ki taraf hon taake sab se oonche point par woh V ki shakal banayein. Yahan thora sa rukein phir aahista aahista neeche aayein aur harkat dohrayein.

Upright Row, on Multi Press.instructions_ur:
Harkatein basically SZ-bar wali hi hain, lekin aap multi press ki bar istemal karte hain:
Seedhe khare hon, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Bar ko overhand grip se raanon par pakrein, baazu seedhe hon. Bar ko jism ke qareeb rakhte hue thodi tak uthayein. Kohniyan bahar ki taraf hon taake sab se unche point par V shape banayein. Yahan thora rukein, phir aahista neeche aayein aur harkat dohrayein.

Upward Stretch.instructions_ur:
Dono haath seedhe sar ke oopar phailayein, hatheliyan aapas mein mili hon.
Kamar seedhi rakhte hue aahista aahista haathon ko oopar aur peeche dhakelein.

V-Bar Pulldown.instructions_ur:
Pull-down machine par baith jayein jis ke top pulley par V-Bar laga ho.
Machine ka knee pad apne qad ke mutabiq set karein. Yeh pads bar ke weight ki wajah se aap ke jism ko oopar uthne se rokte hain.
V-bar ko hatheliyan aamne saamne rakh kar (neutral grip) pakrein. Seena bahar nikaalein aur lats ko behtar engage karne ke liye thora sa (taqreeban 30-degrees) peeche jhukein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Lats ka istemal karte hue shoulder blades ko dabate hue bar ko neeche khenchein. Tab tak jaari rakhein jab tak seena taqreeban V-bar ko na chhoo le. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Poori harkat ke dauran dhad ko sakit rakhein.
Sukri hui position par ek second rok kar, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista bar ko wapas shuruati position mein layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

V-Bar Pullup.instructions_ur:
V-bar ke beech wale hisse ko pull-up bar ke beech mein rakh kar shuru karein (agar aap ke pull-up station mein neutral grip handles nahin hain). V-Bar ke handles neeche ki taraf honge taa ke aap handles ke zariye pull-up bar se latak sakein.
V-bar ko mazbooti se rakhne ke baad, dono taraf se bar pakrein aur us se latak jayein. Seena bahar nikaalein aur lats ko behtar tareeqe se active karne ke liye thora peeche jhukein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Lats istemal karte hue dhad ko upar kheenchein aur saath sar ko thora peeche jhukayein taa ke thodi chin-up bar se na takraye. Jab tak seena taqreeban V-bar ko na chhoo le jaari rakhein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Sukeri hui position mein ek second rokne ke baad, saans andar lete hue aahista aahista jism ko shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Vertical Swing.instructions_ur:
Dumbbell ko dono haathon se pakar kar taangon ke beech baazuon ki poori lambai par latakne dein. Kamar seedhi aur sar upar rakhein.
Kulhon se jhukte aur ghutne halke se morte hue dumbbell ko taangon ke beech jhulayein.
Kulhe, ghutne aur takhne zor se seedhe kar ke harkat ko ulat dein aur khud ko upar uchhalein, aur dumbbell ko sar ke upar jhulayein.
Utarte waqt, taangon se jhatka jazb karein aur agle rep se pehle dumbbell ko dhad ki taraf le aayein.

Walking Lunge.instructions_ur:
Shuruati position: Paon kulhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon aur haath kulhon par rakhein ya side par dumbbells pakrein.
Qadam: Daayin taang se aage ki taraf lamba qadam lein.
Neeche aana: Kulhe neeche layein jab tak dono ghutne taqreeban 90-degree angle par na mud jayein.
Agla qadam: Aage wale paon ki aedi se zor laga kar khare hon, aur peeche wala paon aage la kar seedha agle lunge mein qadam rakhein.

Walking, Treadmill.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye, treadmill par chadhein aur menu se pasandeeda option chunein. Zyada tar treadmills mein manual setting hoti hai, ya aap koi program chala sakte hain. Aam tor par aap apni umar aur wazan daal sakte hain taa ke exercise mein jalne wali calories ka andaza lagaya ja sake. Workout ki shiddat badalne ke liye unchai (elevation) set ki ja sakti hai.
Treadmills aasani, dil ke liye faide deti hain, aur aam tor par bahar chalne ke muqable mein jodon par kam asar daalti hain. Chalte waqt, darmiyani se tez raftaar se chalein, sust raftaar se nahin. Kam shiddat wali activity hone ki wajah se, walking kuch doosri activities jitni calories nahin jalati, lekin phir bhi bohat faida deti hai. 150 lb ka shakhs 30 minute tak 4 miles per hour par chal kar taqreeban 175 calories jalata hai, jabke do guna tez daurne par 450 calories. Chalte waqt sahi posture rakhein, aur handles sirf zaroorat par pakrein, jaise utarte waqt ya dil ki dharkan check karte waqt.

Wall Balls.instructions_ur: Medicine ball lein, kandhon ke barabar stance banayein, squat karein, ball ko deewar par jitna ooncha ho sake zor se phenkein aur pakar lein

Weighted Ball Hyperextension.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye exercise ball par is tarah let jayein ke dhad ball par daba ho aur farsh ke mutawazi ho. Balance ke liye paon ke panje farsh par dabe hon. Weight plate ko thodi ke neeche ya gardan ke peeche rakhein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Kulhon aur kamar ke nichle hisse se mod kar aahista aahista dhad upar uthayein. Yeh harkat karte hue saans bahar nikaalna yaad rakhein.
Kamar ke nichle hisse par contraction ek second rokein aur saans andar lete hue dhad ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Apne program mein jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Weighted Ball Side Bend.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye exercise ball par aise letein ke dhad ki baayin side (kamar, kulha aur kandha) ball se lagi ho.
Paon farsh par hon aur taangein cross ho kar ball se latki hon. Daayen haath se weight plate ko sar ki daayin taraf bilkul saath pakrein. Tip: Yaqeeni banayein ke plate ki hamwar side sar se lagi ho.
Baayan baazu dhad ke aar paar rakhein taake hatheli obliques par ho. Baayen forearm aur baazu ke oopri hisse ke darmiyan right angle (90 degree) ho. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kamar se side par jhuk kar dhad ki side ko oopar uthayein.
Contraction ko ek second rokein aur saans andar lete hue aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.
Side badal kar exercise dohrayein.

Weighted Bench Dip.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke liye ek bench apni kamar ke peeche aur doosra apne saamne rakhein. Benches jism ke perpendicular hon, ek bench ko uske kinare se pakrein, haath jism ke qareeb aur kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Baazu poori tarah seedhe hon.
Taangein aage doosre bench ke oopar seedhi rakhein. Taangein farsh ke parallel aur dhad farsh ke perpendicular ho. Apne partner se dumbbell apni god mein rakhwayein. Note: Yeh exercise partner ke saath karna behtar hai kyunke weight god mein rakhna mushkil ho sakta hai aur madad ke baghair chot lag sakti hai. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Saans andar lete hue kohniyan mor kar aahista aahista jism ko itna neeche layein ke upper arm aur forearm ke darmiyan 90 degree se thora kam angle ban jaye. Tip: Poori harkat mein kohniyan jitna ho sake qareeb rakhein. Forearms hamesha neeche ki taraf hone chahiyein.
Triceps se dhad ko wapas oopar laate hue, saans bahar nikaalte waqt khud ko shuruati position tak uthayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Weighted Crunches.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal seedhe let jayein, paon zameen par seedhe hon ya bench par tike hon aur ghutne 90 degree ke angle par mude hon.
Weight ko seene se laga kar pakrein, ya use dhad ke oopar seedha utha kar pakar sakte hain. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalein aur aahista aahista kandhon ko farsh se uthana shuru karein. Kandhe farsh se lagbhag 4 inch oopar uthne chahiyein jabke kamar ka nichla hissa farsh par rahe.
Harkat ke oopar abs ko sukerein aur zara ruk jayein.
Phir saans andar lein aur aahista aahista wapas shuruati position mein neeche aa jayein.

Weighted Jump Squat.instructions_ur:
Halke wazan wala barbell kandhon ke peeche rakhein. Is exercise ke liye aap weighted vest, sandbag, ya kisi aur qism ki resistance bhi istemal kar sakte hain.
Wazan itna halka hona chahiye ke aap ki raftaar zyada dheemi na ho. Paon kandhon ki chaurai se thode bahar hon aur sar aur seena upar hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Countermovement ke saath thoda squat karke neeche jayein aur foran simt badal kar zameen se zor se uchhlein, kulhe, ghutne aur takhne seedhe karein. Poore jump mein achha posture barqarar rakhein.
Zameen par wapas aate hue taangon se jhatka jazb karein.

Weighted Pull Ups.instructions_ur:
Dip belt ke saath weight lagayein aur usay kamar ke gird mazbooti se bandhein. Pull-up bar ko hatheliyan aage ki taraf rakh kar pakrein. Medium grip ke liye haath kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon. Dono baazu aap ke saamne seedhe hon aur chuni hui grip se bar pakre hon.
Dhad ko taqreeban 30 degree peeche le jayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein kham banayein aur seena bahar nikaalein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ab saans bahar nikaalein aur dhad ko upar kheenchein jab tak sar haathon se upar na aa jaye. Upar sukeri hui position tak pohanchte hue shoulder blades ko peeche aur neeche sukerne par dhyan dein.
Upar sukeri hui position mein thora ruk kar, saans andar lein aur aahista aahista dhad ko shuruati position mein neeche layein, baazu seedhe aur lats poori tarah stretch hon.

Weighted Push-ups.instructions_ur:
Setup: Aam plank position mein shuru karein, weight plate upper back par mazbooti se balance ki hui ho.
Alignment: Sar se eriyon tak seedhi line barqarar rakhein, core engage karein taa ke kamar neeche na latke.
Execution: Jism ko neeche layein yahan tak ke seena taqreeban zameen ko chhoo le, kohniyan taqreeban paintalees degree par rakhte hue.
Ascent: Hatheliyon se dabaa kar shuruati position mein wapas aayein, baazu poori tarah seedhe karte hue.

Weighted Sissy Squat.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare hon, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par aur paon ki ungliyan uthi hui, ek haath se squat rack ke beams pakrein aur doosre baazu se seene ke upar plate pakrein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Ek baazu se khud ko sambhalte hue, ghutne morein aur pelvis aur ghutnon ko aage la kar dhad ko aahista aahista zameen ki taraf neeche layein. Neeche jaate hue saans andar lein aur tab rukein jab upper aur lower legs taqreeban 90 degree ka zaawiya bana lein. Stretch position ko ek second rokein.
Ek second rokne ke baad, raan ke muscles se dhad ko wapas shuruati position tak upar layein. Upar aate hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitni dafa tay kiya hai utni dafa dohrayein.

Weighted Sissy Squat with Weight Plate.name_ur: Weighted Sissy Squat Weight Plate ke saath
Weighted Sissy Squat with Weight Plate.instructions_ur:
Is exercise ke naam se dhoka na khayein, yeh ek assisted squat hai jo quadriceps (taangon ke muscles) par asar daar tareeqe se kaam karta hai.
Sahaare ke liye ek haath se weight rack ya bar pakrein aur doosre haath se weight plate seene par pakar kar rakhein.
Pait andar khench kar squat karein, jism ko farsh ki taraf neeche layein jab tak ghutne taqreeban poori tarah mud na jayein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Note: Poori exercise ke dauran paon farsh par mazbooti se jame rakhein.

Weighted Sit-Ups - With Bands.instructions_ur:
Bands ko decline bench ke nichle hisse ke gird bandh kar shuru karein. Handles ko decline bench ke andar ki taraf rakhein taa ke let kar aap dono tak pohanch sakein.
Taangein decline machine mein daal kar fix karein. Ab dono haathon se exercise bands tak pohanchein. Handles ko pronated (hatheliyan saamne) grip se pakrein. Unhein hansli ki haddi ke qareeb rakhein aur kalai ghuma kar neutral grip (hatheliyan dhad ki taraf) mein layein. Note: Poori exercise ke dauran baazu saakit rehne chahiyein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue dhad ko upar layein yahan tak ke upper body zameen ke seedhi khari (perpendicular) ho. Ek second sukerein rakhein aur saans andar lete hue upper body ko wapas shuruati position tak neeche layein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Weighted Squat.instructions_ur:
Do flat benches ko kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar shuru karein. Un ke upar khare hon aur weighted belt ko kamar ke gird lapetein, utne weight ke saath jitna aap ke liye aaramdeh ho. Yaqeeni banayein ke paon ki ungliyan bahar ki taraf hon.
Jab aap seedhe khare hon aur weight taangon ke beech latak raha ho, baazuon ko jism ke side mein poore seedhe rakhein. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Sar upar aur posture seedha rakhte hue ghutne mor kar shuru karein. Tab tak neeche jayein jab tak upper leg aur pindliyon ke darmiyan zaawiya 90 degree se thora kam na ho jaye (yaani woh point jahan upper legs zameen ke mutawazi se neeche hon). Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein. Tip: Agar exercise sahi ki gayi hai to ghutnon ka agla hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banayega jo saamne ki taraf amudi ho. Agar ghutne us khayali line se aage hain (yaani paon ki ungliyon se aage) to aap ghutne par ghair zaroori dabao daal rahe hain aur exercise ghalat ki gayi hai.
Zyada tar paon ke agle hisse (ball) se flat bench ki satah ko dabaate hue aur taangein dobara seedhi karte hue jism ko wapas upar le jayein aur shuruati position mein aa jayein. Exercise ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Wide Grip Chin Up.instructions_ur:
Chin up bar ko kandhon ke faasle se thori chauri grip se pakrein.
Jism seedha rakhte hue khud ko oopar aur bar ki ek side ki taraf khenchein.
Jism ko wapas shuruati position mein neeche layein.
Ab khud ko bar ki doosri side ki taraf oopar uthayein.
Dohrayein.

Wide Grip Standing Biceps Curl with Barb.name_ur: Chauri grip Khare ho kar Biceps Curl Barbell ke saath
Wide Grip Standing Biceps Curl with Barb.instructions_ur:
Yeh biceps curl ka chauri grip wala version hai. Chauri grip muscle ke bahar wale (lateral) hisse par zyada kaam karti hai.
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hon aur pait andar khencha ho.
Barbell ko hatheliyan oopar rakh kar jitna aaram se ho sake utna chaura pakrein.
Baazu raanon ke saath poori tarah seedhe karein.
Kohniyan sakit rakhte hue bar ko seene ki taraf uthayein jab tak forearms seene ko na chhoo lein.
Thori der rokein aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Note: Agar jism jhoolne se rokne mein mushkil ho to deewar ya khambe se tek laga lein.

Wide Stance Barbell Squat.instructions_ur:
Hifazat ke liye yeh exercise squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai. Shuru karne ke liye bar ko rack par apne qad ke mutabiq oonchai par rakhein. Sahi oonchai chun kar bar par weight load karne ke baad bar ke neeche aayein aur kandhon ka peechla hissa (gardan se thora neeche) bar ke neeche rakhein.
Dono haathon se bar ko dono taraf se pakrein aur pehle taangon se dhakel kar aur saath hi dhad ko seedha karte hue bar ko rack se utha lein.
Rack se peeche hatein aur taangein kandhon ke faasle se zyada chauri stance mein rakhein, paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf hon. Sar hamesha oopar rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigar sakta hai, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Sar oopar aur posture seedha rakhte hue ghutne mod kar aahista aahista bar ko neeche lana shuru karein. Tab tak neeche jayein jab tak raan aur calves ke darmiyan angle 90-degrees se thora kam na ho jaye (yani raanein farsh ke parallel se neeche hon). Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein. Tip: Agar exercise sahi ki gayi hai to ghutnon ka saamne wala hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banayega jo saamne ki taraf perpendicular ho. Agar ghutne us khayali line se aage hain (paon ki ungliyon se aage) to ghutnon par ghair zaroori dabao par raha hai aur exercise ghalat tareeqe se ki gayi hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue paon ki aedi se farsh ko dhakel kar aur taangein dobara seedhi karte hue bar ko oopar uthayein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Wide Stance Stiff Legs.instructions_ur:
Zameen par wazan lage barbell se shuru karein. Chauri stance banayein, aur phir bar pakarne ke liye kulhon se jhukein. Kulhe jitna ho sake peeche hon, aur taangein taqreeban seedhi hon. Kamar seedhi, aur sar aur seena upar rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Kulhon ko istemal karte hue unhein aage dhakel kar harkat shuru karein aur baazuon ko seedha latakne dein. Seedhe khare hone tak jari rakhein, aur phir aahista aahista wazan ko shuruati position mein wapas layein. Lagataar reps ke liye wazan ka zameen ko chhoona zaroori nahi.

Wide-Grip Barbell Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Flat bench par let jayein aur paon farsh par mazbooti se jama lein. Chauri pronated (hatheliyan aage) grip, jo har haath ke liye kandhon ke faasle se taqreeban 3 inch bahar ho, ke saath bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu lock kar ke apne oopar seedha thamein. Bar dhad aur farsh ke perpendicular hogi. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aayein jab tak bar seene ke darmiyani hisse par mehsoos na ho.
Ek second ruk kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ke muscles se bar ko dhakel kar shuruati position mein wapas layein. Sukri hui position mein baazu lock karein aur seene ko dabayein, ek second rokein aur phir aahista aahista dobara neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein oopar jaane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Bench Press.name_ur: Chauri grip Decline Barbell Bench Press
Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Bench Press.instructions_ur:
Decline bench par let jayein aur paon bench ke saamne wale hisse mein mazbooti se phansa lein. Chauri pronated (hatheliyan aage) grip, jo har haath ke liye kandhon ke faasle se taqreeban 3 inch bahar ho, ke saath bar ko rack se uthayein aur baazu lock kar ke apne oopar seedha thamein. Bar dhad aur farsh ke perpendicular hogi. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista neeche aayein jab tak bar seene ke nichle hisse par mehsoos na ho.
Ek second ruk kar, saans bahar nikaalte hue seene ke muscles se bar ko dhakel kar shuruati position mein wapas layein. Sukri hui position mein baazu lock karein aur seene ko dabayein, ek second rokein aur phir aahista aahista dobara neeche aana shuru karein. Tip: Neeche aane mein oopar jaane se kam az kam do guna waqt lagna chahiye.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.

Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Pullover.instructions_ur:
Decline bench par let jayein aur dono taangein mazbooti se phansa lein. Pronated grip (hatheliyan bahar ki taraf) se sar ke peeche rakhi barbell pakrein. Is exercise mein barbell ko kandhon ke faasle se chaura pakrna zaroori hai. Baazuon ki madad se aahista aahista barbell ko farsh se oopar uthayein.
Sahi position mein baazu poori tarah seedhe aur farsh ke perpendicular honge. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Barbell ko aadhe daire ki shakal mein wapas neeche le jana shuru karein jaise ise farsh par rakhne lage hon, lekin baazu farsh ke parallel hote hi ruk jayein. Tip: Baazu hamesha poori tarah seedhe rakhein. Harkat sirf kandhe ke jod par honi chahiye. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein.
Ab saans bahar nikaalte hue barbell ko oopar layein jab tak shuruati position mein wapas na aa jayein. Barbell par hamesha poora control rakhna yaad rakhein.
Apne training program ke mutabiq jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa harkat dohrayein.
Set khatam hone par barbell ko aahista aahista neeche layein jab tak yeh sar ke barabar na aa jaye aur phir chhor dein.

Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown.instructions_ur:
Pull-down machine par baith jayein jis ki upar wali pulley par chauri bar lagi ho. Machine ka knee pad apne qad ke mutabiq set karna zaroori hai. Yeh pads bar par lage resistance se aap ke jism ko upar uthne se rokte hain.
Tay ki gayi grip ke saath, hatheliyan saamne ki taraf rakh kar bar pakrein. Grips par note: Chauri grip ke liye haathon ka faasla kandhon ki chaurai se zyada hona chahiye. Medium grip ke liye haathon ka faasla kandhon ki chaurai ke barabar hona chahiye aur tang grip ke liye kandhon ki chaurai se kam.
Jab dono baazu aap ke saamne seedhe hon aur bar chuni hui grip chaurai par pakri ho, dhad ko taqreeban 30 degrees peeche le jayein, kamar ke nichle hisse mein kham banayein aur seena bahar nikaalein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue, kandhon aur baazu ke upar wale hisson ko neeche aur peeche kheench kar bar ko neeche layein jab tak woh seene ke upar wale hisse ko na chhoo le. Tip: Poori tarah sukerne ki position par pahunch kar kamar ke muscles ko sukerne par dhyan dein. Dhad ka upar wala hissa saakit rahe aur sirf baazu hilein. Forearms ka kaam sirf bar pakarna hai; is liye forearms se bar ko neeche kheenchne ki koshish na karein.
Sukri hui position mein ek second ke baad, kandhe ki haddiyon (shoulder blades) ko aapas mein sukerte hue, aahista aahista bar ko wapas shuruati position tak upar le jayein jab baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur lats poori tarah stretch hon. Harkat ke is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa yeh harkat dohrayein.

Wide-Grip Pulldown Behind The Neck.name_ur: Gardan ke peeche Chauri grip Pulldown
Wide-Grip Pulldown Behind The Neck.instructions_ur:
Pull-down machine par baith jayein jis ke upar wali pulley par chauri bar lagi ho. Machine ka knee pad apne qad ke mutabiq set karna yaqeeni banayein. Yeh pads bar par lage wazan se aap ke jism ko upar uthne se rokenge.
Tay ki hui grip ke saath bar ko hatheliyan saamne ki taraf kar ke pakrein. Grips ke baare mein note: Chauri grip ke liye haathon ka faasla kandhon se zyada hona chahiye. Medium grip ke liye haathon ka faasla kandhon ke barabar, aur tang grip ke liye kandhon se kam hona chahiye.
Dono baazu saamne phaile hue aur bar chuni hui grip par pakre hue, dhad aur sar ko aage layein. Bar ke beech se gardan ke peeche tak ek khayali line ka tasawwur karein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue kandhon aur upper arms ko neeche aur peeche laate hue bar ko neeche layein yahan tak ke woh gardan ke peeche chhoo le. Tip: Poori tarah sukerne wali position par pohanch kar kamar ke muscles ko sukerne par dhyan dein. Upper dhad saakit rehna chahiye aur sirf baazu hilne chahiyein. Forearms ka kaam sirf bar pakarna hai; is liye forearms se bar ko neeche kheenchne ki koshish na karein.
Shoulder blades aapas mein sukerte hue ek second sukerne wali position mein rehne ke baad, aahista aahista bar ko wapas shuruati position tak uthayein jab baazu poori tarah seedhe aur lats poori tarah stretch hon. Is hisse mein saans andar lein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa yeh harkat dohrayein.

Wide-Grip Rear Pull-Up.instructions_ur:
Pull-up bar ko chauri grip se pakrein, hatheliyan aage ki taraf hon.
Dono baazu saamne seedhe hon aur bar pakri ho, dhad aur sar ko aage layein taake pull-up bar se gardan ke peeche tak ek khayali line ban jaye. Yeh aapki shuruati position hai.
Dhad ko upar uthayein jab tak bar gardan ke peeche ke qareeb na aa jaye. Iske liye kandhon aur upar ke baazuon ko neeche aur peeche kheenchein aur sar ko thora aage jhukayein. Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans bahar nikaalein. Tip: Poori contracted position par pohanch kar kamar ke muscles ko sukerne par dhyan dein. Upar wala dhad harkat ke dauran saakit rehna chahiye aur sirf baazu hilne chahiyein. Forearms ka kaam sirf bar pakarna hai, aur kuch nahi.
Contracted position par ek second ke baad saans andar lena shuru karein aur aahista aahista dhad ko shuruati position mein neeche layein jab baazu poori tarah seedhe hon aur lats poori tarah stretch hon.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa yeh harkat dohrayein.

Wide-Grip Standing Barbell Curl.name_ur: Chauri grip Khare ho kar Barbell Curl
Wide-Grip Standing Barbell Curl.instructions_ur:
Dhad seedha rakh kar khare ho jayein aur barbell ko bahar wale chaure handle se pakrein. Hatheliyan saamne ki taraf hon. Kohniyan dhad ke qareeb hon. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Baazu ke upar wale hisse ko saakit rakhte hue, saans bahar nikaalte hue aur biceps ko sukerte hue weight ko aage curl karein. Tip: Sirf forearms hilne chahiyein.
Harkat jaari rakhein jab tak biceps poori tarah sukar na jayein aur bar kandhon ki oonchai tak na aa jaye. Sukri hui position ek second rokein aur biceps ko zor se sukerein.
Saans andar lete hue aahista aahista bar ko wapas shuruati position mein lana shuru karein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Wind Sprints.instructions_ur:
Pull-up bar se pronated grip ke saath latak jayein. Baazu aur taangein seedhi honi chahiye. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ek ghutne ko tezi se jitna ooncha ho sake utha kar shuru karein. Jism ya taangon ko mat jhulayein.
Foran harkat ulti karein, us taang ko wapas shuruati position mein layein. Saath hi doosre ghutne ko jitna ooncha ho sake uthayein.
Set mukammal hone tak taangein baari baari badalte rahein.

Windmills.instructions_ur:
Kamar ke bal let jayein, baazu side mein phaile hue aur taangein seedhi. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi.
Ek taang uthayein aur tezi se usay jism ke upar se doosri taraf le jayein, aur doosre haath ke qareeb zameen ko chhoone ki koshish karein.
Shuruati position mein wapas aayein, aur doosri taang ke saath dohrayein. 10-20 reps tak baari baari karte rahein.

World's Greatest Stretch.instructions_ur: Baghair equipment ke tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Wrist Circles.instructions_ur:
Seedhe khare ho kar shuru karein, paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par. Baazuon ko side mein uthayein jab tak woh poore seedhe aur zameen ke mutawazi na ho jayein, kandhon ki barabar unchai par. Tip: Dhad aur baazu angrezi harf 'T' ki shakal banayein. Hatheliyan neeche ki taraf hon. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Kalaiyon ke ilawa poore jism ko saakit rakhte hue, dono kalaiyon ko aage ki taraf gol daire mein ghumana shuru karein. Tip: Tasawwur karein ke aap haathon ko brush bana kar daire bana rahe hain. Yeh exercise karte hue aam tor par saans lete rahein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Wrist Curl.instructions_ur: dumbbell ke saath tayyar ho jayein, control ke saath sahi form mein harkat karein, aur wapas shuruati position mein aa jayein.

Wrist Rocks.instructions_ur: Haathon aur ghutnon ke bal shuru karein, hatheliyan farsh par seedhi. Haath jamaye rakhte hue aahista aahista aage aur peeche jhoolein. Mobility aur lachak ko narmi se behtar karne ke liye sirf aaramdeh, dard ke baghair kalai ki range mein harkat karein.

Wrist Roller.instructions_ur:
Shuru karne ke liye seedhe khare ho kar wrist roller ko pronated grip (hatheliyan neeche ki taraf) se pakrein. Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par hon.
Aahista aahista dono baazu uthayein yahan tak ke woh poori tarah seedhe aur saamne zameen ke parallel hon. Note: Yaqeeni banayein ke rope roller par lipti hui na ho. Forearms ke ilawa poora jism saakit rehna chahiye. Yeh shuruati position hai.
Ek waqt mein ek kalai ko upar ki taraf ghumayein aur rope ko roller par lapet kar wazan ko bar tak upar layein.
Jab wazan bar tak pohanch jaye to kalai ko neeche ki taraf ghuma kar aahista aahista wazan ko wapas neeche laana shuru karein yahan tak ke woh shuruati position tak pohanch jaye.
Apne program mein tay kiye hue reps jitni dafa dohrayein.

Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar.name_ur: Straight Bar ke saath Wrist Rotations
Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar.instructions_ur:
Barbell dono haathon se pakrein, hatheliyan neeche ki taraf; haathon ka faasla taqreeban kandhon ke barabar. Yeh aapki shuruati position hogi.
Har haath ko baari baari istemal karte hue, kalai ko aise seedha karein jaise akhbaar lapet rahe hon. Failure tak baari baari aage peeche karte rahein.
Kalai mod kar harkat ulti karein, mukhalif simt mein lapetein. Failure tak baari baari harkat jaari rakhein.

Yoke Walk.instructions_ur:
Yoke aam tor par yoke apparatus ke saath kiya jata hai, lekin kabhi kabhi fridge ya doosri bhaari cheezon ke saath bhi dekha jata hai.
Apparatus ko kandhon ke pichle hisse par rack kar ke shuru karein. Sar aage dekhte hue aur kamar arched rakhte hue, ediyon se zor laga kar yoke uthayein.
Chhote, tez qadmon ke saath jitni tezi se ho sake chalna shuru karein. Yoke ko sambhalne aur position mein rakhne ke liye aap us ke side posts pakar sakte hain. Tay shuda faasle tak jitni tezi se ho sake jaari rakhein, aam tor par 75-100 feet.

Zecher Squats.instructions_ur:
Squat ka yeh tareeqa Front Squat jaisa hai, yeh quadriceps (raanon) ke oopri muscles banane mein kaam karta hai.
Weight rack se barbell utha kar seene par rakhein. Barbell ko baazu cross kar ke pakrein.
Paon kandhon ke faasle se thore chaure rakhein, ghutne aur paon ki ungliyan halki si bahar ki taraf hon.
Pait andar khench kar ghutnon aur kulhon se mud kar aahista aahista neeche aayein jaise baith rahe hon (squat).
Jitna control se ho sake utna neeche jayein, jism ko paon ki ungliyon ki taraf khiskne na dein (is se balance bigar jayega).
Neeche wali position mein ruk kar aahista aahista seedhe ho kar shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Note: Harkaton ki aadat dalne ke liye pehle baghair weight ke squat ki practice karein.

Zercher Squats.instructions_ur:
Hifazat ke liye yeh exercise squat rack ke andar karna behtar hai. Shuru karne ke liye pehle bar ko rack par aisi oonchai par set karein jo aap ke qad ke mutabiq ho. Sahi oonchai kamar se upar magar seene se neeche kahin bhi ho sakti hai. Sahi oonchai chunne aur bar par wazan lagane ke baad haathon ko aapas mein jor lein aur bar ko forearm aur upper arm ke darmiyan baazuon ke upar rakhein.
Bar ko upar uthayein taake woh forearms ke upar tika ho. Agar bar sahi tarah pakra hai to aisa lagega jaise aap ne baazu cross kiye hon magar un ke upar se bar guzar raha ho.
Rack se peeche hatein aur paon kandhon ke barabar medium stance mein rakhein, paon ki ungliyan thori bahar ki taraf hon. Sar har waqt upar rakhein kyunke neeche dekhne se balance bigar jayega, aur kamar seedhi rakhein. Yeh aap ki shuruati position hogi. (Note: Is bayan ke liye hum upar batayi gayi medium stance istemal karenge jo majmooi development ko target karti hai; lekin aap foot stances wale hisse mein batayi gayi teeno stances mein se koi bhi chun sakte hain).
Sar upar rakh kar seedha posture barqarar rakhte hue ghutne mor kar bar neeche lana shuru karein. Neeche jate rahein yahan tak ke raan aur pindli ke darmiyan angle 90 degree se thora kam ho jaye (yaani woh point jahan raanein zameen ke parallel se neeche hon). Harkat ka yeh hissa karte hue saans andar lein. Tip: Agar aap ne exercise sahi ki hai to ghutnon ka agla hissa paon ki ungliyon ke saath ek khayali seedhi line banayega jo saamne ki taraf perpendicular hogi. Agar ghutne us khayali line se aage hain (yaani paon ki ungliyon se aage) to aap ghutne par ghair zaroori dabao daal rahe hain aur exercise ghalat ki gayi hai.
Saans bahar nikaalte hue zyada tar paon ke agle hisse se zameen ko dhakel kar bar uthana shuru karein, taangein dobara seedhi karein aur shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.
Jitne reps tay kiye hain utni dafa dohrayein.

Zottman Curl.instructions_ur:
Paon kandhon ke barabar faasle par rakh kar khare hon, ghutne halke se mude hon aur pait andar khencha ho.
Har haath mein ek dumbbell pakrein, hatheliyan aamne saamne hon.
Haath side par rakh kar shuru karein.
Baazuon ko oopar curl karein aur jab dumbbells seene tak pohanchein to kalaiyan ghuma kar hatheliyan neeche ki taraf kar dein.
Thori der rokein aur phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein.

Zottman Preacher Curl.instructions_ur:
Preacher Curl Bench par baith jayein.
Haath mein dumbbell pakrein, hatheli oopar ki taraf ho.
Baazu ko bench ke saath poori tarah seedha karein.
Baazu ko oopar curl karein aur jab dumbbell seene tak pohanche to kalai ghuma kar hatheli neeche ki taraf kar dein.
Thori der rokein, phir shuruati position mein wapas aa jayein aur baazu badal lein.
